programme.title: Koh-Lanta (Survivor)
programme.desc: The iconic competitors of the game take the direction of Panama, on a tiny island bathed in the waters of the Pacific: Camille, Charlotte, Christina, Clementine, Freddy, Dorian, Jacques, Joana, Laure, Lola, Maxime, Moussa, Naoil, Nicolas, Tania, Ugo, Vincent and Yassin. These experienced adventurers and adventurers will compete in a totally unpredictable season.
programme.desc-more: This show brings together a group of adventurers on an isolated island. They must live independently in conditions close to nature, without access to modern amenities. The main objective is to survive the elements, find food, water and build a shelter. However, candidates are also subjected to physical and mental tests. 24 adventurers left their daily lives to try to win the most famous TV survival games. Among them, two former winners, Frédéric and Ugo, who will use their experience to help the two new red and yellow tribes. At the end of the very first event of this edition, which they lost, Vanessa, Melissa, Illyesse and Nathanaël were taken to a hostile island to form the cursed tribe, doomed to a sad fate, unless they discover a protective statuette. Whoever finds her can regain her place in the game by facing one of the members of the yellows and reds, eliminated during the comfort test.

programme.title: New York Judicial Police
programme.sub-title: Between the hammer and the anvil
programme.desc: To resolve the murder of an elected woman's daughter, a fashion designer or a crisis management consultant, New York police inspectors investigate the field and gather evidence that criminalizes the suspects. They work in conjunction with the Manhattan Attorney's Office assistants who prepare the indictments that will be presented to the court. After Anthony Anderson left, Mehcad Brooks, seen in "Desperate Housewives", joined the casting in the role of Inspector Jalen Shaw.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of Manhattan, where skyscrapers hide as many dreams as nightmares, an elite criminal police unit is fighting relentlessly against one of the darkest scourges in society: sexual crimes. Under the inflexible but caring leadership of Captain Don Cragen (Dann Florek), this specialized team combines professional rigour and human commitment, placing victim protection at the centre of every investigation. In a world where violence leaves invisible traces, these police officers must not only track down the perpetrators, but also restore the dignity of those who have been broken. Among them, Inspectors Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) and Elliot Stabler (Christopher Meloni) form an emblematic duo, united by unwavering determination and empathy that pushes them to invest far beyond the files. Benson, whose personal past has created a strong sensitivity to the suffering of victims, especially women and children, embodies a calm force in the face of horror. Stabler, a passionate family member, brings combative energy, sometimes at the limit of obsession, to bring justice to the fore. Together, they navigate through the meandering of the most icy cases, where every detail counts and where each testimony can cause an investigation to tip over. Over time, the unit evolves with the arrival of new members. Each case confronts them with a heartbreaking reality: broken lives, silences that are complicit, and systems that too often fail to protect the most vulnerable. Between the interview rooms where tight parts are played, the streets of New York where every shadow can conceal a danger, and the personal lives of these policemen – marked by the emotional repercussions of their profession – the series explores without fail the complexities of justice and redemption. Here, victories are measured as much as the convictions obtained as the lives saved, and each episode reminds that behind the statistics are destinies hidden. In this constant struggle, one question persists: how far are these men and women ready to go so that light prevails over darkness?

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: After the tragic murder of a girl, Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) is at the head of a complex investigation that leads her to team up with Frank Cosgrove (Ice-T) and Jalen Shaw (Octavio Pizano), both members of the judicial police. Together, they are engaged in an investigation that plunges them into the depths of a large criminal network, while Eliott Stabler (Christopher Meloni), Benson's former partner and expert in organized crime, brings his experience to unravel this sinuous affair. Throughout the season, the team is confronted with a series of disturbing cases, including an international criminal operation that tests their limits. Season 24 begins with a captivating crossover bringing together the universes of "New York, Special Unit", "New York, Criminal Police" and "New York, Organized Crime", promising fans an immersion in thrilling intrigues and unexpected twists.
programme.desc-more: In the hectic New York City, the Special Police Unit is dedicated to the fight against sexual crimes and cases involving vulnerable victims, orchestrated by the determined detective Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay). Each episode plunges investigators into often sordid and complex situations where the discovery of a revolting crime requires their sensitivity and professionalism. The members of this unit, composed of experienced detectives, are engaged in thorough investigations, gathering evidence and interviewing suspects with the aim of bringing the culprits to justice. Cases, including rape, abuse of minors and sexual trafficking, are not only sensitive but also emotionally stressful. The Special Unit would not only act as investigators, but also as support for victims, highlighting their trauma and the challenges they face in rebuilding themselves.

But when Elliot's daughter, Maureen, a teenage girl, herself witness a terrible murder, her father feels for the first time completely disembodied. Stephanie March has been involved in the distribution since the beginning of this season as the intransigent assistant to prosecutor Alexandra Cabot. Ice-T, however, wears the suit of Inspector Tutuola, who will form an attractive pair with his colleague John Munch for 14 seasons.
programme.desc-more: In the hectic New York City, the Special Police Unit is dedicated to the fight against sexual crimes and cases involving vulnerable victims, orchestrated by the determined detective Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay). Each episode plunges investigators into often sordid and complex situations where the discovery of a revolting crime requires their sensitivity and professionalism. The members of this unit, composed of experienced detectives, are engaged in thorough investigations, gathering evidence and interviewing suspects with the aim of bringing the culprits to justice. Cases, including rape, abuse of minors and sexual trafficking, are not only sensitive but also emotionally stressful. The Special Unit would not only act as investigators, but also as support for victims, highlighting their trauma and the challenges they face in rebuilding themselves.

programme.desc: Lucy is a brilliant lawyer who sacrificed her private life for her career. A few days before Christmas, while she alone celebrates her recent promotion, she meets Matt, her youthful love, whom she had not seen in twenty-five years. Should she obey the rules of travel in time and not touch anything in the past or should she take the risk of radically changing her future?

It all starts with an accident between two boats on the coasts of the city, where two people die, and the appearance of an amnesia woman. Soon, members of the Delcourt, Vallorta and Moreno families found themselves involved in a web of family mysteries and dramas. Doctors, police officers, lawyers and ordinary citizens find themselves trained in a series of extraordinary events, facing challenges both personal and professional.

programme.title: Koh-Lanta (Survivor)

After rare tests and magisterial strategic blows, all marked by a demonstration of survival techniques on the camps, the two finalists were separated by the members of the final jury, composed of adventurers eliminated from reunification. programme.title: Koh-Lanta (Survivor)

programme.desc: Pierre Lescure talks to actress Catherine Frot, whose last film, "Un bon patrone", by Philippe de Chauveron with Didier Bourdon, was released in theatre on November 4. programme.title: Invisible wounds
programme.desc: After a mother disappeared, her best friend investigated and became aware of the violence that the missing woman was victims of in her marriage.
programme.desc-more: Camille (Sarah Suco) is missing. Murder, suicide or run away? The testimonies of her entourage give an contradictory picture of this married woman and mother of two little girls. Camille's journey until her disappearance is replayed before our eyes, at the same time as advance the intimate investigation conducted by her best friend and sister of her husband and the police investigation conducted by Captain Larivière (Lubna Azabal), to find her. This dive into a woman's life describes the effects of psychological manipulation within the couple. An invisible but destructive violence that sometimes leads to the worst.

programme.title: Captives
programme.desc: Late 19th century. Determined to find her mother, a young woman was confined to a Parisian asylum where she was hospitalized.
programme.desc-more: In 1894, Fanni Devander voluntarily entered the hospital of the Salpêtrière. While Dr. Charcot died a few months earlier, the young woman, married and mother of family, entered a facility where women of all ages, often suffering from mental disorders, were confined in very harsh conditions. Welcomed by a supervisor, nicknamed La Douane, who takes some of her property, Fanni meets Marguerite Botard, the nurse in chief, and Flaviane, a resident, to whom she entrusts that she is looking for her mother, who has been incarcerated for many years in a Parisian psychiatric institution.

programme.title: Provencal Colorado: The world of ochres
programme.desc: Visit the spectacular ochre quarries of Rustrel, in the department of Vaucluse, which have earned the region the nickname of "Colorado Provençal".
programme.desc-more: Several million years ago, what was to become Provence was under the sea. The sea retreated behind it from clay-rich sands and from the ocreous and white shores. The landscape of this corner of Provence, enhanced by its quarries, is the result of nature, erosion and the work of men. Without them, the ochre would have remained secret, hidden under vegetation. With Sophie Seigneur, Nicolas Raymond, Richard Mégret, Christophe Allemand, Nicolas Brandel, Gilles Camus.

programme.title: The art of crime
programme.desc: A young woman is found murdered in a photo studio. Antoine and Florence discover that this murder is linked to a masterpiece by Edward Manet.
programme.desc-more: In a photo studio, Emma Wurtz's lifeless body (Eléonore Bernheim), a 25-year-old legal secretary, is discovered, immerse the art world in deep dismay. This mysterious murder is amplified by a selfie erased two hours after her death, where Emma poses alongside an iconic painting by Edward Manet, "At Tortoni", a masterpiece that has been missing for more than thirty years during the famous flight of the Gardner Museum in Boston. Faced with this enigma, Florence (Nicolas Gob), an art lover and experienced investigator, turns to Jean-Louis Marquet (Philippe Duclos), a renowned detective in the field of stolen works, to assist him in this complex affair. However, Marquet's arrival did not please Antoine (Benjamin Egner), who was fighting against his own growing feelings for Florence, fuelling palpable tension between the protagonists. As the investigation progresses, buried secrets threaten to burst, revealing a criminal network in the heart of the art world.

programme.desc-more: On November 3, 1996, 14 men and 2 women took up the challenge of the Vendée Globe by stinging Sables-d-Olonne for the only race around the world in solitary, non-stop, and non-assisted. But soon the third edition of this competition turns into a nightmare when, in the southern seas, a storm of the power of a hurricane takes sailors to the trap. Seven of them will not finish the event, three will end off course, five boats have been shipwrecked and a sailor has never returned. Twenty-five years later, they are still inhabited by this odyssey.

programme.desc: On 9 January 2002, Daniel Legrand Jr., in a letter to France 3, acknowledged the facts and stated that he had witnessed the murder of a Belgian girl at the home of the Delays. programme.desc-more: On 9 January 2002, in a letter addressed to France 3 and to Judge Burgaud, Daniel Legrand Jr. acknowledged the facts and stated that he had witnessed the murder of a Belgian girl at the home of the Delays at the end of 1999. His revelations, which are in fact lies, are a cover-up for the chronicle. But, unlike Myriam Badaoui and one of his sons, Thierry Delay totally denies the facts. Excavations are organized but don't give anything. Only a Belgian RTBF journalist, Georges Huercano-Hidalgo, casts doubts on the investigation of Judge Burgaud.

programme.title: Outreau's case

programme.title: Open-pit detention
programme.desc: Created in 2020, the Baudonne Farm, near Bayonne, is an alternative to detention that accommodates women in detention for the last months of their sentences.
programme.desc-more: Created in Tarnos in 2000 by Gabi Mouesca, a former Basque activist who spent 17 years behind bars, the Emmaus Baudonne Farm is a reception and reintegration place offering an alternation to women detained for the last months of their sentences. In this large building surrounded by forests and fields, Annie, Evelyne and Rosy have their rooms and keys, allowing them to start to learn step by step freedom while discovering a job. For them, this unique structure is a passage between prison and the outside world.

programme.title: Simon Coleman
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 4 of the Simon Coleman series, with Jean-Michel Tinivelli, Flavie Péan, Ted Etienne
programme.desc-more: Simon Coleman (Jean-Michel Tinivelli) is a policeman with a fearless character, a specialist in infiltration missions who does not hesitate to risk his life in the service of justice. Her contagious smile and relaxed attitude to the most perilous situations give her a charismatic and confusing aura. While he inspires confidence in some of his colleagues, others perceive him as an unconscious player in Russian roulette. Simon navigates a world where every choice can have dramatic consequences, skillfully juggling with external threats while keeping a keen sense of humour. As he immerse himself in criminal environments plunged into the meanderings of illegality, he must not only expose criminals, but also face his own demons and the growing pressure of his profession. As the episodes progress, the issues become more intense, forcing Simon to establish complex relationships with his colleagues, his superiors and even potential informants, while the danger is around every corner. In this dangerous game where the line between good and evil becomes blurred, Simon fights to protect the city he loves while wondering about the price to pay for his mission.

programme.title: Audrey's refuge
programme.desc: Audrey, Tommy and Maeva are discovering the veterinary profession with Hector. Audrey's confident, but she realizes Tommy and Maeva are doing better than she does.
programme.desc-more: In a small village animated by nature, Audrey, a 7-year-old girl full of life, is dedicated to the protection and well-being of the animals around her. With a heart overflowing with tenderness and empathy, she interacts with a multitude of species, from loving dogs to singing birds, to wild animals that cross her path. Every day, she strives to prove that harmony between humans and animals is possible, using gentle and respectful methods. Through his adventures, Audrey meets various characters, such as his best friend who helps him in his missions, and a local veterinarian who teaches him the basics of animal care. Together, they overcome challenges, discover moving stories and learn the importance of compassion. By cultivating these values, Audrey inspires its people to change their gaze on wildlife and embrace a more environmentally friendly way of life.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole burys her health book in the garden to avoid the vaccine in school, but Princess brings him back. He must hide it without being vaccinated.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: The traveller
programme.desc: Yann Kandinsky is contacted by an unknown person about three disappearances. He investigates in Brittany, alerted by the hunger strike of one of the victims' mothers.
programme.desc-more: In search of deep loneliness in a remote Allier forest, investigator Kandinsky sees his peace disturbed by insistent anonymous messages. The latter establish a disturbing link between three unexplained female disappearances in the Brest region. The desperate action of Madeleine Guyot, the mother of a victim on hunger strike, finally convinced him to intervene. He established his headquarters at home and actively joined the relatives of the missing to dig up the buried secrets mysteriously linking these women.

programme.desc-more: This week, Julie immerse herself in the captivating universe of aquaponia alongside François, a passionate gardener-fisherman, who merges her two loves into a singular vegetable garden. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: A Frenchman named Gabin
programme.desc: Jean Gabin was the most emblematic actor of French cinema of the 20th century because of his personal journey and his roles on the big screen.
programme.desc-more: Jean Gabin remains the most emblematic French actor of the last century. From the Third to the Fifth Republic, the Popular Front at the end of the Thirty Glories, the artist has embodied in cinema France of cities and fields, that of factories and cafes, ports and suburbs, through a comprehensive and varied filmography, rich in masterpieces such as "La Bête humaine", "Le Quai des mismes", "La Grande Illusion", "La Traversée de Paris" or "Un ape en hiver". Between 1935 and 1940, Gabin was featured in twelve films, ten of which became classics of French cinema, under the leadership of Jean Grémillon, Marcel Carné, Jean Renoir and Julien Duvivier. This documentary outlines a portrait of the actor and man, Jean Alexis Moncorgé.

programme.title: Flight, three voices from overseas
programme.desc: Cross portraits of Axelle Saint-Cirel, Livia Louis-Joseph Dogué and Luan Pommier, three lyrical singers from Outre-mer in the midst of the ascent.
programme.desc-more: The ascent of three lyrical singers - Axelle Saint-Cirel, Luan Pommier and Livia Louis-Joseph Dogué - reveals three singular trajectories which, each in its own way, push the codes and open the doors of the opera. Mezzo-soprano with a deep stamp, Axelle Saint-Cirel, winner of the fifth edition of the Voice of the Overseas 2023 contest, bears in her the legacy of Guadeloupe. Lyric singer, pianist and composer, Luan Pommier, prize at the 2020 Voix des Outre-Mer competition, is moving on a path where virtuosity and sensitivity meet. Winner of the 2019 Young Talent Award from the Voice of the Overseas Competition, the Martiniquia soprano Livia Louis-Joseph Dogué is a rising figure of her generation.

programme.title: Rescuers at Sea: Call and Sacrifice
programme.desc: On the night of August 7, 1986, five rescuers died trying to rescue a pleasure boat. This tragedy makes the French aware of the dangers of their profession.
programme.desc-more: On the night of August 7, 1986, five volunteer rescuers from the Aber Wrac'h SNSM station were on their way to rescue a pleasure craft in distress near Bec Island. The operation turned into a disaster when their canoe broke into the Kerguen rocks, leaving no survivors among the crew. This tragedy reveals the daily perils of marine rescue and constitutes an electroshock. The surrounding emoi causes the change of the organization of rescue at sea, allowing the improvement of equipment, professionalisation and the establishment of protections for rescuers.

Passionate about Indian cuisine, she makes her discover the flavors of her universe, between her perfumed cuisine and the visit of the saffron exploitation of her friend Stéphane. On the menu: a dal of coral lentils scented with red onions, grated tomatoes and spices (mustard seeds, turmeric, curry leaves, pepper, pepper, kasuri methi and asafoetida), accompanied by basmati rice saffron, a vegetable sambar and a potimarron purée sprinkled with blueberries. A tasty episode, where Brittany and India agree in a mixture of gestures, fragrances and colours.

programme.title: Operation Hao
programme.desc: Two young people in formation in Hao's adapted military service regiment embody the question of Polynesian youth in the face of the choice of leaving or staying.
programme.desc-more: Emmanuelle and Tehau, two young Polynesians from the Tuamotu, are engaged in a one-year training within the regiment of adapted military service recently installed on the Hao atoll. Emmanuelle, from the island, and Tehau, from a neighbouring atoll, learn about tropical agriculture and restoration, with the hope of getting a job and, perhaps, discovering a military vocation. Their journey takes place on an island marked by history: former rear base of the army during the nuclear tests, prosperous and then deserted at its stop, Hao is now seeking to retain his youth.

programme.title: Tandem
programme.desc: ‘Dissonance A virtuoso violinist of the Montpellier orchestra is murdered and his instrument replaced by a copy. Is the murderer a musician too?
programme.desc-more: In the middle of a general rehearsal at the Opéra de Montpellier, François Durieux was discovered dead. He was killed by a luteur's gun. The first violin of the Philharmonic Orchestra was a young man known for his talent but very lonely who gave the impression of living only for his passion: music. He owned a prestigious 18th-century violin. His love of music was nourished by his mother and Pascal, his luthier and mentor. The investigation began with François's second violin rival.

programme.title: Vera's investigations
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 14 in the series Les enquêtes de Vera
programme.desc-more: In the wild moors of Northumberland, swept by icy winds and bathed in raw light, crimes never remain buried for long. It is here that Vera Stanhope (Brenda Blethyn), chief inspector with a rough temperament as the surrounding landscapes, conducts her investigations with a relentless intuition and caustic humour that destabilizes her colleagues as well as the suspects. Dressed in her eternal worn coat, with a headband in shape, she embodies a force of nature, indifferent to conventions, obsessed with one thing: the truth. With him, Joe Ashworth (David Leon), his dedicated assistant, acts as a spiritual son – a delicate balance between his ideal youth and the experienced cynicism of his mentor. Everything changes when a 15-year-old, Luke Armstrong, is found dead in his bathtub, his face frozen in an expression of terror, strangled by a lace. But what should look like an ordinary family drama turns into a macabre riddle: the assassin has laid fresh flowers on the surface of the water, such as a funeral offer or a sinister signature. For Vera, this too much theatrical detail feels the calculation. Who could have done such a cold and methodical act? A relative? A stranger? Or worse, someone who's just getting started? As the investigation sinks into the unfavorable secrets of the small community, Vera and Joe discover that Luke, apparently a high school student without history, hid troubled bonds – family lies, school tensions, perhaps even dangerous relationships. Each testimony raises new questions, each alibi cracks. Then a second murder occurs, even more meticulously staged. The doubt is no longer allowed: a serial killer is walking around the county, and his ritual seems to obey a logic that only a twisted mind could understand. Between the heavy silences of suspects, the unsaid of a region where everyone knows each other and the false-likes of well-organized respectability, Vera must unravel the skewer of a case where nothing seems to be the same. But the more it digs, the closer the danger gets. Because this killer isn't just hitting – He watches, he anticipates, and he likes to play with those who track him. How far will Vera have to go to get rid of her game before a new victim falls? And what does this series of murders reveal about the buried demons in this lost corner of England, where appearances are often the best of camouflages?

programme.title: A Frenchman named Gabin
programme.desc: Jean Gabin remains the most emblematic French actor of the last century. From the Third to the Fifth Republic, the Popular Front at the end of the Thirty Glories, the artist has embodied in cinema France of cities and fields, that of factories and cafes, ports and suburbs, through a comprehensive and varied filmography, rich in masterpieces such as "La Bête humaine", "Le Quai des mismes", "La Grande Illusion", "La Traversée de Paris" or "Un ape en hiver". Between 1935 and 1940, Gabin was featured in twelve films, ten of which became classics of French cinema, under the leadership of Jean Grémillon, Marcel Carné, Jean Renoir and Julien Duvivier. This documentary outlines a portrait of the actor and man, Jean Alexis Moncorgé.

programme.title: Jade's armor
programme.desc: Injured, Lan Jun must rest. But the teenager disobeys to date Kai. At the same time, La Tigresse finds an Eclat who makes her invulnerable.
programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, a young woman apparently ordinary, finds herself confronted with an extraordinary destiny. A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Flash, the champion of the levier race, disappears in incomprehensible circumstances from his ultra-secure box, the day before an important race.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with an exceptional sense of observation, and his brother Bro, impulsive and intrepid, are an unlikely duo of investigators. Together, they embark on exciting investigations that challenge even Scotland Yard's expertise. Each episode plunges them into mysterious and complex cases, ranging from unexplained disappearances to bold thefts, where their animal instincts and intelligence lead them to surprising deductions. Clever, with his sharp mind, uses his analytical skills to decorate the clues, while Bro brings a touch of bravery, not hesitant to plunge into action. Their complicity and unique dynamics allow them to confront formidable criminals and solve puzzles that human detectives have not been able to solve for years. In this adventure, the two brothers also discover buried secrets and unexpected truths, while strengthening their brotherly bond.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole doesn't want to get her hair cut by Naomi's mom because of Samson's story. He's looking for ideas to avoid scissors.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile, a young adventurer with a lot of imagination, finds himself facing a capillary dilemma that puts his ingenuity to the test. While he is supposed to go to Naomi's mother for a haircut, Anatole fears to live the same fate as Samson, whose legendary strength was tied to her hair. To avoid scissors, he embarked on a series of creative and farfelus schemes, seeking to escape this dreaded chore. His attempts, ranging from clever disguises to hilarious excuses, lead Anatole into a series of unexpected misadventures. Accompanied by his friends, he explores increasingly inventive solutions, but each plan seems to be facing unforeseen circumstances. Between laughter and twists, Anatole will learn that sometimes it is better to face her fears rather than trying to flee them, while discovering the true sense of friendship and self-acceptance.

programme.desc: Belfort and Lupin are helping the moles Arlette, Georgette and Colette who have dug galleries under the new French-style floor that must be presented to the King.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of the 17th century, the sumptuous Palace of Versailles became the scene of unexpected adventures thanks to an extraordinary duo: Belfort, the faithful dog of Louis XIV, and Lupin, a bold wolf with a well-drained character. Between court intrigues and unexpected dangers, Belfort and Lupin embody loyalty and the spirit of adventure, making the hearts of the spectators vibrate at the rhythm of their epic exploits in a Versailles filled with magic and mystery.

programme.desc-more: Under the curse of the ghost of the fearsome witch Morgan Le Fey, Scooby-Doo and his band are propelled into the legendary era of King Arthur, where the kingdom of Camelot is in trouble. King Arthur (the actor's voice) is himself threatened by Morgan's machinations, which seek to extend his power. In an unexpected moment, Sammy (the actor's voice), trying to use a piece of cheese, managed to extract Excalibur from the stone, an act that questioned the sovereign's legitimacy. To restore order and prove Arthur's worth, Merlin (the actor's voice) announced that a decisive tournament would determine the true heir to the throne. The Scooby-Doo band, armed with courage and spirit, is committed to participating in the tournament, while seeking to break the curse that is weighing on the kingdom. They will have to face dangerous trials and formidable opponents to save Camelot and his king.

programme.desc-more: In the middle of the summer, as the overwhelming heat invades their neighbourhood, Molusco (Marc Bretonnière) and Rafik (Matthew Forbes) are fuelling an ambitious dream: to dig a pool in their garden to become the true kings of the summer season. Enthusiastic and motivated, they attack their project with an overflowing energy, determined to create a space of relaxation and pleasure. However, their ambition quickly turned to disaster. By increasing their efforts to make their pool irresistible, they find themselves consuming astronomical water, thus undermining the city's reserves. The situation degenerates as the inhabitants begin to feel the effects of their recklessness. Between whooping and misadventures, Molusco and Rafik will have to face the consequences of their careless act, while trying to save their summer and repair the damage caused.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: The day before the class photos, Molusco found himself not attractive: he landed on the heads of the globe fishes who made him a super original hairstyle. Except that the fish are poisonous and intoxicate Molusco, who suddenly suffers from an excess of confidence in him.
programme.desc-more: In a world where absurd people are living alongside everyday life, Musculo, a half-hust, half-human boy, dreams of a normal existence, similar to that of any eleven-year-old child. As he navigates between his marine origins and his desire for integration, he faces unique challenges. His attempts to blend into the life of a schoolgirl are often hampered by his physical peculiarities and strange behaviors inherited from his dual nature. Accompanied by his friends, who are trying to help him adapt, Musculo discovers the joys and sorrows of childhood, while learning to accept his singularity. The crazy situations and misunderstandings are linked, highlighting the themes of identity and self-acceptance. With a touch of humour and tenderness, this episode explores the obstacles that Musculo must overcome in order to realize his dream of an ordinary child's life, while revealing the richness of his unique personality.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco became addicted to a program on survival in hostile environments. He then took Coco and Rafik on a field expedition. But he quickly discovers that he's not the adventurer he thought he was...
programme.desc-more: In a world where normality is a distant dream, Musculo, a half-hust, half-human boy, aspires to lead the life of an eleven-year-old child. Evolved in a colorful and staggered universe, he faces the daily challenges of childhood while juggling with his hybrid nature. His adventures lead him to be friends with colourful characters, such as his faithful companion, a small sarcastic crab, and his neighbor, a girl full of life who ignores all his peculiarities. Together, they are engaged in fantastic quests, ranging from searching for a submarine treasure to participating in children's games competitions. However, Musculo also has to face the prejudices and misunderstandings of others, who see in him a curiosity rather than a comrade. Through his adventures, he discovers the value of friendship and the importance of accepting his true identity.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: A mysterious vigilante, who remotely controls electrical equipment connected thanks to his hacker skills, attacks all the wealthy among London's animals.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, an exceptional-looking Indian pig, and his brother Bro, an impulsive and fearless companion, are attacking mysteries that even Scotland Yard has not been able to solve. Their insatiable curiosity pushes them to plunge into delicate business, mixing secrets, betrayals and puzzles. Each episode sees them explore emblematic places and interview colorful characters, ranging from local traders to mysterious street dwellers. With a mixture of intelligence and instinct, Clever uses his sense of sharp observation to detect often neglected clues, while Bro, as a driving force, brings a touch of boldness to their investigations. Together, they form an unlikely but effective duo, sailing through the meandering of London's crime. Their quest for truth leads them to discover surprising revelations, questioning everything they thought they knew about their neighbourhood.

programme.title: Mystery Lane

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad asks Bluey to finish his breakfast, she wants to know why he always gives her orders.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Capuçon Gautier at the Olympia
programme.desc: Accompanied by his faithful accomplice, pianist Jérôme Ducros and the Orchestre Lamoureux, directed by conductor Johanna Malangré, cellist Gautier Capuçon takes over the titles of his album " Destination Paris", among which we find "La Foule" by Edith Piaf, "Les Champs-Elysées" by Joe Dassin, or "La Bohème" by Charles Aznavour. In this concert recorded at Olympia, the French musician celebrates the capital Paris – an inspiring and poetic city, out of time – that crosses all styles and all the periods in which classical and variety are found.

programme.title: Musical crossing at the Hotel de la Marine
programme.desc: This performance, presented in the prestigious framework of the Court of the Intendant at the Hotel de la Marine, brings together a string quartet and three lyrical singers around a program dedicated to the great works of the classical repertoire. Covered by generations of Talents Adami Classic, this evening highlights the remarkable voices of Michèle Bréant (soprano), Flore Royer (mezzo-soprano) and Alexandre Baldo (baritone bass), accompanied by an exceptional string quartet: Stéphanie-Marie Degand and Iris Scialom on violin, Marie Ducroux on viola and Christian-Pierre La Marca on cello. Together, they will perform masterpieces by Mozart, Borodine and Léo Delibes, while also drawing on an older repertoire, with works by Henry Purcell and Marin Marais.

programme.title: When was the last time?
programme.desc: What more effective way to solve a problem than to get rid of it in a "definitive" way? One night, as every night in his little well-ordered life, a woman will commit the worst: the indescribable and unfaithful act of poisoning her husband. Only, there is a long way from the plan to the implementation. She quickly understands that to solve her problem, the solution chosen, as radical as it is irreversible, is not necessarily the best...

programme.title: Witchcraft for two pianos
programme.desc: The articulation between classical music, shadows and magic is the starting point of this original project led by pianists Naïri Badal and Adelaide Panaget, better known as the Duo Jatekok. Through a program of plays evoking the immemorial figure of the witch, on the scorching notes of Rachmaninov, Debussy or Stravinski, a cool listening, a crow sits on the shoulder of a pianist, wolves, lutins and chimeras are created live with hands.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Champollion, the parrot of Sir Arthur Bones, a famous archaeologist, came to ask Clever for help, because his master was abducted by a humanoid robot.
programme.desc-more: In a world where adventure and mystery are interspersed, Clever, a young amateur detective, finds himself confronted with an unexpected situation when he receives a visit from Champollion, the parrot of Sir Arthur Bones, a renowned archaeologist. Champollion, a panicked man, reveals that his master was abducted by a humanoid robot, an event that seems to have come out of a science fiction story. Intrigued and determined to help, Clever is engaged in an investigation that will lead him to explore ancient catacombs and long-sought secrets. As he investigates, he will discover mysterious clues and forgotten artifacts, while facing unexpected dangers. With the help of his friends, Clever will have to be a cunning and courageous man to thwart the kidnapper's plans and save Sir Arthur. The stakes are high, and each discovery brings it closer to a truth that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: A poodle that continuously participates in canine beauty competitions is attacked at night in its home by a tentacular creature.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a sharp sense of observation, and his brother Bro, a little impulsive, are embarking on bold police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity and their natural instinct to solve mysteries push them to explore business that even Scotland Yard struggles to elucidate. Together, they decipher complex puzzles and face perilous situations, while using their trickery and team spirit. Clever, with his intelligence and attention to detail, contrasts with Bro's fervour temperament, creating a captivating dynamic between the two characters. As they go through their adventures, they discover a network of intrigues that drags them into theft, deceit and secrets that are well guarded. Their quest for truth leads them to rub themselves with mysterious characters and unexpected situations, proving that even the smallest can have a great impact on the world around them.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: A very long-glawed feline with a speckled coat, wearing a carved mask, bursts into the Queen's room in the middle of the night and disappears with her.
programme.desc-more: In a mysterious London, a disturbing event shakes the royal court when, in the middle of the night, a feline with a spotted coat and surprisingly long claws bursts into the Queen's room (Barbara Scaff). This serval, wearing a carved mask that gives it a enigmatic look, attacks the peace of the monarchy by disappearing with the sovereign. The alert is quickly given and a complex investigation is under way, involving members of the Royal Guard and city detectives. Andy Chase is a clever detective, determined to break the mystery behind this intriguing creature and find the Queen before it's too late. As the investigation proceeds, hidden secrets, unexpected alliances and surprising revelations emerge, plunging the spectator into an atmosphere of tension and intrigue where each clue could be the key to the resolution of this bold flight.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: After absorbing a potion of Voldenuix, Asmatix thought he was back at the battle of Lutèce. Chevrotine will try to take advantage of it to get revenge for Labienus.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of "Idefix and the Indomitable", Asmatix, the famous Druid, finds himself in a situation to say the least unexpected after ingesting a potion concocted by the sorcerer Voldenuix. This potion carried him mentally to the tumultuous period of the battle of Lutèce, where he believed himself in the midst of the clashes between the Gauls and the Romans. As Asmatix tries to navigate this past world, Chevrotine, his accomplice, both unpredictable and cunning, sees an opportunity to settle his accounts with Labienus, the Roman centurion. Driven by a desire for revenge, Chevrotine embarked on a bold plan to destabilize Labienus, but things did not go as planned. Tensions are rising, and quiproquos are accumulating, testing Asmatix's ingenuity and Chevrotin's determination in an adventure full of twists and humour.

programme.desc-more: In a small Gallic village where gastronomy is queen, Pomdofine, the famous cook, is at the head of a popular Gaulish kitchen cart. To counter this culinary success, Labienus, a clever Roman strategist, decides to put in place a bold plan with the help of his accomplices, Plendastus and Anglaigus. Together, they concoct a canteen cart of Roman cuisine, hoping to seduce the villagers with exotic and tasty dishes, while imposing themselves as the new masters of gastronomy. The tensions between the Gauls and the Romans intensified as the two sides competed to attract the greedy. The inhabitants of the village, caught between two fires, face culinary choices that may well influence the harmony of their community. In this tasty duel, unexpected alliances that suggest promise to spice up the plot, while celebrating the passion for good cooking.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Chico, a pink flamingo, crashes at the feet of Belfort and Lupin, thinking he came to Africa. The two heroes will try to help him find his way back.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the "Belfort & Lupin" series, the story begins unexpectedly when a pink flamingo named Chico, disoriented and exhausted, crashes at the feet of our two heroes, Belfort and Lupin. Convinced of having arrived in Africa, Chico quickly realized that he was far from his destination. The two protagonists, always ready to help those in need, decide to embark on a rock adventure to help the flamboyant bird find its way back. As they travel, they meet a gallery of colorful characters and find themselves confronted with comedic and unexpected situations. Challenges are accumulating, testing their ingenuity and friendship. As the tracks multiply, Belfort and Lupin will have to navigate through misunderstandings and misunderstandings, proving that mutual aid and solidarity are essential, even in the most disconcerting moments.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.sub-title: From the menagerie to the rififi
programme.desc: The change of the lama Serge's enclosures creates a real tsunami in the household because Madame Rosa does not support her new neighbour.
programme.desc-more: At La Ménagerie, a local zoo, the change of the enclosures of the lama Serge (Alexandre Nguyen) provokes a real agitation. Indeed, Madame Rosa (Barbara Tissier), a passionate and devoted careful woman, cannot bear the presence of this new neighbour with an unpredictable character. Serge, with his mischievous temperament and his tendency to sow disorder, disturbs the well-ordered daily life of the household, where every animal and every employee has their place. The tension between Rosa and Serge, exacerbated by the mockery of other animals, is rising, while the zoo director, Mr. Bouvier (Hugo Brunswick), is trying to find a solution to calm the situation. Over the days, conflicts are increasing, leading to nasty and unforeseen situations. Between rivalries, emerging friendships and the challenge of living together, this episode promises a humorous exploration of inter-animal and human relations, where everyone will have to learn to accept differences.

programme.title: Dodin Buffant's passion
programme.desc: In the mid 1880s, in France. A famous astronomer is developing a scheme to conquer the heart of his faithful and complicit cook.
programme.desc-more: At the end of the 19th century in France, Eugénie (Juliette Binoche) dedicated her life to chef Dodin Bouffant (Benoît Magimel), whose cook she has been faithful for two decades. Renowned for its refined dishes that seduce the greatest personalities of the time, Dodin finds in the presence of Eugénie an indispensable support, both in the vegetable garden and in the kitchens of his prestigious establishment. Their relationship, much more than just professional collaboration, flourishes in a profound complicity that flirts with love, although they have never formalized their union, despite Dodin's repeated proposals. While their daily lives are punctuated by sumptuous dinners for notables, an underlying tension is emerging, revealing the true feelings that unite them. In the face of the demands of high gastronomy and their own desires, Eugene and Dodin must navigate between passion and tradition, questioning the norms of their time.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: When Detective McFlare meets his agent, Pigeon Paxton, who is about to reveal important information to him, they are both attacked.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen mind and remarkable observational capacity, and his brother Bro, a little more impulsive and bold, are embarking on police investigations that defy understanding. While Scotland Yard struggles to solve thorny business, the two fur brothers take charge, proving that even the smallest can have a great impact. Their first case plunges them into an intriguing mystery: a series of inexplicable disappearances of precious toys in the neighbourhood. With their sense of deference, Clever and Bro question unlikely witnesses, explore dark alleys and use clever schemes to dislodge the culprits. As they investigate, they discover an unsuspecting criminal network, testing their intelligence and courage. Each investigation brings them a little closer to the truth, but also to the dangers that lie ahead.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: Idéfix is locked in the kennel of the Louve. While Monalisa asked him about the location of the den of the Indomitable, Muffine helped him.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of "Idefix and the Indomitable", Idéfix (Benjamin Bollen), the faithful companion of Asterix and Obelix, finds himself in a perilous situation. Locked in the kennel of the fearsome Louve, he faces the interrogation of Monalisa (Kelly Marot), a clever and determined figure, who seeks to discover the location of the secret den of the Indomitable. As tensions rise and time is running out, Muffine (Edwige Lemoine), Idéfix's courageous and fearless friend, is undertaking a bold mission to save him. Aware of the dangers ahead, she was developing an ingenious plan to infiltrate the territory of the Louve and to thwart her actions. Meanwhile, the story is enriched with moments of humour and friendship, as the characters fight to defend their values and protect their community. The stakes are high and every decision counts in this thrilling adventure.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: Arquebus loses the taste of fighting. Padgachix, disappointed to find himself without an opponent to his size, made a pact with the beagles to give him a little dynamism.
programme.desc-more: The arrival of Gracchus Plendastus, a flamboyant and ambitious figure, at the Louve causes palpable agitation among the inhabitants. Monalisa, a clever, clever young mouse, does not see with a good eye this intrusion that threatens her daily life. She then decided to take advantage of the gourmet taste of the nearby mice to concoct a Machiavellic plan. By orchestrating a series of misunderstandings and tricks, Monalisa hopes to defeat Gracchus' intentions and regain control of his territory. The mice, seduced by the promise of tempting feasts, are drawn into his ploy, ignoring the consequences of their actions. In this tumultuous context, friendship and loyalty will be tested, while Monalisa will have to navigate between his personal ambitions and the well-being of his community. This captivating narrative plunges us into a universe where intrigues and alliances weave around the quest for power and survival.

programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the animated series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Baratine, a little heroine with a big heart, finds herself in a delicate situation when she clings the paw between the roots of a majestic tree. This tree, coveted by Anglaigus, a character determined to transform it into toothpicks, becomes the symbol of the struggle for nature's preservation. As Anglaigus' plans threaten the balance of their environment, Baratine, with his indomitable spirit and sense of justice, becomes a leader of a resistance movement. She joins her friends in defending their precious tree and mobilizes the inhabitants of the village to oppose the invader. Through thrilling adventures, Baratine discovers the strength of union and the importance of protecting their natural heritage. This touching and humorous narrative addresses themes of solidarity and ecology, captivating both young and old.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: All eggs were requisitioned for Easter, so there is no more one for the king's meal. Belfort and Lupin try to preserve a swan egg from cooks.
programme.desc-more: In the majestic setting of the Palace of Versailles in the 17th century, the intrepid duo of Belfort, a faithful dog of Louis XIV, and Lupin, a daring wolf, was illustrated by his heroic actions. In the lush gardens of the royal residence, these two unlikely friends devote themselves to protecting their fur-and-fine companions, whether they are from the Royal Household or the surrounding wilderness. Each episode leads them into thrilling adventures, where their friendship and courage are tested. Whether it's to rescue an injured bird or to find a lost cat, Belfort and Lupin are showing remarkable team spirit. Through unexpected challenges, they discover not only the joys of mutual aid, but also the dangers that lie ahead in this enchanting and perilous world. Their incessant quest to save the most vulnerable leads them to experience moments rich in emotions, thus forging an unwavering link between these two creatures, emblematic of loyalty and bravery.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep, the movie
programme.desc: A sheep drags all his flock into the big city, where he has a lot to do to prevent the head of the pound from catching the lost animals.
programme.desc-more: In a picturesque farm, Shaun (voice of Justin Fletcher), a young, mischievous and fearless sheep, aspires to escape the daily routine. With the help of his animal comrades, he developed a bold plan to take a vacation for the myopic farmer, whose benevolence is often put to the test. To distract Blitzer (voice of John Sparkes), the vigilant shepherd dog, Shaun and his friends are implementing a series of hilarious tricks. However, when their scheme takes an unexpected turn, the farmer finds himself trapped in a caravan that starts to de-calm the hill. As Blitzer pursues him, Shaun and the other sheep quickly realize that they need the help of their master to navigate this chaotic situation. Determined to find the farmer and restore balance on the farm, Shaun embarks on an adventure full of twists and lessons on friendship and responsibility.

programme.title: Kina & Yuk: ice foxes
programme.desc: In the North, a couple of polar foxes fight to found a family despite the global warming that deprives them of food.
programme.desc-more: In an increasingly threatened Arctic landscape, Kina (Véronique Boileau) and Yuk (Joe Bishop), a pair of polar foxes, are preparing to welcome their range. Since their childhood, they have shared precious moments in this glacial region, but Kina's pregnancy has brought about changes in their daily lives. A skilled hunter, Yuk, takes on him to ensure the livelihood of his companion, who becomes less able to hunt. On one of his expeditions, he started chasing a bear, hoping that he would let him eat some seals. However, hunting is complicated by the devastating effects of climate, which is transforming their habitat. While Yuk is isolated on a piece of drifting ice, he faces unforeseen challenges. His family's survival depends on it, and he will have to navigate in a hostile environment to find his way back to Kina.

programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: A prestigious diamond exhibited at the British Museum has just been stolen and the flight bears the signature of Warragul, the famous diamond gnome.
programme.desc-more: In the lively Lexington district of London, the unusual duo formed by Clever, an exceptional-flavoured Indian pig, and his brother Bro, an impulsive but loyal companion, embarks on captivating investigations. Although their appearance may seem ordinary, their insatiable curiosity and lively intelligence propel them to the heart of mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. In this episode, they find themselves facing a complex affair involving mysterious disappearances and misleading clues, which lead them through the dark alleys and the well-kept secrets of the city. Clever, with his keen sense of observation, deciphers the smallest details, while Bro, with his fervent temperament, does not hesitate to put himself in danger to discover the truth. Together, they must navigate a world where appearances are often misleading, while learning to trust their instincts to thwart the plans of an elusive criminal.

programme.title: It's still not a witch.
programme.desc: CTPS takes you into the secrets of the kingdom of Egypt and eternal life. According to the Egyptians, for a soul to gain access to eternal life, it was necessary to keep its body. In the cabin, Max "undresses" a model of mummy to understand the techniques used and also tells us about the "naturally" mummified animals. Surprised, some mummies came from South America, others from China... the Egyptians were not the only ones to have this practice. Mathieu discovers the mummies of the Museum of Fine Art and Archaeology in Besançon and accesses a place forbidden to the public: reserves. Kimi goes to the Museum of Man to participate in an exceptional operation to restore an Egyptian mummy.

programme.title: Family
programme.desc: When she was in Strasbourg, where she had been raped by her father for the first time, Christine Angot decided to visit her family.
programme.desc-more: Christine Angot, a renowned writer, embarks on an introspective journey after a major encounter at a book festival. Desiring to understand the roots of her trauma, she decided to return to Strasbourg to explore the family past linked to her father, Pierre, who had been her executioner during her teenage years. Her first stop leads her to Elizabeth, Peter's companion, with whom she engages in a tumultuous conversation, seeking to bring out buried truths. This meeting, full of emotions, reveals tensions and unsaid, updating the complexity of family relations. Christine then went to her mother, Claude, in the hope of finding answers and a form of reconciliation. However, confrontation is equally difficult, with each exchange filled with pain and resentment. Through these visits, Christine tries to heal her wounds and redefine her identity in the face of a past that haunts her.

As a result of the attacks on women, it has become the liberation of their word over the years. programme.title: Secret archives
programme.desc: To win over the public, to reach the top of the poster and to return even after terrible crossing of the desert, is the destiny of some artists, phoenix of the scene. Charles Aznavour pierced very late after contrary winds. He never let go and ended up winning. Fragilized by extreme melancholy, singer Renaud has dived several times and has risen every time. While she was a popular actress, Annie Girardot abandoned the cinema to succeed in the theatre. Finally, singer Claude Nougaro was thanked by his record company for lack of sales before returning in a frantic way with his tube "Nougayork". These revenges on life were filmed, photographed by relatives who agreed to share their treasures.

programme.title: Become Lucky Love
programme.desc: Born with one less arm, Luc Bruyère has been subjected to violence in the eyes of others since his earliest age. He chose to take on the job of a singer.
programme.desc-more: Luc Bruyère never imagined himself dying old. Question of destiny and personal history, no doubt. Born with one less arm, he has been subjected from his early age to violence in the eyes of others, even turning his life into hell. So why not consume it and burn it as quickly as possible, this life, even if it destabilizes its loved ones, its mother especially. Luc chose to take on himself, to transform himself, to become what he always dreamed of: singer. With his angel face, nothing resists him and he has fun, like a kid never satisfied. But the story would be too good for him at least. To live his incandescent love, he became a little more damaged and, today, at the dawn of his 30 years, he looks at the road he has travelled and is doing without taboos.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Benny, the nicest and most popular dog in the neighborhood, suddenly changes his personality. He starts biting after seeing a symbol engraved on a tree in the park.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two brothers, Clever, a lively-minded Indian pig, and Bro, his impulsive brother, are launching investigations that even defy Scotland Yard's abilities. Clever, with an acute sense of observation and an extraordinary intelligence, is often the brain behind their investigations, while Bro, always ready to act without thinking, brings a touch of energy and audacity to their adventures. Together, they are attacking mysterious and complex cases that have left the police perplexed for years. Each episode plunges them into captivating puzzles, where they have to decipher clues, question witnesses and navigate a world of intrigues. As their reputation grows, they attract the attention of enigmatic characters who seek to defeat them. Clever and Bro will have to unite their strengths and talents to solve mysteries that may well change their lives forever.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Mr. Auzaguet creates a vegetable garden at school to reconcile children with vegetables, but the students get tired of gardening quickly.
programme.desc-more: In this episode of the series "Anatole Latile", Mr.Auzaguet, a passionate and enthusiastic teacher, decides to create a vegetable garden at school with the aim of reconciling his students with vegetables. He hopes to awaken their curiosity and encourage them to adopt a healthier diet. However, children, initially intrigued by this initiative, are quickly getting tired of the gardening and the routine involved. Laughters and games leave room for boredom, and cultivated vegetables gradually become objects of disinterest. In view of this, Mr Auzaguet must redouble his imagination and creativity to bring his project back to life. It offers fun activities and challenges that could revive the enthusiasm of children for the vegetable garden. This episode explores the themes of engagement, food education and perseverance in the face of adversity, while highlighting the relationships between students and their teachers.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole's parents have good news. They're gonna take her to the Startruc amusement park. Anatole's concern is that his newsletter will arrive and it is not good.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: A fox dressed as a sheep arrives at the farm. He immediately charms all the sheep. Only Shaun is suspicious...
programme.desc-more: In a peaceful corner of the English countryside, Shaun, a malicious and resourceful sheep, bores himself from the monotonous routine of the farm where he lives with his sheep companions. Always looking for a new adventure, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the daily monotony. With the help of his friends, a much less clever group of sheep, he concocts a bold plan to spend an unforgettable day. However, their escape quickly turns into a series of hilarious mishaps when animals find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations, ranging from a trip to a city trip to unexpected encounters with humans. While Shaun must show creativity and courage to get his flock embarrassed, he realizes that friendship and solidarity are essential to overcoming obstacles. In this animated comedy, Shaun's adventurous spirit and his faces promise to captivate spectators of all ages.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: After taking a bath to please Vitamin, Padgachix, clean as a new penny, is reluctant to help Idefix fight against the Romans who pollute the Seine.
programme.desc-more: In the "Eaux troubles à Lutèce" episode of the series "Idéfix et les Indomitables", the harmony of the city of Lutèce is threatened by an increasing pollution of the Seine, orchestrated by the Romans. Padgachix (Benjamin Bollen), eager to seduce the beautiful Vitamin (Kelly Marot), decided to redo a beauty. After a reinvigorating bath, he found himself clean as a new penny, but this metamorphosis made him reluctant to help his friend Idéfix (Jean-Claude Donda) in his fight against the Romans. Idefix, faithful and determined, knows that he must act to preserve the environment and quality of life of the inhabitants of Lutece. Faced with Padgachix's indifference, Idefix decided to take charge of the matter. As he embarks on a journey full of twists, he will have to find allies and strategies to counter the plans of the invaders and restore the cleanliness of the Seine waters.

programme.desc: Lovendpis the Egyptian returns to recover a magic amulet stolen from his master by Labienus. He would like to get Turbine back in the meantime.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", the plot focuses on the unexpected return of Lovendpis the Egyptian (Benjamin Bollen), a character with a mysterious past and dark motivations. The latter's mission is to recover a magical amulet, precious relic stolen from his master by Labienus (Jean-Claude Donda), a former opponent who does not retreat in front of anything to preserve his power. In parallel, Lovendpis is a person who is very talented and who can help him find Turbine (Kelly Marot). As the characters embark on an adventure sown with pitfalls through the mysteries of ancient Egypt, they will have to face enigmas, traps and formidable opponents. In this unbridled race, unexpected alliances and betrayals risk changing the course of events, while the magic amulet holds secrets that could upset their destiny to all.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: Deported to the forest with other animals from Lutèce, Idéfix finds himself confronted with the extremist Chevrotine who sees there the opportunity to create his personal army.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Idéfix (Benjamin Bollen), the faithful companion of Asterix, finds himself deported to a remote forest, where he faces a perilous situation. In this new hostile environment, he meets other animals from Lutèce, all victims of an unjust system. Together, they have to overcome their differences to survive. However, the calm was quickly broken by the appearance of Chevrotine (Jean-Claude Donda), an extremist with disproportionate ambitions, who saw in this assembly a golden opportunity to form his own armed group. Chevrotine, charismatic but dangerous, seeks to manipulate animals by exploiting their despair. Idefix, aware of the stakes, must bring his comrades together and find a way to resist this growing threat. This fight for freedom and solidarity will test their determination and team spirit, while they try to escape the claws of Chevrotine.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Belfort notes that her mother has a strange behavior: she is more severe and distant than usual, and refuses to let her children approach her.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of the sumptuous gardens of the Palace of Versailles in the 17th century, two unexpected companions, Belfort and Lupin, are engaged in a series of thrilling adventures. Belfort, a faithful Louis XIV dog, and Lupin, a bold wolf, form an inseparable duo, joining forces to protect the hair and feather residents of the Royal Household and the surrounding wildlife. Each episode leads them into perilous situations where their friendship and ingenuity are tested. Meetings with colourful characters, spectacular rescues and unexpected discoveries will mark their journey. Together, they will face challenges, overcome traps and navigate through the intrigues of the royal court, while learning to overcome their differences. In this series, friendship and loyalty intertwine with moments of humour and emotion, offering a unique look at animal life at the Sun King's court.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: After an uncontrolled slide in the castle, Lupin found himself locked in the cabinet at the clock. Belfort wants to deliver his friend.
programme.desc-more: After an unexpected slide in the corridors of the majestic Versailles castle, Lupin (Alexandre Nguyen) finds himself trapped in the mysterious clock cabinet. This cabinet, both fascinating and terrifying, is subjected to a complex mechanism that the royal watchmaker dates back every day at nightfall. Alarmed by this situation, Belfort, Lupin's faithful friend, is concerned about the disastrous consequences if humans discover the presence of his companion in the castle. To save Lupin before the watchmaker's arrival, Belfort drew up a bold plan. Knowing by heart the workings of the daily life of Versailles, he formed a team of intrepid animals: Ariane, Gazette, Artus, Marcus, and even Madame Rosa. Together, they engage in a perilous mission, while avoiding crossing Bazire, the royal dog, who continues to pursue Belfort to remind him of his obligations. The adventure is full of twists and dangers.

programme.title: Scooby Doo and cyber tracking
programme.desc: From prehistory to the future, through all the other eras, the five heroes of Mystery & Cie are looking for a wicked ghost virus.
programme.desc-more: Scooby-Doo, Sammy (Shaggy Rogers), Fred, Daphne and Vera meet again to solve an intriguing puzzle involving a ghost virus that threatens to capture the digital world. As they plunge into the meanderings of this case, the group finds themselves trapped in a video game that transports them through their own past adventures. This immersive experience propels them into different eras, ranging from cave age to futuristic worlds in space. Each time is punctuated by unexpected twists and quiproquos, as they encounter alternative versions of themselves, which further complicates their mission. Faced with unprecedented challenges and puzzles to solve, our heroes will not only have to foil the plans of the ghost virus, but also navigate the potential consequences of their interactions with their doubles, endangering the course of history.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco and Rafik are caught by Mr.Plusse in the hallways because they laugh at a photo on Molusco's cell phone: Coco sleeping, disguised as a girl. Mr. Plusse is under the spell and asks to meet this beautiful woman, whom Molusco makes her aunt look like. The beginning of an idyllic?
programme.desc-more: In a world where imagination and reality mix together, Musculo, a young half-hust, half-human boy, dreams of an ordinary life at the age of eleven. Every day, he confronts the challenges of a singular existence, desperately seeking to integrate among the children of his age. Although its hybrid nature gives it unique features, such as the ability to camouflage in the water, it aspires to live classic childhood adventures, such as playing football or participating in birthday parties. His interactions with his friends, who oscillate between curiosity and misunderstanding, highlight the themes of acceptance and identity. Musculo navigates through the joys and sorrows of childhood while discovering the limits of his condition. Through comical and moving situations, this series explores the quest for belonging and the small victories that accompany the path to self-acceptance.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Lola no longer has a job and Molusco's parents decide to move. Molusco and Rafik will do everything to prevent this but they cause castatrophics throughout the city.
programme.desc-more: In the fantastic world of "Mousco", Musculo, a half-hustler, half-human boy, struggles with his unique identity and his desires as an ordinary child. At only eleven years old, he dreams of living in a life similar to that of his comrades, but his singular appearance and aquatic characteristics make this aspiration difficult. Through the wild and moving adventures, Musculo tries to navigate the challenges of childhood, from school to friendship, while confronting the prejudices of other children. Accompanied by his friends, he explores the joys and sorrows of daily life, learning to accept his difference. Between comic situations and moments of tenderness, Musculo discovers that true friendship and self-acceptance are the keys to overcoming obstacles. This initiatory journey highlights the themes of identity, acceptance and resilience, while offering a tender and humorous look at the transition to adulthood.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Athena, the bitch of a scientist, comes to consult Clever and Bro, because she and her master were attacked by the spectre of an old associate.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two unlikely brothers are embarking on investigations that defy understanding. Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro, his somewhat impulsive brother, find themselves involved in mysterious things that even Scotland Yard struggles to elucidate. Their first investigation plunges them into an unexplained network of disappearances that shakes the local community. By looking at every detail, Clever uses his intelligence and ability to notice clues that humans might neglect, while Bro, with his fervoury temperament, does not hesitate to engage physically in defending their quest for truth. programme.title: It's still not a witch.
programme.desc: Maritime traffic is about 60,000 commercial vessels on the water every day, plus more than 40,000 recreational vessels. To allow the loading and unloading of goods and passengers between land and sea, humans have created ports! Today, these are places where tomorrow's innovations are born! In Bordeaux, Kimi discovers that the ports are centres of technological innovation with connected oysters and bathymetry and dredging systems to ensure access to the port. Mathieu brings us to discover the port of Le Havre, which focuses on protecting the environment by integrating sustainable solutions to reduce its ecological footprint.

programme.title: Reporters
programme.desc: A month of the life of the journalists of the Gamma agency: close-up on the work of journalists and on the ethical issues they face.
programme.desc-more: Paris, October 1980. Day after day, Raymond Depardon followed the press photographers of Gamma, of which he was one of the founders. Between two planes, two trains, they cover, among other things, Jacques Chirac's visit to the merchants of Paris, Giscard d'Estaing's trip to China, and Georges Marchais' campaign, candidate for the presidency of the Republic. Some, more specialized, are ready for anything for a scoop that will sell all over the planet, others prefer to work on a subject in depth.

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The happy gang of jungle Aces continues to want to bring peace and justice to the nature around them, despite some enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In the vibrant Lexington neighbourhood of London, two fearless brothers, Clever, a sharp-minded Indian pig, and Bro, his impulsive brother, are embarking on police investigations that challenge imagination. With insatiable curiosity and remarkable intelligence, they find themselves resolving cases that even Scotland Yard has not been able to solve for years. While Clever uses his sense of observation to decipher the clues, Bro does not hesitate to plunge his head first into action, which leads them into situations as comic as well as proving. Their first case led them to investigate the mysterious disappearance of a precious jewel, a theft that left the community in a state of dismay. While traveling through the alleys of Lexington, the two brothers will discover a world of intrigues, secrets and unexpected characters, while learning to master their own talents and strengthen their brotherly bond.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, an exceptional-looking Indian pig, and his brother Bro, an impulsive and fearless companion, are attacking mysteries that even Scotland Yard has not been able to solve. Their insatiable curiosity pushes them to plunge into delicate business, mixing secrets, betrayals and puzzles. Each episode sees them explore emblematic places and interview colorful characters, ranging from local traders to mysterious street dwellers. With a mixture of intelligence and instinct, Clever uses his sense of sharp observation to detect often neglected clues, while Bro, as a driving force, brings a touch of boldness to their investigations. Together, they form an unlikely but effective duo, sailing through the meandering of London's crime. Their quest for truth leads them to discover surprising revelations, questioning everything they thought they knew about their neighbourhood.
