programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In the lively city of Lutèce, chaos is taking hold when Labienus, the Roman governor, imposes a curfew to track down Lentix, a bold bandit who sow terror among the rich citizens. Lentix, skilfully camouflaged in his cart, has the habit of robbing the inhabitants, leaving behind him a wake of fear and anxiety. Faced with this threat, Poulerotix, a brave local hero, is entrusted with the mission of protecting the lutecians and putting an end to the actions of this elusive thief. As tension rises, Poulerotix must bring his allies together and develop strategies to counter Lentix's plans. In this race against the clock, he will have to navigate through intrigues, unexpected alliances and reversals of situation, while preserving the indomitable spirit of the inhabitants of Lutece. The stakes are high and the destiny of the city rests on its shoulders.
programme.desc-more: Idefix and the Indomitable (2020)
programme.desc: Idefix and the Indomitable (2020)

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.sub-title: Monalisa, a friend who wants you good
programme.desc: In a colorful and offbeat universe, the episode "Monalisa, a friend who wants you good" of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable" plunges us into a series of unexpected events. Monalisa (Kelly Marot), the famous and charming heroine, accidentally finds herself involved in a chaotic incident when a mysterious potion, destined for Sonélématine (Jean-Claude Donda) by the malicious Voldenuix (Benjamin Bollen), explodes, covering it as well as Padgachix (Stéphane Bern) unexpectedly. This magical explosion brings a series of hilarious quiproquos, highlighting the unique skills of each character and their ability to adapt to the most nasty situations. While Monalisa is trying to repair the damage caused by this explosive potion, it must also manage the consequences of its actions on its friends and enemies. This episode promises humor, friendship and unexpected lessons about trust and relationships in a world where magic can sometimes play cruel tricks.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the episode entitled "Les petits peas du roi", Madame Rosa, an elephant emblematic of the Ménagerie, finds herself chained, accused of having devoured all the peas of the royal vegetable garden, reserved for the dinner of Louis XIV. This desperate situation does not escape Belfort and Lupin, who cannot accept to see their friend treated in this way. Driven by their sense of justice, they decide to conduct the investigation to prove the elephant's innocence. Their investigation led them to explore the mysteries of Mrs Rosa's somnambulism crises, questioning the accusation against her. To solve this enigma, our two heroes will have to deploy their observation and deduction skills, while navigating the machinery of the royal court. With the growing pressure of the Grand Souper approaching, Belfort and Lupin must act quickly to find the missing peas and save their friend from an unfair fate.
programme.desc-more: Belfort & Lupin (2023)
programme.desc: Belfort & Lupin (2023)

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: As the Court of Versailles prepares to welcome the Siam Ambassadors, an atmosphere of curiosity and excitement reigns among the nobles. Accompanied by this prestigious delegation, Sita, a young black panther with a bewitching charism, is much more than just a pet. Its presence symbolizes a delicate diplomatic mission, aimed at strengthening the links between two distinct cultures. As the visit unfolds, Sita is a valuable asset, navigating with ease in the court's intrigues. However, the underlying tensions and rivalries between the members of the French nobility threaten to disrupt this historic meeting. Ambassadors, whose intentions are not always clear, must juggle diplomacy with political manoeuvres. As events take an unexpected turn, Sita finds herself at the heart of a power game where every gesture counts. Is her mission really what she seems to be?

Okoo-koo invites them to share activities (original contents), offers tips and tricks to make daily life more fun, a place to live together to invent the world of tomorrow.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In a world where mystery and danger are mixed, Clever (Kaycie Chase), a clever investigator, announces to her colleagues Bro (Andy Chase) and McFlare (Doug Rand) that she has finally got a set of crucial clues. These revelations lead her to the location of the next meeting of The Cause, a secret organization led by an evil Knight whose intentions are obscure and threatening. As Clever and his friends are about to infiltrate this clandestine meeting, they realize that the stakes are much higher than they imagined. Each clue brings them closer to a plot that could have devastating repercussions on their city. In parallel, tensions are mounting between the team members, each facing their own demons. As time is running out, Clever must deploy all his ingenuity to thwart the Machiavellical plans of The Cause before it is too late.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In the foggy streets of London, Clever, a pig of remarkable intelligence, is dedicated to an unusual mission: to solve the mysteries that affect pets and their owners. With a sharp mind and an unparalleled sense of observation, Clever joins a diverse team of accomplices, including four-legged friends and people passionate about justice. Each investigation plunges him into a secret world where treason, riddles and surprising revelations are mixed. From the disappearance of a precious cat to the strange behavior of a watchdog, each case puts to the test its ingenuity and determination. By sailing through mysterious London, Clever discovers that the truth is often more complex than it seems. With a touch of humour and a great sensitivity, this episode takes us into a thrilling adventure where friendship and loyalty are essential to triumph over dark forces that threaten the welfare of animals.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: A day with Balovin
programme.desc: A constellation of performers converges towards Biarritz to celebrate Daniel Baloits' work. The reinterpretations of his iconic songs reveal the many facets of his career, though interrupted early. The Souchon brothers and Sandrine Kiberlain re-visited "My son my battle," while Youssoupha and Thibault Cauvin proposed a singular version of "Living or surviving." Nach concludes the tribute with "Evidently", a title written by Michel Berger. The testimonies, notably of Matthew Chedid, explore the forerunner role of the artist who died at 33 years of age.

programme.title: Basic, sessions
programme.desc: Production : Morgane Production Basic celebrates music! Discover young talents on France 4 during the upcoming Basic sessions! Since its first season, Basic, the sessions have given itself a mission: to make discover today those that we will listen to tomorrow. Now in 26-minute format, each show gives carte blanche to an emerging artist for an unreleased concert of five tracks, designed to be customized and recorded without audience at the FGO Barbara, a Parisian cultural institution emblematic of the support for young musical creation.

programme.title: Jade's armor
programme.desc: While all the Jades of the past are appreciated for their qualities, Jade 8 is called "Special" by Malik Melki. Vexaeus, she's looking to re-enact her image.
programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, a young woman apparently ordinary, finds herself confronted with an extraordinary destiny. A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The happy gang of jungle Aces continues to want to bring peace and justice to the nature around them, despite some enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, a pig named Clever, with a keen sense of observation, and her brother Bro, a little impulsive, are embarking on captivating investigations. Although their innocent appearance seems to be unthinkable, both pets prove to be outstanding detectives, able to thwart the thorniest mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. Through their adventures, they attack cases as intriguing as they are diverse, ranging from mysterious disappearances to daring robberies. Clever uses his intelligence and his sense of analysis to decipher clues, while Bro, with his fervent temperament, does not hesitate to take risks to protect his sister and to pierce the buried secrets. Together, they form an unexpected duo, proving that even the smallest can make a big difference in the quest for truth.
programme.desc-more: Mystery Lane (2021)
programme.desc: Mystery Lane (2021)

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two inseparable companions, Clever, a pig from India with exceptional insight, and his brother Bro, a little more impulsive, are embarking on fascinating police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity pushes them to attack cases that even Scotland Yard detectives struggle to solve. In this episode, they find themselves facing a complex mystery involving a series of unexplained disappearances and clues lost in the alleys of the city. While Clever uses his keen sense of observation to decipher the puzzles, Bro often gets carried away by his enthusiasm, which leads them into unforeseen and sometimes perilous situations. Together, they must navigate through a world of intrigues and secrets, while cultivating their brotherly bond and their love for adventure. The two brothers will discover that the key to solving this mystery may be their ability to combine their unique talents.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro's somewhat impulsive brother, are engaged in captivating police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity has led them to solve mysteries that even Scotland Yard has been struggling to clear for years. In this thrilling episode, the two animals discover a series of strange disappearances that seem to be linked to a disturbing urban legend: the Gorgon of Regent's Park, a mythical creature that, according to rumours, is hidden in the shadows of London's gardens. As they navigate through the secrets of their neighbourhood, Clever uses his intelligence and his sense of analysis, while Bro uses his audacity to interrogate the inhabitants and decipher clues. Together, they will have to overcome unexpected obstacles and prove that even the smallest can dig up great truths in a city where appearances are often misleading.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: It's ecology week at school. Children are invited to participate in several tests, to test and develop their ecological habits.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: In a peaceful corner of the English countryside, Shaun, a malicious and resourceful sheep, bores himself from the monotonous routine of the farm where he lives with his sheep companions. Always looking for a new adventure, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the daily monotony. With the help of his friends, a much less clever group of sheep, he concocts a bold plan to spend an unforgettable day. However, their escape quickly turns into a series of hilarious mishaps when animals find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations, ranging from a trip to a city trip to unexpected encounters with humans. While Shaun must show creativity and courage to get his flock embarrassed, he realizes that friendship and solidarity are essential to overcoming obstacles. In this animated comedy, Shaun's adventurous spirit and his faces promise to captivate spectators of all ages.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of season 2, Padgachix (Benjamin Bollen), the famous dog of the undeserved, is convinced that his mistress, Vitamin (Kelly Marot), prefers more slender animals. Desiring to prove to him that he can be a worthy companion, he embarks on a desperate quest to regain his form. His solution? A revolutionary exercise wheel, designed by the farfelu inventor Anglaigus (Jean-Claude Donda) for the General. However, things are turning unexpectedly when the wheel, with an uncontrollable mechanism, starts to turn at full speed in the streets of Lutece. Pungachix is trapped inside, causing a real disorder in the city, causing panic among the inhabitants. His friends, including the cunning Obélix (Stéphane Bern) and the wise Asterix (Edwige Lemoine), must join forces to save their companion while trying to restore calm before the situation degenerates completely.
programme.desc-more: Idefix and the Indomitable (2020)
programme.desc: Idefix and the Indomitable (2020)

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", a mysterious potion makes unexpected wonders. Turbine, the bitch with a well tempered character, begins to spit diamonds, causing the greed of Labienus and Plendastus, two unscrupulous crooks. Seeing a golden opportunity, they do not hesitate to kidnap the bitch to exploit this incredible phenomenon to their advantage. As the two malefrats draw up a Machiavellical plan to take advantage of this unexpected situation, Idéfix (Benjamin Bollen), the faithful companion, is launching a race against the clock to save his four-legged friend. With courage and determination, he uses his irresistible instincts to thwart the plans of the kidnappers. This journey rich in twists and adventures will test the friendship and loyalty of the characters, while revealing unexpected facets of their personality.
programme.desc-more: Idefix and the Indomitable (2020)
programme.desc: Idefix and the Indomitable (2020)

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Voldenuix, the clever owl, decided to make a romantic gesture by offering Sonelematine a precious necklace that once belonged to Monalisa. This iconic jewel is more than just an accessory; It is full of history and mystery. To achieve his plan, Voldenuix joins Turbine, a character with a lively mind and always ready for adventure. Together, they embark on a bold quest to recover the necklace, but the task will not be easy. Using a magic potion, Turbine hopes to copy the jewel, but this manipulation could have unexpected consequences. As they travel, they will have to navigate through comical obstacles and surprising puzzles, while learning lessons about friendship, love and the value of precious objects. The episode promises to be rich in twists and humour, faithful to the spirit of Idéfix's adventures.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Tonight, the castle park is preparing to host a spectacular fireworks fire in honor of the king, attracting the curiosity of the city's inhabitants. Artus (Alexandre Nguyen) and Marcus (Hugo Brunswick), two inseparable friends, decided to attend the preparations for this festive event. As they explore the behind the scenes of the organization, they discover a vibrant world of colours and secrets. The two young men find themselves immersed in an electric atmosphere, where the pyrotechnicians work to create heavenly wonders. However, as they conduct their playful investigation, they dig up underlying tensions and unexpected rivalries between the members of the preparation team. As the long-awaited moment approaches, Artus and Marcus realize that this fireworks could reveal more than mere bright flashes, and that much more important issues are hidden behind this royal celebration.
programme.desc-more: Belfort & Lupin (2023)
programme.desc: Belfort & Lupin (2023)

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: At the heart of a Castle where tales come to life, Charles Perrault evokes the history of the Little Red Chaperon. However, a mysterious wolf, lost in the surrounding groves, draws the attention of the Guard, who is pursuing it. Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen), initially paralyzed by fear, saw his apprehension turn into determination thanks to Lupin (Hugo Brunswick), who persuaded him to help this animal in distress. For Lupin, this encounter with a wolf of his kind, named Remus, is of particular importance. As the two companions engage in a mission of exfiltration, Remus gradually settles in Lupin's heart, appearing as a fascinating father figure. But Lupin needs a crucial question: should he abandon Belfort to join a pack and live among his fellow men? The fear of losing his friend and the threat to their quest exacerbate Belfort's concern.
programme.desc-more: Belfort & Lupin (2023)

programme.title: It's still not a witch.
programme.desc: Mathieu returns to the past at the National Museum of Natural History. He will relive the major discovery that founded chemistry: matter is not composed of elements imagined by the alchemists (water, air, earth fire) but of atoms. Cecile will discover exciting experiences to illustrate that some chemical elements have similar characteristics, as shown in the periodic table of elements. Max tells us the fabulous history of the construction of Mendeleyev's painting and explains how it works. With SAMI we discover many surprises of the history of chemistry.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo & Batman: The Alliance of Heroes
programme.desc: In this thrilling adventure, the iconic Scooby-Doo team, composed of Fred (Frank Welker), Daphné (Grey DeLisle), Vélma (Kate Micucci), Shaggy (Matthew Lillard) and the brave Scooby-Doo (Frank Welker), are facing formidable opponents. Their investigation leads them to Gotham City, where they cross the road to Batman (Kevin Conroy), the famous masked vigilante. Together, they join forces to solve disturbing mysteries that threaten the security of the city. As they pursue a mysterious naughty draped in a red cape, the team faces situations of tension, between frantic fights and thrilling chase races aboard the mythical Batmobile. The talents of Scooby-Doo and his friends as investigators are tested, while Batman's ingenuity is crucial to defeating the machiavelic plans of their enemies. A adventure full of humour, action and mystery that will delight fans of both universes.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In a colorful and bland universe, Ozzy, an inveterate farcer, decides to play a joke to his friend Rafik, triggering a series of hilarious mishaps. Unfortunately, Rafik takes this joke too seriously and, convinced that Molusco is behind this joke, he is embarking on a spiral of comic vengeance. The two friends are following the wrong turns, from absurdity to frankly catastrophic, until their friendship is put to a severe test. It is then that Coco, the voice of reason, proposes a brilliant idea to stop this escalation of jokes that threatens to separate them. In another segment, Molusco and Coco find themselves in a difficult situation as they try to raise funds for a Mother's Day gift for Lola. Their quest leads them to register for a Mexican wrestling tournament, where they will have to face formidable and unexpected opponents.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In a world where imagination and reality intersect, Musculo, a young boy at once oyster and human, dreams of an ordinary existence like that of children of his age. At only eleven years old, he sails between his two identities, seeking to integrate among his comrades while facing the unique challenges that his hybrid nature imposes on him. In this thrilling episode, Musculo finds himself trained in an unexpected adventure when invasive crustaceans threaten his small village. With the help of his friends, he must learn to accept his differences and use his special abilities to defend his home. As the threat grows, Musculo discovers the value of friendship and courage, while learning to embrace his unique identity. Between bad situations and moments of tension, this initiatory quest will lead him to redefine what it means to be "normal" in a world populated by extraordinary creatures.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In a world where the extraordinary is close to daily life, Musculo, a half-hustler, half-human boy, aspires to live the life of an eleven-year-old normal child. With a singular appearance, he struggles with his unique identity while navigating the challenges of childhood. Between school, friends and family expectations, Musculo has to face situations that test his willingness to integrate. Every day is a new adventure, whether it is to try to blend among his comrades or to discover the joys and sorrows of childhood. His interactions with colourful characters, such as his classmates and family, bring a touch of humour and tenderness to his journey. Musculo is determined to prove that, despite his differences, he can embrace his singularity while aspireing to a life full of normality.

programme.title: Molusco

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro's impulsive and adventurous brother, are engaged in investigations that go beyond imagination. Together, they start a series of mysterious cases that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. Their first challenge is to bring them into a complex enigma involving a daring art flight, where invaluable works have disappeared without leaving any trace. Thanks to their lively mind and ability to sneak into unexpected places, the two brothers discovered a well-organized criminal network, using clever techniques to escape justice. While they are thwarting the plans of their opponents, Clever and Bro will also have to overcome their own differences to make the truth come out. Their friendship and determination will be tested in this thrilling adventure, where each clue counts and where danger is around every corner.
programme.desc-more: Mystery Lane (2021)
programme.desc: Mystery Lane (2021)

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with an exceptional sense of observation, and his brother Bro, impulsive and intrepid, are an unlikely duo of investigators. Together, they embark on exciting investigations that challenge even Scotland Yard's expertise. Each episode plunges them into mysterious and complex cases, ranging from unexplained disappearances to bold thefts, where their animal instincts and intelligence lead them to surprising deductions. Clever, with his sharp mind, uses his analytical skills to decorate the clues, while Bro brings a touch of bravery, not hesitant to plunge into action. Their complicity and unique dynamics allow them to confront formidable criminals and solve puzzles that human detectives have not been able to solve for years. In this adventure, the two brothers also discover buried secrets and unexpected truths, while strengthening their brotherly bond.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: The science of dreams
programme.desc: On the death of his father, Stéphane Miroux, a young creative man, left Mexico to find his mother in Paris, hoping to become a recognized illustrator. He is employed in a company manufacturing calendars. But he doesn't like this work so uncreative. His superior and colleagues do not understand him. So Stéphane takes refuge on his imaginary television set, all in cardboard. One day, he met his pretty neighbour Stephanie, whom he fell in love with. But her eccentricities end up repelling the young woman...

programme.title: GTA, the game no limit
programme.desc: In thirty years, the video game "Grand Theft Auto", now known as GTA, has moved from the status of pariah rejected by the political and media class to that of iconic work. A tech and testosterone version of the game of gendarmes and thieves, the franchise has reinvented the rules since the 1990s by offering hundreds of millions of gamers a total space of freedom. But beyond the unbridled pursuits and its sulphurous aura, what does this global phenomenon really reveal? The film, carried by the voice of actress and comedian Fadily Camara, and sublimated by Laurent Seince's artistic direction and the original musical creation of Dimitri Leroy, brings together for the first time the pioneers of GTA: Keith Hamilton, Paul Farley, Gary Penn and Jamie King.

programme.title: Abdoul makes his movie
programme.desc: Meeting with actresses, actors, directors and directors in the Provence-Alpes Côte d'Azur region, through relaxed, intimate and sometimes staggered interviews. Interviews are held in different places in Marseille and its surroundings, in the cinema, in the street, day.

programme.title: Gims in Paris la Défense Arena: the concert event
programme.desc: After being the first French rapper to fill the Stade de France in 2019, Gims chose a new arena for an exceptional concert in the largest hall in Europe: Paris la Défense Arena. With its twenty years of career, eight million albums sold and billions of streams, Gims is an out-of-class artist, multi-rewarded and acclaimed by more than 25 million fans around the world. In this phenomenal show that has already gathered 800,000 spectators this year in France, Gims offers a grand performance with its timeless tubes, such as "Sapés comme nevere", "Bella", or more recently "Ciel".

programme.title: Top Comedy Club
programme.desc: Mathieu Madenian is visiting the Comedy Club, La Péniche du laughter, in Strasbourg for this new evening. On stage, the audience has the opportunity to spend a moment with Laurent Arnoult, Alice Lombard, Najim, Jasmine Volakas, Jan Paul Poveda, Stéphane Dubaron, Cindy Oliveira, Blase, Claudia Modica and Romain Raulin.

programme.title: Jade's armor
programme.desc: Xinyan realizes that Tiangou brought an egg from Beasticon from the Stone Garden. The monkey entrusts the baby Beasticon to Lan Jun, who takes care of it as she can.
programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, a young woman apparently ordinary, finds herself confronted with an extraordinary destiny. A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The happy gang of jungle Aces continues to want to bring peace and justice to the nature around them, despite some enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two unlikely brothers are embarking on investigations that defy understanding. Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro, his somewhat impulsive brother, find themselves involved in mysterious things that even Scotland Yard struggles to elucidate. Their first investigation plunges them into an unexplained network of disappearances that shakes the local community. By looking at every detail, Clever uses his intelligence and ability to notice clues that humans might neglect, while Bro, with his fervoury temperament, does not hesitate to engage physically in defending their quest for truth. Together, they must navigate a complex world where appearances are deceptive and where each character hides a secret. As they sink into these mysteries, their brotherly bond will be tested, revealing unexpected truths about their own past.

programme.desc: Mystery Lane (2021)

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two unusual pets, Clever, a pig from India in the sense of exceptional observation, and his brother Bro, impulsive in character, are embarking on captivating investigations. Their peaceful daily life quickly turns into a series of thrilling adventures as they tackle mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. Thanks to Clever's sharp intelligence and Bro's audacity, the two partners are at the heart of complex business, where every detail counts. From the disappearance of precious objects to puzzles that challenge logic, their determination leads them to foil clever plans. But their quest for truth also exposes them to unexpected dangers, testing their brotherly bond. In this episode, Clever and Bro's humor and ingenuity illuminate dark affairs, revealing that even the smallest of us can make a difference.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Mystery Lane - Season 1 - Season 1
programme.desc-more: In a world where mystery and danger are mixed, Clever (Kaycie Chase), a clever investigator, announces to her colleagues Bro (Andy Chase) and McFlare (Doug Rand) that she has finally got a set of crucial clues. These revelations lead her to the location of the next meeting of The Cause, a secret organization led by an evil Knight whose intentions are obscure and threatening. As Clever and his friends are about to infiltrate this clandestine meeting, they realize that the stakes are much higher than they imagined. Each clue brings them closer to a plot that could have devastating repercussions on their city. In parallel, tensions are mounting between the team members, each facing their own demons. As time is running out, Clever must deploy all his ingenuity to thwart the Machiavellical plans of The Cause before it is too late.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole and Jason are training Princess to become a detective bitch. Mylène gets back at the wheel of Jason's video game and hides it in a secret place.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.sub-title: At the corner of the fire
programme.desc: In a peaceful corner of the English countryside, Shaun, a malicious and resourceful sheep, bores himself from the monotonous routine of the farm where he lives with his sheep companions. Always looking for a new adventure, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the daily monotony. With the help of his friends, a much less clever group of sheep, he concocts a bold plan to spend an unforgettable day. However, their escape quickly turns into a series of hilarious mishaps when animals find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations, ranging from a trip to a city trip to unexpected encounters with humans. While Shaun must show creativity and courage to get his flock embarrassed, he realizes that friendship and solidarity are essential to overcoming obstacles. In this animated comedy, Shaun's adventurous spirit and his faces promise to captivate spectators of all ages.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In the captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Lutèce is in a state of discord after the recent incidents caused by Halowine, Arctix and Antarctix, invaders who sow discord in the city. Faced with this growing threat, Labienus, the Roman strategist, made the bold decision to capture wolves wandering around the surrounding forest, convinced that these creatures could be used as a weapon against the Gaulish irredentists. Meanwhile, Turbine, Idéfix's faithful companion, realizes that this initiative could have disastrous consequences for the balance of nature and the tranquillity of Lutece. Determined to prevent Labienus from harming wolves, Turbine launched a race against the clock to warn Chevrotine, the wise and cunning inhabitant of the village. In this thrilling adventure, the characters will have to navigate between loyalty and bravery, while facing complex moral choices.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In the episode "Miche o ma miche" of season 2 of "Idéfix et les Indomitables", Idéfix (Benjamin Bollen), Asterix's faithful companion, finds himself in a delicate situation when he is captured and locked in the kennel of the Louve. During his imprisonment, he was confronted with Monalisa (Kelly Marot), a clever investigator who did not hesitate to use schemes to discover the secret den of the Indomitable. Monalisa, determined to defeat the plans of the indomitable Gauls, uses his intelligence and trick to question Idefix, hoping that he will reveal crucial information. Meanwhile, Idéfix, faithful to his team, must use his ingenuity to resist pressure and protect his friends. As tensions rise, the episode explores the themes of loyalty, bravery and resistance to adversity, while offering a mix of humour and adventure unique to the universe of Asterix.

programme.title: Idefixes and Indomitables
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Idefix and the Indomitable", Padgachix, a bold and often unpredictable character, makes a discovery that will upset his life: a cursed mirror capable of making his user progressively invisible. As he explores the mysteries of this ancient artifact, he quickly realizes that this invisibility is not without consequences, taking him away from his friends and plunged him into a state of growing loneliness. To lift the curse that eats him, Padgachix must undertake a perilous quest to lay the mirror before the statue of Hohis, an ancient god whose legend is marked by magic and wisdom. Accompanied by his faithful companions, he will have to overcome unexpected obstacles and confusing puzzles, while discovering the true value of friendship and courage in the face of adversity. This adventure promises to be rich in twists and life lessons.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the captivating world of the household, Richard de Rastignasse, a charismatic lion, is distinguished by its beauty and majestic appearance. Surrounded by a plethora of fascinated animals, it quickly becomes the pertussis of its entourage, attracting the attention of all in its elegant manners and undeniable charisma. His growing popularity encourages many companions to copy him, seeking to imitate his behavior and style. Within this dynamic, other animals, each with their unique personality, begin to compete to attract attention, resulting in a series of comical and touching situations. However, behind this facade of glory, Richard has to face his own doubts and the growing expectations of his entourage. As the household moves around, Richard will have to navigate between the quest for his identity and the pressure to stay at the top, while discovering what it really means to be a leader in this vibrant ecosystem.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In a context of fascist and mystery at the court of Louis XIV, an unfortunate incident occurred when young Ariane (Nathalie Homs) found herself to lace the royal billiard carpet, a masterpiece of craftsmanship. She panicked about the consequences of her act, and turned to her two accomplices, Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen) and Lupin (Hugo Brunswick), masters in the art of trickery and concealment. Together, they must develop a clever plan to mask this blunder before the game begins, where nobles and courtiers expect a demonstration of talent. Between daring ploys and nasty situations, the trio is launching a race against the clock, juggling the intrigues of the court and the expectations of the guests. As tensions rise, loyalty and ingenuity will be tested in a universe where every false step could have fatal repercussions.

programme.title: It's still not a witch.
programme.desc: A tree made of plastic bricks, that's a good idea, isn't it? Cecile is convinced of this... until Max and Mathieu made him notice a detail that changed everything: his tree is made of plastic... And the plastic comes from oil! But where does oil actually come from? How is it transformed into plastic? And above all, are there more ecological alternatives? Curious, Cécile goes on a mission to go back to the source of plastic: from the ground floor to the toys. Meanwhile, Mathieu is embarking on another investigation: can we make plastic without oil? And if so, how?

programme.title: Lego Scooby-Doo: Hollywood Ghost
programme.desc: Scooby-Doo and his friends won a trip to Hollywood. They visit the former Briqueton studios. But Scooby Gang soon discovered that these places are haunted by the ghost of a horror movie actor, Boris Karnak. He hunts Scooby-Doo and his band under the appearance of his old roles: a headless rider, a mummy or a zombie and sabotages the shooting of a fiction. The Scooby Gang decides to act: Sammy and Daphne become artists, Vera is the cameraman and Fred the director.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In a world where the fantastic mixes with reality, Musculo, a young half-hustler, half-human boy, struggles to integrate among children of his age. At only eleven years old, he aspires to lead a normal existence, far from curious eyes and mockery. Between his adventures on the oceanfront and his interactions with human friends, Musculo faces unique challenges related to its hybrid nature. His days are rhythmic with unexpected encounters and crazy situations, where he must juggle his aquatic identity with his childhood desires. In this captivating episode, Musculo embarks on a quest to prove that he can be like any other child, while discovering the beauty of his difference. His relationships with his fellow students, as well as the lessons he learns about self-acceptance, reveal an unexpected depth of his journey.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In the lively Lexington neighbourhood of London, two inseparable companions, Clever, a lively-minded Indian pig, and Bro, his somewhat impulsive brother, are embarking on captivating police investigations. programme.title: Bluey
programme.sub-title: Bumpy and the wise old grey-eyed leach
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.sub-title: Animals: they only lack the word!
programme.desc: Mathieu discovers the communication of exotic animals, Kimi is interested in domestic animals, while Max explains how humans decipher these fascinating languages.

programme.title: Vincent Niclo and the Symphonic Choir: Bel Canto Tour
programme.desc: In this show, Vincent Niclo, the famous tenor with four octave voices, pays tribute to the beautiful canto by mixing vocal virtuosity and emotions, thus transporting the spectator into a lyrical and majestic universe. Since his meeting with Celine Dion, whose debut he made and a world tour with Sarah Brightman, he has had the chance to sing on the most beautiful scenes in the world.

programme.title: Capuçon Gautier at the Olympia
programme.desc: Accompanied by his faithful accomplice, pianist Jérôme Ducros and the Orchestre Lamoureux, directed by conductor Johanna Malangré, cellist Gautier Capuçon takes over the titles of his album " Destination Paris", among which we find "La Foule" by Edith Piaf, "Les Champs-Elysées" by Joe Dassin, or "La Bohème" by Charles Aznavour. In this concert recorded at Olympia, the French musician celebrates the capital Paris – an inspiring and poetic city, out of time – that crosses all styles and all the periods in which classical and variety are found.

programme.title: Witchcraft for two pianos
programme.desc: The articulation between classical music, shadows and magic is the starting point of this original project led by pianists Naïri Badal and Adelaide Panaget, better known as the Duo Jatekok. Through a program of plays evoking the immemorial figure of the witch, on the scorching notes of Rachmaninov, Debussy or Stravinski, a cool listening, a crow sits on the shoulder of a pianist, wolves, lutins and chimeras are created live with hands.

programme.title: Living
programme.desc: Show recorded on January 27, 2024 at the theatre of Suresnes. A choreographer and scenographer, Mickaël Le Mer imagines a show in the form of a vibrant tribute to women with all the space of the stage reserved for them exclusively. Through a hip hop dance that subtly highlights the singularity of each one, eight virtuoso dancers expose the various challenges of their existence. With music that faithfully accompanies the dancers' every move, this hypnotizing show offers a sensation of the most organic.

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The happy gang of jungle Aces continues to want to bring peace and justice to the nature around them, despite some enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The evil knight"Salty, a cat of the royal guard, is paralyzed by a mysterious knight with supernatural powers. Clever and Bro must discover the identity of this knight and lift the spell.
programme.desc-more: In a world where adventure and mystery are interspersed, Clever, a young amateur detective, finds himself confronted with an unexpected situation when he receives a visit from Champollion, the parrot of Sir Arthur Bones, a renowned archaeologist. Champollion, a panicked man, reveals that his master was abducted by a humanoid robot, an event that seems to have come out of a science fiction story. Intrigued and determined to help, Clever is engaged in an investigation that will lead him to explore ancient catacombs and long-sought secrets. As he investigates, he will discover mysterious clues and forgotten artifacts, while facing unexpected dangers. With the help of his friends, Clever will have to be a cunning and courageous man to thwart the kidnapper's plans and save Sir Arthur. The stakes are high, and each discovery brings it closer to a truth that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "An empty cage in Wimbledon"Flash, the champion of the hounds race, disappears in incomprehensible circumstances of his ultra-secure box, the day before an important race.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a sharp sense of observation, and his brother Bro, a little impulsive, are embarking on bold police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity and their natural instinct to solve mysteries push them to explore business that even Scotland Yard struggles to elucidate. Together, they decipher complex puzzles and face perilous situations, while using their trickery and team spirit. Clever, with his intelligence and attention to detail, contrasts with Bro's fervour temperament, creating a captivating dynamic between the two characters. As they go through their adventures, they discover a network of intrigues that drags them into theft, deceit and secrets that are well guarded. Their quest for truth leads them to rub themselves with mysterious characters and unexpected situations, proving that even the smallest can have a great impact on the world around them.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In a mysterious London, a disturbing event shakes the royal court when, in the middle of the night, a feline with a spotted coat and surprisingly long claws bursts into the Queen's room (Barbara Scaff). This serval, wearing a carved mask that gives it a enigmatic look, attacks the peace of the monarchy by disappearing with the sovereign. The alert is quickly given and a complex investigation is under way, involving members of the Royal Guard and city detectives. Andy Chase is a clever detective, determined to break the mystery behind this intriguing creature and find the Queen before it's too late. As the investigation proceeds, hidden secrets, unexpected alliances and surprising revelations emerge, plunging the spectator into an atmosphere of tension and intrigue where each clue could be the key to the resolution of this bold flight.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of "Idefix and the Indomitable", Asmatix, the famous Druid, finds himself in a situation to say the least unexpected after ingesting a potion concocted by the sorcerer Voldenuix. This potion carried him mentally to the tumultuous period of the battle of Lutèce, where he believed himself in the midst of the clashes between the Gauls and the Romans. As Asmatix tries to navigate this past world, Chevrotine, his accomplice, both unpredictable and cunning, sees an opportunity to settle his accounts with Labienus, the Roman centurion. Tensions are rising, and quiproquos are accumulating, testing Asmatix's ingenuity and Chevrotin's determination in an adventure full of twists and humour.

To counter this culinary success, Labienus, a clever Roman strategist, decides to put in place a bold plan with the help of his accomplices, Plendastus and Anglaigus. Together, they concoct a canteen cart of Roman cuisine, hoping to seduce the villagers with exotic and tasty dishes, while imposing themselves as the new masters of gastronomy. The tensions between the Gauls and the Romans intensified as the two sides competed to attract the greedy. The inhabitants of the village, caught between two fires, face culinary choices that may well influence the harmony of their community. In this tasty duel, unexpected alliances that suggest promise to spice up the plot, while celebrating the passion for good cooking.

programme.sub-title: From the menagerie to the rififi
programme.desc: At La Ménagerie, a local zoo, the change of the enclosures of the lama Serge (Alexandre Nguyen) provokes a real agitation. Indeed, Madame Rosa (Barbara Tissier), a passionate and devoted careful woman, cannot bear the presence of this new neighbour with an unpredictable character. Serge, with his mischievous temperament and his tendency to sow disorder, disturbs the well-ordered daily life of the household, where every animal and every employee has their place. The tension between Rosa and Serge, exacerbated by the mockery of other animals, is rising, while the zoo director, Mr. Bouvier (Hugo Brunswick), is trying to find a solution to calm the situation. Over the days, conflicts are increasing, leading to nasty and unforeseen situations. Between rivalries, emerging friendships and the challenge of living together, this episode promises a humorous exploration of inter-animal and human relations, where everyone will have to learn to accept differences.

programme.desc-more: In the vast and wild Canadian forest, Grizzy, an imposing and cunning brown bear, enjoys a comfortable existence in the forest guard cabin, which he considers his kingdom. When he appropriates the delights of this isolated retreat, he encounters a horde of mischievous and fearless lemmings, small mammals who, although often clumsy, do not retreat in front of anything to counteract Grizzy's plans. These lemmings, with their limited intelligence but their unwavering determination, engage in a series of hilarious confrontations with the bear, competing for the domination of the hut and the treasures it contains. Misadventures are going on as Grizzy faces unexpected challenges, clever traps and nasty situations, while trying to preserve his quiet lifestyle. The struggle between the bear and the lemmings gives rise to moments of burlesque comedy, making each episode a unique and entertaining adventure.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Teen Titans are not teenagers like the others. Thanks to their superpowers, they intervene when the world is in serious danger. With humour and relaxation, they save the universe from all perils. At their head, Robin, who grew up in a circus with his parents. He was adopted by Batman, who trained him well. He now flies his own wings, leaving Gotham City for Jump City. Next to him, the figure Starfire, an alien princess born on the planet Tamaran, but also Raven, daughter of a Terrin and a distant conqueror. A series of animated rhythmic, adventure-filled and humorous.
programme.desc-more: In a world where teenage superheroes fight for justice, the Teen Titans stand out for their offbeat humour and carefree spirit. Lead by former Batman protégé Robin (Scott Menville), they left Gotham City to settle in Jump City, where they dedicated themselves to protecting citizens while juggling the challenges of adolescence. Next to Robin are Starfire (Hynden Walch), an extraterrestrial princess with extraordinary powers, and Raven (Tara Strong), a young woman with mystical abilities inherited from an evil father. Together, they face various threats, ranging from super-villains to interdimensional monsters, while cultivating solid friendships and living hilarious adventures. With epic fighting and nasty situations, this series of animation takes the spectators into a whirlwind of action and laughter, proving that even heroes need moments of lightness.

Lead by former Batman protégé Robin (Scott Menville), they left Gotham City to settle in Jump City, where they dedicated themselves to protecting citizens while juggling the challenges of adolescence. Next to Robin are Starfire (Hynden Walch), an extraterrestrial princess with extraordinary powers, and Raven (Tara Strong), a young woman with mystical abilities inherited from an evil father. Together, they face various threats, ranging from super-villains to interdimensional monsters, while cultivating solid friendships and living hilarious adventures. With epic fighting and nasty situations, this series of animation takes the spectators into a whirlwind of action and laughter, proving that even heroes need moments of lightness.

programme.title: Dodin Buffant's passion
programme.desc: At the end of the 19th century in France, Eugénie (Juliette Binoche) dedicated her life to chef Dodin Bouffant (Benoît Magimel), whose cook she has been faithful for two decades. Renowned for its refined dishes that seduce the greatest personalities of the time, Dodin finds in the presence of Eugénie an indispensable support, both in the vegetable garden and in the kitchens of his prestigious establishment. Their relationship, much more than just professional collaboration, flourishes in a profound complicity that flirts with love, although they have never formalized their union, despite Dodin's repeated proposals. While their daily lives are punctuated by sumptuous dinners for notables, an underlying tension is emerging, revealing the true feelings that unite them. In the face of the demands of high gastronomy and their own desires, Eugene and Dodin must navigate between passion and tradition, questioning the norms of their time.

programme.title: Gangnam project, the K-pop adventure
programme.desc: "Boys, Clothes, Money" Not convinced by the words of Astra's first song, Hannah decides to write something deeper.
programme.desc-more: In the episode "Boys, Clothes, Money" of the series "Gangnam project, the K-pop adventure", Hannah (Julia Kim Caldwell), a young artist in the budding, finds herself confronted with the challenges of the Korean pop music world. While listening to the lyrics of Astra's first song, her band, she feels a deep dissatisfaction with their superficiality. Determined to bring emotional depth to their project, Hannah is engaged in an intense creative process to write words that resonate with her own experiences and aspirations. However, this personal quest led him to explore complex themes such as identity, friendship and pressures in the music industry. In parallel, his relations with his groupmates, including the charismatic Sean (Sean Baek) and the dynamic Taran (Taran Kim), are put to the test, as they sail together in a world where image and success are often a priority over true artistic expression.

programme.title: Gangnam project, the K-pop adventure
programme.desc: "K-drama familial"An unexpected visitor arrives in Korea and questions everything Hannah thought she knew about her family.
programme.desc-more: In the "K-drama familial" episode of the series "Gangnam project, the K-pop adventure", the heroine Hannah (Julia Kim Caldwell) is confronted with an unexpected upheaval when the arrival of a mysterious visitor in Korea questions everything she thought she knew about her family background. As she navigates the glamorous and competitive world of K-pop, Hannah discovers buried secrets that could change her life forever. This newcomer, linked to his past, raises questions about his identity and family ties. In parallel, Hannah must juggle her artistic ambitions and growing tensions within her family, exacerbated by the shadow of this visitor. As she embarks on a quest to break the mysteries of her roots, Hannah will face difficult choices and redefine what the family really means.

programme.title: Gangnam project, the K-pop adventure
programme.desc: "The interview"Hannah helps a distracted Chan-Mi prepare for an important interview with a potential sponsor of the showcase.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting episode of the series, Hannah, a caring and experienced mentor, is at the heart of the preparations for a crucial interview for her protégé Chan-Mi (Julia Kim Caldwell). The latter, plagued by a persistent distraction, struggles to focus on the stakes of a showcase that could propel her career into the ruthless world of K-pop. As time is running out, Hannah deploys all her skills to help Chan-Mi overcome his doubts and prepare mentally. Together, they review the expectations of potential sponsors, discuss presentation strategies and put in place self-confidence exercises. Their exchanges reveal not only Chan-Mi's ambitions, but also the challenges it faces in the music industry. Through moments of tension and complicity, this episode highlights the importance of support and preparation in the quest for success, while exploring the dynamics of mentoring within the vibrant universe of K-pop.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "Project: Hippocampus"A cat named Jellybean comes to consult Clever: his master, a great violinist, suddenly went mad. He broke his violin and thought he was a baby.
programme.desc-more: In the lively Lexington neighbourhood of London, two inseparable companions, Clever, a lively-minded Indian pig, and Bro, his somewhat impulsive brother, are embarking on captivating police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity and observational skills lead them into mysterious cases that even Scotland Yard has not managed to solve for years. While Clever uses his sagacity to decipher often neglected clues, Bro, with his fervent temperament, does not hesitate to plunge head down into action, leading them to perilous but thrilling situations. Together, they face complex puzzles, ranging from inexplicable disappearances to daring flights, while combining with colourful characters encountered during their adventures. Their friendship and complementarity are tested as they navigate a world where danger and mystery hide at every corner of the street, proving that even the smallest heroes can make a big difference.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The Secret of the Templars" Snowball and Charcoal, Clever's cage neighbors at the pet store, were removed during the night. Clever receives a tablet in his office showing them prisoners.
programme.desc-more: In the lively Lexington district of London, two fearsome investigators, Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and his brother Bro, impulsive and energetic, are attacking mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. Their insatiable curiosity prompts them to explore ancient and complex affairs, mixing legends and hidden truths. Through exciting surveys, they discover clues, meet eccentric characters and navigate a world where danger is rumbling around every corner. The two brothers, although very different in their approach, combine their strengths to thwart the plans of the most clever criminals. Their complicity and team spirit will lead them to surprising revelations, while confronting them with moral dilemmas. In this quest, Clever and Bro demonstrate that even the smallest can accomplish great things when justice is at stake.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The Treasure of the Catacombs"Champollion, the famous archaeologist Sir Arthur Bones parrot, came to ask for help from Clever, because his master was abducted by a humanoid robot.
programme.desc-more: In a world where adventure and mystery are interspersed, Clever, a young amateur detective, finds himself confronted with an unexpected situation when he receives a visit from Champollion, the parrot of Sir Arthur Bones, a renowned archaeologist. Champollion, a panicked man, reveals that his master was abducted by a humanoid robot, an event that seems to have come out of a science fiction story. Intrigued and determined to help, Clever is engaged in an investigation that will lead him to explore ancient catacombs and long-sought secrets. As he investigates, he will discover mysterious clues and forgotten artifacts, while facing unexpected dangers. With the help of his friends, Clever will have to be a cunning and courageous man to thwart the kidnapper's plans and save Sir Arthur. The stakes are high, and each discovery brings it closer to a truth that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: "The Mermaids" In trying to get a package he dropped, Oscar falls head first in the park lake. Malika dives into her suite to save him.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the sumptuous setting of the Palace of Versailles in the seventeenth century, two unexpected companions, Belfort, a young boy with a valiant heart, and Lupin, Louis XIV's beloved dog, embark on fascinating adventures. While the royal residence gardens are dotted with secrets and mysteries, Belfort and Lupin dedicate themselves to the protection of the animals that inhabit the Royal Household and surrounding areas. Their unwavering friendship leads them to face a variety of challenges, ranging from the search for a rare bird in danger to the defense of a young fawn threatened by predators. Each episode leads them into thrilling quests where courage and trickery are of the essence. Between the carelessness of childhood and the majesty of the court, Belfort and Lupin learn valuable life lessons while establishing ties with their feathered and hairy companions, enriching their world of friendship and adventure.
