Each episode sees them navigate through lush gardens, court intrigues and unforeseen dangers, while discovering hidden secrets about the relationships between nobles and their animals. Their unwavering loyalty and team spirit push them to face a variety of challenges, ranging from the release of captive animals to the resolution of mysteries surrounding inexplicable disappearances. Together, they demonstrate that even the most unlikely bonds can lead to acts of bravery and sincere friendship.

programme.desc-more: In the vast and wild Canadian forest, Grizzy, an imposing and cunning brown bear, enjoys a comfortable existence in the forest guard cabin, which he considers his kingdom. When he appropriates the delights of this isolated retreat, he encounters a horde of mischievous and fearless lemmings, small mammals who, although often clumsy, do not retreat in front of anything to counteract Grizzy's plans. These lemmings, with their limited intelligence but their unwavering determination, engage in a series of hilarious confrontations with the bear, competing for the domination of the hut and the treasures it contains. Misadventures are going on as Grizzy faces unexpected challenges, clever traps and nasty situations, while trying to preserve his quiet lifestyle. The struggle between the bear and the lemmings gives rise to moments of burlesque comedy, making each episode a unique and entertaining adventure.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep, the film: the farm counterattack
programme.desc: A sheep meets a nice alien and wants to help him return to his planet when it is the target of a government organization.
programme.desc-more: In the small town of Mossingham, an extraordinary event is being prepared. A spaceship, from a distant galaxy, is landing with difficulty, attracting the attention of an old man and his faithful dog. Meanwhile, Shaun the sheep (voice of Justin Fletcher), mischievous and curious, leads a quiet existence at the farm, surrounded by his friends and under the watchful eye of the farmer and Bitzer, the dog (voice of John Sparkes). The unexpected arrival of an alien, straight out of the ship, disturbs this harmony. This newcomer, with surprising powers, is taking Shaun and his comrades into a series of crazy adventures. As the nonsense accumulates, the animals of the farm must display ingenuity and unity to manage the situation, while discovering the wonders and mysteries of this being coming from elsewhere.

programme.title: Nej' at the Accor Arena
programme.desc: Since his childhood, artist Nej', 29 years old has come a long way. After abandoning her hat in 2022, which allowed her to preserve her intimacy, she opened herself to the world, and now continues the success with records and tours. Her passion for music, nourished by her family environment, led her to crucial encounters like that with Yannick Noah, who propelled her to the stage.

programme.title: The 55th interceltic festival of Lorient - The great show
programme.desc: Laurent Luyat plunges into the heart of the Festival Interceltique de Lorient, whose 55th edition celebrates Cornwall, and celebrates the Celtic and Gaelic culture. The "great show" is the main point of the event. It offers views close to artists, on stage and behind the scenes. The show, which alternates live performances and encounters, reveals to the public the very essence of Celtic cultures, not to mention gathering the anecdotes and confidences of the 500 participating artists.

programme.title: The real family
programme.desc: A couple who raise a young boy entrusted by social assistance cannot overcome their sentence after his return to their father.
programme.desc-more: In the idyllic setting of a beachside campsite, where the children's laughter mix with the sound of the waves, Anna (Mélanie Thierry) and Driss (Lyes Salem) enjoy the last moments of family holidays. Around them, they gravitate their two sons, Jules and Adrien, as well as Simon, a six-year-old boy with a malicious smile, whom they have raised with love since he was barely eighteen months old. For Anna, Driss and the children, Simon is an integral part of their home, a solid family balance, built day after day in tenderness and complicity. But this harmony is about to be shaken by a phone call that will change everything. Eddie (Félix Moati), Simon's biological father, resurfaces after months of absence and instability. This time, he's determined: he wants his son's custody back. Anna's news is a shock. How can we accept the idea of seeing this child who she loved, raised and protected as her own? Between the legal procedures, Eddie's expectations and Simon's rights, she finds herself caught in an emotional vice, torn between her mother's instinct and the implacable reality of a system that leaves little room for the nuances of the heart.

programme.title: Surfing, the sacred fire
programme.desc: The surf competition of the Olympic Games in Paris 2024 is taking place far from the capital in Tahiti, French Polynesia, where this ancestral Polynesian tradition began, and finally imposed itself as a worldwide activity. At the beginning, it was fought by the Westerns, and finally became an object of emancipation throughout the eras, being embodied by legendary characters who marked the political and cultural history of this nautical activity.

programme.title: Billie Eilish, her French story
programme.desc: This documentary traces the unique relationship between singer Billie Eilish and France. Testimonials, archival images and music excerpts depict an exceptional artist. Billie, the first star born after 2000 to conquer the planet, embodies a whole generation with her style, sincerity and intimate texts. From "SoundCloud" to the Grammy Awards, she successfully shook the music industry. Icon queer, vegan and feminist, she sang for the closing of the Olympics 2024 since California. An exciting "French Story", told by its fans, artists and experts.

programme.title: Gangnam project, the K-pop adventure
programme.desc: In this intense episode of "Gangnam Project, the K-pop adventure", tension reaches its peak while Hannah (Julia Kim Caldwell), Sun Hee (Angela Son) and Mina (M.J. Kang) find themselves in a difficult situation. In the absence of their charismatic leader, the three young artists face growing disagreements that threaten their cohesion and performance during rehearsals for a crucial showcase. Each individual's personal ambitions are beginning to emerge, exacerbating rivalries and testing their nascent friendship. Hannah, determined to prove her worth, is confronted with Mina's sometimes naive optimism, while Sun Hee, more pragmatic, tries to maintain a semblance of harmony. As the hours of repetition go by, disagreements turn into open confrontations, revealing the real motivations of each. This internal conflict may well have disastrous consequences for their future in the competitive world of K-pop.

programme.title: Gangnam project, the K-pop adventure
programme.desc: In an exciting showcase, the emerging talents of K-pop compete for the attention of the public and the music industry. Astra, a young prodigy, is literally amazed by the performance of a group, but her enthusiasm is quickly darkened by a series of unexpected challenges. Hannah, a faithful friend of Astra, realizes that the stakes are higher than they seem and that success does not come without sacrifices. In the face of growing pressure and the need to stand out in this competitive environment, Hannah is developing a bold B plan. She desperately seeks help from her allies, including Zeberia, an experienced mentor, and Sean Baek, a former allied competitor. Together, they will have to navigate through the intrigues and rivalries that characterize the ruthless world of K-pop, while discovering the strength of friendship and resilience to adversity.

programme.title: Great detectives!
programme.sub-title: The Case of the Curious News
programme.desc: Four teenagers decide to create their detective agency: this is the beginning of a series of adventures.
programme.desc-more: In a small Australian city, a group of four pre-teens with a keen sense of justice and insatiable curiosity unite to found their own detective agency. Composed of the intelligent and determined Abby (Abby Bergman), the brilliant Aston (Aston Droomer), the russy Jamil (Jamil Smyth-Secka) and the creative Anna (Anna Cooke), this group of friends embarks on a series of captivating investigations that lead them to solve mysteries around their school and neighbourhood. Each episode confronts them with various puzzles, ranging from the disappearance of personal objects to disturbing rumours that disturb the peace of their establishment. As they strive to thwart clever ploys and discover the truth, young detectives must also navigate the challenges of friendship, loyalty and school rivalries. With an unwavering team spirit, they face unexpected obstacles, testing their investigative skills and their ability to remain united against adversity. "Super detectives!" plunges spectators into a thrilling universe where every investigation is a full-fledged adventure, filled with suspense and humour. Young heroes learn that solving mysteries is not only a matter of intelligence, but also of courage and solidarity.

programme.title: Vegetosaur
programme.desc: In a colorful and vibrant prehistoric world, Ginger, a young trimartopos full of curiosity and energy, makes the unexpected encounter of a group of small Rex Peas, mischievous and endearing creatures. At first, their differences seem insurmountable, but quickly, a sincere friendship is forged between them, pushing them to explore together the wonders of their environment. Through thrilling adventures, Ginger and his new friends discover the value of mutual help and understanding, while facing the challenges that nature holds for them. The small Rex Peas, with their sense of humour and team spirit, learn to appreciate Ginger's unique qualities, while she turns out to be an unexpected leader. Together, they will have to overcome obstacles and misunderstandings, proving that friendship can transcend all differences, and that each individual, regardless of his or her size or appearance, has a vital role to play in the world around them.

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: When a danger occurs or there is a serious problem in the forest, the jungle Aces are there to try to find a solution.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.desc: When a danger occurs or there is a serious problem in the forest, the jungle Aces are there to try to find a solution.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a sharp sense of observation, and his brother Bro, a little impulsive, are embarking on bold police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity and their natural instinct to solve mysteries push them to explore business that even Scotland Yard struggles to elucidate. Together, they decipher complex puzzles and face perilous situations, while using their trickery and team spirit. Clever, with his intelligence and attention to detail, contrasts with Bro's fervour temperament, creating a captivating dynamic between the two characters. As they go through their adventures, they discover a network of intrigues that drags them into theft, deceit and secrets that are well guarded. Their quest for truth leads them to rub themselves with mysterious characters and unexpected situations, proving that even the smallest can have a great impact on the world around them.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In a mysterious London, a disturbing event shakes the royal court when, in the middle of the night, a feline with a spotted coat and surprisingly long claws bursts into the Queen's room (Barbara Scaff). This serval, wearing a carved mask that gives it a enigmatic look, attacks the peace of the monarchy by disappearing with the sovereign. The alert is quickly given and a complex investigation is under way, involving members of the Royal Guard and city detectives. Andy Chase is a clever detective, determined to break the mystery behind this intriguing creature and find the Queen before it's too late. As the investigation proceeds, hidden secrets, unexpected alliances and surprising revelations emerge, plunging the spectator into an atmosphere of tension and intrigue where each clue could be the key to the resolution of this bold flight.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole wants to go to the fireworks. Unfortunately, that night, he and his little sister were guarded by Mylène Bombix, who did not want to move.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: The herd accidentally eats the farmer's surprise cake on his birthday. Shaun needs to find some ingredients to prepare another.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the sumptuous gardens of the Palace of Versailles in the seventeenth century, two unlikely companions, Belfort, a faithful dog of King Louis XIV, and Lupin, a daring wolf, formed an inseparable team. Their friendship leads them to extraordinary adventures, where their courage and ingenuity are tested. Together, they travel the green alleys of the royal residence, launching rescue missions to rescue animals in distress, whether they are from the Royal Household or from the surrounding forests. Their quest leads them through intriguing mysteries and unexpected encounters, while highlighting the richness of animal life at that time. In a fascinating historical setting, Belfort and Lupin discover not only the importance of friendship and loyalty, but also the challenges of protecting those who have no voice. Each episode brings them a little closer to the soul of Versailles and its secrets.
programme.desc-more: Belfort & Lupin (2023)

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the lively city of Belfort, the atmosphere warms up when the rosary of the King, an eccentric artist, begins to create a flamboyant hat decorated with ostrich feathers. This capricious ambition arouses the concern of two ladies of the high society, Madame Du Bec (Nathalie Homs) and Madame De Buc (Barbara Tissier), who see this as a danger to their status and reputation. Fearing that this new trend would destabilize the classical elegance of their circle, they decided to do everything possible to sabotage the chapelier's project. In a frantic race against the clock, the two women develop schemes to counter the designer's plans, leading them to a parade of colourful characters, including the faithful assistant of the chapelier (Guillaume Beaujolais) and a young apprentice (Hugo Brunswick) who wanted to prove his worth. Tensions rise as each one confronts each other in a ballet of intrigues and quiproquos, revealing the hidden undersides of the high society.
programme.desc-more: Belfort & Lupin (2023)
programme.desc: Belfort & Lupin (2023)

programme.title: It's still not a witch.
programme.desc: Kimi has just built a house in paste to shape, but Mathieu's unfortunate dance step has reduced his work to crumbs. Convinced that concrete would be a much better option, Mathieu quickly came up against a reality: did he only know how to make concrete? This is the beginning of a fascinating double investigation! While Mathieu is exploring the secrets of the manufacture of modern concrete, Kimi plunges into history to explore the mystery of legendary Roman concrete, this ancient material far more resistant than one imagines.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of the "Mulusco" series, Molusco, an eccentric and daring character, is embarking on a quest to recover a precious video game that he previously took to the nerds the same morning. However, his mission becomes complicated when he discovers that these same nerds had the same idea and head to Ozzy's house to recover their property. What seemed to be a simple getaway quickly turns into a real chaos when a multitude of Ozzy, each with distinct traits and diverse personalities, invades the house. The situation becomes critical: if the different versions of Ozzy cross, this could lead to an inevitable disaster. Molusco will have to navigate through this growing confusion, while avoiding explosive encounters between these multiple incarnations of Ozzy, to achieve its objective without the world going into disorder.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the "Mousco" series, Lola devotes herself to the manufacture of leg prosthetics for Coco, a sparkling character who finds a new joy to live by juggling with a ball. Lola's creativity quickly attracts the attention of Molusco and Rafik, who see Coco as a real lucrative opportunity. By entering a juggling contest, they already imagine the glory and rewards that could result. However, their enthusiasm turns into disaster when the situation is beyond control. Coco, now under pressure from a dangerous mafia, finds himself trapped in a dark world where entertainment is mixed with the threat. The episode explores the themes of ambition, friendship and the unexpected consequences of choices. As Coco struggles to escape this grip, the real intentions of those around him begin to reveal themselves, adding palpable tension to the plot.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Rafik and Molusco, two young friends seeking recognition, feel marginalized in the face of the appeal of the nerds and their famous detective club, which never fails to attract the attention of girls. They are jealous of their popularity and decide to embark on the adventure by creating their own club of investigators. With the help of Coco, a passionate police series, they are putting in place an ambitious plan to impress their friends and family. Their initiative quickly grew and they began to solve mysteries, attracting the attention of their comrades. However, their enthusiasm is tested when the cases they are trying to resolve are more complex than they anticipated. Between rivalries, false leads and unexpected twists, Rafik and Molusco will have to learn to work as a team and face their own weaknesses to prove their value and gain respect for their peers.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the "Mulusco" series, Molusco and Rafik face a major challenge: preparing a cake for a school duty. In the face of their lack of culinary experience, they decided to appeal to Mamie Pétula, Rafik's grandmother, who was known for her pastry skills. The call to Grandma Pétula triggers a series of crazy and unexpected situations, as the two friends try to follow her eccentric advice to the letter. Between unlikely ingredients and surprising cooking methods, their cuisine is transformed into a veritable laboratory of culinary experiences. The adventures are bound up as the two boys juggle with the expectations of their teacher and the whims of a farfetched recipe. As preparation progresses, they discover not only the secrets of pastry, but also the importance of mutual help and creativity, while facing hilarious and unexpected situations.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In a world where adventure and mystery are interspersed, Clever, a young amateur detective, finds himself confronted with an unexpected situation when he receives a visit from Champollion, the parrot of Sir Arthur Bones, a renowned archaeologist. Champollion, a panicked man, reveals that his master was abducted by a humanoid robot, an event that seems to have come out of a science fiction story. Intrigued and determined to help, Clever is engaged in an investigation that will lead him to explore ancient catacombs and long-sought secrets. As he investigates, he will discover mysterious clues and forgotten artifacts, while facing unexpected dangers. With the help of his friends, Clever will have to be a cunning and courageous man to thwart the kidnapper's plans and save Sir Arthur. The stakes are high, and each discovery brings it closer to a truth that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a sharp sense of observation, and his brother Bro, a little impulsive, are embarking on bold police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity and their natural instinct to solve mysteries push them to explore business that even Scotland Yard struggles to elucidate. Together, they decipher complex puzzles and face perilous situations, while using their trickery and team spirit. Clever, with his intelligence and attention to detail, contrasts with Bro's fervour temperament, creating a captivating dynamic between the two characters. As they go through their adventures, they discover a network of intrigues that drags them into theft, deceit and secrets that are well guarded. Their quest for truth leads them to rub themselves with mysterious characters and unexpected situations, proving that even the smallest can have a great impact on the world around them.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: The treasures of the Paris of the Belle Epoque
programme.desc: From 1880 to 1914, Paris became the capital of the world. During the Belle Epoque, a new generation of artists seeking freedom came from around the world to express their creativity in areas such as architecture, decorative arts, jewellery and advertising. The Paris of this flourishing era will also shape the mythical figure of Parisienne. As the dancers of the French cancan fascinate their audience, Paris celebrates progress and modernity by hosting the largest universal exhibition in history. This documentary explores these treasures of the Paris de la Belle Epoque.

programme.title: The metamorphoses of the Grand Palais
programme.desc: Inaugurated for the Universal Exhibition of 1900 and built to "the glory of French art", the Grand Palais is currently experiencing the greatest renovations of its history. The monument, which was designed to host the major artistic events, is being re-established to host the largest sporting event, the Olympic Games of 2024, where the fencing and taekwondo events will take place. This documentary traces the history of this building and its many past and future renovations.

programme.title: Medici's Will

For his last day, he calls his son Laurent, whom he sees only too little and reveals to him a well-kept secret: the true story of Mona Lisa. Then begins a fascinating journey through time, where artistic mysteries and family secrets interlace, forever shaking Laurent's vision of art... and its origins.

programme.title: Second hand... first of class?
programme.desc: Repairing rather than throwing and "upcycling" rather than buying new, the circular economy is becoming more and more popular with the French.
programme.desc-more: The second hand has the wind in France. In Saint-Herblain, private individuals sell their effects in a covered attic vacuum, year round. Romain Chassagne, a brocante lover, imported this concept from Finland, and opened about 60 brands across the country. Other shops sell the products by kilo. Beyond the used clothing, the second hand touches other sectors: luxury, building, household appliances... But this market is not always virtuous, and the circular economy also has its shortcomings.

programme.title: Jamy's World
programme.sub-title: Climate warming: will our roads hold?
programme.desc: Global warming is putting a severe strain on the road network. From Normandy to the Alps, from Cantal to Ardèche, Jamy meets those who secure the roads.
programme.desc-more: Roads cracked by drought, bridges weakened by floods, landslides on mountain roads: global warming is putting the road network to great test, increasing the risk of accidents. From Normandy to the Alps, from Cantal to Ardèche, Jamy drives to meet those who secure the roads. New ways are being put in place to address the effects of heat and drought, but at what cost? And above all, are they effective? What are the protection nets worth on our mountain roads? How can we avoid a disaster in France like that of the Genoa Bridge? Jamy is witnessing impressive life-size tests on protective devices.

programme.title: Catherine Leroy, a French woman in the Vietnam War
programme.desc: At 21, without experience, young photographer Catherine Leroy left alone to cover the Vietnam War. His photographs are of a staggering depth.
programme.desc-more: Catherine Leroy was one of the few women photographers who covered the Vietnam War between 1966 and 1968. At 21, she had no experience, and decided to leave everything to go as close to the hostilities as possible. His photos, of a staggering proximity, tell of a war seen by a fearless young woman who, alone among soldiers of her age, was able to capture the reality of combat with force and humanity. While Vietnam was its first land, it continued its work on other fronts until the 1990s. Catherine Leroy imposed her look before being forgotten.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: The series follows Bluey, an anthropomorphic six-year-old puppy, an Australian Bouvier, characterized by its abundance of energy, imagination and curiosity.
programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Silence, It Grows!
programme.desc: Meeting - Louise Gros The engravings of Louise Gros take shape by a set of superpositions, where details emerge as the various stages take place. programme.title: Jamy's World
programme.sub-title: Car, plane, climate: can we still travel?
programme.desc: The private sector is in the midst of a revolution. In France and Austria, Jamy Gourmaud tests these more environmentally friendly modes of travel.
programme.desc-more: Jamy explores the transportation problem, the main contributors to global warming, and options for moving in the near future. Originally presented as the vehicle of the future, the electric car is now very controversial. For longer journeys, the train seeks to credibly become a serious alternative to the aircraft. For daily trips, bikes and carpooling are the obvious solutions for the planet and the congestion of our cities but still have work to convince as many people as possible.

programme.title: Encorred, 200 in the look of Chamonix guides
programme.desc: A look back at the history of the Chamonix Guide Company, evoking the unheard-of challenges it has faced with dignity and those it now faces.
programme.desc-more: The history of the Chamonix guide company is inseparable from that of mountaineering and the valley that saw it born. Over the past 200 years, guides have been able to meet many challenges, making their organization a myth. They are today the actors of a changing mountain: surfership, global warming, loss of freedom, the causes are multiple. This film is at a crossroads. Between tradition and modernity, he traces the history of the Chamonix Guides Company, evoking the unheard-of challenges she has met with dignity and those she now faces.

programme.desc: A common feature of the continent's Croatia and the Adriatic, Istria is a peninsula in the northwestern part of the country. Many peoples have left their mark on it. Unveiling its seafood, truffles, olive oil and great wines, the peninsula offers Tiga a paradise for its taste buds.
programme.desc-more: A common feature between mainland Croatia and the Adriatic, Istria is a peninsula in the northwestern part of the country. This territory that takes place in the Adriatic is a land of cultural interweaving and contrasts thanks to its geographical location. Many people have left their mark on it, and the most important influence is that of Venice. Today, the coastal towns of the peninsula are still imbued with Italian architectural and cultural heritage. Using its freshly fished seafood, its divine truffles, its wonderful olive oil and its great wines, the peninsula will offer Tiga a true paradise for its taste buds... programme.title: Beautiful escapes
programme.sub-title: The Cevennes, a return to the sources
programme.desc: The territory of the Cevennes covers four massifs: Mount Lozère, Causse-Méjean, the Cevenole valleys and Mount Aigoual. It is the only French National Park inhabited. It offers remarkable landscapes shaped by man and nature. Its assets are increasingly attracting supporters of a simpler life.
programme.desc-more: Located in the Central Massif, the Cevennes offer exceptional places surrounded by large preserved natural spaces. A destination of choice for those who support a simpler life, wishing to get away from the big cities. This territory, forming a mountain range, has its National Park, the only one inhabited in France. The park, along with a large part of the Cevennes, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Subjects: Stevenson's Road History • Made in Cevennes • Change of life • Here it is the Cevennes • Wildlife • Living in isolation.

programme.title: The Docs of La Grande Librairie
programme.desc: Victor Hugo's words and the ideals that permeate his works always resonate with current social, cultural and political concerns.
programme.desc-more: Victor Hugo is an undisputed figure of French literature, and he is a name that resonates throughout the centuries. Whether it is through his novels, their countless adaptations or the ubiquitous references to his work, he left an indelible imprint in literary history. But Hugo was not only a writer, he was also a man of political commitment, a defender of the oppressed, whose ideals permeate his works and give them a resonance that traverses the generations. His life, marked by dramatic events, and his exceptional longevity nourished his legend, propelling his influence far beyond his time.

programme.desc: Ten years after the advent of the #MeToo movement, this survey demonstrates how the Hollywood film industry continues to discredit the voice of actresses.
programme.desc-more: Almost ten years after the #MeToo movement came into existence, this survey demonstrates how Hollywood continues to stifle women's speech. If the system has been flickering, it has not disappeared, but reorganized. Today, to silence actresses, a new method has become necessary: online denigration campaigns. The actress Blake Lively was victimized after she denounced the atmosphere of one of her films. From hundreds of private exchanges, from the audience of the actress and the man she accuses, the investigation reveals the workings of a new economy of influence, in which press attachés, crisis communicators, bloggers, youtubers and influencers can help shape, and sometimes destroy, a reputation.

programme.title: On behalf of the lost children
programme.desc: In the 1930s, the great reporter Alexis Danan began a long fight to secure the closure of the children's bagnes in France.
programme.desc-more: In 1934, 56 young prisoners, aged 13 to 21, rebelled and escaped in the Belle-Ile-en-Mer correction house. Hunted by the inhabitants, fishermen and estivants, they are captured and violently punished. The case is scandalous and moves France as a whole. Alexis Danan, a great reporter in Paris-Soir, then launched himself in the fight of his life: denouncing the inhuman conditions of these children's bagnes, awakening opinion and getting the closure of these "houses of tortures". The terrible testimonies and revelations he delivers shake the country. Several detention centres were closing and the first reforms of juvenile justice were finally being implemented.

programme.title: Route 66, an American legend
programme.desc: A century after its creation, Route 66, which connects Chicago and Los Angeles, remains a collective fiction powerful enough to continue to tell America.
programme.desc-more: Drive 66 runs nearly four thousand kilometres from the Midwest to the Pacific, through the Oklahoma Plains and Arizona deserts, and runs between Chicago and Los Angeles. But this film is neither a travel guide nor a historical documentary in the classical sense, it tells how an asphalt ribbon has become a real American fiction. The road was removed from federal records in 1985, and became a heritage with Historic Route 66, but it was mainly through images that it survived. A century after its creation, it remains a collective fiction, powerful enough to continue to tell America, its dreams of freedom as its contradictions.

programme.title: ICE, the hunt for man
programme.desc: This investigation deciphers the system of the ICE in the United States, which turns migrants into enemies and uses fear as a formidable political tool.
programme.desc-more: The American border no longer draws the contour of the country. She's been through him now. Since Donald Trump's return to power, she has come to the corner of the streets, in front of houses, in schools and at the exit of the courts. Thanks to exceptional access, the film follows ICE leaders and their agents on the ground, where lives become "targets" and arrests of "good results". To understand how this federal agency, born after September 11, changed its nature as much as it changed its scale, the investigation dates back to its history, decrypts its methods, follows the money that finances its expansion and traces the journey of its agents.

programme.title: A life of manchot
programme.desc: The penguins of the Crozet Islands disappear. Researchers try to identify the reasons for these mass disappearances by following some of these birds.
programme.desc-more: On the Crozet archipelago, lost to the south of the Indian Ocean, the populations of royal penguins are changing curiously from island to island. Are these seabirds victims of predators like orcas, scavengers like giant petrels or other more devious causes? To discover this mystery, researchers identify and follow some of these tireless swimmers.

programme.title: Jamy's World
programme.sub-title: Climate warming: will our roads hold?
programme.desc: Global warming is putting a severe strain on the road network. From Normandy to the Alps, from Cantal to Ardèche, Jamy meets those who secure the roads.
programme.desc-more: Roads cracked by drought, bridges weakened by floods, landslides on mountain roads: global warming is putting the road network to great test, increasing the risk of accidents. From Normandy to the Alps, from Cantal to Ardèche, Jamy drives to meet those who secure the roads. New ways are being put in place to address the effects of heat and drought, but at what cost? And above all, are they effective? What are the protection nets worth on our mountain roads? How can we avoid a disaster in France like that of the Genoa Bridge? Jamy is witnessing impressive life-size tests on protective devices.

programme.title: On the casoar track
programme.desc: In New Guinea, a film crew accompanies a group of Kasua, who are looking for the casoar, a giant key-to-be bird in their world.
programme.desc-more: Anthropologist Florence Brunois-Pasina takes a film crew to the borders of inner Papua New Guinea to immerse themselves in the Kasua people, whom she has been around for 30 years. Guided by their hosts in the primary tropical forest, they set off together on the casoar trail. This large, considered dangerous terrestrial bird is considered by the natives as the great gardener of the forest. He disperses the seeds, a skill that gives him a role as sower and connector of the forest sectors, as well as as a nourisher of the Kasuas who live from the collection and gathering. Neither god nor totem, the casoar is a cornerstone of their world.

programme.title: White Torture
programme.desc: In its prisons, the Iranian Mullah regime uses white torture, a mechanism of psychological destruction, to break political prisoners.
programme.desc-more: White torture is the one that involves placing an individual in total isolation, between 4 white walls and without natural light, for a long period of time. The Iranian authorities use it to obtain confessions from detainees and impose heavy sentences, sometimes to the point of death. This documentary is the mouthpiece of sixteen former prisoners, both men and women, who have been subjected to torture, some for several hundred days. Activists and former political prisoners filed complaints against their jailers.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

Determined to save their corner of paradise, young heroes turn into true vigilantes, using their ingenuity and courage to thwart the plans of this antagonist. As they go on their journey, they discover the importance of friendship, solidarity and environmental protection. By engaging in a series of exciting missions, they will have to overcome challenges and face perilous situations while remaining faithful to their values. Their quest to preserve the farm will lead them to realize that even the smallest of us can make a big difference when we act together.

programme.title: The fabulous history of birds, dinosaurs among us
programme.desc: A review of the history of birds that, after surviving the last great extinction, have become one of the most diverse species on the planet.
programme.desc-more: Daniel Field, a specialist in paleo-ornithology at Cambridge University, is working on the reconstruction of the major stages of bird evolution, the last survivors of the disaster that led to the extinction of their cousins dinosaurs. In 2019, he found in a fossil the crane of the oldest modern bird ever discovered. Now, research focuses on the reasons for their survival for millions of years and on their colonization of our planet. However, many of the 11,000 species of birds that inhabit the Earth today are threatened with extinction.

programme.title: Winning return for the kitchen of old
programme.desc: Family cuisine, simmered dishes and the comforting side of Proust made a remarkable return to the table of great chefs and amateur cooks.
programme.desc-more: Once put in the old grimoires, the recipes of old make a frantic return today on social networks, in bookstores and in starred restaurants. This phenomenon, which combines nostalgia, a quest for meaning, conviviality and eco-responsible approach, demonstrates a deep need to reconnect with our roots but also with "good eating". Constance has made her 86-year-old Mamou a social media star by filming her preparing her family recipes. Some restaurateurs, like Jean Sévénes, surf on their childhood memories. Elsewhere, others do not hesitate to rehabilitate the offal or to put the soup in fashion.

programme.title: Farm products: to drink and eat?
programme.desc: From markets to supermarkets, from mountain farms to mega-farms, from artisans to industrialists, research behind the scenes of the production of "farmers" products.
programme.desc-more: Farm products represent 4 billion euros in turnover each year in France. Farmers' and producer's co-operative markets are growing, and even large areas offer wide ranges of farm products in their shelves. In the consumer imagination, these products oppose industrial agriculture and are based on all the virtues. The reality is more contrasted. Apart from a few very well-structured sectors, the regulation that defines the farmer label is vague and not binding. To be entitled to it, we must produce and transform on the farm, defined as a single geographical entity.

Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.desc: Simon and Lou want to play figurines, but Gaspard presses them to make a hide-and-seek with him. He insists, over and over again, convinced that Simon and Lou will never find him. Challenged, the two buddies end up getting into the game: of course they'll find it!
programme.desc-more: In the episode entitled "Professor Wolf's Game", Simon (the fearless hero) and his gang of friends are facing a captivating challenge. During a school trip, they discover a mysterious board game left by Professor Wolf, an eccentric teacher whose passion for puzzles and adventures made him famous. Intrigued, Simon, accompanied by Super Lou, Super Ferdi and Captain Rabbit, decides to explore the rules of the game, which seem to plunge them into a parallel universe filled with challenges and puzzles to solve. Using their respective skills, they will have to demonstrate courage, creativity and teamwork to overcome the obstacles ahead. As they move forward in the game, the boundary between reality and fiction becomes narrower, and they realize that each choice can have unexpected consequences. Children will learn the importance of friendship and collaboration in this thrilling adventure.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa loves jumping with feet in mud puddles with her pair of golden boots, which Suzy finds rather yellow. It's a good day, because it's the day of the big jump contest in mud puddles. But Mrs Duck takes advantage of the snack to chew Peppa's boots and run away. With the help of his family and friends, Peppa is pursuing the thief...
programme.desc-more: Peppa Pig is a little slut full of life and energy that invites young viewers to dive into her colorful and playful world. With his little brother George (Harley Bird), his mom Pig (Morwenna Banks) and his dad Pig (Richard Ridings), Peppa explores the world around him with curiosity and a touch of impertinence. Each episode presents daily situations, ranging from games in the mud to visits to friends, farm adventures or beach trips. The characters meet friends such as Suzy Sheep (Lily Snowden-Fine) and Danny Dog, each bringing a unique touch to the stories. Through lessons on friendship, family and imagination, Peppa and her loved ones discover the joy of the little moments of life, often punctuated with laughter and surprises. This animated series, delicate and full of humor, captivated the hearts of children while awakening their curiosity about the world.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: At school, at home or at the playground, Peppa Pig and his friends go from discovery to discovery. Every adventure is a pretext to have fun and learn.
programme.desc-more: Peppa is a mischievous and dynamic pig girl who lives on rewarding adventures with her family, composed of her little brother George, her mom Pig and her dad Pig. In a colorful and fun world, Peppa and George explore their environment while learning to express their emotions and interact with others. Their days are punctuated with games in mud puddles, visits to friends like Suzy Sheep and Pedro Pony, and exciting discoveries, whether by painting, playing hide-and-seek or going to the farm. Through these moments of complicity, young spectators are invited to discover the values of friendship, family and curiosity. Awarded by a BAFTA Award in 2005 for its quality of pre-school animation, this exciting series offers an educational and entertaining universe for toddlers.

programme.title: At the end it's the sea
programme.desc: François Pécheux descends the St. Lawrence, a Canadian river 1200 kilometres long, meeting those living on its shores or on the water.
programme.desc-more: François Pêcheux takes us to Lake Saint Laurent in Canada. His journey begins with a friendly meeting and a plane trip. Departure from Lake Ontario, stops at Gananoque to sail on a luxury boat. His route continued to Montreal, where he faced the void during his meeting with a glass washer specializing in large buildings. Then it was in Quèbec that he met two lovers of freedom and wood who showed him their unusual home, nestled in the swamps. Last stop at Tadoussac to observe whales.

programme.title: Lucky Luke
programme.desc: In a few years, Daisy Town has become a huge no man's land where gangsters Billy The Kid and Pat Poker are making terror reign with colts. Because he was born in this far west town, Lucky Luke is sent to the scene to restore order. There, he meets some of his old enemies...
programme.desc-more: To ensure a new success in the elections, the President of the United States wants to complete the work of the railway linking the East coast to the West coast. The inauguration will take place in Daisy Town. But in a few years, the city has become a den of bandits, among them the dangerous Billy the Kid and Pat Poker. Lucky Luke is in charge of restoring order. But the cowboy has never returned to Daisy Town since his parents died, killed in front of his eyes when he was a child. On the spot, he meets old enemies like Jesse James or Calamity Jane, but also love in the person of Belle Starr.

programme.title: C tonight
programme.desc: From Monday to Thursday, "C tonight" gives the floor to researchers, artists and intellectuals from all walks of life. The program is built around a political or social subject that has made the news of the day. This debate allows us to deepen our reflection on this event with the aim of enlightening the complexity of the world.
programme.desc-more: With French people more concerned than ever about the repercussions of the various political, health, social, economic, energy and war crises in Ukraine and the Middle East, intellectuals, artists and protagonists at the centre of the news come to bring their expertise to a debate. Karim Rissouli and Camille Diao, accompanied either by Laure Adler or Arthur Chevallier, receive several guests who provide answers to the questions that are topical while revealing their ideas. Ideas are the stars of this event, which highlights a diversity of views on the complexity of the world.

programme.title: A year on Earth
programme.desc: "Spring Renewal"In the savannah, as in the California desert, in Asia or on an island in the Indian Ocean, the return of spring is the time for animal renewal.
programme.desc-more: By turning around the sun, our planet exposes its surface to the creative energy of the seasons. This revolution shapes all life on Earth, offering as many opportunities as challenges for the animal kingdom. From the Arctic to tropical areas, discovering wildlife adaptations and behaviors in the spring with leatherback turtles, hummingbirds from Costa, Kenya, elephants from Botswana, and Douc primates in Vietnam.

programme.title: A year on Earth
programme.desc: "Summer, time of abundance"On earth as in the oceans, summer is a season of feasts as well as famine, fires and torrential rains.
programme.desc-more: Summer is a time of prosperity for some animals and a period of great danger for others around the world. In the northern hemisphere, all shots are allowed between rodents in Canada while Chinese pandas survive with bamboo and Manta rays and cleaner fish pair in Maldives waters. In the southern hemisphere, the great migration of the gnomes and zebras is not without its encumbrance, while the elephants use their memory to find water in Africa and the wildlife of Australia are preparing for large fires.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: "The folk music band" Peppa is a lovely pig chipy who lives with her brother George, Mom Pig and Papa Pig. What Peppa prefers is to play, dress up, walk outside and jump in the mud. His adventures always end happily, in a concert of laughter and "Groin".
programme.desc-more: Peppa is a little mischievous slut who shares her daily life with her family in a colorful and playful world. Surrounded by her little brother George, Mom Pig and Papa Pig, she explores the world around her with curiosity and enthusiasm. Both children embark on daily adventures, whether they jump into mud puddles, visit the zoo or play with their friends. Through fun and sometimes nasty situations, Peppa and George discover the simple joys of life, learning to express their emotions and develop their vocabulary. The themes of friendship, family and learning are at the heart of each episode, offering young spectators valuable lessons while entertaining them. The series, which won a BAFTA Award in 2005 for its quality of animation, continues to captivate children from all over the world with its endearing characters and fantasy stories.

programme.title: Second hand... first of class?
programme.desc: Repairing rather than throwing and "upcycling" rather than buying new, the circular economy is becoming more and more popular with the French.
programme.desc-more: The second hand has the wind in France. In Saint-Herblain, private individuals sell their effects in a covered attic vacuum, year round. Romain Chassagne, a brocante lover, imported this concept from Finland, and opened about 60 brands across the country. Other shops sell the products by kilo. Beyond the used clothing, the second hand touches other sectors: luxury, building, household appliances... But this market is not always virtuous, and the circular economy also has its shortcomings.

programme.title: Catherine Leroy, a French woman in the Vietnam War
programme.desc: At 21, without experience, young photographer Catherine Leroy left alone to cover the Vietnam War. His photographs are of a staggering depth.
programme.desc-more: Catherine Leroy was one of the few women photographers who covered the Vietnam War between 1966 and 1968. At 21, she had no experience, and decided to leave everything to go as close to the hostilities as possible. His photos, of a staggering proximity, tell of a war seen by a fearless young woman who, alone among soldiers of her age, was able to capture the reality of combat with force and humanity. While Vietnam was its first land, it continued its work on other fronts until the 1990s. Catherine Leroy imposed her look before being forgotten.

programme.title: Beautiful escapes
programme.desc: Tanzania is a wild sanctuary, with breathtaking landscapes, and magical face-to-faces with lions, zebras, buffaloes or giraffes, totem animals from this East African country. It is by entering villages, off the beaten track, that a whole different face is revealed. The country has more than 120 ethnic groups and almost as many languages. Finally, the Zanzibar archipelago is the farniente touch of this journey. With its architecture, spice farms and white sandy beaches, this destination is a must. Jérôme Pitorin begins his stay in a ULM, alongside Cédrick, an unconditional lover of Zanzibar.
programme.desc-more: Jérôme Pitorin is exploring Tanzania, a country of the most incredible fauna and flora in East Africa, and its Zanzibar archipelago, with its paradise beaches bordered by the clear and turquoise blue waters of the Indian Ocean. More than 120 ethnic groups live in Tanzania, for almost as many languages. Topics: Zanzibar beaches • Success dream in Dar Es Salaam • Edgar, green entrepreneur at 15 years of age • University of Wildlife • The repentant poachers • Meet the Kilimanjaro, the Tanzanian giant.

programme.title: The Lost Amazonian Civilization
programme.desc: In the Amazon rainforest, a team of archaeologists and botanists are looking for traces of a thousand-year-old and extinct civilization.
programme.desc-more: In the Colombian Amazonian forest, the French archaeologist Stéphen Rostain goes on the trail of the first Indians who, according to him, migrated and lived on these lands 13,000 years ago. If many d-archaeologists doubt this theory, the best evidence available to Stéphen is a rock fortress covered with paint based on mineral pigments. While the origin and meaning of these signs are still widely open to interpretation, they represent a wildlife much different from that we know.

programme.desc: In the Allier department, the village of Echasses is home to a treasure: one of the largest lithium deposits in Europe. We'd have to open a mine to operate it.
programme.desc-more: In the Allier department, the village of Echasses is home to a treasure: one of the largest lithium deposits in Europe. To exploit this metal, which is essential for electric car batteries, the French company Imerys plans to open an underground mine. A huge project with the aim of producing 34,000 tonnes of lithium hydroxide each year, which is equipping 700,000 vehicles per year. Strategic for France, but also for Europe, this project is presented as a solution to overcome the dependence on critical metals while accelerating the energy transition.

programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.desc: "Never again, never again in life"Accompanied by Grandma, Gaspard and Simon arrive at the beach. But when the children run to the shore, they realize that the sea has disappeared.
programme.desc-more: With their grandmother, Grandma, Gaspard and Simon are heading for the beach, looking forward to a sunny day by the sea. When they arrive, the excitement of the children is palpable, but their joy quickly turns into confusion when, running towards the shore, they discover with astonishment that the sea has completely disappeared. Faced with this inexplicable phenomenon, the three companions embark on a playful investigation to understand what might have happened to the ocean. As they explore the beach looking for clues, they meet stranded marine creatures and eccentric characters who help them solve this mystery. Their adventure leads them to a series of surprising discoveries about the environment and the importance of the sea. With humour and curiosity, Gaspard and Simon learn valuable lessons about nature and friendship while trying to bring the sea back to its normal state.

programme.desc: Artificial intelligence was used to work on the physical reconstruction of broken works of art. Focus on this process.

For the first time, computer scientists, robotic engineers, archaeologists and historians are testing revolutionary technology for one of the most complex tasks of archaeology: the physical reconstruction of broken works of art. Focus on this process and, above all, on the outcome of this long-term work.

programme.title: Revelations, 200 years of photography
programme.desc: By making the images, the voices of the great photographers and the music, this film traces two hundred years of photographs of the world around us.
programme.desc-more: For two centuries, we have been photographing the world to try to grasp the truth, to keep track of it or to fix its beauty. Made up exclusively of photographs, this documentary offers a sensitive crossing of our visual history. From the first experiments to images of the 21st century, the words of great photographers, iconic and contemporary artists accompany this exploration of what photography has changed in our relationship to the world. It has made the invisible visible, upset our certainties, shaped our memories and transformed our way of telling history.

programme.title: A year on Earth
programme.desc: "The fall metamorphoses"Before the end of the year and the return of winter, anticipation is essential. For many animals, autumn offers as many opportunities as challenges.
programme.desc-more: For the animal world, autumn is a period of transition and great change. In America, the tamias are waging a land war and seeking to make food reserves for winter, grizzly bears are enjoying fishing before rivers freeze and lilliputians grow wings to migrate to Mexico. In Antarctica, young penguins become adults and prepare for the big dive. In Africa, thirsty elephants are waiting for rains that have become unpredictable due to climate change and are being hunted by opportunistic lionesses.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.sub-title: Mission I tidy up my room
programme.desc: "Mission I tidy my room"When Simon and Gaspard can't find their toys anymore, Dad advises them to tidy their room. Like superheroes, they put in supersonic mode.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "Simon Superlapin", Simon (a fearless young boy) and his friend Gaspard find themselves facing a disturbing mystery: their toys have disappeared without leaving any trace. In the face of this disconcerting situation, their father offers them a simple but effective solution: to tidy up their room. Motivated by the idea of finding their treasures, Simon and Gaspard embark on a thrilling adventure, adopting superhero postures and transforming themselves into real storage experts. With enthusiasm, they implement storage techniques worthy of the greatest heroes, deploying their energy and creativity to bring their playing space back to life. As they do their mission, they discover not only the importance of the organization, but also the value of friendship and teamwork. This playful challenge is proving to be a rewarding lesson on disorder and responsibility.

programme.desc-more: In this sparkling episode of the series "Simon Superlapin", humor and imagination blend into a captivating adventure. Simon (voice of the actor) decides to make a joke to his brother Gaspard (voice of the actor) by devouring his chocolate flan, which causes a disastrous reaction. Gaspard, obviously upset, exclaims: "It's not funny at all! To calm his brother and change his mind, Simon proposes a superhero game. The two brothers quickly turned into Captain Rabbit and Superlapin, diving into a fantastic world full of colours and adventures. However, the situation took an unexpected turn when Captain Rabbit, in a malice, made the same joke to Superlapin by drinking his long-awaited mega flan. To add to the confusion, he pretended the presence of the dreadful Professor Wolf, but he actually appeared, taking advantage of the discord to seize their gadgets. Now, Captain Rabbit and Superlapin must join forces to recover their valuable tools and restore order in their imaginary world. A mission that looks as funny as it is exciting!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: "The cabin of interior"On a very cold day, Papa Pig proposes to Peppa and George to build a cabin, waiting for Mom Pig to finish working. An indoor cabin is a perfect place to watch TV together!
programme.desc-more: Peppa is a little mischievous slut who shares her daily life with her family in a colorful and playful world. Surrounded by her little brother George, Mom Pig and Papa Pig, she explores the world around her with curiosity and enthusiasm. Both children embark on daily adventures, whether they jump into mud puddles, visit the zoo or play with their friends. Through fun and sometimes nasty situations, Peppa and George discover the simple joys of life, learning to express their emotions and develop their vocabulary. The themes of friendship, family and learning are at the heart of each episode, offering young spectators valuable lessons while entertaining them. The series, which won a BAFTA Award in 2005 for its quality of animation, continues to captivate children from all over the world with its endearing characters and fantasy stories.

programme.title: The Moodz
programme.desc: "The song of the Moodz"Furax, Zoumzoum and Oops are about to paint a fresco in the forest, but tensions appear. Youpi then offers them to learn a song together.
programme.desc-more: In the episode "The Song of the Moodz", friends Furax, Zoumzoum and Oops gather in the forest, ready to create a colourful fresco that could brighten their environment. However, creative excitement is rapidly darkened by growing tensions between the three accomplices. Each has different ideas about the artistic direction of their project, which leads to disagreements and frustration. In the face of this delicate situation, their friend Youpi, always optimistic, proposes an unprecedented solution: to learn a song together. This activity could not only distract them, but also increase their complicity. As they plunge into the musical world, tensions begin to dispel, allowing each one to express his emotions and to reconnect. This moment of sharing and creativity could well transform their friendship and artistic project into a memorable experience.

programme.title: The Moodz
programme.sub-title: Bisou shares the words of the heart
programme.desc: "Bisou shares the words of the heart"Furax accuses Grongron of losing his giraffe stuffed. Dispute and hurtful words are exchanged. Bisou invites his friends to tell what everyone has observed and felt.
programme.desc-more: In this poignant episode of the series "Les Moodz", tensions rise between Furax and Grongron when Furax accuses Grongron of having lost his precious giraffe stuffed. The ensuing dispute is marked by hurtful words and mutual accusations, revealing deep-seated frustrations and unexpressed emotions. Faced with this delicate situation, Bisou, the empathic character of the group, decides to intervene. He invites his friends to share their comments and feelings about the dispute, creating a space for dialogue and understanding. As each person exchanges, he or she reveals his or her own fears and vulnerabilities, transforming a simple argument into an opportunity for emotional growth. This episode explores the themes of friendship, communication and the importance of expressing one's feelings, while highlighting the relationshipal dynamics within the group, echoing universal experiences of conflict and reconciliation.

programme.title: At the end it's the sea
programme.desc: "Saint-Laurent (Canada)"François Pécheux descends the St. Lawrence, a Canadian river that is 1200 kilometres long, meeting those living on its shores or on water.
programme.desc-more: François Pêcheux takes us to Lake Saint Laurent in Canada. His journey begins with a friendly meeting and a plane trip. Departure from Lake Ontario, stops at Gananoque to sail on a luxury boat. His route continued to Montreal, where he faced the void during his meeting with a glass washer specializing in large buildings. Then it was in Quèbec that he met two lovers of freedom and wood who showed him their unusual home, nestled in the swamps. Last stop at Tadoussac to observe whales.

programme.title: Hot potato! Potato in danger
programme.desc: Potatoes, a favourite food for French people, are at risk because of climate change, soil depletion and food security issues.
programme.desc-more: France is not only a major potato consumer, cooked in all its forms, but also the world's largest exporter. Focusing on the Hauts-de-France and Brittany, this potato culture brings with it its lot of problems. Indeed, its production requires a lot of energy and water and damages the soil. France therefore faces a huge challenge, namely to maintain its status as a potato master while taking into account the environmental and economic challenges associated with it.
programme.desc: France is not only a major potato consumer, cooked in all its forms, but also the world's largest exporter. Focusing on the Hauts-de-France and Brittany, this potato culture brings with it its lot of problems. Indeed, its production requires a lot of energy and water and damages the soil. France therefore faces a huge challenge, namely to maintain its status as a potato master while taking into account the environmental and economic challenges associated with it.

programme.title: The roads of the impossible
programme.sub-title: Alaska, the adventurers of the cold
programme.desc: "Alaska, the adventurers of the cold"In the winter in Alaska, with its procession of extreme temperatures, ice and blizzard, makes all movements risky, but some take the road.
programme.desc-more: In Alaska, the cold turns water into an ice highway, a vital route for the locals but very dangerous for those who venture where the ice is not thick enough. The oil hauliers encounter another danger, the avalanches. The roads are sometimes impassable, so pilots earn their lives on short flights, but the cold can easily damage their gear. The gold researchers are ready to brave the cold water and blizzard to try their luck in this lucrative business. While global warming is very much affecting the region, new dangers are emerging.

At the heart of the vineyards, villages and landscapes that make the region's identity, Célyne Fuselier discovers a territory where the taste of good bread, great tablées and simple pleasures draw a certain idea of happiness to the French. As she travels, the host meets those who make this land live generous and perpetuate her taste for sharing. programme.title: The Rookie: Los Angeles Cop
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the season 8 episodes of The Rookie: Los Angeles cop's series
programme.desc-more: Recently divorced and faced with a major turning point in his life, John Nolan (Nathan Fillion), a man aged 40 years, finds himself somewhat lost after his son left for university. On an ordinary day, he became a witness to a bank robbery where he barely escaped death. This traumatic event leads him to a profound introspection on his life choices and the path he wishes to take. Driven by a strong desire to change his life, John decided to leave his old life behind and settle in Los Angeles to fulfill his dream of becoming a policeman. As a new LAPD member, he must navigate in a complex environment where danger and stress are pervasive. At the earliest age of recruits, he found himself under the wing of Talia Bishop (Alyssa Diaz), his educational determination, who would have to help him overcome the specific challenges associated with his unique situation. Between training events, police intrigues and the need to prove its worth to younger colleagues, John Nolan will have to show courage and resilience while finding his place in a constantly changing world.

programme.title: The Rookie: Los Angeles Cop
programme.desc: Officer John Nolan (Nathan Fillion), now an instructor, is facing a troubling past when he again crosses the road of the formidable Rosalind Dyer serial killer. The latter, always wanting to make Nolan understand that their accounts are not settled, threatens to plunge him into a spiral of chaos. At the same time, his colleagues Timothy Bradford (Eric Winter) and Lucy Chen (Melissa O'Neil) are sent on a cover mission to Las Vegas, where they have to infiltrate a notorious criminal gang, putting their lives at risk. As this fifth season unfolds, tensions are rising and unexpected alliances are formed, notably through several crossovers with characters from the derived series, The Rookie: Feds. The stakes have never been so high for Nolan and his team, who must navigate between loyalty, danger and the shadows of their past.
