programme.title: Michel tells Sardou
programme.desc: Michel Sardou, the icon of French song with a hundred million records sold, gives his fans an appointment for an exceptional film where, facing camera, he tells how his personal story shaped his career as an artist and his songs. He evokes his childhood dreams, his difficult years but also his first songs composed with Michel Fugain. He also gives himself about his intimacy, speaking of his love conquests, his divorce, but also his story as incredible as unknown with actress Mireille Darc. His interview, punctuated with images of retransmissions of his concerts and photos of shows, is the opportunity to review the exceptional stagings that characterize the impressive career of this monument of French song...

programme.title: Michel Sardou: I remember a farewell
programme.desc: After 60 years of career, Michel Sardou has said goodbye to the stage by offering his audience a final tour that brought together more than 400,000 spectators across France. Accompanied by an orchestra, on the stage of the Defense Arena in March 2024, the singer, eternal revolted and seductive, performed his greatest successes. From "I'm going to love" to "Being a woman", passing through "Les lacs du Connemara", "En chantant", "Le France" or "Je vole", this sacred monster of the French song leaves the lights of the scene with a monumental show, at the height of its success.

programme.title: We don't agree!
programme.desc: French people who are in conflict (with their neighbours, their relatives, a professional) have decided to rely on Julien Courbet to find out who is wrong and who is right in their dispute. Julien Courbet will gather, in stage and in public, the two opposing parties. He will listen to each other's arguments, confront them, send an investigator to the spot to film the situation, consult experts. Finally, they can offer them a choice: either they finally manage to agree and find a negotiated solution between them, or it is he, Julien Courbet, who will say, in the light of the elements revealed, who is wrong and who is right in their conflict.

programme.title: Leonard Cohen : Live in London
programme.desc: In July 2008, Leonard Cohen returned to the O2-Arena in London, after fifteen years of absence, to perform his most famous compositions: "Suzanne", "Hallelujah" and "Dance Me to the End of Love". The texts of the poet, who was above all a poet, full of melancholy and a perpetual thirst for spirituality, have marked generations and have been repeated many times, including among the classics of pop history. From rock ballads to folk ballads, this legendary concert offers pure moments of grace brought by its inimitable deep voice in an intimate and felt-down atmosphere.

programme.title: Viking myths
programme.desc: Myths are the foundation of our culture. It is all about love, war, betrayal, ambition, the struggle for freedom, sacrifice, happiness, transgression, the place of destiny... After Les Grands Myths, let's discover the mythology of the Far North, which has been a rich source of art history and pop culture.
programme.desc-more: The gods Thor, Odin and Loki, the giants, the elves and the dwarfs, the Ragnarök: François Busnel explores the myths and legends of the ancient Vikings.

programme.title: Thorin, the last Neanderthalian
programme.desc: In 2015, the discovery in the Mandrin Cave, in the heart of the Rhône Valley, of a large number of Neanderthal fossils, is the starting point of an archaeological adventure. This late representative of Neandertal, named Thorin as the dwarf king of Tolkien, was about 40,000 years old and gave new clues about this species, which lived on the Eurasian continent for 300,000 years before mysteriously extinguished. Why did she disappear in favor of Homo sapiens? This is what the pre-historian Ludovic Slimak and his team have been trying to understand, who have been exploring the Mandrin cave for twenty years, occupied for eighty millennia and miraculously preserved thanks to the sands carried by the mistral, which are engulfing in its opening to the north.

While he stopped at the island of Elbe to deliver a message to Napoleon, his return to Marseilles was marked by intense joy, as he was about to marry his beloved, Mercedes (Lia Amanda). programme.title: The Count of Monte Cristo: Revenge
programme.desc: Dantes, now known as Count de Monte-Cristo, returns to Paris with one goal in mind: revenge. He was supported by his faithful companion Jacopo, and immerse himself in the Parisian world where he discovered that his former rival, Fernand (Roger Pigaut), had become General Count of Morcerf and Mercedes's husband (Lia Amanda), his former love. By saving Fernand from a rixe, Dantès crossed the path of Albert (Jean Marais), the son of Mercedes, who did not doubt the true identity of his savior. Although Mercedes recognizes her former fiancé as Dantes, she is torn between her past and her present, refusing to flee with him. As Dantès weaves his web of revenge, he must navigate a world of betrayal, secrets and confrontations that will test his convictions and his desire for justice.

programme.title: The beauties of the Andes Cordillera
programme.desc: The Andes Cordillera, the world's longest mountain range that borders the western coast of South America for some 8,000 kilometres, is in perpetual motion. Colossal forces from the atmosphere and the depths of the earth are doing this tirelessly. The Anglo-German geologist Colin Devey embarked on a large expedition from Ecuador to Patagonia, through the Amazonian basin and the Atacama Desert, during which he exchanged with other geologists, volcanologists or biologists. It also meets the women and men who live in these areas, sometimes directly near volcanoes and their dangers, such as the Chimborazo, in Quito. But this ardent neighbour also brings benefits: its ashes, rich in minerals, enrich the soils that become suitable for agriculture.

programme.title: Super-bladed, a phenomenon under surveillance
programme.desc: Devastating mega-tempests, able to uproot trees and crash planes, intrigue scientists. These super-ramps are now being studied using radars and drones. Meteorologists and storm hunters decipher the mechanisms of these extreme events. With climate change, these storms are intensifying, making their study crucial.

programme.title: The mysterious world of clouds
programme.desc: A cluster of droplets suspended in the sky, the clouds evoke a dreamlike and poetic imagination. These physical phenomena are still largely unexplained and are being researched worldwide. At the top of the Puy-de-Dôme, a vacuum cleaner allows the wind to analyze the droplets, revealing microorganisms with amazing adaptation strategies. In Leipzig, eastern Germany, a unique cloud simulator in Europe is studying the role of turbulence in the formation of rain. In northern Australia, at Cairns Airport, a high-tech aircraft crosses the cloud bands and collects aerosol data to analyze differences between the northern and southern hemispheres.

programme.title: Leonard Cohen : Live in London
programme.desc: In July 2008, Leonard Cohen returned to the O2-Arena in London, after fifteen years of absence, to perform his most famous compositions: "Suzanne", "Hallelujah" and "Dance Me to the End of Love". The texts of the poet, who was above all a poet, full of melancholy and a perpetual thirst for spirituality, have marked generations and have been repeated many times, including among the classics of pop history. From rock ballads to folk ballads, this legendary concert offers pure moments of grace brought by its inimitable deep voice in an intimate and felt-down atmosphere.

programme.desc: At the Philharmonie de Paris, the legend of Brazilian music revisits half a century of career, in an engaged and eclectic concert.

programme.desc: Baldr, Odin's favorite son, is dead in a nightmare. To save her, Odin leaves to the kingdom of Hel to question the völva, a late seer.
programme.desc-more: Myths are the foundation of our culture. It is all about love, war, betrayal, ambition, the struggle for freedom, sacrifice, happiness, transgression, the place of destiny... After Les Grands Myths, let's discover the mythology of the Far North, which has been a rich source of art history and pop culture.

programme.title: Mercy
programme.desc: Back in his native village to attend a funeral, a young man found himself trapped in it after a fight that turned into drama.
programme.desc-more: Jérémie Pastor, a young man from Toulouse, travels to the picturesque village of Saint-Martial to attend the funeral of Jean-Pierre Rigal, his former baker's boss. Upon his arrival, he was warmly welcomed by Martine, the widow of the deceased, who offered to settle in his son Vincent's room. However, Jeremiah's return was not unanimous: Vincent, jealous and distrustful, saw with a bad eye the presence of the one whom he considered an intruder. Tensions are rising rapidly between the two men, exacerbated by Jeremiah's suspicion of Vincent's interest in his mother. Moreover, the friendship between Vincent and Walter Bonchamp, a common friend, stirs up Jeremiah's jealousy, which gradually feels marginalized. In this emotionally charged context, buried secrets and family rivalries resurface, leading Jeremiah into a spiral of intrigues and unexpected revelations.

Upon his arrival, he was warmly welcomed by Martine, the widow of the deceased, who offered to settle in his son Vincent's room. However, Jeremiah's return was not unanimous: Vincent, jealous and distrustful, saw with a bad eye the presence of the one whom he considered an intruder. Tensions are rising rapidly between the two men, exacerbated by Jeremiah's suspicion of Vincent's interest in his mother. Moreover, the friendship between Vincent and Walter Bonchamp, a common friend, stirs up Jeremiah's jealousy, which gradually feels marginalized. In this emotionally charged context, buried secrets and family rivalries resurface, leading Jeremiah into a spiral of intrigues and unexpected revelations.

programme.title: Frosia, a free woman in the gulag
programme.desc: Euphrosinia Kersnovskaya, called Frosia, was 33 years old when the USSR condemned her to gouglag in Siberia in 1940. She begins 18 years of wandering that she tells in her diary.
programme.desc-more: In 1919, the family of Euphrosinia Kersnovskaya, known as Frosia, fled the Bolshevik revolution to settle in Bessarabia, a territory between Ukraine and Romania, which corresponds to the present Moldova. In 1940, the USSR invaded the region and seized the property of all landowners. Frosia and her mother were driven from their house, and the young woman was arrested and sentenced to relegation in Siberia. It is the beginning of twelve years of wandering in the heart of the Goulag, from which it will escape to be arrested again and then repeatedly transferred, to the terrible camp of Norilsk north of the polar circle. At the request of his mother, Euphrosinia Kersnovskaya reported this journey in an illustrated newspaper.

programme.title: François-Joseph, Sissi's eternal husband
programme.desc: Portrait of the last Austro-Hungarian emperor, François-Joseph, an immutable conservative who fell in love with the most fantastic of his cousins, Sissi.
programme.desc-more: Archduke François-Joseph I led Austria-Hungary with an iron hand for nearly seventy years, from 1848 to 1916. His reign, the longest of the Habsburg Empire, will also be in many respects the last. From an early age, he received an extremely strict military and religious education designed to give him a perfect sense of duty. He was deeply conservative and devoted to preserving the ancient imperial hierarchies and traditions, which he would not see collapse at the end of World War I. But in 1854 he chose to marry the most fanciful of his cousins, the Duchess Elizabeth of Wittelsbach, then 16-year-old Sissi, who would reject until his death the appearance and constraints of the court.

programme.title: Clint Eastwood, the last legend
programme.desc: 70 years of career in front of and behind the camera, still active at the age of 90, Clint Eastwood is the latest Hollywood legend. Back on his path.
programme.desc-more: An angular face crisscrossed by wrinkles, the gaze simmered under the hat, underlined by a rictus recognizable between a thousand: this image belongs now to the collective imagination. If it seems immemorial, it is actually less frozen than it appears. From the nice cowboy from his TV debuts to the cynical mercenary of Sergio Leone's westerns, from the twisted cop of "Dirty Harry" to the romantic photographer of "On the Road to Madison", and to the old man of his latest films, Clint Eastwood has embodied a surprising range of characters, while remaining himself. His journey is in his image: in motion, open to the cross-roads, free and rich in many facets.

programme.desc: Thanks to new microscopy techniques, science can now act on proteins that produce energy and coordinate vital functions.
programme.desc-more: What's going on in our cells? In 1951, the death of an American with a staggering cancer, Henrietta Lacks, revealed the promises of cell culture. The study of its cells, still cultivated in the laboratory, marked a turning point in medicine. Thanks to new microscopy techniques, science can now act on proteins, molecular motors and mitochondria, which produce energy and coordinate vital functions. programme.desc-more: Rough geysers, hot hot springs and wildlife dominated by bears and wolves are all essential facets of Yellowstone in the Rocky Mountains. The first protected national park in the world, it was established in 1872 and has made emulations in the United States, which now number sixty-three. From the aquatic nature of the Everglades to the tropical forests of the Olympic Peninsula, from the heat of the Sonora Desert (Saguaro) to the Alaskan Frimas (Gates of the Arctic), to the Yosemite Valley, the Grand Canyon and the Great Smoky Mountains, this documentary surveys eight iconic American national parks and their biodiversity reserves.

programme.title: Nazi Crimenel seeks employer: Walter Rauff's runaway - 1942-1949
programme.desc: The incredible investigation into Walther Rauff, a former SS officer and mass criminal, protected and recruited by various secret services during the Cold War.
programme.desc-more: From 1942 to 1945, SS Walther Rauff was an important and zealous part of the "final solution", first on the eastern front, imagining the use of gas trucks to exterminate tens of thousands of "enemies of the Reich". Close-up on Walther Rauff's bloody route from the eastern front to the Nazi occupation command in Italy via Tunisia - where his plan to deport the Jewish community to the European camps failed little because of the Allied landing in North Africa. It shows how, through a secret agreement reached in February 1945 in Ticino between Rauff's superior, Karl Wolff, and a young American intelligence officer, the future CIA leader John Foster Dulles, outlines the collaboration between the two sides.

programme.title: The secret sale of Jews from Romania
programme.desc: From 1958 to 1989, communist Romania secretly sold its Jewish citizens for cattle and then for foreign currency. Back on this freezing state traffic.
programme.desc-more: From 1958 to 1989, Communist Romania secretly sold its Jewish citizens: first traded for cattle and agricultural equipment, then minted in foreign currency with Israel. By crossing the security archives and witness accounts of survivors, the film reveals the hidden history of this human trafficking, which led to the almost total erasure of the Jewish community in the country. A shocking investigation into one of the best kept secrets of the Eastern Block.

programme.title: The Count of Monte Cristo: Treason
programme.desc: Marseilles, 1815. Declared as Bonapartiste on his wedding day, Edmond Dantès was imprisoned at If Castle for 18 years. He managed to escape one day, assisted by Abbé Faria, and managed to seize the fabulous treasure of Monte Cristo. Now he can devote himself to preparing for revenge...
programme.desc-more: In 1815 Edmond Dantès (Jean Marais), a promising young sailor, took command of the ship Pharaoh after the death of his captain. While he stopped at the island of Elbe to deliver a message to Napoleon, his return to Marseilles was marked by intense joy, as he was about to marry his beloved, Mercedes (Lia Amanda). However, the jealousy of Fernand (Roger Pigaut), Mercedes' cousin, and the machinations of other conspirators, who see him as a threat to their ambitions, lead to his betrayal. Accused of Bonapartism, Dantès was imprisoned at the sinister castle of If, where he endured years of suffering. In this isolation, he discovered a plan of escape and met a former prisoner, Abbé Faria, who transmitted him with valuable knowledge. Once free, Dantès turned into a Count of Monte Cristo, determined to orchestrate a relentless revenge against those who destroyed his life.

programme.desc: Edmond Dantès became the Count of Monte-Cristo, rich to millions, and returned to good Paris society. He began his terrible revenge and began to attack Caderousse, the lieutenant who had denounced him once. He soon pushed him to the crime and sent him to the gallows...
programme.desc-more: Dantes, now known as Count de Monte-Cristo, returns to Paris with one goal in mind: revenge. He was supported by his faithful companion Jacopo, and immerse himself in the Parisian world where he discovered that his former rival, Fernand (Roger Pigaut), had become General Count of Morcerf and Mercedes's husband (Lia Amanda), his former love. By saving Fernand from a rixe, Dantès crossed the path of Albert (Jean Marais), the son of Mercedes, who did not doubt the true identity of his savior. Although Mercedes recognizes her former fiancé as Dantes, she is torn between her past and her present, refusing to flee with him. As Dantès weaves his web of revenge, he must navigate a world of betrayal, secrets and confrontations that will test his convictions and his desire for justice.

Felix, driven by the weight of expectations and secrets, succumbs to alcohol to escape the reality of his existence. His self-destructive behaviour does not go unnoticed and begins to break the already fragile ties of his family. Meanwhile, Richard, the patriarch, finds himself facing a bitter truth: he must reveal to his children that Chris has diverted crucial funds from their society, an act that challenges trust and loyalty within the clan. The situation worsens when the family discovers that Emily, their daughter, has plunged into the world of bloggers, exposing intimate details of their privacy. This mixture of betrayals, addictions and upsetting revelations highlights the fractures of a family that struggles to keep itself at afloat in an ocean of despair.

programme.title: See Paris again
programme.desc: Mia, a performer, especially for radio, lives in Paris with her companion, Vincent, a doctor. One night, both of them have dinner in a brewery, when Vincent, called for an emergency, has to leave. Mia takes her bike home, but, surprised by the rain, stops at a restaurant, where a birthday is celebrated. Suddenly, armed men came up, carnageing in the establishment. Mia, shot wounded, survives, but remains permanently marked by the tragedy. Some time later, she returned to the scene to meet other survivors.

programme.title: The Year of Bears
programme.desc: Writer and documentary writer Pierre Mann begins his quest in Romania, which concentrates the highest density of brown bears in Europe. In the Carpathian mountains, where the plantigrades live, wildlife forms an extraordinary living tissue, now threatened by unbridled logging. In Kamchatka, in the Russian Far East, the director follows the trail of Siberian grizzly bears, who eagerly await the arrival of the salmon to rebuild their fat layer after the winter. At the edge of the Arctic, he approached the ice lord, the polar bear, as close as possible to the near disappearance of the ice pack.

programme.title: Is that true?
programme.desc: With a car accident, which earned him a post-traumatic amnesia, Felix, a quinquennial financier, returned home after almost two months of hospital. To celebrate his return, his wife, Anne, who had their luxurious home redecorated in his absence, gave him a surprise by inviting their close friends. Suddenly, Micha, a young woman, arrives from nowhere. Living in a poor neighbourhood, she is looking for her daughter Emily, a teenage girl who has been missing for weeks, without, according to her, the police caring. Touched by his distress, Felix offers to stay for dinner...

programme.title: Klaus Nomi : Third type singer
programme.desc: Born in Bavaria, holder of a dual lyrical/rock underground art curriculum followed in the creative boom of the 1970s between West Berlin and New York, and then revealed to the general public in France in 1981, Klaus Sperber, alias Klaus Nomi, shone as loud as briefly in the pop sky. It is in a mythical artistic tribe, the New Wave New York, that its singularity and popularity as a singer are rooted. High-contrast voice as enchanting in the classic register as in pop cold wave, white clown makeup and retrofuturistic plastic costume: Nomi, Queer icon before the hour, has not only instinctively understood the spirit of his time, he has anticipated the future.

programme.title: Talking Heads : Stop Making Sense Live at Pantages Theatre, 1983
programme.desc: The incredible energy and the unspoilt and communicative pleasure of being on stage at Talking Heads, an American rock and pop band, seized by Jonathan Demme's eight virtuoso cameras during their concerts at the prestigious Pantages Theatre in Los Angeles in December 1984. As figures of New York's intelligentsia, these exceptional artists have always been one step ahead of others and their ten albums have forever scored in the 1980s. They have been through the decade with elegance. Their musical performances have been part of the legend of rock and cinema.

programme.title: Leonard Cohen : Live in London
programme.desc: In July 2008, Leonard Cohen returned to the O2-Arena in London, after fifteen years of absence, to perform his most famous compositions: "Suzanne", "Hallelujah" and "Dance Me to the End of Love". The texts of the poet, who was above all a poet, full of melancholy and a perpetual thirst for spirituality, have marked generations and have been repeated many times, including among the classics of pop history. From rock ballads to folk ballads, this legendary concert offers pure moments of grace brought by its inimitable deep voice in an intimate and felt-down atmosphere.

programme.title: Gilberto Gil at the Philharmonic of Paris : Aquele Abraço Tour

After Les Grands Myths, let's discover the mythology of the Far North, which has been a rich source of art history and pop culture.

programme.title: Bottlenecks in Istanbul
programme.desc: With its 16 million inhabitants, Istanbul is the world champion of traffic jams. Stanbouliotes lose an average of 100 hours a year in the traffic jams. If bike couriers and water vendors earn their living through the engulfed roads, many families must organize their daily lives according to traffic.

programme.title: Cats and wild dogs
programme.desc: Lions, cheetahs, caracals, servals, lynxes, forest cats, wolves, vicarrin dogs, jackals, lycaons and dingos are formidable predators. But these great wild felines and canids are nonetheless under pressure from the presence and human activities. Their natural habitat has been drastically reduced. Fortunately, initiatives are being implemented on all continents to protect them.

The unfortunate play on the great political chessboard orchestrated by his father, Pope Alexander VI, and his brother Caesar, the girl with irreproachable education was a change of exchange during various unsuccessful attempts to alliance. His successive marriages on the basis of intrigues have forged a grim reputation for him, which inspired many authors, including Alexandre Dumas and Victor Hugo.

But as the bills accumulated, Rainer was suddenly deprived of the position of construction manager that his company had made him look forward to. Doreen, on the other hand, sympathizes with Mara, a girl of the same age, who quickly trains him in dirty blows...

She then made a brief passage through Hollywood, and then scandalized the public upon her return to Germany by showing herself naked in Willi Forst's "Confession of a Sinner". In 1955, she flew to Broadway at Cole Porter's initiative, where she played Ninotchka in the musical "Stilk Stockings". New horizons opened up: if she continued her career as an actress, often confined to intellectual characters who doubted, Hildegard Knef would now flourish in the song, in parolière and exceptional performer, while publishing books, including the autobiographic bestseller "A péval donné".

The directors who directed it - André Téchiné, Arnaud Desplechin, Benoît Jacquot, Nicole Garcia, Hirokazu Kore-eda... - mix with the actress's own voice to outline an out-of-standard course.

programme.desc: In the Paris of the 1970s, Fedora (Marthe Keller), an icon of cinema, chose to end her life by falling under a train, plunged the world of show in terror. At his funeral, Barry Detweiler (William Holden), a Hollywood producer, recalled the tragic events that preceded this fateful decision. His quest to find Fedora led him to Corfu, where the actress, now recluse, tries to escape the pressure of success. Barry met Countess Sobryanski (Hildegard Knef), a close friend of Fedora, and Dr. Vando (José Ferrer), an expert in aesthetic surgery, who held secrets about the actress's life. Through their stories, Barry discovers Fedora's hidden suffering, between the desire for renewal and the relentless reality of the film industry. This poignant journey raises questions about fame, loneliness and the price to pay for glory.

Bathed by the Atlantic, this preserved microcosm is home to an exceptional fauna: green turtles that have come to breed there, fiddle crabs, vultures, chameleons, varans and birds with flamboyant plumages.

On the way, their diligence stops to take aboard Marquis Warren, famous bounty hunter, and Chris Mannix, who is to become the new sheriff of Red Rock. Until the storm calms down, all stop in Minnie's mercery. But the owner is absent. Instead, Ruth and the other passengers meet some curious characters: the English Oswaldo Mobray, the Southern officer Sanford Smithers and the taiseux Joe Gage...

programme.title: Uma Thurman: Emancipation of a Warrior
programme.desc: Raised by Bohemian parents, open-minded, traveling to India from 1 year old, Uma Thurman, of Swedish origin, has fed a journey apart in the Hollywood world. After a childhood she felt unusual, she discovered the theatre as a revelation at school, then began to play a dinghy role in the "Dangerous Links" or "The Baron of Münchausen". She then won her slinging and emancipated star band thanks to Quentin Tarantino, in 的Pulp fiction But these experiences also come with attacks on men, including Harvey Weinstein, whom she was able to stand up to.

programme.title: Cluedo

The evening is tense, because the guests don't know who brought them together. After the mysterious Mr. Moore arrived, Wadsworth revealed that all guests were victims of blackmail from Moore. The tone is rising. Moore then offered each guest a weapon and pushed them to kill Wadsworth, who locked them in the mansion. The lights then suddenly go out. When they turn on again, Moore died.

Along with scientists, an immersion in the privacy of this tundra resident, symbol of the fragile balance of Arctic ecosystems.

Killer compartment
programme.desc: In Avignon, Bambi (Simone Signoret), a woman with a well-dipped character, embarks on the night train connecting Marseille to Paris. On the way, she meets Daniel (Jacques Perrin), a young runaway, clumsy and without a ticket, whom she decides to help by hiding him in her compartment. The complicity between the two characters is settled, but their journey takes a tragic turn when, in the early morning, a passenger is found strangled in the train. Inspector Grazziani (Jean-Louis Trintignant) was quickly called to the scene to conduct the investigation. His mission is to interview the occupants of the compartment, but he quickly discovers that the killer always seems a step ahead. As tensions rise and the mystery thickens, Bambi and Daniel find themselves trapped in a dangerous game where trust is put to the test and where everyone could be the next suspect. Suspense is intensifying as time is running out to expose the murderer.

programme.title: The century of Costa Gavras
programme.sub-title: The Origin: A Blow to Woe
programme.desc: With his first two films, "Compartment killers" and "Un homme de trop", Costa-Gavras immediately imposed his style where action led to narration.

programme.desc: When We Were Sisters:

programme.title: Fiume or death!
programme.desc: In 1919, the poet and singer of the war Gabriele D'Annunzio took possession of the town of Fiume, now Rijeka, in Croatia. A unknown story, which its inhabitants reinterpret today in an original docu-fiction and full of humor.

programme.title: Water keepers
programme.desc: In ten stages, meet with the guards of blue gold, who re-appropriate ancestral know-how or innovate to offer a living land to future generations. In this episode: in the Ladakh, at the borders of the Indian Himalayas, amazing artificial glaciers allow to irrigate cultures and help communities cope with water scarcity.

programme.title: Zone of conflict - Global crises in brief
programme.desc: Since the beginning of the Russian large-scale invasion of Ukraine, Finland has experienced a considerable increase in sabotage: the country deplores, among other things, scrambled GPS signals, which disrupt air traffic, or damaged submarine cables in the Baltic Sea. According to Western security services, these hybrid attacks are Russia's work and are aimed at destabilizing Western countries. The Kremlin, for its part, regularly criticises Finland's accession to NATO, while denying any involvement in these actions. While both countries are separated by a border of 1,300 kilometres - the longest land boundary between Russia and the European Union - Brussels closely monitors the situation. Is there a risk of the situation degenerating into a military conflict?

programme.title: Hot air balloons in Poland: summit meeting"
programme.desc: In southern Poland, the small town of Krosno is the meeting place of the international elite of balloon pilots. 101 crews competed in this competition, which crowned the one who was most precise in directing his aircraft. When time is not on the side, this air sport puts the nerves to a tough test and can quickly prove dangerous.

programme.title: Wild Belgium
programme.desc: From the reliefs of the Ardennes to the dikes of Flanders, water shapes the territories and determines the richness of their biodiversity. The reintroduction of beavers brought back animals that were no longer seen in Belgium, like the black storks, which benefit from the feeding ponds created by their dams.

programme.title: Wild Belgium
programme.desc: This is the beginning of winter in Belgium and the High Fagnes are the ideal stopover for the thousands of cranes migrating south. They gather together with their families before returning to North Africa, driven by the rising currents generated by the last hot winds of the year. Flying spiders, too, use wind as a means of transport. When this one is favorable, they rush into the air, hung on a long wire that they themselves secreted, to quickly reach their feeding areas. With its piercing view, the peregrine falcon is distinguished by its impressive ability to catch prey. Capable of flying at 350 kilometers/hour, it is the fastest animal in the world.

programme.title: Newfoundland, stay or leave?
programme.desc: In Canada, residents of a fishing village on the Island of Newfoundland are invited to leave the site because of the cost of infrastructure.

programme.title: Saint Peter of Rome: The largest Renaissance construction site
programme.desc: In the 16th century, Pope Julius II launched the construction of the Basilica of St Peter of Rome. This titanium-rich construction site will last more than a century, from 1506 to 1626. Despite the plague, the bag of Rome and many fatal accidents, thousands of workers built this masterpiece. History highlights these forgotten artisans, stone tailors and goldsmiths, who have helped to erect this mythical sanctuary.

programme.title: The Treasure of the Basilica of St. Francis of Assisi
programme.desc: Focus on the meticulous restoration work of the frescoes of the Basilica of Assisi, partially destroyed by an earthquake in 1997.

programme.title: Water keepers
programme.desc: In Valencia, faced with the rampant urbanization, people are mobilizing to save the canals that supply orchards.

programme.title: Italy: Prisoners, Film Critics · Global Voices
programme.desc: Nine Italian prisoners temporarily turned their prison against the film festival della Lessinia. Some work as volunteers, while others, who remain behind bars, act as jurors. The emotion is great with this project of all possible where a place of detention suddenly transforms into cinema.

programme.title: The beautiful team
programme.desc: Five unemployed workers in Paris, Jean (Jean Gabin), Charles (Charles Vanel), Raymond, Jacques and Mario, a Spanish refugee threatened with expulsion, won the big prize of the national lottery. Jean has the idea of putting this money in common, in the purchase of an old washyard from the suburbs to ruin, which they will turn into a laughing guinguette of which they will co-owner. They work with confidence, but the group's solidarity is fragile. Destiny is on them.

programme.title: Gourmet travel
programme.desc: Maultaschen in Swabian, jiaozi in China or tortellini in Italy: ravioli and ravioli are an emblematic specialty of traditional cuisines of the world.

programme.title: The Shannon River: In the heart of Ireland
programme.desc: In Ireland, the Shannon River winds between humid marshes and green plains before finishing its race in Limerick, in an estuary populated by dolphins.

programme.title: Le Connemara : The Wild Gas of Ireland
programme.desc: Peatlands with the ocean, focus on one of the few regions in Europe where fauna and flora enjoy a preserved environment.

programme.title: The bottom of the maps: the essential
Artificial Intelligence: The ultimate human invention?
programme.desc: For a long time, considered a promising yet still infancy technology, artificial intelligence is now evolving at a dizzying pace. As it gains ground, the question of its limits and our ability to maintain control of it arises with a new urgency. From the first networks of neurons to increasingly autonomous systems, this documentary traces decades of research by combining archives and testimonies of pioneer researchers. He compares his views with those of former employees of large AI companies, those working for his safety and families directly confronted with the drifts of certain chatbots. A multi-voice story that makes the history of a technological revolution intersect with the questions it raises today.

programme.title: Robot killers, weapons in AI's hands
programme.desc: In Kiev, on the 17th day of the war in Ukraine, the crash of a drone revealed advanced narcotics in the field of autonomous lethal weapons. On land, in the air or on the sea, the AI is revolutionizing weapons systems. Beyond its use in the field, AI is also under study in other areas: law enforcement, recognition, transportation... The researchers bring their expertise here on these advances in the field of new technologies, and on the necessary limits to be put in place to avoid dangerous drifts.

programme.title: Controversy
programme.sub-title: Should a compulsory national service be re-established in France?
programme.desc: Almost 30 years after the end of military service, the question of compulsory national service reappeared in the public debate. Some see it as a way to recreate the link, to convey common values and to strengthen the spirit of citizenship. Others report a costly measure.

programme.sub-title: Control of places of deprivation of liberty: audition by Pierre Coppey
programme.desc: On Wednesday 4 November, MPs will be hearing Pierre Coppey, whose appointment as Comptroller General of Places of Deprivation of Liberty (CGLPL) was proposed by Emmanuel Macron. The former Deputy Director of VINCI and President of VINCI Autoroutes would thus take over Dominique Simonnot, whose term of office ended on 14 October, for a period of six years. The CGLPL is an independent institution responsible for monitoring all places of deprivation of liberty, including prisons but also psychiatric hospitals, closed educational centres, administrative detention centres (CRAs) and police custody facilities. After his hearing in the Assembly and then in the Senate, members of Parliament and senators must approve or not approve his appointment.

programme.title: Giorgia Meloni and the Gull clan
programme.desc: In September 2022, Brothers of Italy, Giorgia Meloni's party, came to the top of the general election with 26% of the vote. Invested as President of the Council in October, she implemented a conservative program promised to Italians during her campaign and very impregnated by an identity project. It is increasing punitive measures against humanitarian NGOs, migrants, LGBTQIA+ couples, ravers or protesters. This strategist, stubbornly refusing to declare himself "antifascist", is at the same time trying to reassure its European partners. With her long friendship with Donald Trump, the first woman president of the Italian History Council received a new impetus when the American magnate was re-elected in 2024, which openly named her her privileged interlocutor in Europe.

Meetings and interviews with his closest friends, including his mother Beverly, and his mentor, David Frum, who shares the secrets of his ambitions and plans to transform America and Europe.

programme.title: Head for the Elysée
programme.sub-title: The N.R., on the way to victory?
programme.desc: Marine Le Pen, a favourite of the polls, is embarking on the conquest of the Elysée. Citizens are talking about their daily concerns while following the presidential campaign.
programme.desc-more: On 7 July 2026, the presidential campaign was launched. On that day, Marine Le Pen saw his electoral horizon clear. The favourite of the polls can finally embark on the conquest of the Elysée. In Hayange, a town of Moselle, formerly a fief of the left, the RN is now raising great hope. At the other end of the country, in the Gard, the RN elected representatives are mobilizing to defend the taurine traditions, which is worth them some popularity. In Saumur, in the West, a business owner of SMEs is concerned. In Alfortville, a French teacher regrets that a class at the school has been closed again. For many citizens, politics is a daily reality, far from slogans and intrigues of power. This does not prevent them from following the presidential campaign and from having an opinion on the candidates and their programmes.

programme.title: Georges Pompidou, the cruelty of power
programme.desc: What a singular destiny that Georges Pompidou, the son of teachers, became the right-hand man of General de Gaulle, before succeeding him in 1969. An unusual and unpremeditated journey, because unlike many others, Pompidou never ardently seeks power. From stage to stage, he has the highest responsibilities, such as a fatality. As wonderful as it is, this destiny is revealed by a nameless cruelty to this man who is fond of life and happiness. Taking over from the colossus of Gaulle is a challenge that is almost impossible to meet.

programme.desc: Gerande, a fortune born of salt. In the extreme south of Brittany the largest northern salt marshes of Europe are spread. Between the medieval city of Guérande and the peninsula of the Croisic, the curves and geometric shapes of these salt marshes tell a history of more than a thousand years. - The salty destiny of the Franche-Comté. On the reliefs of Franche-Comté, the woods and pastures spread as far as possible and conceal a hidden treasure, salt. From the Middle Ages, men began to exploit the salt springs flowing into the Frankish-Comtine basements. Over the centuries, this manna has transformed the economy and face of this region of eastern France, as evidenced by the impressive Royal Saline of Arc-et-Senans, the jewel of 18th-century architecture.

programme.desc: They are the link between Paris and the territories. The 130 prefects have a delicate task of implementing national policy in the regions and departments. Born from a modest background, Valérie Michel-Moreaux has risen to this position thanks to his will alone. Pollution to PFAS, suicide of farmers, cities in ruins: this not like the others is going through crises with a style of its own. Its challenge is to defend the Republic and also to reconcile rural territories with decisions taken in a distant capital.

programme.title: Justice in France
programme.sub-title: Correctional appeal hearing at the Rennes Court of Appeal
programme.desc: At the Rennes Court of Appeal, two men appeared in the accused's box. One is prosecuted for four offences, the other for six. At the heart of the audience: drug trafficking and possession of weapons. How can we plead the case of an accused whose defence system is not credible? How can we demand the fair penalty when the defendant has been convicted many times for similar acts? Yet, despite the seriousness of the accusations, the two men defend themselves in a casual manner and sometimes deny the evidence. In addition to the question of whether the defendants are guilty, the force of a public hearing is to be the privileged witness of the contradictory debate between lawyers and magistrates. The power of a hearing is also to witness the fight that lawyers are leading for their client.

programme.desc: Between the city of Gerande and the peninsula of the Croisic stretch out the largest northern salt marshes of Europe. In Franche-Comté, pastures are full of salt.
programme.desc-more: Gerande, a fortune born of salt. In the extreme south of Brittany the largest northern salt marshes of Europe are spread. Between the medieval city of Guérande and the peninsula of the Croisic, the curves and geometric shapes of these salt marshes tell a history of more than a thousand years. - The salty destiny of the Franche-Comté. On the reliefs of Franche-Comté, the woods and pastures spread as far as possible and conceal a hidden treasure, salt. From the Middle Ages, men began to exploit the salt springs flowing into the Frankish-Comtine basements. Over the centuries, this manna has transformed the economy and face of this region of eastern France, as evidenced by the impressive Royal Saline of Arc-et-Senans, the jewel of 18th-century architecture.

At the other end of the country, in the Gard, the RN elected representatives are mobilizing to defend the taurine traditions, which is worth them some popularity. In Saumur, in the West, a business owner of SMEs is concerned. In Alfortville, a French teacher regrets that a class at the school has been closed again. This does not prevent them from following the presidential campaign and from having an opinion on the candidates and their programmes.

programme.title: Madam Prefect
programme.desc: The cameras followed Valérie Michel-Moreaux during her last year in the Vosges, a prefect who is not like the others who is going through crises with a style of her own.
programme.desc-more: They are the link between Paris and the territories. The 130 prefects have a delicate task of implementing national policy in the regions and departments. Many men, but also a few women. The cameras followed one of them during his last year in the Vosges, a department that is in a state of waiting, between factory closures and population decline. Born from a modest background, Valérie Michel-Moreaux has risen to this position thanks to his will alone. Pollution to PFAS, suicide of farmers, cities in ruins: this not like the others is going through crises with a style of its own. Its challenge is to defend the Republic and also to reconcile rural territories with decisions taken in a distant capital.

programme.title: Justice in France
programme.sub-title: Correctional appeal hearing at the Rennes Court of Appeal
programme.desc: At the Rennes Court of Appeal, two men appeared in the accused's box. How can we plead the case of an accused whose defence system is not so credible?
programme.desc-more: At the Rennes Court of Appeal, two men appeared in the accused's box. One is prosecuted for four offences, the other for six. At the heart of the audience: drug trafficking and possession of weapons. How can we plead the case of an accused whose defence system is not credible? How can we demand the fair penalty when the defendant has been convicted many times for similar acts? Yet, despite the seriousness of the accusations, the two men defend themselves in a casual manner and sometimes deny the evidence. In addition to the question of whether the defendants are guilty, the force of a public hearing is to be the privileged witness of the contradictory debate between lawyers and magistrates. The power of a hearing is also to witness the fight that lawyers are leading for their client.

Etxaniz, Asteasuinzarra, Irazustabarrena and Etxaide are four activists of the Basque separatist organization ETA, political refugees in the French Basque Country. They fell under the bullets of the LAG, the Anti-Terrorist Liberation Groups. Between 1983 and 1987, 27 people were murdered by the LAG on French soil.

programme.title: Cultural exception, the battle that saved French cinema
programme.desc: Are creative works mere merchandise? France and the United States were at stake in the intense economic and diplomatic battle during the GATT negotiations in 1993. In the name of free trade, the Americans are weighing their weight to dismantle the financing system for French cinema and to deliver it to the great winds of Yankee competition. But France, helped by Europe, resists and manages to make the United States fold. Thus the concept of "cultural exception" was born. This story is told through the look of lobbyist Jack Valenti, who will work to defend Hollywood's interests against European diplomats and politicians.

programme.title: France - Cambodia, so far, so close
programme.desc: How did Cambodia, ravaged less than fifty years ago by one of the most deadly genocides of the twentieth century, become the host of the 20th Summit of La Francophonie? And what remains, more than 160 years after the protectorate chosen by King Norodom I in 1863, of the singular bond between Phnom Penh and Paris? The common history of the two countries is that of a passionate relationship: a protectorate requested rather than impossibly, an independence obtained without confrontation by Norodom Sihanouk in 1953, and then the collapse under Pol Pot's regime. Peace is negotiated in Paris at the 1991 Conference. Those who have lived it from the inside tell behind the scenes. Cambodian officials are talking about reconstruction, the delicate balance between China, Vietnam and the West, and the place France can still hold.

programme.title: J.D. Vance: The revenge of an America
programme.desc: From his chaotic childhood to the White House, J.D. Vance embodied the revenge of MAGA (Make America Great Again). To tell the story of the U.S. Vice President Thomas Snegaroff and David Thomson met with about ten people who have been with him throughout his life. These tell who J.D. Vance really is: how man has evolved ideologically and how he has transformed politically. Meetings and interviews with his closest friends, including his mother Beverly, and his mentor, David Frum, who shares the secrets of his ambitions and plans to transform America and Europe.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: NCIS officers are investigating the abduction of a Navy Petty Officer and the disappearance of her husband. Torres is trying to apologize to Abby.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting new season of NCIS, the team of specialized agents, led by the intrepid Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), finds itself confronted with a series of complex and intriguing cases involving Navy personnel. Their investigation begins with the mysterious disappearance of a man, which occurred six months earlier, and which seems to be a crucial clue to a recent car explosion. As they explore this case, a new mystery arises: the tragic death of a woman whose body was found after a fall of a building. The victim's doctor, reluctant to share information about his or her background, becomes an issue for Gibbs, who must convince him or her to collaborate. Barely this resolved case, Gibbs, accompanied by Palmer (Brian Dietzen) and Quinn (Emily Wickersham), set out at sea to elucidate the murder of a marine, testing their ingenuity and determination. This 14th season promises to be rich in suspense and rebound.

programme.title: My boy
programme.desc: A man, passionate about his profession and not very busy with his son, learns that he was abducted. He's gonna try to find him.
programme.desc-more: Julien (Guillaume Canet), a globe-trotter journalist passionate about his profession, has always lived between two planes, two reports, two continents. An existence rhythmic by urgency and adrenaline, which ended up consuming his couple. The tensions, repeated absences and wear and tear of time were the reason for her marriage with her ex-wife, leaving behind them a tense relationship, but an unalterable love for their child, a seven-year-old boy, fragile light in their shaken lives. Everything changes during a stopover in France. Between two correspondences, Julien falls on a heartbreaking voice message: his ex-wife, the voice broken by the sobs, announces to him the unthinkable. Their son disappeared during a school bivouac in the mountains, swallowed by the vast wilderness as if he had never existed. The hours pass, the research is organized, but the tracks remain tenuous, and the anguish grows, suffocating. Without hesitation, Julien abandons everything to rush to the place, determined to find his child at all costs. In this mountainous setting where nature, both majestic and hostile, seems to keep its secrets, Julien encounters a wall of silence and uncertainty. The gendarmes, the teachers, the other parents: each has his version of the facts, his doubts, his unsaid. The clues are rare, the hypotheses multiply, and time, an unrelenting enemy, stretches without mercy. Between false leads and disappointed hopes, Julien must also deal with his own demons – his regrets, his guilt for having been a father absent, and this question that eats him up: could he have prevented this tragedy if he had been there?

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: A Navy officer is murdered. Gibbs and his team have two suspects: the wife and the mistress, who accuse each other of the murder.
programme.desc-more: NCIS' thirteenth season opens with palpable tension, while Special Agent Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), who was left for death at the end of the previous season, recovers from his injuries. Meanwhile, Tony DiNozzo (Michael Weatherly) is on the front line against La Vocation, a fearful terrorist group operating in China. programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: In the 13th century, an archer of the army of late King Richard returned to England, bringing the crown of the sovereign before winning Nottingham.
programme.desc-more: In 1199 King Richard the Lion's Heart died in France in a battle, leaving his kingdom in the grip of uncertainty. Robin Longstride (Russell Crowe), a disillusioned archer of the army, decides to desert and finds himself playing an unexpected role: Sir Loxley, a recently deceased knight. On returning to England, he brought back the crown for the crown of Prince John, Richard's brother. Robin discovers the extent of corruption in the country and crosses the path of Marianne (Cate Blanchett), Loxley's widow, and her family, all in despair. While a plot threatens to plunge England into chaos, Robin, with the help of a band of outlawers, is engaged in a fierce struggle to defend the oppressed and restore justice, thus defying the authority of Prince John and his dark allies.

programme.title: Hit Man
programme.desc: In New Orleans, a man on a police mission decides to ignore protocol by helping a woman who was abused by her husband.
programme.desc-more: Gary Johnson (Glen Powell), a professor of philosophy at the University of New Orleans, has a seemingly ordinary existence. An electronics enthusiast, he put his talents at the service of the local police, participating in listening operations to thwart potential criminal plans. His life is changing when he is forced to replace a colleague on a mission, pretending to be a hit man. This unexpected role allows him to discover a dark world where morality is tested. As a false killer, Gary quickly finds himself immersed in perilous situations, charged with unmasking citizens ready to commit the irreparable. As he juggles his identity as a professor and as a criminal, Gary must navigate into complex ethical dilemmas, confronting his personal values while trying to protect innocent lives. This double game will lead him to redefine what it really means to be a hero.

programme.desc: The Bodins decided to organize a big evening in their farm to raise funds and rebuild the church of the village that Christian accidentally set fire to. programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: In the fifth century, King Arthur and his prious knights tried to raise up the divine mission entrusted to them: to go in search of the Holy Grail.
programme.desc-more: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: British intelligence agent Clayton Reeves contacted NCIS when one of his men disappeared in a place in Philadelphia, where the body of a sailor was found. Sent to the scene with Bishop, Quinn has to face a trauma of his past, which made him leave active service...
programme.desc-more: In this exciting new season of NCIS, the team of specialized agents, led by the intrepid Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), finds itself confronted with a series of complex and intriguing cases involving Navy personnel. Their investigation begins with the mysterious disappearance of a man, which occurred six months earlier, and which seems to be a crucial clue to a recent car explosion. As they explore this case, a new mystery arises: the tragic death of a woman whose body was found after a fall of a building. The victim's doctor, reluctant to share information about his or her background, becomes an issue for Gibbs, who must convince him or her to collaborate. Barely this resolved case, Gibbs, accompanied by Palmer (Brian Dietzen) and Quinn (Emily Wickersham), set out at sea to elucidate the murder of a marine, testing their ingenuity and determination. This 14th season promises to be rich in suspense and rebound.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: In this exciting new season of NCIS, the team of specialized agents, led by the intrepid Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), finds itself confronted with a series of complex and intriguing cases involving Navy personnel. Their investigation begins with the mysterious disappearance of a man, which occurred six months earlier, and which seems to be a crucial clue to a recent car explosion. As they explore this case, a new mystery arises: the tragic death of a woman whose body was found after a fall of a building. The victim's doctor, reluctant to share information about his or her background, becomes an issue for Gibbs, who must convince him or her to collaborate. Barely this resolved case, Gibbs, accompanied by Palmer (Brian Dietzen) and Quinn (Emily Wickersham), set out at sea to elucidate the murder of a marine, testing their ingenuity and determination. This 14th season promises to be rich in suspense and rebound.
programme.desc-more: Within the Naval Criminal Investigative Service, an elite unit specializing in crimes related to the Marines, terrorists or spy networks, a team with a variety of profiles and complementary work in the shadows to unravel intrigues where betrayals, lies and loyalty are met. Led by Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), a former Marine sniper with a turbulent past and legendary reputation, the agents combine surgical intuition with unconventional methods. With him, Timothy McGee (Sean Murray), a brilliant but sometimes too methodical analyst, and Nick Torres (Willer Valderrama), a former agent infiltrated with explosive charisma, form a duo as effective as unpredictable. Completing the Ellie Bishop team (Emily Wickersham), a specialist in criminal psychology with formidable instincts, Jimmy Palmer (Brian Dietzen), a medical examiner with a heart, and Kasie Hines (Diona Reasonover), an expert in forensics whose analytical intelligence often saves the bet. Not to mention Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll), director of NCIS, whose strategic decisions weigh heavily in the course of investigations, and Alden Parker (Gary Cole), a former FBI profile whose arrival is changing the established dynamics.

Not to mention Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll), director of NCIS, whose strategic decisions weigh heavily in the course of investigations, and Alden Parker (Gary Cole), a former FBI profile whose arrival is changing the established dynamics.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: In the fifth century after Jesus Christ, in the present-day Britain, King Arthur reigned over his court in Kaamelott. He was entrusted with a divine mission and was constantly searching for the Grail, the cup that Jesus of Nazareth would have used at the Supper. But here, the famous Knights of the Round Table are not very effective in helping him. Incompetent, wrestlers, novices and lazy, they multiply the gaffes. Life in Kaamelott is full of surprises. A successful series that cultivates absurd with delight. The actor and director Alexandre Astier is next to his father, Lionnel Astier.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: NCIS officers continue to investigate cases involving Navy personnel, whether they are victims, culprits or mere witnesses. Gibbs and his team began to look into the case of a missing man six months earlier. The explosion of a car seems to be connected to this mysterious file. Later, a woman died, falling from the top of a building, who occupied the specialists. The victim's doctor refuses to provide information about his or her history. Gibbs is trying to convince her to cooperate. Barely this solved crime, Gibbs goes to sea with Palmer and Quinn to try to identify the killer of a marine. A 14th season still as exciting, worn by the insinuable Mark Harmon in the role of Leroy Jethro Gibbs.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: NCIS' thirteenth season opens with palpable tension, while Special Agent Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), who was left for death at the end of the previous season, recovers from his injuries. Meanwhile, Tony DiNozzo (Michael Weatherly) is on the front line against La Vocation, a fearful terrorist group operating in China. In an episode crossover, Gibbs' team collaborates with their Louisiana colleagues, bringing a new dynamic to the investigation. As DiNozzo navigates a complex international investigation, he must juggle the implications of collaboration between NCIS, the FBI and the British intelligence services. The situation is very strong when Ziva David (Pa Pablo's Cote) is directly threatened, exacerbating tensions between team members, including with Tony. This season will also mark the departure of Michael Weatherly, one of the pillars of the series, while Gibbs, for the first time in thirteen years, changes haircuts, symbolizing a new era in the team.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: NCIS' thirteenth season opens with palpable tension, while Special Agent Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), who was left for death at the end of the previous season, recovers from his injuries. Meanwhile, Tony DiNozzo (Michael Weatherly) is on the front line against La Vocation, a fearful terrorist group operating in China. In an episode crossover, Gibbs' team collaborates with their Louisiana colleagues, bringing a new dynamic to the investigation. As DiNozzo navigates a complex international investigation, he must juggle the implications of collaboration between NCIS, the FBI and the British intelligence services. The situation is very strong when Ziva David (Pa Pablo's Cote) is directly threatened, exacerbating tensions between team members, including with Tony. This season will also mark the departure of Michael Weatherly, one of the pillars of the series, while Gibbs, for the first time in thirteen years, changes haircuts, symbolizing a new era in the team.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: In this exciting new season of NCIS, the team of specialized agents, led by the intrepid Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), finds itself confronted with a series of complex and intriguing cases involving Navy personnel. Their investigation begins with the mysterious disappearance of a man, which occurred six months earlier, and which seems to be a crucial clue to a recent car explosion. As they explore this case, a new mystery arises: the tragic death of a woman whose body was found after a fall of a building. The victim's doctor, reluctant to share information about his or her background, becomes an issue for Gibbs, who must convince him or her to collaborate. Barely this resolved case, Gibbs, accompanied by Palmer (Brian Dietzen) and Quinn (Emily Wickersham), set out at sea to elucidate the murder of a marine, testing their ingenuity and determination. This 14th season promises to be rich in suspense and rebound.

programme.title: The little history of France
programme.desc: In a humorous and offbeat approach, this series highlights characters close to major historical figures of France, such as Vercingetorix, Jeanne d'Arc and Napoleon. Through a series of sketches in various historical contexts, the writers offer an unprecedented look at the landmarks of the past. Each episode plunges the spectator with humour into the daily lives of these iconic figures and their loved ones, often contrasted with the weight of history.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: School's over
programme.desc: Agathe, a young, dynamic and life-filled English teacher, is very much appreciated by her Parisian students. However, her daily life changes when she learns that she was appointed to a small picturesque village of Picardie in Trouilly-sur-Selle. Determined to make a good impression, she moved to Gilbert and Simone, a welcoming couple who were happy to welcome her to their home. Yet, Agathe quickly discovers that Simone suffers from amnesia, making cohabitation somewhat difficult. The school year is expected to be complicated: at the pre-entry meeting, Agathe is increasing the bumblebees against her new colleagues, while her first hours with well-dipped students are just as chaotic. Over the days, she began to find her bearings in this new life, while developing an unexpected complicity with Raphael, her colleague teaching mathematics. Together, they navigate between the challenges of education and the unforeseen circumstances of a rural life that contrasts with its former Parisian daily life.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: In 1199 King Richard the Lion's Heart died in France in a battle, leaving his kingdom in the grip of uncertainty. Robin Longstride (Russell Crowe), a disillusioned archer of the army, decides to desert and finds himself playing an unexpected role: Sir Loxley, a recently deceased knight. On returning to England, he brought back the crown for the crown of Prince John, Richard's brother. Robin discovers the extent of corruption in the country and crosses the path of Marianne (Cate Blanchett), Loxley's widow, and her family, all in despair. While a plot threatens to plunge England into chaos, Robin, with the help of a band of outlawers, is engaged in a fierce struggle to defend the oppressed and restore justice, thus defying the authority of Prince John and his dark allies.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Laure is absolutely convinced that Van Hagen is sequestering poor Caroline. Alone against all, she does everything she can to convince her friends.
programme.desc-more: Caroline (Tonya Kinzinger) made her big comeback, leaving behind her the tensions that had passed with Bertrand, who finally decided to turn the page on her adventure with Tony. However, a new obstacle is emerging on their way: Louis (Frédéric Deban) is in prison, wrongly accused of the murder of Julia. While Jessica (Adeline Blondieau) holds a valuable video surveillance tape from the clinic that could exonerate Louis, she also reveals compromising evidence against Paolo (Luis Marquès). In another part of the city, Iannis (Romeo Sarfati) makes an unexpected connection with a tramp, who turns out to be David, his son's father. At the same time, the clinic faces a major challenge when a sick inmate, entrusted by Lieutenant Peretti, takes Laure (Bénédicte Delmas) as a hostage. This twelfth season promises its lot of intrigues, surprises and haletant twists.

programme.title: Christmas a cappella
programme.desc: Since a drama that has been experienced during Christmas holidays, a single father has avoided celebrating these holidays. This year, his sister and daughter have a surprise.

programme.title: Christmas fire all flames
programme.desc: A woman, a ballet teacher, entrusts a student with the main role of Christmas production of "Casse-Noisette" and falls under the charm of her father-in-law.

programme.title: A Christmas sprinkled with love
programme.desc: While she is supposed to spend the Christmas holidays in Hawaii with her father, a young woman goes on a detour and goes to the city where her mother grew up to sell her property.

programme.title: Married at Christmas!
programme.desc: On her 30th birthday, at Christmas, a young woman absorbed by the preparations for her brother's marriage did not know that a secret admirer was preparing a surprise for her.
programme.desc-more: Leah is going to be 30 on the same day as her brother Paul's wedding. Drew, their childhood neighbour and friend, is back in the small town of Rose Lake for Christmas and he is determined to make sure his birthday doesn't go by the hatch.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: After the events in Jane's house, the vise tightened around Red John. The identification of the killer becomes the priority of the CBI.
programme.desc-more: After gradually reducing his list of suspects concerning Red John, the serial killer who upset his life, Patrick Jane (Simon Baker) finds himself facing an increasingly complex dilemma. The closer he approaches the identity of the murderer, the more he intensifyes his acts of violence, sowing terror around him. Despite the traps set by Red John, Jane is perceptive and manages to expose the criminal. However, their explosive confrontation forces Jane to flee the country to escape the threat she faces. Two years later, Teresa Lisbon's team (Robin Tunney) was dissolved, and Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti) and Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) began a new life together. As Jane lives under a false identity, a new opportunity presents itself to him, marking the beginning of a season full of tensions and revelations, with the arrival of new characters, including Kim Fischer (Emily Swallow) and the FBI agent, who bring an unexpected dynamic to the plot.

programme.title: Daily, part two
programme.desc: Your information, culture, sport and humour appointment with Yann Barthès and his team.

programme.title: The big bulk
programme.desc: The Grand Vrac is a short entertainment program incarnated by Camille Lellouche. In the form of a humorous, off-the-shelf TV game, it makes bulk practice a popular, fun and accessible subject for all. Through a large print run, viewers have the opportunity to get their shopping reimbursed, while (re)discovering this simple way of consumption to integrate into everyday life.

programme.title: 90' Investigations
programme.sub-title: Raid Police Officers: Strong Operations for High-Risk Missions
programme.desc: RAID, the Elite Police Unit, is celebrating its 40th anniversary. From the selection of these experienced men to the most tense missions, a team followed the daily lives of these exceptional police officers. Each year, hundreds of them try to integrate RAID, but few resist multiple tests.
programme.desc-more: Dive into the heart of RAID, the elite unit of the National Police, which celebrates its 40th anniversary this year. With 500 men trained in the most dangerous situations, this intervention force was founded, among other things, by Commissioner Broussard, famous for having ended Jacques Mesrine's cavalry. Each year, hundreds of candidates try to join their ranks, but few pass the physical and mental tests, which are particularly challenging. For elected officials, rigorous training begins. Because on the ground, the pressure is permanent.

programme.title: 90' Investigations
programme.sub-title: French Army Against Drug Traffic: A Merciless War in the Caribbean
programme.desc: Martinique and Guadeloupe have become hubs of international drug trafficking. Tens of tons of cocaine and cannabis are smuggled in each year. To combat this scourge, the French army is fighting a daily battle against traffickers in the Caribbean Sea.
programme.desc-more: Guadeloupe and Martinique are jewels with many attractions. But life in the Caribbean is not necessarily as sweet as it seems. The location of these islands, close to the drug-producing countries, makes them ideal entry points for the export of drugs to European territory. This international drug trafficking logically mobilizes the French army, which patrol, especially with the support of frigates Le Ventôse and Le Germinal, daily to intercept the boats of the traffickers.

programme.sub-title: The exceptional rescue of some 60 cats
programme.desc: Faced with the growing abandonments, this series follows the daily lives of SPA shelters. Employees and volunteers work to care for and find a new animal home.

programme.title: Animals to adopt: new family for a new life

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.sub-title: The dream will not come true
programme.desc: The team joins a working group of infiltration in the hope of breaking a terrible underground network of human trafficking.
programme.desc-more: In the bustling streets of New York, the Special Unit for Victims, led by the Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) determined, is facing disturbing cases that test their skills and humanity. In this 21st season, inspectors, including the faithful Fin Tutuola (Ice-T) and the insight Kat Tamin (Jamie Gray Hyder), are delving into complex investigations of sexual crimes, child abuse and domestic violence. Each episode reveals the emotional and moral challenges that team members face as they navigate between the pain of victims and the quest for justice. Unity, often confronted with failing systems and prejudices, must also manage its own internal struggles, while striving to restore hope and dignity to the people it serves. The series, rich in drama and tension, offers a free-ranging look at often neglected realities.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: After ten years of hard hunting, Jane finally discovers the identity of Red John who, as he expected, is not an unknown to him.
programme.desc-more: After gradually reducing his list of suspects concerning Red John, the serial killer who upset his life, Patrick Jane (Simon Baker) finds himself facing an increasingly complex dilemma. The closer he approaches the identity of the murderer, the more he intensifyes his acts of violence, sowing terror around him. Despite the traps set by Red John, Jane is perceptive and manages to expose the criminal. However, their explosive confrontation forces Jane to flee the country to escape the threat she faces. Two years later, Teresa Lisbon's team (Robin Tunney) was dissolved, and Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti) and Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) began a new life together. As Jane lives under a false identity, a new opportunity presents itself to him, marking the beginning of a season full of tensions and revelations, with the arrival of new characters, including Kim Fischer (Emily Swallow) and the FBI agent, who bring an unexpected dynamic to the plot.

programme.desc-more: After gradually reducing his list of suspects concerning Red John, the serial killer who upset his life, Patrick Jane (Simon Baker) finds himself facing an increasingly complex dilemma. The closer he approaches the identity of the murderer, the more he intensifyes his acts of violence, sowing terror around him. Despite the traps set by Red John, Jane is perceptive and manages to expose the criminal. However, their explosive confrontation forces Jane to flee the country to escape the threat she faces. Two years later, Teresa Lisbon's team (Robin Tunney) was dissolved, and Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti) and Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) began a new life together. As Jane lives under a false identity, a new opportunity presents itself to him, marking the beginning of a season full of tensions and revelations, with the arrival of new characters, including Kim Fischer (Emily Swallow) and the FBI agent, who bring an unexpected dynamic to the plot.

programme.title: Quotidien Daily Show

Between immersive reports, chronicles, interviews, "Quotidien" offers a condensation of the current affairs thanks to columnists such as Jean-Michel Aphatie, Amber Chalumeau, Julien Bellver, Étienne Carbonnier and Pablo Mira. The show also hosts several guests, both French and international. Concerts are even held on the stage.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: the two towers
programme.desc: To save the world, two young, fearless hobbits must throw an evil ring into the fire of a volcano, and their friends face a powerful witch.
programme.desc-more: In Middle Earth, where the shadows of Sauron spread more and more daily, the struggle for the survival of free peoples reached a decisive turning point. Frodo Sacquet (Elijah Wood), carrying the Unique Ring, and his tireless companion Sam Gamegie (Sean Astin) continue their exhausting march towards the Mordor, a cursed territory where every step brings them closer to their destiny. Their route, sown with tangles and despair, is now guided by a disturbing presence: Gollum (Andy Serkis), a creature torn between his visceral hatred for the Hobbits and his sickly obsession with the Ring. Sometimes ambiguous allies, sometimes creeping threats, Gollum leads them through mortal marshes and hostile mountains, where every decision could seal their fate. Meanwhile, the Ring Community, dispersed but not defeated, faced its own trials. Aragorn (Viggo Mortensen), heir to a throne he still refuses to assume, Legolas (Orlando Bloom), the mortally shot elf, and Gimli (John Rhys-Davies), the dwarf in the heat of fire, are pursuing the monstrous Uruk-hai creatures of Saraumane, who have taken away their young companions Merry (Dominic Monaghan) and Pippin (Billy Boyd). Their quest leads them to Rohan, a kingdom where legendary riders see their strength slashed under the corrupt influence of Sarumane. There they discovered Theoden (Bernard Hill), a broken king, manipulated by the fates of the enemy, whose people were on the brink of annihilation.

programme.title: 90' Investigations
programme.sub-title: Raid Police Officers: Strong Operations for High-Risk Missions
programme.desc: RAID, the Elite Police Unit, is celebrating its 40th anniversary. From the selection of these experienced men to the most tense missions, a team followed the daily lives of these exceptional police officers. Each year, hundreds of them try to integrate RAID, but few resist multiple tests.
programme.desc-more: Dive into the heart of RAID, the elite unit of the National Police, which celebrates its 40th anniversary this year. With 500 men trained in the most dangerous situations, this intervention force was founded, among other things, by Commissioner Broussard, famous for having ended Jacques Mesrine's cavalry. Each year, hundreds of candidates try to join their ranks, but few pass the physical and mental tests, which are particularly challenging. For elected officials, rigorous training begins. Because on the ground, the pressure is permanent.
