programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Alexis is relieved: he found the two crooks who scammed the beach bar. He decides, in turn, to fool thieves with Jessica's help.
programme.desc-more: Caroline (Tonya Kinzinger) made her big comeback, leaving behind her the tensions that had passed with Bertrand, who finally decided to turn the page on her adventure with Tony. However, a new obstacle is emerging on their way: Louis (Frédéric Deban) is in prison, wrongly accused of the murder of Julia. While Jessica (Adeline Blondieau) holds a valuable video surveillance tape from the clinic that could exonerate Louis, she also reveals compromising evidence against Paolo (Luis Marquès). In another part of the city, Iannis (Romeo Sarfati) makes an unexpected connection with a tramp, who turns out to be David, his son's father. At the same time, the clinic faces a major challenge when a sick inmate, entrusted by Lieutenant Peretti, takes Laure (Bénédicte Delmas) as a hostage. This twelfth season promises its lot of intrigues, surprises and haletant twists.

programme.title: Charlie and the chocolate factory
programme.desc: A modest boy participates in a contest organized by the director of a chocolate factory. The key: a visit to the famous candy factory.
programme.desc-more: At the heart of this adventure is Charlie Bucket (Freddie Highmore), a boy with a big heart from a modest family, close to him in a small house with cracked walls. Despite the deprivations, Charlie keeps his passion for chocolate intact, a rare luxury he savors with delights. When Willy Wonka (Johnny Depp), the mysterious and eccentric owner of the famous Wonka chocolate shop, announces a contest as unexpected as it is exceptional, hope is invited into Charlie's life. Five gold tickets, hidden in chocolate tablets around the world, will offer their happy holders an exclusive tour of the factory – and a lifetime store of sweets. For Charlie, whose every play counts, this quest is an impossible challenge... But the impossible never stopped the dreamers. While tickets are discovered one by one by spoiled, capricious or simply lucky children, Charlie finds himself in a competition as exciting as it is perilous. Each candidate embodies a trait of character pushed to the extreme, and Wonka's factory, with its technological wonders and enigmatic Oompa-Loompas, seems designed to test much more than their resistance to sugar. But behind the laughter and the cascades of candy, there is a deeper question: what does Willy Wonka really want by opening the doors of his sweet kingdom? And why does Charlie, among all the children, seem to draw his attention?

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: the Ring Community
programme.desc: To save the world from an all-powerful evil force, a group of brave adventurers must destroy a ring at the very place of its creation.
programme.desc-more: Frodo Sacquet (Elijah Wood), a young hobby as discreet as it is courageous, inherits a ring of modest appearance, forged once by Sauron, the Lord of Darkness. This jewel is none other than the Unique Ring, an instrument of absolute power capable of corrupting anyone who owns it and of delivering the Middle Earth to eternal slavery. Under the wise advice of Gandalf the Grey (Ian McKellen), a wise and dreaded magician, Frodo understands that he must leave the County, his peaceful village, to undertake a perilous journey to the Destiny Mountain, the only place where the Ring can be destroyed. But such a journey is not alone. Around Frodo the Community of the Ring is formed, an unlikely alliance of nine companions with different origins and motivations: Sam (Sean Astin), his faithful gardener and childhood friend, ready to follow him to the ends of the world; Meriadoc and Pippin (Dominic Monaghan and Billy Boyd), two mischievous hobbits whose carelessness hides unfailing loyalty; Aragorn (Viggo Mortensen), a mysterious ranger and heir to a forgotten throne, marked by a history of fighting and sacrifice; Legolas (Orlando Bloom), an elf archer with piercing eyes and mortal grace; Gimli (John Rhys-Davies), a bulge but valiant dwarf, representing a proud and distrustful people towards the elves; and Boromir (Sean Bean), a Gondor man tormented by the weight of his legacy and the expectations of his declining kingdom.

programme.title: The Christmas Magic Cookies
programme.desc: Luis sells the Panadería Casillas and asks Maya, who is a lawyer, to assist him. The Panadería Casillas is a pastry that makes Christmas cookies made from gingerbread that have magic power. When a Casillas prepares a cake cake especially for someone, this person can make a wish. Maya, for her part, is preparing for an interview to join a large law firm in Dener. This is not to mention the arrival of Luis' nephew Alex, who is also a lawyer and works in New York. Maya and Alex haven't met since they were together in high school. At that time, they were in love with each other, without anything ever happened between them.

programme.title: The secret recipe for Christmas cookies
programme.desc: Annie, the heir of the cookie factory owned by her late grandmother, is trying to move from New York to Maplewood, the town where she wants to run the company. But its way too modern quickly ends up causing anger from the local population...

programme.title: The secret Christmas pact
programme.desc: As Christmas approaches. Chris and Kate, twins with diametrically opposed lives, are challenging to exchange places. Once the exchange is completed, the unexpected increases. Ready to give up the challenge, the two sisters meet someone each, but under the identity of the other...
programme.desc-more: Twins with opposite lives, Chris and Kate decide to exchange their place as Christmas approaches. But it's not all going as planned. They are about to abandon the challenge. Then each one meets and changes her mind.

programme.title: Christmas in the skin of another
programme.desc: Audrey, a waitress in a restaurant and mother of a little girl, leads a simple and disorderly life. Julia, a businesswoman ordered and snob, puts her family in the middle of the line. As Christmas parties approach, these two women, whom everything opposes, find themselves magically in the body of the other...
programme.desc-more: Audrey, waitress and mother of a little girl in a disorderly daily, one day goes to the same Christmas shop as Snob Julia, businesswoman and real work executioner. Each one then finds himself in the skin of the other, discovering a life opposite to his.

programme.title: Balanced Meals
programme.desc: Laurent Mariotte gives all the tricks to make good dishes, like a real chef, with fresh and seasonal ingredients.

programme.title: Super Mario Bros, the movie
programme.desc: Bowser, the wicked Koopa, wishes to rule the Mushroom kingdom and has for that purpose an army under his command. But it is without counting on the presence of the famous plumber, Mario, who is called to the rescue to help Princess Peach, but also to save her brother Luigi...
programme.desc-more: As they try to repair an underground pipe, Mario and his brother Luigi, both plumbers, find themselves immersed in a new fairy world through a mysterious conduit. But when the two brothers are separated, Mario is engaged in a very exciting adventure to find Luigi. In his quest, he can count on the help of the fungus Toad, resident of the Mushroom Kingdom, and the wise advice, in combat techniques, of Princess Peach, a determined warrior at the head of the Kingdom. Thus Mario managed to mobilize his own forces to complete his mission.

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Fire Cup
programme.desc: A major event is taking place in Poudlard: the Three Witchers' tournament, whose participants from all countries are traditionally designated by the Fire Cup. To the general surprise, the Cup selects Harry, who is not old enough to participate. He gets a waiver...
programme.desc-more: While the mortuary leaves of Poudlard Park are stained red by the early autumn frimas, an unusual excitement is shaking the corridors of the school of witchcraft. This year, the legendary Three Witchers' Tournament is re-appearing, a magical competition as perilous as it is prestigious, opposing the champions of the three largest European schools: Poudlard, Beauxbâtons and Durmstrang. Around the Fire Cup, an ancient artifact with blue flames, students and teachers gather, eager to discover the names of the happy elected ones. Yet, no one expects the magic fire to simmer to spit out a fourth name, that of a participant who should never have been in the run: Harry Potter (Daniel Radcliffe). Accused of cheating by a part of the school and viewed with distrust by his peers, Harry found himself despite being propelled into the heart of a tournament where every event puts his life in danger. Between dragons spitting fire, deadly puzzles at the bottom of a black lake and mazes haunted by invisible creatures, the challenges follow each other, more formidable than the other. Yet, behind the murmurs and suspicions, a question persists: how could the Cup have designated a witch who has not even reached the required age? As tensions rise and alliances become fragile, Harry gradually discovers that an invisible hand pulls strings from this tournament... A hand that belongs to the one whose name is the blood of the sorcerers: Lord Voldemort.

programme.title: Daily, first part

programme.title: Daily, part two
programme.desc: In this second part, Yann Barthès and his entire team come back to the news and often present it in an impertinent and funny way.

programme.title: Quotidien Daily Show
programme.desc: A great information session that combines humour and impertinence. French and international politics, media, culture, sport: all topics are reviewed. Each show has a carte blanche to deal with the news in its own way.
programme.desc-more: This program offers a talk show based on current facts. Presented by former Little Journal host Yann Barthès, the show is broadcast in prime time access every day of the week. Between immersive reports, chronicles, interviews, "Quotidien" offers a condensation of the current affairs thanks to columnists such as Jean-Michel Aphatie, Amber Chalumeau, Julien Bellver, Étienne Carbonnier and Pablo Mira. The show also hosts several guests, both French and international. Concerts are even held on the stage.

programme.title: Hunger Games
programme.desc: In the ruins of North America, a repressive state forces its twelve districts to send two teenagers each year to the Hunger Games, bloody circus games. When little Prim was drawn to the 12th District, her 16-year-old sister Katniss volunteered to replace her...
programme.desc-more: After a series of blood-crash revolts, the United States has left room for Panem, a totalitarian nation divided into 12 submissive districts, each exploited for the resources of a luxurious and cruel Capitol. To remind everyone of the price of the rebellion, the regime organizes an annual television event as popular as it is human: the Hunger Games. Twenty-four teenagers, a boy and a girl drawn at random in each district, are thrown into a deadly arena where only one rule applies: kill or be killed. The winners gain glory, the losers offer their death in entertainment. And for the Capitol, the show must continue. Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence), 16, was taught in childhood to survive in the ruins of District 12, a mining territory where hunger is rumbling and hope is measured in pieces of stolen bread. She is an outstanding hunter, and every day she braves the limits of the forbidden forest to feed her family, composed of her mother, broken by grief, and her little sister, Prim (Willow Shields), soft and vulnerable. When the day of the Month arrives – this drawing with lots that seals the fate of the Tributes – Katniss only has a prayer: let the name Prim not be called. Yet when the spell falls upon her sister, a visceral instinct pushes her to act. She volunteered to replace her, sealing her entrance into the arena and possibly her death sentence.

programme.title: 90' Investigations
programme.sub-title: Stups, drivers, drunk nights: the gendarmes of Brittany on alert
programme.desc: Every summer, when tourists flock, the gendarmes of Brittany are on the lookout to stop the seasonal rise of delinquency. The 200 police officers of the Lorient company are involved in fighting, often related to alcohol consumption, road accidents or other drama.
programme.desc-more: In the summer, with the influx of tourists, delinquency increased by 20% in southern Brittany. For two months, the magazine's team followed the daily lives of the Lorient gendarmes. Jacques must intervene to stop an unbalanced bar tour and threatening passersby with a kitchen knife. Geoffrey and Ludwig, on the other hand, try to get drivers. Some people don't hesitate to flee or make up their plaque. Lionel, on the other hand, is about to live a restless night, with a serious accident and a degenerating marital dispute.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Accused of murder, Jessica (Bénédicte Delmas) finds herself behind bars, while her colleagues at the Academy continue their rehearsals, determined not to let this tragedy start their passion for the show. When she was released, Jessica invested herself in her life, but fate was subject to other trials. Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), for her part, learns that Louis (Romeo Sarfati) must undergo a cardiac transplant, a news that further complicates the dynamics of the group. Meanwhile, Mathias (Lionel Auguste), who was the victim of an accident, faced a difficult reality after losing the use of her legs. Jessica's health is deteriorating, because she discovers that she has breast cancer. Followed by Laure at the Gulf Clinic, she refuses to let her disease define her existence. This thirteenth season is marked by dramatic events that upset the daily lives of this joyful band, facing unprecedented emotional and physical challenges.
programme.desc-more: In Saint-Tropez, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a medical student, is preparing to marry Alain. However, on the day of her marriage, she felt an irrepressible impulse to find Grégory (Stéphane Slima), her youthful love, and decided to flee the altar. At the same time, Louis (Romeo Sarfati), the brother of Grégory, was dismissed from high school and crossed the road to Caroline (Adeline Blondieau), an attractive singer but engaged with the artist Samuel. Louis was immediately charmed and engaged in a quest to conquer his heart, even if it brought him into conflict with Samuel. As each person's life crosses, Jessica (Marie-Christine Adam), an American woman met by Gregory on a trip, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Laure, wary of this new coming, ends up being friends with her, which further complicates the relationships between the characters. Tearing choices and complex feelings emerge in this canvas of life full of passion and twists.

programme.title: Let me have your hand at Christmas.
programme.desc: Becoming an expert in Christmas traditions, Christy, a commercial in a toy company, is challenged to organize a reception for a customer. But this one is Jewish. Christy, who has no knowledge of Hanukca's traditions, must quickly learn.

programme.title: Twelve puppies for Christmas
programme.desc: A beginner canine therapist, Erin is responsible for finding homes for twelve puppies abandoned before Christmas. A mission that brings her closer to her boss, Martin. This one will prove less unpleasant and egocentric than she thought.

programme.title: Nine kittens for Christmas
programme.desc: Back in Oregon to see his family at Christmas, Marilee, who runs a veterinary clinic in Miami with her boyfriend, Miles, falls on Zachary, his ex. He discovered a box filled with nine kittens abandoned in front of the fire station where he worked. With Marilee's help, he's trying to find them a family before Christmas...

programme.title: Christmas, my boss & me
programme.desc: In the hope of saving the coffee that her adoptive parents hold, Annie Park, an independent lawyer, goes to the premises of a real estate developer. She made a deal with William Holt, the entrepreneur's son. She agrees to pretend to be her lawyer for a week, in order to escape from the one assigned to her by her father, who does not trust her, if he undertakes in exchange to save the institution.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: After gradually reducing his list of suspects concerning Red John, the serial killer who upset his life, Patrick Jane (Simon Baker) finds himself facing an increasingly complex dilemma. The closer he approaches the identity of the murderer, the more he intensifyes his acts of violence, sowing terror around him. Despite the traps set by Red John, Jane is perceptive and manages to expose the criminal. However, their explosive confrontation forces Jane to flee the country to escape the threat she faces. Two years later, Teresa Lisbon's team (Robin Tunney) was dissolved, and Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti) and Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) began a new life together. As Jane lives under a false identity, a new opportunity presents itself to him, marking the beginning of a season full of tensions and revelations, with the arrival of new characters, including Kim Fischer (Emily Swallow) and the FBI agent, who bring an unexpected dynamic to the plot.
programme.desc-more: Patrick Jane (Simon Baker), a talented mentalist who reads people and analyzes their behaviour, uses his skills to help the California Bureau of Investigation (CBI) solve complex criminal cases. With a sense of caustic humour and a sometimes controversial approach, he worked closely with Agent Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney), whose rigor and professionalism contrasted with Patrick's more disdainful nature. Together, they make up a dynamic team that navigates through thrilling investigations while trying to solve personal mysteries. In the background, Patrick is also obsessed with his quest for revenge against Red John, a serial killer who tragically took the life of his wife and daughter. This hunt led him to juggle his role as an investigator with his inner demons, revealing the depths of his psyche while unifying the sons of criminal plotters.

programme.title: The Holiday
programme.desc: As the Christmas holidays approach, as the lights glitter and the world seems bathed in magic, two women, whom everything opposes, prepare to live an unexpected parenthesis, far from the disappointments that have furnished their year. Iris Simpkins (Kate Winslet), a British journalist with discreet charm and romantic soul, has just discovered the cruel truth: his fiancé, Jasper (Rufus Sewell), he deceived and is about to marry another woman. She wanders through the snowy streets of London, feeling betrayed not only by the man she loved, but also by this period of the year that is supposed to celebrate love and joy. On the other side of the Atlantic, Amanda Woods (Cameron Diaz), a Hollywood producer with a well-dipped character and a frantic rhythm of life, has also suffered a painful disillusionment: her companion, whom she believed to be faithful, abandoned her without remorse. Exasperated by the lies and cynicism of Los Angeles, she only aspires to one thing: flee. It is by almost magic chance, via an online ad, that these two women who are separated decide to exchange their lives during the holidays. Iris leaves his picturesque and warm cottage, nestled in the English countryside, to settle in the luxurious and sunny villa of Amanda in Beverly Hills. Amanda, however, landed in a world a few light years from her daily life: an English village where pubs cracked fire, where neighbours greeted each other with sincerity, and where time seemed to be stopped. While Iris discovers California's glamour and agitation, trying to rebuild under the golden sun, Amanda, uncomfortable in this idyllic yet authentic decor, finds herself confronted with simplicity that destabilizes her as much as she touches her. Yet, far from their landmarks, each will experience an experience that will upset their certainty. Between unexpected encounters – a shy and attentive composer for Iris, a charming brother and land-to-earth for Amanda – and discoveries about themselves, they will gradually rediscover what they had forgotten: the trust, the joy of little things, and perhaps even love. But as Christmas approaches, and with him the end of their exchange, a question arises: will these fortuitous meetings suffice to heal their wounds? And above all, will they dare to seize this second chance that offers themselves to them, or will they let this spark of happiness spout like a mere illusion of vacation?

programme.title: 90' Investigations
programme.sub-title: Christmas markets and department stores: the madness of the biggest rush of the year
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 13 of the 90' series Investigations

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: "The curse" Jessica finds herself in prison. David's in the hospital and the classes are suspended. The students of the Academy decide to continue the rehearsals.
programme.desc-more: Caroline (Tonya Kinzinger) made her big comeback, leaving behind her the tensions that had passed with Bertrand, who finally decided to turn the page on her adventure with Tony. However, a new obstacle is emerging on their way: Louis (Frédéric Deban) is in prison, wrongly accused of the murder of Julia. While Jessica (Adeline Blondieau) holds a valuable video surveillance tape from the clinic that could exonerate Louis, she also reveals compromising evidence against Paolo (Luis Marquès). In another part of the city, Iannis (Romeo Sarfati) makes an unexpected connection with a tramp, who turns out to be David, his son's father. At the same time, the clinic faces a major challenge when a sick inmate, entrusted by Lieutenant Peretti, takes Laure (Bénédicte Delmas) as a hostage. This twelfth season promises its lot of intrigues, surprises and haletant twists.

In another part of the city, Iannis (Romeo Sarfati) makes an unexpected connection with a tramp, who turns out to be David, his son's father. At the same time, the clinic faces a major challenge when a sick inmate, entrusted by Lieutenant Peretti, takes Laure (Bénédicte Delmas) as a hostage. This twelfth season promises its lot of intrigues, surprises and haletant twists.

programme.title: Married at Christmas!
programme.desc: Leah is going to be 30 on the same day as her brother Paul's wedding. Drew, their childhood neighbour and friend, is back in the small town of Rose Lake for Christmas and he is determined to make sure his birthday doesn't go by the hatch.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: "Mr. X"Five DEA agents were murdered. During the investigation, Jane fell under the charm of one of the witnesses, a woman indirectly linked to drug trafficking.
programme.desc-more: After gradually reducing his list of suspects concerning Red John, the serial killer who upset his life, Patrick Jane (Simon Baker) finds himself facing an increasingly complex dilemma. The closer he approaches the identity of the murderer, the more he intensifyes his acts of violence, sowing terror around him. Despite the traps set by Red John, Jane is perceptive and manages to expose the criminal. However, their explosive confrontation forces Jane to flee the country to escape the threat she faces. As Jane lives under a false identity, a new opportunity presents itself to him, marking the beginning of a season full of tensions and revelations, with the arrival of new characters, including Kim Fischer (Emily Swallow) and the FBI agent, who bring an unexpected dynamic to the plot.

programme.title: 90' Investigations
programme.sub-title: Raid Police Officers: Strong Operations for High-Risk Missions
programme.desc: Dive into the heart of RAID, the elite unit of the National Police, which celebrates its 40th anniversary this year. With 500 men trained in the most dangerous situations, this intervention force was founded, among other things, by Commissioner Broussard, famous for having ended Jacques Mesrine's cavalry. Each year, hundreds of candidates try to join their ranks, but few pass the physical and mental tests, which are particularly challenging. For elected officials, rigorous training begins. Because on the ground, the pressure is permanent.

programme.title: 90' Investigations
programme.sub-title: French Army Against Drug Traffic: A Merciless War in the Caribbean
programme.desc: Guadeloupe and Martinique are jewels with many attractions. But life in the Caribbean is not necessarily as sweet as it seems. The location of these islands, close to the drug-producing countries, makes them ideal entry points for the export of drugs to European territory. This international drug trafficking logically mobilizes the French army, which patrol, especially with the support of frigates Le Ventôse and Le Germinal, daily to intercept the boats of the traffickers.

programme.desc-more: The show "Star Academy" – which saw the birth of many successful singers such as Nolwenn Leroy, Olivai Ruiz or Jenifer – appeared in 2001 – has made a big return to TF1 in 2022 after fourteen years of absence. Their days are thus littered with classes, rehearsals, but also moments of relaxation and complicity in the heart of an exceptional experience that will mark them forever.

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The one who bluffed the social worker
programme.desc: The person who will decide whether Monica and Chandler are capable of adopting a child is Joey's ex-girlfriend, whom he didn't call back after he seduced her.
programme.desc-more: While the iconic group of friends is at a decisive turning point in their lives, Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) must navigate in a new emotional balance. He is divided between his feelings for Charlie, Joey Tribbiani's girlfriend (Matt LeBlanc), who also questions his own relationship with Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston). Rachel, for her part, is considering a professional opportunity in Paris, which further complicates the dynamics between the characters. Meanwhile, Monica Geller (Courteney Cox) and Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) are taking steps to start a family, dreaming of a peaceful life in the suburbs. Unexpected reunions with Janice (Maggie Wheeler) add a dose of comedy and nostalgia, while Phoebe Buffay (Lisa Kudrow) receives a wedding proposal from Mike Hannigan (Paul Rudd). This explosive and emotional finale celebrates friendship, love and choices that define life.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: A month in the maternity halls of the hospital centre of Poissy-Saint-Germain, the most important in Ile-de-France, where every year 4,500 babies are born.
programme.desc-more: After the success of the first season, the maternity clinic of the inter-municipal hospital in Poissy-Saint-Germain, where a baby comes into the world every two hours, returns to the maternity ward. For almost a month, fifty cameras filmed 24 hours a day the privacy of families, as well as the daily lives of maternity workers. Coralie, 17, and single, Sophie, who is about to give birth to triplets, Stéphane super "coach" who (re) falls in love with his wife, Daouda very stressed because his wife has to undergo a caesarean... so many intense and sensitive situations.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Whether they help midwives or make it difficult for them, most dads would miss the great moment of birth for nothing in the world.
programme.desc-more: There is a regret that men will never admit: not being able to bring children to life. In secret, they would like to have this incredible gift that nature has entrusted only to women. So, because of the lack of birthing, today the dads decided to occupy the ground and appropriate this unique moment. Whether they help midwives or make it difficult for them, most dads would miss this great moment for nothing in the world. Men of courage want to enjoy this magical moment by all means, and to do so do not retreat in front of anything.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: For almost a month, fifty cameras went to Poissy's maternity home to film the daily lives of medical personnel and their patients.
programme.desc-more: Women's expectations of childbirth are as high as future mothers themselves. Some want to control everything, others hope that this moment is as short as possible or that everything will be carried out according to their convictions, even if it is suffering. So midwives and doctors must listen to their desires, even when they are rather unusual. But birth sometimes escapes all predictions and the health care teams, such as the parturients and their entourage, are forced to recover from it during the events.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: Since her mother died, Haley, devastated by grief, is no longer the same. Brooke has to deal with her mother's and Alexander's love relationship.
programme.desc-more: After Lucas (Chad Michael Murray) and Peyton (Hilarie Burton) left Tree Hill, the city was in a state of rapid growth. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) takes over the musical label, determined to make the talents she supports shine. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush) is preparing to launch a new collection for her brand, settling in with Julian (Austin Nichols), who is working on an ambitious film production. The dynamics of their relationship evolve as they together face the challenges of the entertainment world. Millicent (Lisa Goldstein), influenced by Clothes Over Bros' new agry, Alex (Jana Kramer), is beginning to change behaviour, creating tensions. At the same time, Nathan (James Lafferty) is plunged into a scandal that threatens his marriage to Haley, and Clay (Robert Buckley), his sports agent, is trying to keep the family at bay. This season, marked by twists and the arrival of new memorable characters, explores the challenges of friendship, love and professional ambitions.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: The whole gang is back from Utah. While Haley discovers that she is pregnant, Clay and Quinn, seriously injured by Katie, are between life and death.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting eighth season, Nathan Scott (James Lafferty) is embarking on a new phase of his sports career, exploring opportunities outside basketball fields, while juggling with the challenges of personal life. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) is receiving news that could upset her life and her family. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush), in the midst of wedding preparations, faced increasing difficulties with her shop, which her mother Victoria (Jana Kramer) seemed to be endangering by constant disagreements. Determined not to let these obstacles affect him, Brooke seeks to advance in her personal life. At the same time, the Quinn couple (Shantel VanSanten) and Clay (Robert Buckley) face a dangerous situation that threatens their happiness. This season is marked by palpable dramatic tension, with events that accumulate and heavy consequences to bear for all protagonists.

programme.desc: 27 young people, including two women, aged 21-35, dream of becoming commando instructors and joining the army elite. All are already experienced soldiers, but only a handful will achieve its goal. For three weeks, trials are taking place in a true course of the fighter.
programme.desc-more: 27 young people, including two women, aged 21 to 35, dream of becoming commando instructor and joining the army elite. To achieve this, they must surpass themselves in ruthless trials. All are already experienced soldiers, but only a handful will achieve its goal. For three weeks, trials, day and night, in the forest as in the water, are taking place in a true journey of the fighter where no weakness is tolerated. Candidates must hold, at all costs. The aim is to plunge these commandos apprentice instructors into a state of extreme fatigue to test their physical abilities, resistance and ability to push their limits.

programme.sub-title: Mulhouse: The elite PSIG gendarmes on alert!

programme.title: Emergency Calls
programme.sub-title: Normandy Gendarmes: The Battle Against Delinquency
programme.desc: At 1:30 am, in the department of Eure in Normandy, daily life seems peaceful. Yet in the Norman countryside, 1200 gendarmes face crime in all its forms: break-in robberies, unconscious driving at nearly 300 km/h, disturbing disappearance of a mother, neighbourhood conflicts or gang robbers. The cameras followed two months of turbulent interventions with the Eure gendarmes.

programme.title: Emergency Calls
programme.sub-title: Allier firemen: shock missions on the road of all dangers
programme.desc: Every 19 minutes, the 2000 Allier firefighters go into operation, often for out-of-standard missions. The teams had to extract a horse drowning in the vase, rescue injured hikers in a hard-to-reach gorge or face an attack by Asian hornets.
programme.desc-more: The Allier fire department is responsible for the security of the department. And it is on average every 19 minutes that they intervene for missions that are sometimes out of order. From the rescue of the drowning of a 500-pound horse to the rescue of injured hikers, through an attack of Asian hornets, they are on all fronts and must stand ready for various and varied interventions. In addition, one of the most dangerous nationals crosses the department and is the site of many accidents.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Fifty cameras observe the daily life of the staff of a maternity in Ile-de-France, where, every year, more than 4,500 babies are born.
programme.desc-more: If it takes a baby about 41 weeks to develop in the best conditions in her mother's belly, it may be that this time frame is shortened, sometimes up to 23 weeks. In France, nearly one in ten babies is born prematurely. Whether spontaneous or induced prematurity, it is the health of the child and the mother who are at stake. Parents must then exercise composure and put the life of the newborn in the hands of midwives. The maternity of Poissy Saint-Germain-en-Laye is often confronted with the most serious situations.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: Miranda spent her last day in Tree Hill before flying to England. Haley has completely isolated himself from his own. Quinn takes Jamie to a treasure hunt.
programme.desc-more: After Lucas (Chad Michael Murray) and Peyton (Hilarie Burton) left Tree Hill, the city was in a state of rapid growth. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) takes over the musical label, determined to make the talents she supports shine. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush) is preparing to launch a new collection for her brand, settling in with Julian (Austin Nichols), who is working on an ambitious film production. The dynamics of their relationship evolve as they together face the challenges of the entertainment world. Millicent (Lisa Goldstein), influenced by Clothes Over Bros' new agry, Alex (Jana Kramer), is beginning to change behaviour, creating tensions. At the same time, Nathan (James Lafferty) is plunged into a scandal that threatens his marriage to Haley, and Clay (Robert Buckley), his sports agent, is trying to keep the family at bay. This season, marked by twists and the arrival of new memorable characters, explores the challenges of friendship, love and professional ambitions.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: The whole gang is back from Utah. While Haley discovers that she is pregnant, Clay and Quinn, seriously injured by Katie, are between life and death.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting eighth season, Nathan Scott (James Lafferty) is embarking on a new phase of his sports career, exploring opportunities outside basketball fields, while juggling with the challenges of personal life. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) is receiving news that could upset her life and her family. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush), in the midst of wedding preparations, faced increasing difficulties with her shop, which her mother Victoria (Jana Kramer) seemed to be endangering by constant disagreements. Determined not to let these obstacles affect him, Brooke seeks to advance in her personal life. At the same time, the Quinn couple (Shantel VanSanten) and Clay (Robert Buckley) face a dangerous situation that threatens their happiness. This season is marked by palpable dramatic tension, with events that accumulate and heavy consequences to bear for all protagonists.

programme.title: Welcome home
programme.desc: Alexandre and Julien open the doors of their establishment. Near Vesoul, these two friends have built more than 2 hectares of unusual housing inspired by the Far North.
programme.desc-more: The most famous guest house competition offers many surprises! Discover exceptional areas, moments of sharing and conviviality... but also competition and sharp criticism, prepare yourself for twists at each stage! Where the houses have charm and the guests of character: Every week, four couples open the doors of their guest house and receive themselves in turn to judge each other! From the reception to the quality of services, to the inspection of the house and its exteriors, to the quality/price ratio... everything will be checked and noted without concession. At the end of the week, only one duo will win the coveted title of "Best Guest House" and leave with the sum of €3,000.

programme.desc: In front of the love coach, Vivian explains why he wants to leave the adventure, before he goes after Jonathan again. At the villa, Marine is revising to impress Valentin.
programme.desc-more: A group of anonymous men and women or who have already participated in reality TV shows in the past is housed in a superb villa with the aim of solving their problems related to their love life. To help them, the seduction coach Lucie Mariotti offers them a galant appointment with suitors from outside. The expert is also present at individual coaching sessions to try to learn more about the failures of their sentimental past and help them identify the nature of the brakes to their love happiness.

programme.title: The three brothers
programme.desc: Upon the death of their mother, who left a fabulous pactole for their inheritance, three brothers, who had never met before, learned to know each other.
programme.desc-more: Didier Latour (Didier Bourdon), Bernard Latour (Bernard Campan) and Pascal Latour (Pascal Légitimus) have nothing in common, except for the same father they never knew. On the day a notary calls them to announce that they inherit three million francs, their lives are changing. Money, crazy projects, dreams of greatness... Everything seems possible. But their euphoria is short: a simple administrative delay, and poof! The fortune their file between fingers. Worse still, they find themselves accused of fraud, hunted down by the police and the bailiffs, and forced to flee with, as a bonus, a child turbulent of which no one wants. Then begins a frantic run through France, where our three unlucky "brothers" chain the galleys with an innate talent to make things worse. Between begging disguised as a street show, attempts to rob disastrouss and encounters with characters more hideous than each other, their journey becomes a series of disasters as unpredictable as hilarious. Every plan to get out of business turns into a fiasco, every lie collapses under their own unsureness, and their emerging solidarity is constantly being tested.

programme.title: Crime Chronicles
programme.desc: On 20 February 2016 in La Bastide-Clairence, Basque Country, Pascal Rouxel, his wife, their two sons and their daughter-in-law, are about to share a meal when shots are fired. Only the children are found alive. The investigators suspect the sons, Yann and Kevin, who accuse each other of double murder.
programme.desc-more: On 24 December 2013, Roselyne Rouxel, 54, was found dead in her kitchen in Plérin, Côtes-d'Armor. Her husband, Alain, claims that she choked with a piece of meat during the Christmas meal. Yet investigators quickly discovered disturbing inconsistencies in his version of the facts. The autopsy reveals signs of strangulation and suspicious injuries. The investigations reveal a couple in crisis, undermined by tensions and unsaid.

programme.sub-title: The screens have taken control! Super Nanny to the rescue
programme.desc: Amandine and Jonathan raise their two daughters, Liliou, 8, and Myla, 3. From morning to evening, the television receives all the attention of the children. Jonathan, a video game enthusiast, is isolated. In this fragile organization, tensions are mounting. Yet, at the granny's, the girls, far from the screens, are soothed. Super Nanny has to face a major challenge in helping this family.
programme.desc-more: In a daily newspaper where screens occupy a central place, Amandine, home helper, and Jonathan, a façadier, raise their two daughters Liliou, 8, and Myla, 3. From morning to evening, the TV remains lit and receives all the attention of the children. Jonathan, for his part, is passionate about video games and is isolated every night, leaving Amandine alone to manage the end of the day. In this fragile organization, tensions are mounting. Myla, from her three-year-old age, monopolizes attention. She does not hesitate to violently oppose her sister, while Liliou gradually disappears. Yet, at "Mami Coconut", the girls are calmed down, accomplices and far from the screens. In the face of this striking contrast, Super Nanny faces a major challenge to help this family reconnect.

Parents don't know how to control boys anymore, jealous of each other. The challenge for Super Nanny is to bring harmony back to this family.
programme.desc-more: Cyril and Fallon are the parents of four boys aged 2 to 11. True "trandades," in their own words, who spend their days fighting, insulting and returning home. Jaloux, they do not maintain any complicity; And their attitude eventually exasperates the couple, who no longer know how to manage them. Exhausted by a family atmosphere under constant stress, the mother admits she no longer supports her children. Super Nanny's challenge? Bring calm and harmony to this disembodied family, and above all, restore ties between these four brothers at war.

programme.title: Super Nanny

programme.desc: Sophie, a maternity lawyer, and Jérémy, a real estate agent, are the parents of three children: Victoria, 4 years old, Leo Paul, 3 years old, and Valentin, 3 months old. Sophie manages the daily life at home while Jérémy works. Between shambles and quarrels, everything becomes a pretext for rivalry between the two elders. Super Nanny has to increase her ingenuity to restore family balance.
programme.desc-more: Sophie, a maternity lawyer, and Jérémy, a real estate agent, are the parents of three children: Victoria, 4 years old, Leo Paul, 3 years old, and Valentin, 3 months old. In this context, where conflicts take place, despite the notable lack of screens within the home, Super Nanny will have to redouble her ingenuity to restore family balance.

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: Five kids, two teenagers, one mommy: Super Nanny comes to order.
programme.desc: Jessica, managing director of an escape game, raises her five children on her own, every other week: Rone, 13, Ava, 11, Lev, 9, and the twins Taëlle and Liora, 7 years old. Rone, diagnosed with HPI, is as brilliant as she is unmanageable. The fight between brothers and sisters is increasing. In the face of this explosive situation, Super Nanny is trying to ease tensions.
programme.desc-more: Jessica, 40, is the manager of an escape game and raises her five children on her own, every other week: Rone, 13, Ava, 11, Lev, 9, and the twins Taëlle and Liora, 7 years old. Rone, the senior HPI diagnosed, is as brilliant as he is unmanageable, especially because of his phone addiction and his constantly boiling mind. Ava suffers from the attention paid to her brother and struggles to express his emotions. The disputes between brothers and sisters are increasing, putting Jessica's authority to a great test. In the face of this explosive situation, Super Nanny intervenes to try to restore order, calm tensions and give Jessica the keys to her authority.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Pregnancy is a time full of emotions for the future mother and her loved ones. To the great joy that most often accompanies this period is mixed with a certain concern, which the future parents avoid to show, but which is perfectly normal. This is what Emilia and Zied are experiencing, who are waiting for two happy events. As a young woman has already lost twins to five months of pregnancy, these births are expected with hope but also concern. Pauline and Ludovic are waiting for their second child, as are Kevin and Melody.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: After the birth and the first days of medical accompaniment, comes the moment, feared or expected, of the return home. For all these parents, a new life begins. What does their daily life look like now? To know this, teams followed the families of this second season. Between moments of happiness and doubts, they entrust their first impressions of parents.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Alexandra decided to have a child at 44 years of age, requiring a major follow-up of her pregnancy and a scheduled delivery in Caesarean section. If she awaits the happy event with serenity, her companion José questions her parenthood in her 40s. Astrid, however, is waiting for her second little boy, but is concerned about the weight of her baby, which has exceeded her term by a few days. Finally, Ana is about to give birth to her son after having had a lot of difficulty accepting and managing the miscarriage of her previous pregnancy.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: After Lucas (Chad Michael Murray) and Peyton (Hilarie Burton) left Tree Hill, the city was in a state of rapid growth. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) takes over the musical label, determined to make the talents she supports shine. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush) is preparing to launch a new collection for her brand, settling in with Julian (Austin Nichols), who is working on an ambitious film production. The dynamics of their relationship evolve as they together face the challenges of the entertainment world. Millicent (Lisa Goldstein), influenced by Clothes Over Bros' new agry, Alex (Jana Kramer), is beginning to change behaviour, creating tensions. At the same time, Nathan (James Lafferty) is plunged into a scandal that threatens his marriage to Haley, and Clay (Robert Buckley), his sports agent, is trying to keep the family at bay. This season, marked by twists and the arrival of new memorable characters, explores the challenges of friendship, love and professional ambitions.
programme.desc-more: While Julian (Austin Nichols) finally made the decision to move to Brooke (Sophia Bush), she was preparing to welcome Alex Dupre (Jana Kramer), a famous actress who would become the face of her new clothing collection. Millicent (Lisa Goldstein), Brooke's best friend, goes to the airport to get Alex back, but the meeting is not going as planned, as Alex proves to be unbearable and capricious. Meanwhile, Nathan (James Lafferty) was under pressure because of the blackmail exerted by Renee (Kate Voegele), which prompted him to worry about his career as a basketball player. Although he tries to reassure Clay (Robert Buckley) by saying that he did not have an affair with Renee, tensions are rising and secrets are beginning to emerge. The relationships between the characters become more complex as they navigate between ambitions, betrayals and desires, each seeking to find its place in this tumultuous world.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: In this exciting eighth season, Nathan Scott (James Lafferty) is embarking on a new phase of his sports career, exploring opportunities outside basketball fields, while juggling with the challenges of personal life. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) is receiving news that could upset her life and her family. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush), in the midst of wedding preparations, faced increasing difficulties with her shop, which her mother Victoria (Jana Kramer) seemed to be endangering by constant disagreements. Determined not to let these obstacles affect him, Brooke seeks to advance in her personal life. At the same time, the Quinn couple (Shantel VanSanten) and Clay (Robert Buckley) face a dangerous situation that threatens their happiness. This season is marked by palpable dramatic tension, with events that accumulate and heavy consequences to bear for all protagonists.

programme.title: Star Academy, the daily
programme.desc: The show "Star Academy" – which saw the birth of many successful singers such as Nolwenn Leroy, Olivai Ruiz or Jenifer – appeared in 2001 – has made a big return to TF1 in 2022 after fourteen years of absence. For several months, anonymous singers and singers live together in Dammaria-les-Lys Castle to take an intensive training with renowned teachers to advance them and help them to give the best of themselves. Their days are thus littered with classes, rehearsals, but also moments of relaxation and complicity in the heart of an exceptional experience that will mark them forever.

programme.title: The Villa of Broken Hearts
programme.desc: A group of anonymous men and women or who have already participated in reality TV shows in the past is housed in a superb villa with the aim of solving their problems related to their love life. To help them, the seduction coach Lucie Mariotti offers them a galant appointment with suitors from outside. The expert is also present at individual coaching sessions to try to learn more about the failures of their sentimental past and help them identify the nature of the brakes to their love happiness.

programme.title: The Mortal Instruments: The City of Darkness
programme.desc: New York, these days. During one night, Cary (Lily Collins), 15, witnessed a murder. She's terrified when the victim's body mysteriously disappears in front of her eyes... She then discovered the existence of an invisible war between demonic forces and the secret society of the Shadow Hunters. The mysterious Jace (Jamie Campbell Bower) is one of them. By her side, Cary will play a role in this adventure that she would never have imagined.

programme.title: Tattoo Cover : Tattoo Saviours
programme.desc: In Lyon, Marty has a delicate mission: tattooing Anaïs, a young woman who has undergone a double mastectomy. Thanks to his cover, he will help her regain some of her femininity and confidence in her. At the shop, Gisèle comes to cover an old, crazy tattoo, a relic far away from the woman she has become, caring for in psychiatry, dedicated and caring. Vincent, on his leg, wears a tattoo he no longer assumes. Express transformation is needed. Finally, from Belgium, Désirée, a young sparkling woman, comes to correct a spelling mistake tattooed behind her ankle. With this cover, she turns the page and turns this mistake into a pattern she will now wear with a smile.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Yolène, 28, and Florian, 26, are waiting for their third child. For the first two, the couple had used in vitro fertilization. As for Anilia, she is pregnant for the second time. Although the father left, the thirty-year-old remained positive. She decides to give birth with her best friend, who works as a child care assistant at the hospital in Poissy. For their part, 26-year-old Marta and 27-year-old Carlos will welcome their first baby. Carlos is very relaxed, ready for all eventualities and approaches this delivery with great lightness.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Since the first shootings, five years ago, from "Baby boom" to the inter-municipal hospital in Poissy-Saint-Germain-en-Laye, more than a hundred babies were born under the eye of the cameras. The work of doctors, midwives and caregivers is a cross-section of the future parents' lives. For the first time, teams from the show went back to see Gabin, Cassandre, Andrea and Marie to show them the images of their coming to the world. Emotional moments are at the meeting.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: For every mother who arrives at maternity with contractions, the questions of the nursing staff are always the same: can you assess the pain on a scale of 1 to 10 and would you like a peridural? In France, one in five women prefers to give birth naturally. The other four, for their part, were anxious to benefit from the peridural so as not to suffer as their mothers at one time. It is an anesthesia that is supposed to alleviate the sometimes terrible pains of the world.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: In this exciting eighth season, Nathan Scott (James Lafferty) is embarking on a new phase of his sports career, exploring opportunities outside basketball fields, while juggling with the challenges of personal life. programme.desc-more: While Julian (Austin Nichols) finally made the decision to move to Brooke (Sophia Bush), she was preparing to welcome Alex Dupre (Jana Kramer), a famous actress who would become the face of her new clothing collection. Millicent (Lisa Goldstein), Brooke's best friend, goes to the airport to get Alex back, but the meeting is not going as planned, as Alex proves to be unbearable and capricious. Meanwhile, Nathan (James Lafferty) was under pressure because of the blackmail exerted by Renee (Kate Voegele), which prompted him to worry about his career as a basketball player. The relationships between the characters become more complex as they navigate between ambitions, betrayals and desires, each seeking to find its place in this tumultuous world.

Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush), in the midst of wedding preparations, faced increasing difficulties with her shop, which her mother Victoria (Jana Kramer) seemed to be endangering by constant disagreements. Determined not to let these obstacles affect him, Brooke seeks to advance in her personal life. At the same time, the Quinn couple (Shantel VanSanten) and Clay (Robert Buckley) face a dangerous situation that threatens their happiness. This season is marked by palpable dramatic tension, with events that accumulate and heavy consequences to bear for all protagonists.
programme.desc-more: While Julian (Austin Nichols) finally made the decision to move to Brooke (Sophia Bush), she was preparing to welcome Alex Dupre (Jana Kramer), a famous actress who would become the face of her new clothing collection. Millicent (Lisa Goldstein), Brooke's best friend, goes to the airport to get Alex back, but the meeting is not going as planned, as Alex proves to be unbearable and capricious. Meanwhile, Nathan (James Lafferty) was under pressure because of the blackmail exerted by Renee (Kate Voegele), which prompted him to worry about his career as a basketball player. Although he tries to reassure Clay (Robert Buckley) by saying that he did not have an affair with Renee, tensions are rising and secrets are beginning to emerge. The relationships between the characters become more complex as they navigate between ambitions, betrayals and desires, each seeking to find its place in this tumultuous world.

programme.title: Star Academy, the daily
programme.desc: The show "Star Academy" – which saw the birth of many successful singers such as Nolwenn Leroy, Olivai Ruiz or Jenifer – appeared in 2001 – has made a big return to TF1 in 2022 after fourteen years of absence. For several months, anonymous singers and singers live together in Dammaria-les-Lys Castle to take an intensive training with renowned teachers to advance them and help them to give the best of themselves. Their days are thus littered with classes, rehearsals, but also moments of relaxation and complicity in the heart of an exceptional experience that will mark them forever.

programme.title: The Villa of Broken Hearts
programme.desc: A group of anonymous men and women or who have already participated in reality TV shows in the past is housed in a superb villa with the aim of solving their problems related to their love life. To help them, the seduction coach Lucie Mariotti offers them a galant appointment with suitors from outside. The expert is also present at individual coaching sessions to try to learn more about the failures of their sentimental past and help them identify the nature of the brakes to their love happiness.

programme.title: The idea of being with you
programme.desc: Solene (Anne Hathaway), a 40-year-old divorced woman, juggles her career as an art gallery owner and her role as a dedicated mother to her teenage daughter, Izzy (Ella Rubin). Their complicity is palpable, and they share precious moments, especially at a music festival where they go with friends. It is there that Solène crosses the path of Hayes Campbell (Nicholas Galitzine), a 24-year-old pop star who dedicates a song to her, triggering an unexpected spark between them. As the encounters progress, their attraction becomes an intense passion, and Hayes begins to frequent the gallery of Solene, deepening their connection. However, their age difference, initially perceived as a mere detail, becomes a source of tension when their relationship becomes public. As Solene navigates between her mother's responsibilities and her emerging feelings, she faces the challenges that this unexpected connection generates, both personally and socially.

programme.title: Crime Chronicles
programme.desc: In January 2023, at the Court of Assises du Mans, three men and one woman were accused of burning Aurélie Mignot alive in April 2019 in La Flèche. The investigators had first thought of an accidental fire, but an anonymous call made more than two months after the facts revealed the terrible truth: a horrible plot, organized by the young woman's relatives. The accused are all facing life sentences, but none of them wants to bear responsibility for this terrible tragedy. Back to the case and its outcome.

programme.title: The Villa of Broken Hearts

programme.title: Rugby: Championship of Nations
programme.desc: After losing to New Zealand (40-21) on Day 3 of the Nations Championship, Ireland will want to take advantage of this home game against Argentina to get back on track in the competition. The XV of the clover had started with a prestigious victory in Australia (31-33) before winning in Japan (20-36). On the Pumas side, the score was even more contrasted with two defeats - against Scotland (38-47) and England (24-31) - and a victory against Wales (35-21).

programme.title: Crime Chronicles
programme.desc: A plunge into the heart of disturbing disappearances, more or less perfect crimes, love passions that end badly. In France or abroad, close-up on highly publicized criminal investigations, stunned with twists and twists, which to date have sometimes not yet delivered all their truths. The magazine investigates various facts that have had wide media coverage but also less known cases that are sometimes just as incredible. What's their status today? Have any new information been used to bounce back some investigations? Have the victims finally turned the page and started a new life?

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: When complicity turns into conflict, Super Nanny comes to bring harmony
programme.desc: Sophie, a maternity lawyer, and Jérémy, a real estate agent, are the parents of three children: Victoria, 4 years old, Leo Paul, 3 years old, and Valentin, 3 months old. Sophie manages the daily life at home while Jérémy works. Between constant squabbles and disputes that can go so far as to blows, everything becomes a pretext for rivalry between the two elders. Sophie, for her part, struggles to impose herself fearing to assume the role of "bad", while Jérémy, more authoritarian but very busy with her work, intervenes less often, not without a hint of humor. In this context, where conflicts take place, despite the notable lack of screens within the home, Super Nanny will have to redouble her ingenuity to restore family balance.

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: Help, our four sons don't consider themselves brothers!
programme.desc: Cyril and Fallon are the parents of four boys aged 2 to 11. True "trandades," in their own words, who spend their days fighting, insulting and returning home. Jaloux, they do not maintain any complicity; And their attitude eventually exasperates the couple, who no longer know how to manage them. Exhausted by a family atmosphere under constant stress, the mother admits she no longer supports her children. Super Nanny's challenge? Bring calm and harmony to this disembodied family, and above all, restore ties between these four brothers at war.

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: The screens have taken control! Super Nanny to the rescue
programme.desc: In a daily newspaper where screens occupy a central place, Amandine, home helper, and Jonathan, a façadier, raise their two daughters Liliou, 8, and Myla, 3. From morning to evening, the TV remains lit and receives all the attention of the children. Jonathan, for his part, is passionate about video games and is isolated every night, leaving Amandine alone to manage the end of the day. In this fragile organization, tensions are mounting. Myla, from her three-year-old age, monopolizes attention. She does not hesitate to violently oppose her sister, while Liliou gradually disappears. Yet, at "Mami Coconut", the girls are calmed down, accomplices and far from the screens. In the face of this striking contrast, Super Nanny faces a major challenge to help this family reconnect.

programme.title: Cleaners the household experts
programme.desc: The Cleaners team comes to the aid of Delphine and Julie, two sisters about thirty years old. Delphine invested in an apartment about ten years ago. After months without paying rent, tenants left the accommodation in a dismal condition. In the face of her sister's dismay, Julie asked for help from the Cleaners. Pauline is a doll collector. After losing her mother three years ago, she moved to her father's, who also became ill. To escape this difficult daily life, she would like to transform the basement to exhibit her collection. But the place is full of business from his dead mother.

programme.title: Cleaners the household experts
programme.desc: In their daily lives, they are bloggers, cooks or business leaders, but they lead a double life as household experts. These four agents are ready to intervene! Alexandre, chef, is as demanding on cleanliness as on cooking. Leslie, energetic and inventive, makes her obsession with household a profession. Claude, a sports coach, advocates a healthy spirit in a healthy home. Laura, the professional, aims for perfection. Together, Cleaners have three days to transform an interior and teach tricks.

programme.title: A Christmas tree, two lovers
programme.desc: In the snowy little town of Silver Peak, nestled in the heart of Colorado mountains, the end-of-year celebrations are sacred, especially for Erin Whitmore, the charismatic and determined daughter of the mayor. The event is a celebration of the famous light of the great tree, an event that brings together every year, inhabitants and tourists, and it is set to embark on a quest: to find the perfect tree, symbol of magic and unity. His choice is quickly made on a majestic spruce, punctuating in the garden of his mysterious neighbour, Kevin Dawson, a firefighter with a look as warm as his character is cold. But if Erin sees in this tree the centrepiece of his celebration, Kevin is viscerally attached to it. programme.title: Elemental
programme.desc: In Element City, cohabitation is a wonderful thing between citizens who ignore their differences and highlight their commonalities.
programme.desc-more: Forced to leave their home country due to growing tensions, Brul and Sandra Lumen, two fire elements, are seeking to rebuild in the dynamic metropolis of Element City. This lively city is the refuge of a variety of elements, including those of air, water and land, which often coexist in harmony. However, fire elements, with explosive nature and often misunderstood, struggle to find their place in this diverse society. Determined to overcome prejudice and get accepted, Brul and Sandra joined forces to rehabilitate a delapidated building that they turned into a prosperous shop. Together, they give birth to their daughter, Flam, a real emotional whirlwind that inherits the inflamed temperament of her parents. As she navigates the complexities of her unique identity, Flam must learn to embrace her difference while facing the challenges of a world that can be both fascinating and hostile, thus revealing the subtleties of coexistence between the elements.

programme.title: Ice Age
programme.desc: The prehistoric journey of a mammoth, a lazy and a sword-tedged tiger, who have set themselves the mission of saving a little man.
programme.desc-more: Scrat, an energy-defeating squirrel, snares to bury its precious acorn in a soil that is increasingly hardened by cold. Unknowingly, its stubbornness triggers a cataclysmic chain reaction: a huge wave of ice is breaking out on Earth, forcing thousands of animals to begin perilous migration to more clementous lands. Among them, Manny, a lonely, full-bodied mammoth, gnawed by the weight of a past he refuses to evoke. His path soon crossed Sid, a lazy, loquacious and clumsy, separated from his family by the chaos of the environment. Despite their differences, these two marginals will find themselves bound by a much heavier responsibility than they imagined. As they cross a hostile landscape marked by the stigma of a changing world, they fall on the remains of a ravaged human camp. In the midst of the rubble, a woman, in a last breath, entrusts Sid with a precious burden: Roshan, a human baby she begs to protect. Disembodied but determined, Manny and Sid are taking the child back to his tribe, unaware that their journey has just taken a much more dangerous turn. Their route soon crosses Diego's, a tiger with long teeth as charismatic as it is concerned. Officially charged by his clan to bring the little human – a prey coveted for dark reasons – Diego offers his help to guide them through the dangers of this new icy world. But between the natural traps of a ruthless nature, the growing tensions within this unlikely group and the secrets that each hides, mistrust is taking hold. Who can really trust who? As snowstorms intensify and predators roam, Manny, Sid and Diego will have to learn to overcome their differences if they want to survive. An adventure where mutual aid and trickery will be their best weapons, in a world where ice is not the only danger that awaits them.

Following the questionable leads suggested by Klein, the three friends find themselves immersed in a world of rivalries and mysteries, where each clue could lead them to truth or to their loss. Between betrayals and unexpected alliances, Finn, Sam and Andrew will have to show courage and solidarity to navigate this sea of dangers and discover the fate of Captain La Barrée.

programme.title: Jamie has tentacles.
programme.desc: Jamie, the son of the king of planet Blurb, found refuge on Earth to escape the Blarbs launched after him. The Walsh family is gathering the boy, who has all the difficulties of the world in concealing his powers.
programme.desc-more: Chassed by the Vloks, an alien race avid with flesh, Jamie, the prince of planet Blarb, is forced to flee to Earth to escape a tragic fate. He arrived on our planet and found refuge with Mr. and Mrs. Walsh, a caring couple who offered him shelter. In this new world, Jamie has a special connection with their son, Nerdy (Gabriel Bismuth-Beloved), a shy and introverted teenager whose life is mainly held behind the doors of his room. Despite his extraordinary powers, Jamie must sail with caution, concealing his abilities to avoid attracting the attention of the Vloks. Under constant threat from Lieutenant Contact, a ruthless robot, and Sergeant Gratchett, a mutant cow determined to capture him, Jamie and Nerdy unite to face these perils, learning the value of friendship and courage in a world where every moment can be fatal.

programme.title: Elemental
programme.desc: Forced to leave their home country due to growing tensions, Brul and Sandra Lumen, two fire elements, are seeking to rebuild in the dynamic metropolis of Element City. This lively city is the refuge of a variety of elements, including those of air, water and land, which often coexist in harmony. However, fire elements, with explosive nature and often misunderstood, struggle to find their place in this diverse society. Determined to overcome prejudice and get accepted, Brul and Sandra joined forces to rehabilitate a delapidated building that they turned into a prosperous shop. Together, they give birth to their daughter, Flam, a real emotional whirlwind that inherits the inflamed temperament of her parents. As she navigates the complexities of her unique identity, Flam must learn to embrace her difference while facing the challenges of a world that can be both fascinating and hostile, thus revealing the subtleties of coexistence between the elements.

programme.title: Ice Age
programme.desc: Scrat, an energy-defeating squirrel, snares to bury its precious acorn in a soil that is increasingly hardened by cold. Unknowingly, its stubbornness triggers a cataclysmic chain reaction: a huge wave of ice is breaking out on Earth, forcing thousands of animals to begin perilous migration to more clementous lands. Among them, Manny, a lonely, full-bodied mammoth, gnawed by the weight of a past he refuses to evoke. His path soon crossed Sid, a lazy, loquacious and clumsy, separated from his family by the chaos of the environment. Despite their differences, these two marginals will find themselves bound by a much heavier responsibility than they imagined. As they cross a hostile landscape marked by the stigma of a changing world, they fall on the remains of a ravaged human camp. In the midst of the rubble, a woman, in a last breath, entrusts Sid with a precious burden: Roshan, a human baby she begs to protect. Disembodied but determined, Manny and Sid are taking the child back to his tribe, unaware that their journey has just taken a much more dangerous turn. Their route soon crosses Diego's, a tiger with long teeth as charismatic as it is concerned. Officially charged by his clan to bring the little human – a prey coveted for dark reasons – Diego offers his help to guide them through the dangers of this new icy world. But between the natural traps of a ruthless nature, the growing tensions within this unlikely group and the secrets that each hides, mistrust is taking hold. Who can really trust who? As snowstorms intensify and predators roam, Manny, Sid and Diego will have to learn to overcome their differences if they want to survive. An adventure where mutual aid and trickery will be their best weapons, in a world where ice is not the only danger that awaits them.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: A giant crab appears on the beach. While La Barrée ordered the students to stay safe, Planctons decided to face the crustacean.

However, a bold group of students, known as the Planktons, feel an irrepressible need to prove their bravery in the face of this marine monster. As the danger comes, young pirates will learn crucial lessons about courage, friendship and responsibility.

programme.title: OSS 117 : Rio no longer responds
programme.desc: After a mission to Gstaad, the famous French spy was sent to Rio to find a former Nazi and to retrieve information that jeopardized France.
programme.desc-more: After a perilous mission to Gstaad, secret agent Hubert Bonisseur de la Bath (Jean Dujardin) was dispatched to Brazil for a delicate operation. His mission: to recover a compromising microfilm containing the names of French collaborators in exchange for a substantial sum of money destined for Von Zimmel (Rüdiger Vogler), a former Nazi. In Rio de Janeiro, Hubert found himself in contact with Mossad agents, who were also in the footsteps of Von Zimmel, seeking to bring him back to Israel to be tried for his crimes. Among them, the seductive Lieutenant-Colonel Dolores (Louise Monot) is forced to team up with Hubert, a duo as unexpected as it is explosive. Together, they try to find Heinrich (Alex Lutz), the son of Von Zimmel, who is hiding in a community of hippies. Between political tensions and whoops, Hubert will have to navigate a world where humour and action are mixed, while keeping in mind the importance of his mission.

programme.title: OSS 117: Cairo Spies Nest
programme.desc: In the 1950s, a sexist and clumsy secret agent was sent to Cairo, a strategic intelligence hub, to find a missing colleague.
programme.desc-more: 1955, Cairo. Under a sun of lead, the city is full of secret agents, conspiracy and betrayal. In this maze of intrigues in which the interests of the English, Soviets and Egyptian nationalists intersect, a threat is high: the family of the fallen king Farouk, thirsty for victory, and the mysterious Eagles of Kheops, a fanatical sect ready to take power. Chaos is on the lookout, and France cannot afford to remain a spectator. To restore order in this spy nest, President René Coty sent his master asset: Hubert Bonisseur de La Bath , alias OSS 117 (Jean Dujardin). A secret agent as charismatic as it is unpredictable, this fine limier combines the elegance of a dandy with the audacity of a barouder. Armed with his innate sense of distribution, futuristic gadgets and a trust in him at all odds, he landed in Cairo with a mission: to unravel the sons of a plot that could ignite the entire region.

programme.desc: The people of Rainbow World have lost their shine. Morton chose Bella, Ruby, Poppy, Sunny, Jade, Skyler, Violet and Amaya to help them.
programme.desc-more: The arrival of new students at Rainbow High High is disrupting the delicate balance of social relations within the school. While old friendships are being tested, tensions are mounting between emerging groups of young designers and designers. The new arrivals, with their flamboyant personality and undeniable talent, arouse both admiration and jealousy among the students already in place. Each of them brings a unique touch to the dynamics of the high school, intensifying the competition to stand out in an environment where glamour and creativity are the key words. The protagonists will have to navigate through the intrigues, betrayals and unexpected alliances to find their place in this world where appearance counts as much as talent. Between fashion, friendship and rivalry, Rainbow High explores the challenges of adolescence and the quest for identity in a vibrant and artistic community.

programme.title: L.O.L. Surprise! House of Surprises
programme.desc: Pose and the OGG Crew are invited to the Glitter City evening. What are they gonna wear? Fortunately, Neonicious has something glamorous about each one of them.
programme.desc-more: In the colorful and playful universe of "L.O.L. Surprise! House of Surprises", fans of the famous franchise discover a world where imagination and friendship reign as masters. The iconic characters, including Royal Bee (Ayla Rae Neal), Lady Diva (Brenna Larsen), Swag (Jessica Mikayla Adams) and Neonlicious, meet in the Surprise House, a magical place where every visit promises a unique experience. In this fascinating space, friends are engaged in their favorite activities: tasting toasts to the avocado, sliding on a flamboyant water slide, vibrating the juke box with their favourite pieces and spending memorable pajamas evenings. However, what makes the Surprises House so captivating is its ability to reinvent itself every time you visit. The pieces change, the decors change and new surprises await them at every corner. But behind this apparent lightness are challenges. Friends will have to show creativity and solidarity to overcome unforeseen events and navigate through the surprises that their enchanting place has to offer. Each episode is a journey full of twists, where friendship and mutual help are tested, and where characters learn to celebrate their differences while having fun. In "L.O.L. Surprise! House of Surprises", exploration and discovery are at the heart of every moment, offering young viewers an immersive and joyful experience. (195 words)

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: Andrew spends his time in his newspaper, compiling piracy information. Gustav and Alixe spend their time mocking him.
programme.desc-more: In a world where adventure and plot are omnipresent, Andrew, a young pirate aspirant, devotes his time to writing a newspaper in which he compiles information about piracy and the exploits of the greatest libustists. His passion for writing, however, is a source of mockery on the part of his comrades, Gustav and Alixe, who find it amusing to make him laugh. Their group dynamics are tested when Andrew's precious journal mysteriously disappears. Finn, another student from the academy, then launched an investigation to find the stolen newspaper, convinced that Gustav and Alixe were behind this blow. As tensions rise and suspicions increase, Finn will have to navigate in an ocean of broken friendships and rivalries to discover the truth, while realizing that the real treasure may lie in loyalty and camaraderie.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: Planktons unintentionally destroyed the replica of Griff that La Barrée had made for the bird's birthday. The replica is locked in a safe.
programme.desc-more: In this episode of "Pirate Academy", the Planctons, a group of young and grassy pirates, find themselves in a delicate situation after having, without wishing to do so, destroyed the precious replica of Griff, an iconic bird created by La Barrée to celebrate her birthday. The replica, carefully enclosed in a chest, represents not only a symbol of affection, but also a central element of tradition within the academy. As Plankton attempt to repair their mistake, they set out on a frantic quest to find the pieces of the statue and avoid the anger of La Barrée. On the way, they face unexpected challenges, rivalries with other pirate groups and discover the true value of friendship and responsibility. This episode combines humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of the links that unite the members of the academy in their tumultuous journey.
