programme.title: Asterix in the Bretons
programme.desc: The two brave Gaulish warriors tried to introduce a barrel of magic potion into England, where the Bretons fought against the Roman invader.
programme.desc-more: In the year 50 B.C., the Roman Empire, led by the formidable Julius Caesar, conquered almost all of Brittany, with the exception of a single Gallic village that fiercely resists the invader. Threatened by the loss of their independence, the Bretons, tired and desperate, sent Jolictorix, their leader, to ask for help from his cousin Asterix, an indomitable Gaul known for his exploits. Asterix, accompanied by his inseparable friend Obelix, prepares to go to the rescue of the Bretons. With the help of Druid Panoramix, they concoct the famous magic potion, the source of their superhuman strength. Their journey leads them to Londinium, where an unexpected detour confronts them with formidable challenges. Unfortunately, in the heart of the city, the precious potion is stolen, placing our heroes in a race against the clock to find it. This journey, full of pitfalls, will reveal the team spirit and determination of Asterix and Obelix in front of the Roman invader.

programme.title: The Unicorn School
programme.desc: Taking advantage of one night at the stables, the Sapphires go out in hiding to search for the Crown Stars, but they are not the only ones on their track.
programme.desc-more: Taking advantage of a peaceful night at the stables, the members of the Sapphires group, made up of young and fearless riders, decided to venture in secret for a thrilling quest: to find the Stars of the Crown, legendary artifacts that could change the destiny of their school. Guided by their curiosity and their sense of adventure, they equip themselves with flashlights and slip quietly out of their neighbourhoods. However, their night getaway is not going as planned. On their way, they discover that they are not the only ones looking for these precious Stars. A rival group, the Stars, is also on the track, ready to do anything to get them back. In an atmosphere full of mystery and competition, the Sapphires will have to show courage, cunning and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way, while discovering the true meaning of friendship and loyalty.

programme.title: The Unicorn School
programme.desc: During her visit to the campus, a famous unicorn rider clings to Sophia. Layla meets the rider who was tied to Glacier before she was.
programme.desc-more: As the unicorn school prepares to host a famous rider, the excitement mixes with the palpable tensions between Sophia (Sara Garcia) and Valentina (Sadie Laflamme-Snow). The visit of this emblematic figure revives old rivalries, exacerbating the competition between the students. Meanwhile, Glacier (Kolton Stewart) made an unexpected encounter with an old friend, an event that led him to dive back into buried memories. However, this friendly meeting does not go unnoticed: Layla (Kamaia Fairburn), intrigued and jealous, cannot help feeling a mixture of envy and distrust in the face of this reappeared friendship. As tensions rise and rivalries intensify, each character must navigate in an ocean of contradictory emotions, seeking to find his place within the school while confronting his own insecurities. This complex dynamic promises to upset the fragile harmony that prevails in unicorn school.

programme.title: Armors
programme.desc: With new armor, the young pilots are leaving with Cobalt for their first real mission. Their goal is to find Ajax.
programme.desc-more: In a world where dinosaurs, long gone, are reborn with incredible strength, a new generation of heroes rises to defend the Earth. Five teenagers, with a unique connection to these prehistoric creatures, discover that they are the only ones able to communicate and to ally with these imposing reptiles. Each of them wears a special armor that allows them to pilot their dinosaur and deploy extraordinary capabilities. At the heart of this thrilling adventure, our young protagonists, faced with an ancient evil that threatens the balance of their world, must overcome their doubts and learn to work together. In parallel, they face formidable enemies who seek to exploit the powers of dinosaurs for their own ends. The epic fighting between armor and dark forces is intensifying, testing not only their skills as warriors, but also their friendship and loyalty. As they explore wild landscapes and mysterious ruins, each teenager will have to discover his own inner strength and the true sense of heroism. "Armorsaurs" promises to be a series of captivating actions, where friendship and courage are the keys to saving a world at risk, while revealing secrets that even the bravest of them would never have imagined.

In the second season, he was under the supervision of Matty Webber (Meredith Eaton), former superior of Jack Dalton (George Eads) to the CIA, who entrusted him with increasingly complex missions. At the same time, Wilt (Justin Hires) was sent to espionage training, learning to navigate the dangerous world of intelligence. While MacGyver and his team, composed of Riley Davis (Tristin Mays) and Jack Dalton, face various threats, two iconic figures from the original series are emerging, adding a touch of nostalgia and tension to their adventures. Between international intrigues and technological challenges, MacGyver struggles to save lives while testing his unique skills.

programme.desc-more: The arrival of new students at Rainbow High High is disrupting the delicate balance of social relations within the school. The new arrivals, with their flamboyant personality and undeniable talent, arouse both admiration and jealousy among the students already in place. Each of them brings a unique touch to the dynamics of the high school, intensifying the competition to stand out in an environment where glamour and creativity are the key words. programme.desc: "A hairstyle in bubbling"M.C. Swag has a surprise for her friends: a celebration on the theme of the sand castle. The Tots are looking forward to catching their shovel and launching.
programme.desc-more: In the colorful and playful universe of "L.O.L. Surprise! House of Surprises", fans of the famous franchise discover a world where imagination and friendship reign as masters. The iconic characters, including Royal Bee (Ayla Rae Neal), Lady Diva (Brenna Larsen), Swag (Jessica Mikayla Adams) and Neonlicious, meet in the Surprise House, a magical place where every visit promises a unique experience. In this fascinating space, friends are engaged in their favorite activities: tasting toasts to the avocado, sliding on a flamboyant water slide, vibrating the juke box with their favourite pieces and spending memorable pajamas evenings. However, what makes the Surprises House so captivating is its ability to reinvent itself every time you visit. The pieces change, the decors change and new surprises await them at every corner. But behind this apparent lightness are challenges. Friends will have to show creativity and solidarity to overcome unforeseen events and navigate through the surprises that their enchanting place has to offer. Each episode is a journey full of twists, where friendship and mutual help are tested, and where characters learn to celebrate their differences while having fun. In "L.O.L. Surprise! House of Surprises", exploration and discovery are at the heart of every moment, offering young viewers an immersive and joyful experience. (195 words)

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: "Welcome to the Pirate Academy"Finn, Sam and Andrew remember their debut at the academy: their meeting, the one with Captain La Barrée, and the first adventure lived together.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of "Pirate Academy", Finn, Sam and Andrew, three young pirate seekers, meet to talk about their debut at the academy. Their memories plunge them into a time when they were mere novices, discovering the fascinating and tumultuous universe of piracy. They recall their first meeting, marked by friendly rivalries and promises of friendship, as well as their decisive encounter with the fearsome Captain La Barrée, a charismatic figure who guided them in their first steps at sea. Together, they remember their first thrilling adventure, full of challenges, discoveries and life lessons, which cemented their unwavering bond. This nostalgic episode explores the themes of friendship, bravery and the quest for identity in a world where danger and excitement reign as masters, while laying the foundations for their future exploits.

programme.title: Christmas in skirmishes
programme.desc: A young woman wonders if any of the magic shoes offered by her grandmother will allow her to find the love she so longs for.
programme.desc-more: Boston, December 2019. As the city lights up with glittering garlands and the air vibrates Christmas songs, Noëlle, a young bookshop with a tender and disillusioned heart, is about to live a new month of December as the previous: between the displays of romantic books she devours in secret and the evenings alone in front of holiday films. Yet since his childhood, December has always had a special taste for magic, thanks to a family tradition as mysterious as it is enchanting. Each year, his grandmother offers him a pair of shoes that belonged to his youth, accompanied by a legend: these skids, carefully preserved in their satin box, would have the power to attract true love to the one who wears them. But after a burning disappointment in love, Noëlle put these stories on the shelf of lost illusions... until his grandmother left him that year, a pair of pink scarpins, of timeless elegance. As she walks the snow-covered streets, almost despite her carriageway of these heels that seem to give her a new grace, her path crosses that of John Reid, a charismatic and reserved architect, who came to town to oversee the restoration of an old theatre. Their encounter, first of all by chance, quickly takes on the appearance of modern tales: a spilled coffee, a smile exchanged, and this strange impression that fate suddenly decided to mix in. Yet Christmas, suspicious, refuses to see anything else but a coincidence. But when chance multiplys – an improvised waltz under the city lights, a conversation that seems to last hours and seconds, a common project that brings them together despite them – she begins to wonder whether these pink skies would not, after all, be much more than just shoes.

programme.title: Ice Age
programme.desc: The prehistoric journey of a mammoth, a lazy and a sword-tedged tiger, who have set themselves the mission of saving a little man.
programme.desc-more: Scrat, an energy-defeating squirrel, snares to bury its precious acorn in a soil that is increasingly hardened by cold. Unknowingly, its stubbornness triggers a cataclysmic chain reaction: a huge wave of ice is breaking out on Earth, forcing thousands of animals to begin perilous migration to more clementous lands. Among them, Manny, a lonely, full-bodied mammoth, gnawed by the weight of a past he refuses to evoke. His path soon crossed Sid, a lazy, loquacious and clumsy, separated from his family by the chaos of the environment. Despite their differences, these two marginals will find themselves bound by a much heavier responsibility than they imagined. As they cross a hostile landscape marked by the stigma of a changing world, they fall on the remains of a ravaged human camp. In the midst of the rubble, a woman, in a last breath, entrusts Sid with a precious burden: Roshan, a human baby she begs to protect. Disembodied but determined, Manny and Sid are taking the child back to his tribe, unaware that their journey has just taken a much more dangerous turn. Their route soon crosses Diego's, a tiger with long teeth as charismatic as it is concerned. Officially charged by his clan to bring the little human – a prey coveted for dark reasons – Diego offers his help to guide them through the dangers of this new icy world. But between the natural traps of a ruthless nature, the growing tensions within this unlikely group and the secrets that each hides, mistrust is taking hold. Who can really trust who? As snowstorms intensify and predators roam, Manny, Sid and Diego will have to learn to overcome their differences if they want to survive. An adventure where mutual aid and trickery will be their best weapons, in a world where ice is not the only danger that awaits them.

programme.title: Ice Age 2
programme.desc: The day the glacier that protects their valley threatens to break under the influence of warming, prehistoric animals must make their baluchon and flee.
programme.desc-more: While the Earth, still shaped by the ice of prehistory, is undergoing the first subjugations of a changing climate, a lush valley is home to a community of animals as disparate as they are attached. But this tranquillity is threatened: an imposing ice dam, the last bulwark against the raging waves of the ocean, begins to crack under the effect of an inexorable trigger. For Manny the mammoth, lonely and full of shit, this news sounds like a drink. Persuaded to be the last survivor of his kind, he rubbed his destiny in the company of his inseparable competitors: Sid, the lazy, loquacious and clumsy, whose farfetched ideas often defy logic, and Diego, the sword-ted tiger with a troubled past, drawn between his predatory instincts and his nascent friendship for this unlikely duo. As panic spreads into the valley and thousands of animals set out to secure land, the trio embarks on a journey of tangles. Their route soon crossed that of Ellie, a mammoth female as playful as eccentric, convinced against all evidence of belonging to the family of opossums. His overflowing energy and certainty his confusing sess is shaking Manny's convictions, who sees her as an unexpected hope... But also a mystery to be clarified. Why does this strange creature, surrounded by a band of equally extravagant opossum brothers, ignore its true nature? Meanwhile, well above them, Scrat the sword-destroyed squirrel continues its eternal quest for the perfect acorn, unwittingly triggering cascade disasters that could well precipitate the end of the glacial world.

To stop them, the municipality has set up the largest network of cameras in France. Created ten years ago, the Urban Supervision Centre controls 3,200 cameras. Last year, 1,600 video clips were the subject of a judicial requisition, an average of four a day. Police officers are also facing increasingly violent attacks on the ground. But, thanks to their speed of action, the law enforcement forces often retain the advantage.

programme.title: S.W.A.T.
programme.sub-title: The man who was worth a million
programme.desc: Commander Robert Hicks is not a secret that he is not satisfied with the choice of Hondo, who has just announced the arrival of a new agent in the unit. The latter, Devin Gamble, is the son of a man who killed a police officer a decade earlier. Hondo is working hard to reassure his colleagues and convince them of the validity of his act. Between kidnappings, burglaries, hostage-taking and threats of terrorist attacks, the team must show cold blood to carry out all its perilous missions. This eighth season's program is looking forward to and looking forward to, which producers have announced will be the last of this series to be popular.
programme.desc-more: Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson (Shemar Moore), Lieutenant of the Special Weapons And Tactics (S.W.A.T.) in Los Angeles, commanded an elite police intervention unit. Hondo, who moved into the difficult neighbourhoods where he grew up, often finds himself in an internal conflict between the loyalty he owes to his community and the loyalty he feels to his colleagues. His team, made up of highly qualified members, struggles every day to bring a semblance of security to the inhabitants of the City of Angels, by opposing gang violence, drug traffickers and other criminals who threaten peace. As Hondo faces increasingly dangerous situations, he highlights his tactical skills while trying to maintain a balance between his professional duty and his personal relationships. The stakes are growing as it navigates in a tumultuous environment where each decision can have dramatic consequences.

Tensions are rising as the team navigates in a hostile environment, while facing forces determined to prevent their safe return. This season, full of twists, explores themes of loyalty, sacrifice and justice, captivating fans after an initial announcement of the cancellation of the series, followed by a triumphal return thanks to their unwavering support.

programme.title: Secret of woman
programme.desc: Bethany plans to enjoy her honeymoon with her husband. But his plans and even his relationship could be jeopardized by the groom's best friend. Indeed, he has just discovered that the model wife actually works in a closed house.

programme.title: Christmas with a heart
programme.desc: A brilliant New Yorker returns to spend Christmas in the small town that saw her grow. She finds her youthful love there.
programme.desc-more: Christmas in Crawleigh has never been so emotionally charged. After years of climbing the ranks of a prestigious and exhausting New York career, Sam returned to his small hometown, with a heavy heart and a slender soul. Her existence, which she thought was perfectly controlled, has just collapsed like a castle of cards, leaving her destabilized and in search of comfort. Between the glittering garlands and the snowy streets of this village, where everything seems unchanged, she hopes to find some of the family warmth she has so missed. His mother, who is always as welcoming, opens her arms, but it is another meeting that will upset his stay: Noah's, his youthful love, remained anchored in this picturesque setting as a living memory. Noah never left Crawleigh. He is always as generous and committed as he is, and he devotes his time to helping the poorest in the community, organizing collections, hot meals and events to give the smile back to those who have been abused by life. When Sam saw him at work, she rediscovered this part of herself that she had buried under the records and meetings: this desire to make a difference, this simple joy of sharing and giving. Gradually, she gets dragged into her projects, regaining the pleasure of small things – a shared laugh, an accomplice look, the happiness of seeing eyes light up through a thoughtful gesture. While they work side by side to organize the village's great Christmas party, the old sparks between them are reviving, brighter than ever. Snow walks, conversations in front of a hot chocolate, memories that go back to the surface... Everything seems to bring them back to what they once were, and to what they might have become. Yet Sam cannot help but wonder whether this enchanted parenthesis is just a sweet lure, or whether Crawleigh – and Noah – might well be the port of attachment that she has never stopped looking for.

programme.title: A wedding at Christmas
programme.desc: As Christmas approaches, a woman who has been badly overcame from a break-up visits her father in her inn. On the spot, she meets a seductive man to do everything.
programme.desc-more: A Christmas wedding takes us to a fairytale winter setting, where the sparkling lights and pristine snow hide hearts in search of comfort. Cait (Jessy Holtermann), a young woman on the verge of discouragement after a painful breakup, fled from the rest of the holidays to take refuge in the family hostel, a haven of peace nestled in the mountains. But when she arrived, she discovered a desolate establishment, far from the warm atmosphere she hoped for. Drew (James Liddell), a man who is a lénigmatic and attractive to do everything, tells him a devastating news: his father, overwhelmed by costly repairs, might well be forced to sell the hostel, thus ending a family tradition dear to his heart. Determined to save this place full of memories, Cait refuses to give up. With Drew's unexpected help, whose charm and resourcefulness do not leave her indifferent, she develops a bold plan: turning the hostel into an idyllic setting to host a last-minute wedding. The couple looking for a place to celebrate their union at Christmas could be the miracle solution to bring the establishment back to life and save family finances. But between the logistical unforeseen, family tensions and the doubts that arise again, Cait and Drew will have to show boundless creativity and growing complicity. As preparations accelerate and decorations illuminate the inn with a new glow, a question persists: will this crazy project succeed in restoring hope to Cait, while reviving the flame of unexpected love?

programme.title: The secret life of the Pharaohs
programme.sub-title: Toutankhamon, the Pharaoh with the fabulous treasure
programme.desc: The life and work of Tutankhamon's ancestors, Queen Hatchepsout, the sublime Nefertiti or Akhenaton, some of the most fascinating characters of all antiquity.
programme.desc-more: On 26 November 1922, near Luxor, Egyptologist Howard Carter discovered Tutankhamon's grave, one of the last descendants of a family that had led Egypt for eight generations. Under the aegis of this eighteenth dynasty, the Egyptian kingdom became the richest and most powerful in the world. This series is interested in the life and work of Tutankhamon's ancestors, Queen Hatchepsout, the sublime Nefertiti, and the enigmatic Akhenaton, some of the most fascinating characters of all antiquity.

programme.title: Pyramids: The Mysteries Revealed
programme.sub-title: Kheops and the tomb of secrets
programme.desc: Founder of the Fourth Dynasty, King Snefrou is a great builder: three pyramids are erected during the 25 years that his reign lasted.
programme.desc-more: Among the Seven Wonders of the World, the pyramid of Kheops, in Egypt, is the only one still visible in its original state. The building is 146.5 metres high, 230-wide and consists of more than 2 million blocks - some weighing up to 63 tons - and is now in full swing. Egyptologists and archaeologists have a new tool using aerial images and satellites to analyze soil anomalies and invisible parts. They hope to elucidate the puzzles that remain on this titanium site.

programme.desc-more: In a sunny afternoon in Los Angeles, a brutal execution shakes the city: three members of the East Side Catorces, a feared gang, are shot dead in a park. Inspector Brenda Leigh Johnson (Kyra Sedgwick) and her team from the Priority Investigations Unit are called to the scene of the drama in an emergency. Faced with this widely publicized murder, Brenda must navigate between public pressure and the complexities of a case that reveals broader issues than expected. As she begins her investigation, Brenda notes the disturbing presence of a man at the crime scene: Colonel Walter (Robert Gossett), a former military instructor who claims to know the identity of the shooter. Although his knowledge seems valuable, there is growing mistrust at Brenda's. She wondered about the colonel's real intentions, as tensions, secrets and gang rivalries resurfaced, complicating an already delicate investigation.

Faced with this widely publicized murder, Brenda must navigate between public pressure and the complexities of a case that reveals broader issues than expected. As she begins her investigation, Brenda notes the disturbing presence of a man at the crime scene: Colonel Walter (Robert Gossett), a former military instructor who claims to know the identity of the shooter. Although his knowledge seems valuable, there is growing mistrust at Brenda's. She wondered about the colonel's real intentions, as tensions, secrets and gang rivalries resurfaced, complicating an already delicate investigation.

programme.title: After me happiness
programme.desc: Marie-Laure, mother of four young children, learns that the cancer she suffers from leaves her only a few months to live. She cannot rely on an absent and resigned husband, and she intends to do everything she can to ensure that her children grow up together in a family she chooses. But it is quickly confronted with rigid social services. According to the law, the judge will decide on the placement of the children after the death of Marie-Laure. She and her family are fighting to have the right to decide the fate of her children after her death.

programme.desc-more: On 25 March 2016, in the small town of Châteaumeillant, in the Cher, Fernando Mourao's body, a 60-year-old retired, was discovered at his home by his neighbour and friend, Gilles Tourny. The victim, lying in a pool of blood, was shot in his living room and the murder was grossly masked in robbery. Almost a year later, Gilles Tourny was charged. Yet, part of Fernando Moura's family is not convinced of Gilles Tourny's guilt, now released under judicial supervision.

programme.title: At the scene of the crime

programme.desc-more: On June 3, 1994, a carer who was responsible for providing care to an old couple living in Bezons, Val-d'Oise, discovered a horror spectacle when she arrived at their home. Gaston Moysset, 89, lies in a pool of blood, with his skull broken. He died four days later at the hospital. His wife, witness to the tragedy, was never able to help the police with Alzheimer's disease. After a long investigation, the PJ still hasn't solved the murder. The victim's grandson is suspected and then cleared. But the automated fingerprint file, which was only in its early stages, finally revealed that the fingerprint found in the victim's home was Pierre Lorcy, a boxing champion who almost committed the perfect crime.

programme.title: Pyramids: The Mysteries Revealed
programme.sub-title: Abu Rawash and the missing pyramid
programme.desc: Eminent Egyptians have been able to enter the Abu Rawash site, located north of Cairo. They are trying to unravel the mystery of the remains of this missing monument. It contains elements characteristic of the great royal tombs of the Fourth Dynasty. By taking up height, the specialists discover the foundations of a titanium pyramid and a well descending to more than 21 meters.

programme.title: The secret life of the Pharaohs
programme.desc: The life and work of Tutankhamon's ancestors, Queen Hatchepsout, the sublime Nefertiti or Akhenaton, some of the most fascinating characters of all antiquity.
programme.desc-more: On 26 November 1922, near Luxor, Egyptologist Howard Carter discovered Tutankhamon's grave, one of the last descendants of a family that had led Egypt for eight generations. Under the aegis of this eighteenth dynasty, the Egyptian kingdom became the richest and most powerful in the world. This series is interested in the life and work of Tutankhamon's ancestors, Queen Hatchepsout, the sublime Nefertiti, and the enigmatic Akhenaton, some of the most fascinating characters of all antiquity.

programme.desc-more: In March 1983, in the suburbs of Grenoble, Ludovic Janvier, 6, was kidnapped by an individual in front of his brother Jerome, 7 years old. Later, another boy was abducted in Grenoble under the same circumstances and found dead in a landfill. Four years later, she is a 10-year-old girl who disappears in Isère. Despite all the investigations, these abductions of children have never been clarified. But last March, the Ludovic January case was the first case before the newly created "no further action" division of the Nanterre court.

programme.desc-more: Tuesday, 11 October 2005. Eric Boisseranc returns home to Chazay-d'Azergues, a small village in Beaujolais, a little earlier than usual. Marine, her 20-year-old daughter, is already here. His car is parked in the driveway. When Eric comes in, he calls him, but he doesn't get an answer. Intrigued, he descends the four steps that lead to the living room and discovers Marine's body, lying behind the couch and bathing in a pool of blood. The young woman was stabbed several times with an unheard of rage. I'm afraid Eric's calling a doctor friend. But Marine has already succumbed to his wounds.

programme.title: At the end it's the sea
programme.desc: François Pécheux crossed the United States from north to south, sailing on the largest American river, the Mississippi. It starts from the source, Lake Itasca, and meets those who live by this mythical stream: lovers of large spaces, captain of a barge, blues player on the Memphis road or crayfish fishermen in the delta.

programme.title: At the end it's the sea
programme.desc: François Pécheux made a journey of a thousand kilometers on the Danube, through the Balkans and the Carpathians. It is in Serbia alongside the Gypsy community in Belgrade that his journey begins. He then entered the Iron Gates, with steep gorges full of history. Then, in Romania, he stops on the island of Braila. His adventure continues in the Danube Strait, a fantastic nature reserve where many species of birds and wild horses cross, before ending on the Black Sea.

programme.title: The Fall of the Reich
programme.desc: In June 1944, optimism reigned in the Allied camp. In the West, the landing in Normandy is a success. In their advance, the troops soon threatened the German border. In the east, the Red Army is on the move. With Operation Bagration, it is breaking into Belarus and forcing the Wehrmacht to a terrible retreat. It's time to trust. No doubt is allowed: "The war will be over before Christmas". Yet it is still going on for almost a year, punctuated with atrocious battles and other war crimes. Vincent Lindon tells of the last months of long and murderous fighting.

programme.desc-more: Today, Adeline Toniutti and the auctioneer Léonard Pommez take the direction of the Dawn, near Troyes. They have an appointment with Diane and Marine, who open the doors to their grandmother Mireille's house, which turns out to be a true historical museum. Imperial statue, exceptional goldsmith's, crystal service: nothing seemed to satisfy Mireille's appetite for collector, who accumulated a myriad of objects, whose family is far from imagining that they are true nuggets. To shed light on this legacy, they rely on Adeline's legendary intuition, but above all on the expertise of Maître Pommez. One thing is certain: all these treasures reserve big surprises on auction day!

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: The FBI is looking for a 15-year-old missing teenager who has usurped the identity of a friend of his to work as a courier and locksmith apprentice.
programme.desc-more: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.

programme.title: The strength of the oceans
programme.desc: Under its quiet air, the Manche hides a superpowering marine mechanics. Giant tides, strong currents and formidable storms shape the landscape.
programme.desc-more: Although the Channel seems peaceful between France and England, it hides one of the most powerful marine mechanics on the globe. Its gigantic tides and spectacular currents shape the landscape. The sea is also the scene of extreme events, such as storms capable of breaking ships, or rare weather tsunamis that arise in good weather.

programme.title: Rance Dam: The Tide Challenge
programme.desc: Six decades after its construction, the Rance tidal plant remains a world reference. Diving in the bowels of this out-of-standard dam.
programme.desc-more: Between Saint-Malo and Dinard, the Rance tidal plant, which was put into service 60 years ago, is a crazy challenge to the elements, in one of the regions of the world where the tides are the most powerful. But behind the technological prowess lies a titanic human adventure: for six years, more than 600 workers fought against violent currents to dry a sea arm and build, 13 meters below the water level, a real "cathedral under the sea". Sixty years later, the Rance Dam remains a global reference: it provides with its 24 monumental turbines, the equivalent of the consumption of a city like Rennes, while carrying 60,000 vehicles every day on its roof. Diving in the bowels of this out-of-standard dam.

programme.title: Vouglans Dam: a giant under high surveillance
programme.desc: Vouglans is the dam of all superlatives. This monumental hydroelectric facility is monitored day and night. Engineers and geologists must consider the unthinkable.
programme.desc-more: Climbing at 130 meters, it is the last rampart of an artificial lake 35 kilometers long loaded with 600 million cubic meters of water. Vouglans is the dam of all superlatives. This monumental hydroelectric facility is monitored day and night by state-of-the-art technologies. Its resistance depends on the safety of many cities downstream, including Lyon, but also the Bugey nuclear power plant, which stands less than a hundred kilometers away. Even if the dam is considered safe, there is no zero risk. Since the Fukushima disaster, the idea of an uncontrollable submersion wave of atomic installations has awakened the deepest fears. Physicists, engineers and geologists must then consider the unthinkable.

programme.title: Egypt: Pharaoh Treasures · Global Voices
programme.sub-title: Hidden tombs of the Valley of Kings
programme.desc: After a thousand years of pyramids, the Pharaohs radically changed their funeral strategy to dig their graves in the rock. In the Valley of Kings, an invisible necropolis unfolds under the mountain, with kilometers of galleries carved in limestone. For five centuries, thanks to the meticulous work of the country's best artisans, more than 60 graves were dug there, including those of Tutankhamon, Ramses II and Thutmosis III, pharaohs who came to realize their dream of immortality. This film reveals the spectacular engineering of this underground construction site, unique in the history of humanity.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: The team is looking for an eight-and-a-half month pregnant young HIV positive woman. She disappeared after she went with her husband to do an ultrasound.
programme.desc-more: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.

programme.title: The 10 most mythical roads
programme.desc: Cut to cliffside, suspended above the void or submerged by tides, some French roads challenge all obstacles. From the route of the Great Alps to the Basque cornice, from the gorges of the Verdon to the Passage du Gois, through the Nationale 7 and the route of the Tour de Corse, heading for the discovery of ten mythical routes. Behind these spectacular landscapes is the ingenuity of the builders, which has opened roads where it seemed impossible. Roads that have become over time real symbols of their territory, fascinating both in their history and in the technical challenges they have demanded.

programme.title: The 10 most stunning castles
programme.desc: How did the castles become the most stunning fortresses of the Middle Ages? Through ten emblematic sites, from Haut-Kœnigsburg, fortress of the Vosges peaks, to Castelnaud, citadel of the Hundred Years War, passing through Fougères, one of the largest medieval fortresses in Europe, or Beaufort, lock of the Alps, this documentary tells the incredible ingenuity of the builders who have pushed ever further the limits of defence. Designed to monitor territories, protect people and resist the most formidable sieges, these castles have constantly evolved to cope with the progress of the art of war.

programme.title: The 10 most daring bridges
programme.desc: From Roman arches from the bridge of the Gard to the vertiginous haubans of the Millau viaduct, from the rising bridge Jacques-Chaban-Delmas, the largest in Europe, to the 3,800 tons of steel of the Viaduct du Viaur, this documentary explores ten bridges that have brought the French territories closer together. These non-standard works bear witness to the same ambition throughout the centuries: to cross the impossible. By crossing rivers, gorges or valleys, they tell more than 2,000 years of innovation, technical challenges and human exploits.

programme.title: The 10 most ingenious Roman buildings
programme.desc: The Romans not only conquered territories, they imposed a way of life, whose traces continue to shape French landscapes. From Pont du Gard to Maison Carrée de Nîmes, through the Arles arenas or the Orange Theatre, ten masterpieces of Roman architecture that shaped the French territory. Through these spectacular vestiges, the deep imprint left by the Roman Empire is revealed. A journey into the heart of an exceptional heritage, a testimony of the genius and power of Rome.

programme.title: Jean-Philippe
programme.desc: Fabrice (Fabrice Luchini), a disillusioned quadrennial, stifled in the dull decor of her pavilionary suburbs, between a wife whose routine has blunted dreams and a teenage girl in the midst of revolt. The only flash in his morose daily life is his unconditional adoration of Johnny Hallyday, a timeless icon whose tubes are rhythmic and soften his disillusionment. Posters, records and loop concerts are his last escape, his only reason to get up every morning. But when a watered evening turns into a nightmare after a neighbor overtakes the assemblé to silence him, Fabrice wakes up in a parallel world where his idol never existed. More than I love you, more than L'Envie, nothing. Just a sidereal void, a rewritten popular culture, and an obsessive question: how to live when what made you vibrate disappeared? Decided to restore the order of things, Fabrice embarked on a quest as crazy as it was impossible: to find Jean-Philippe Smet, the man who should have become Johnny, and make him the legend he deserved. But the reality is cruel: the real Smet is only a modest bowling manager, far from the spotlights and crowds of them. Worse, he seems to be content with this unglorious existence, indifferent to the destiny of glory that Fabrice destines him. Between scepticism and polite amusingness, Jean-Philippe resists the grandiose plans of his most determined " fan". Yet, despite the failures, the doors closing and the unbelieving gaze, Fabrice persists, convinced that Smet's raw talent only demands to explode.

programme.title: Like a leader
programme.desc: A keen amateur cook crosses the path of a starred chef without ideas. Both men decided to team up to face adversity.
programme.desc-more: In "As a Chef", a gastronomic comedy released in 2012, we follow the tumultuous journey of Jacky Bonnot (Michaël Youn), a young chef passionate about cooking who is eagerly dreaming of succeeding in the highly competitive world of gastronomy. Despite his undeniable talent, Jacky often faced failures in the small restaurants where he worked, eventually getting fired each time because of his impulsivity and his difficult character to manage. This series of misadventures prompted him to accept a job that was un gratifying in a canteen, far from his starry ambitions. Jacky's destiny took an unexpected turn when he crossed the road of Alexandre Lagarde (Jean Reno), an ultra-mediatic chef who was on the brink of the abyss. Lagarde, once starred and admired, lost his inspiration in cooking and faced a serious threat: the big financial group that owns its establishments is considering firing him if his restaurant loses even one Michelin star. In despair, Alexandre sees in Jacky a potential that could help her revive her passion for gastronomy. The two men, despite their differences in character and status, decided to join forces to counter this terrible threat. Jacky brings Lagarde a breath of freshness and innovation, and together they explore bold and creative recipes to give Lagarde's cuisine back its d Whilstantan shine.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: Anne breaks up with Jack while Danny starts an affair with Elena. It was then that the former husband of the latter, Carlos Aguilar, began to make talk about him. He is willing to do anything to get custody of their daughter, including taking the child away. In this season, it's Jack's turn to be investigated, after being abducted by a psychopath who does not hesitate to torture him. While the team is overwhelmed, especially because of a man who turns out to be a real serial kidnapper, Carlos is redoing his own and threatening the very life of his ex-wife. The writers give a real thickness to the character of Elena, whose daily life becomes a hell.
programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. While Barry seemed to be in good shape, his doctor had advised him to avoid this type of risk activity, fearing for his health. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. Poppy Montgomery, in the role of Samantha Spade, and Enrique Murciano, incarnation of Danny Taylor, join Jack in this investigation that led them to explore the world of food competitions. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

programme.title: Live my life
programme.sub-title: Live my life as a biker
programme.desc: Sandra, a dietician who is very attached to a sedentary and organized life, goes to live 72 hours with Valentine, a nomadic circus artist, and her family. Between life in a caravan, adrenaline and spectacular waterfalls, she will have to face her greatest fears in front of the public!
programme.desc-more: Stephanie, terrified by the two-wheelers and speed, is forkling a big cylinder to share the daily life of a tribe of Bikers. Far from the image she could have, she discovers a universe based on freedom, solidarity and sharing, which could well change her prejudices. In rural areas, Sacha, a model and actor, discovers a profession where days are never written in advance: that of a veterinarian. Emergencies, farm operations and short nights make up the intense daily life of its host. A sustained pace to which the city dweller can adapt?

programme.title: Our heroes of everyday life
programme.sub-title: Val Thorens: ski resort under surveillance
programme.desc: Every year, 4000 motorists are killed on the roads. If speed remains a known factor in accidents, there are also other causes. Thus, straight sections of national roads can cause frontal shocks. Exceedings are also responsible for many of the problems.
programme.desc-more: Dive into the heart of the daily lives of those who care for our safety and health: police, gendarmes, firefighters, UAS teams, etc. Through the reality of the interventions, this series highlights their commitment, their composure to the emergency, and the human challenges they face every day. A striking immersion in the daily lives of exceptional women and men, driven by a single objective: to protect, to rescue, to serve.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.

programme.title: Edward in the hands of silver
programme.desc: Edward is the creature of an old inventor who died before he could implant his hands. As fingers, the young man has sharp blades, which have left many scars on his face very pale. He lives in a huge half-in-church castle where Peg Boggs, the beauty representative of the neighborhood, discovers it one day. The latter, taking pity, decided to welcome him to his family, raising the emotion of the neighbourhood. But Edward, who does wonders of his hand-scissors, becomes the pertussis of the neighborhood.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: In the thick mist of an isolated campaign, where the shadows of trees seem to hide more threats than secrets, detectives Freddy Watson and Cal infiltrate an abandoned farm, identified as a den for a network of drug traffickers. The operation, supposed to be quick and discreet, turns into a nightmare from the first exchanges of fire. A shooting bursts, brutal and chaotic. Watson, hit by a bullet, sank into the dust, his blood mixing with the cold earth. Despite the pain and urgency, he found the force to order Cal to prosecute the fugitive criminals, even leaving him behind. For this hardened cop, failure is not an option – but this time, the rules of the game have changed.

programme.title: Veterinarians, their Live Live Life

programme.title: Veterinarians, their Live Live Life
programme.sub-title: We have to save the little bitch Havana
programme.desc: Havana, a pekinese woman, arrives at the emergency room at the veterinary clinic in Lille. She's seriously hurt in the right eye. Manon, his carer for 4 years, is anxious, the operation can be traumatic for the animal.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In 2017, in the city of Charenton-le-pont, a 12-year-old boy confesses to his mother that he was the victim of a sexual assault. His attacker would be a man he met on social media. His mother decides to go to the police station to file a complaint, and discovers that her son is not the only victim. In 2018 in Avignon, a friend of Cassandre told the police to report the assault she had suffered in the city centre. The attacker is on the run, trying to blackmail her with social media.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region

programme.title: The strength of the oceans
programme.desc: Every year, the French Antilles fear the arrival of devastating cyclones. Faced with these phenomena, many specialists are mobilizing. Pilots crossing the eye of the cyclone to the drone-equipped oceanographers, all track these storms to Miami. Their aim is to anticipate precisely the place and strength of the impact, a crucial challenge because the climate is warming.

programme.title: The strength of the oceans
programme.desc: Although the Channel seems peaceful between France and England, it hides one of the most powerful marine mechanics on the globe. Its gigantic tides and spectacular currents shape the landscape. The sea is also the scene of extreme events, such as storms capable of breaking ships, or rare weather tsunamis that arise in good weather.

programme.title: Bonifacio Falaise: Inevitable Erosion?
programme.desc: Perched on its limestone cliffs more than 80 meters above the Mediterranean, Bonifacio has been fascinated since the 12th century. Behind this picture of postcard is a real threat. The cliffs, subjected to the constant assaults of the sea and weakened by rainwater infiltrations, are gradually eroding. In 2022, the danger rose by a step: several houses were targeted by prefectural orders because of the risk of collapse. On the spot, scientists and geologists seek to understand the evolution of this phenomenon and to anticipate future collapses. Through their research, the city, originally conceived as a stunning fortress, reveals its extreme fragility. How far could erosion endanger Bonifacio's future?

programme.title: Mont-Saint-Michel: the last riddles of the abbey
programme.desc: A millenary monument, Mont-Saint-Michel fascinates both its beauty and its mysteries. Perched on its rocky island, it culminates at 150 meters high, and is the result of an extraordinary architectural challenge. High place of pilgrimage, abbey, fortress remained undefeated during the Hundred Years' War, then a state prison, the Mount is a gigantic stone millefeuille built over the centuries. But behind the facades that everyone knows is another Mont-Saint-Michel, unknown to the general public. Guided tour.

programme.title: Hostage Game
programme.desc:
In a world of ubiquitous tension, "Hostage Game" plunges spectators into the troubled universe of Kyle Snowden (Tyrese Gibson), a former navy whose traumas of the past haunt him. As he tries to rebuild his life after a difficult separation with his wife, he finds himself taking care of his young daughter, Angel. Their daily life takes a dramatic turn when they find themselves, one day, taken hostage at a grocery store, alongside Sam (John Malkovich), Kyle's stepfather and an influential member of Congress.
Their abductor, driven by a desire for revenge, targets Sam for personal reasons, holding him responsible for the arrest of his father, currently in prison. In this crisis situation, Kyle must draw on his military skills and protective instincts to save his daughter and face his inner demons. As hours pass, tensions intensify, and every decision could have fatal consequences. Between the struggle for survival and that of his family, Kyle must navigate through a real game of cat and mouse, where the slightest false step could be tragic.
The outcome of this confrontation will depend not only on his physical abilities, but also on his emotional resilience to a ruthless opponent.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: In the thick mist of an isolated campaign, where the shadows of trees seem to hide more threats than secrets, detectives Freddy Watson and Cal infiltrate an abandoned farm, identified as a den for a network of drug traffickers. The operation, supposed to be quick and discreet, turns into a nightmare from the first exchanges of fire. A shooting bursts, brutal and chaotic. Watson, hit by a bullet, sank into the dust, his blood mixing with the cold earth. Despite the pain and urgency, he found the force to order Cal to prosecute the fugitive criminals, even leaving him behind. For this hardened cop, failure is not an option – but this time, the rules of the game have changed.

programme.title: New York, Criminal Section
programme.desc: In this fifth season of "New York, Criminal Section", Inspectors Robert Goren (Vincent D'Onofrio) and Alexandra Eames (Kathryn Erbe) welcome two new officers, Veteran Mike Logan (Chris Not) and Inspector Carolyn Barek (Annabella Sciorra). Although the two investigators' duos never cross, each one is confronted with complex and intriguing cases. Goren and Eames find themselves facing a grieving patriarch (Malcolm McDowell), whose grief hides dark secrets, while Logan and Barek have to navigate the tumults of a charismatic adoptive mother (Whoopi Goldberg), whose protégés seem to have drifted to crime. This season is distinguished by its innovative formula, where each pair of actors devotes themselves to only half a season, with one episode in two. Fred Dalton Thompson also made a striking appearance, adding a familiar touch to this new dynamic within the "Law & Order" universe.
programme.desc-more: New York City, Criminal Section is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the US judicial system, highlighting a team of elite investigators from the New York Criminal Police. In this vibrant and life-filled metropolis, violent crimes often leave no room for error, and it is the responsibility of these investigators to resolve the darkest cases. Their mission: to track down murderers by looking not only at physical evidence, but also at the psychological distress that drives an individual to commit such atrocities. Each episode follows the investigators, led by Detective Robert Goren (Vincent D'Onofrio). Accompanied by her partner, Detective Alexandra Eames (Kathryn Erbe), this dynamic duo explores the meandering of the criminal mind, relying on innovative psychological methods to apprehend suspects. The episodes often highlight disturbing records, where each murder tells a different story, revealing the motivations and traumas behind the crime. However, at the dawn of every new investigation, investigators must navigate through a network of lies, secrets and manipulation, each case testing not only their professional skills, but also their moral values.

When two parents refuse to report a child to a paedophile in exchange for a large sum of money, Stabler's blood is only a turn. An episode inspired, like many others, by real facts. At the end of the season, Alexandra Cabot's character left his post and would only appear sporadically.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: Young Tommy, the only witness to his mother-in-law's murder, refuses to talk to the police. His father became the main suspect in the case.
programme.desc-more: Can we leave two sexual predators at liberty on the grounds that they must testify soon against a mafia godfather? Is it permissible to take cells from a woman in a coma, even in the interests of medicine? Should we excuse the transgender victim of rape if she kills her assailant? Several cases of conscience torment the team of the special unit. The hearings did not end for this fourth season, in which Sherilyn Fenn, Pam Grier, Rob Estes and Fred Savage participated, impressive in the role of a rapist who himself defended and stood up to prosecutor Cabot.

programme.title: Little secrets between neighbours
programme.desc: Each episode tells an incredible story of neighbours: neighbourhood conflicts, forbidden love, secrets, jealousies... We frequent them every day. We exchange with them polishes in the building yard or over the hedge. We can imagine their intimacy by looking at them out the window. The lives of our neighbors seem perfectly normal... But appearances are deceptive and behind their walls, often hide incredible stories... And you, do you really know your neighbors?

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The one who was doing a job interview
programme.desc: After experiencing a disastrous food criticism, Monica decides to take cooking classes. Rachel suffers from jealousy.
programme.desc-more: While the candles of Monica Geller's (Courteney Cox) and Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) wedding are barely out, news of Rachel Green's (Jennifer Aniston) pregnancy is beginning to spread, creating a palpable tension within the group of friends. Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) and Rachel are trying to navigate this delicate situation, seeking to establish a stable friendship while managing their complex feelings. Rachel, seeking to get closer to Ross, moved home, which made it even more difficult, especially when Ross's new girlfriend, Mona, proposed to write common greeting cards, adding an extra layer of confusion to their dynamics. Meanwhile, Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc) made an unexpected revelation that could upset the fragile balance of the band. This season, acclaimed by critics, highlights Jennifer Aniston's actress talents, hailed by nominations for the Emmy Awards.

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The one who didn't ask anyone to marry
programme.desc: Joey finds Ross's grandmother's ring by chance. He's standing in front of Rachel to pick her up, and the young woman thinks he's proposing.
programme.desc-more: In this memorable season of the iconic series, friendship and relationships continue to become complex for the inseparable group. While Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) and Monica Geller (Courteney Cox) are embarking on an unexpected adventure trying to design a child in a maternity closet, the dynamics between other friends are changing. Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc), in a misunderstanding, finds himself improvising a meeting between Phoebe Buffay (Lisa Kudrow) and a mysterious stranger, Mike (Paul Rudd), who might well upset her life. Meanwhile, Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston) is back on the job, and her feelings towards Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) are getting complicated, especially with the arrival of Charlie, a seductive colleague. Tensions rise and laughter is coming as each navigates through the joys and challenges of love, friendship and careers, all with unforgettable humour.

Meanwhile, Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston) is back on the job, and her feelings towards Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) are getting complicated, especially with the arrival of Charlie, a seductive colleague. Tensions rise and laughter is coming as each navigates through the joys and challenges of love, friendship and careers, all with unforgettable humour.

programme.title: Christmas at the fire
programme.desc: While she just bought a house on the Irish coast, a young American sees her relationship with the real estate agent taking an unexpected turn.
programme.desc-more: As Christmas approaches, Rose, an American woman who lives on real estate speculation, buys a small cottage in Dunclare, on the Irish coast, where her mother lived briefly in the 1980s. When she arrived there, Rose had an appointment with Sean, the real estate agent who sold her the house. What she doesn't know is that she's going to have to negotiate with him to be able to carry out the renovation work of the cottage, much more delabrant than she thought. Decided to sell, she embarked on some beautification work, and took advantage of the local Christmas traditions during her stay. But his relationship with Sean gradually takes on another turn and this trip to Ireland becomes an opportunity for a great challenge.

programme.title: Twilight, chapter 4: Revelation, part 1
programme.desc: Edward and Bella, still human, are finally married. They're going to Brazil for their wedding trip. When they return, the young woman is pregnant.
programme.desc-more: In Forks, the small town wrapped in haze and mysteries, the announcement of the marriage between Bella Swan (Kristen Stewart), a young man as determined as he is vulnerable, and Edward Cullen (Robert Pattinson), a vampire with a dark and tormented past, divides their loved ones. Between hopes and fears, reactions are blurred between sincere joy and deepest concerns, including those of Charlie (Billy Burke), Bella's father, who struggles to accept this extraordinary union. On the eve of the ceremony, Edward, gnawed by guilt, confides in Bella a heavy secret: in his youth as a rebel vampire, he hunted and killed humans, a confession that could have broken their relationship. Yet Bella, whose love for Edward transcends the boundaries of morality and reason, chooses to accept him unreservedly. The wedding day finally arrives, surrounded by a magical atmosphere and full of tension. Even Jacob Black (Taylor Lautner), the heart-torn werewolf whose feelings for Bella have never weakened, made a discreet appearance, unable to stay away from her despite the pain that this union inflicts on her. As the newlyweds fly to an idyllic honeymoon in Brazil, their happiness seems at last to be within reach. But fate, ruthless, reserves to Bella a revelation as unexpected as alarming: she carries in her the child of Edward, a pregnancy that defies the laws of nature and endangers her life. Between the ecstasy of absolute love and the anguish of an uncertain future, Bella and Edward find themselves faced with a heartbreaking choice, where every decision could have irreversible consequences for them... And for those who are dear to them. Alliances will be tested, loyalty questioned, and best-kept secrets threaten to burst out.

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The one we saw in the tea leaves
programme.desc: After his revelations to Rachel, Joey doesn't dare to meet her. But she's making up a pretext to talk to Joey: she says her boss wants to buy her baby. Phoebe, for her part, meets the man of her life, who is not exactly as she imagined. She doesn't know how to react, or if she can fall in love...
programme.desc-more: While the candles of Monica Geller's (Courteney Cox) and Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) wedding are barely out, news of Rachel Green's (Jennifer Aniston) pregnancy is beginning to spread, creating a palpable tension within the group of friends. Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) and Rachel are trying to navigate this delicate situation, seeking to establish a stable friendship while managing their complex feelings. Rachel, seeking to get closer to Ross, moved home, which made it even more difficult, especially when Ross's new girlfriend, Mona, proposed to write common greeting cards, adding an extra layer of confusion to their dynamics. Meanwhile, Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc) made an unexpected revelation that could upset the fragile balance of the band. This season, acclaimed by critics, highlights Jennifer Aniston's actress talents, hailed by nominations for the Emmy Awards.

programme.title: New York, Criminal Section
programme.desc: "The shame of the family"Logan and Barek investigate the murder of the parents of a young man who has shown strange behavior since the tragedy. Traffickers are suspected.
programme.desc-more: In this fifth season of "New York, Criminal Section", Inspectors Robert Goren (Vincent D'Onofrio) and Alexandra Eames (Kathryn Erbe) welcome two new officers, Veteran Mike Logan (Chris Not) and Inspector Carolyn Barek (Annabella Sciorra). Although the two investigators' duos never cross, each one is confronted with complex and intriguing cases. Goren and Eames find themselves facing a grieving patriarch (Malcolm McDowell), whose grief hides dark secrets, while Logan and Barek have to navigate the tumults of a charismatic adoptive mother (Whoopi Goldberg), whose protégés seem to have drifted to crime. This season is distinguished by its innovative formula, where each pair of actors devotes themselves to only half a season, with one episode in two. Fred Dalton Thompson also made a striking appearance, adding a familiar touch to this new dynamic within the "Law & Order" universe.

programme.title: New York, Criminal Section
programme.desc: "The Case of a Life"The daughter of a former ambassador was murdered. Goren and Eames are in charge of the investigation. Their investigations lead them to another similar crime.
programme.desc-more: Several characters left the show, such as the assistant prosecutor Ron Carver, Captain Deakins and even Inspector Carolyn Barek. A younger policeman, Megan Wheeler, now shoulder Logan, while a new captain, Danny Ross, takes over the section. On the side of the settlement, Ross was much less willing to arrange with his troops than his predecessor. Unlike the habits of the "Law & Order" franchise, this season is the bet to involve its protagonists more personally. This is how Goren's family problems or Logan's angery mood interfered here with the investigations.

programme.desc-more: In this fifth season of "New York, Criminal Section", Inspectors Robert Goren (Vincent D'Onofrio) and Alexandra Eames (Kathryn Erbe) welcome two new officers, Veteran Mike Logan (Chris Not) and Inspector Carolyn Barek (Annabella Sciorra). Although the two investigators' duos never cross, each one is confronted with complex and intriguing cases. Goren and Eames find themselves facing a grieving patriarch (Malcolm McDowell), whose grief hides dark secrets, while Logan and Barek have to navigate the tumults of a charismatic adoptive mother (Whoopi Goldberg), whose protégés seem to have drifted to crime. This season is distinguished by its innovative formula, where each pair of actors devotes themselves to only half a season, with one episode in two. Fred Dalton Thompson also made a striking appearance, adding a familiar touch to this new dynamic within the "Law & Order" universe.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: "Programmed Demence" Elliot Stabler is responsible for resolving a case of child kidnapping by a schizophrenic. His investigation brings him to the criminal network.
programme.desc-more: Benson and Stabler investigate both an Islamophobic hate crime, a high school shooting, slave trafficking and a violent husband, and the multitude of sexual maniacs running the streets of New York. Their already trying investigations become almost impossible when victims themselves hesitate to testify. When two parents refuse to report a child to a paedophile in exchange for a large sum of money, Stabler's blood is only a turn. An episode inspired, like many others, by real facts. At the end of the season, Alexandra Cabot's character left his post and would only appear sporadically.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: "The Last Victim"Michael Gardner, a golden boy, is accused of rape by three young women. As the trial approached, he decided to defend himself.
programme.desc-more: Can we leave two sexual predators at liberty on the grounds that they must testify soon against a mafia godfather? Is it permissible to take cells from a woman in a coma, even in the interests of medicine? Should we excuse the transgender victim of rape if she kills her assailant? Several cases of conscience torment the team of the special unit. The hearings did not end for this fourth season, in which Sherilyn Fenn, Pam Grier, Rob Estes and Fred Savage participated, impressive in the role of a rapist who himself defended and stood up to prosecutor Cabot.

programme.desc-more: In this memorable season of the iconic series, friendship and relationships continue to become complex for the inseparable group. While Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) and Monica Geller (Courteney Cox) are embarking on an unexpected adventure trying to design a child in a maternity closet, the dynamics between other friends are changing. Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc), in a misunderstanding, finds himself improvising a meeting between Phoebe Buffay (Lisa Kudrow) and a mysterious stranger, Mike (Paul Rudd), who might well upset her life. Meanwhile, Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston) is back on the job, and her feelings towards Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) are getting complicated, especially with the arrival of Charlie, a seductive colleague. Tensions rise and laughter is coming as each navigates through the joys and challenges of love, friendship and careers, all with unforgettable humour.

programme.title: Josephine, guardian angel
programme.desc: "A bad pass"An angel guard steals from a mother of families who is the victim of cascades of spells, abandoned by a husband whose debts she has to pay.
programme.desc-more: In this poignant episode of the series, Josephine (Mimie Mathy) travels to Belgium to accomplish a new humanitarian mission. She met Véronique (Olivia Brunaux), a single mother who was overwhelmed by overwhelming debts and determined to support her two daughters. In a moment of despair, Véronique made a flight to the supermarket where she worked, a decision that cost her her job and plunged her into a spiral of precariousness. To survive, she plans to prostitute herself, a reality she would never have imagined. However, her destiny changes when she crosses the road to Wadeck (Patrick Catalifo), a committed journalist who is investigating the motivations of women turning to prostitution. Touched by Véronique's heartbreaking narrative, Wadeck finds himself confronted with disturbing truths about society and the status of women. Together, they will try to break the cycle of distress and stigma.

programme.title: Josephine, guardian angel
programme.desc: "Copée du monde"The guardian angel Josephine comes to help a woman about fifty years old whose daughter committed suicide, and who now lives on the street.
programme.desc-more: Josephine comes to the aid of Geneviève Beaumont, a depressed woman who has been living on the street since she lost her job. Josephine discovers the daily lives of the homeless. She learns that Patricia, Geneviève's youngest daughter, committed suicide a few years earlier, after a disappointment in love. Lise, her eldest daughter, blames her mother for this tragedy, accusing her of not being present enough. Josephine is trying to reconcile them.

programme.title: Dr. Cath: Mission Adoption
programme.desc: The teams are waiting for a landlord to be able to seize animals. A family goes to the shelter to meet Vanille, a labrador, for adoption, and we discover the story of Winston, a pony collected at the shelter.

programme.title: Dr. Cath: Mission Adoption
programme.desc: At the shelter, we learn the story of Tyson Bull. Dr. Cath finds the recovered kitten from the old lady and the recently seized sheep are adopted. Fabrice and Dr.Cath visit Naya, previously adopted. The kitten who lost an eye will find her mistress.

programme.title: Dr. Cath: Mission Adoption
programme.desc: The kitten owner didn't come to get it. Dr. Cath finds a pony collected by the teams of "Pets at Risk". It's Tika's adoption day.

programme.title: A treasure in your home
programme.desc: What if a treasure hides in your attic? In each episode, a private individual opens his or her doors, convinced to own a nugget: rare stamps, family jewels, old vase or forgotten old instrument. He entrusts us with the estimate he makes and what he dreams of accomplishing with that sum. Then visit a auctioneer, whose expert verdict sometimes contains cruel disillusionments... or beautiful surprises !!
The lives and careers of relief team members, risking their lives to save others' lives.
programme.desc-more: 9-1-1 is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the crises that hit American citizens and highlights the heroic work of first responders. Through stories from police, firefighters and ambulances, the series offers us a perspective on the challenges they face on a daily basis. Each episode reminds us of the crucial importance of the 9-1-1 emergency number, which is a true link between those in distress and those who work for their safety. The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Together, they lead a diverse team of stakeholders, each bringing their unique skills and personal stories. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: Beverly Hills 2 cop
programme.desc: Axel Foley (Eddie Murphy) is back in Beverly Hills. This time, he comes to lend a hand to his colleagues and friends to solve a case of jewelry theft.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: As Max prepares to say goodbye, the agents are called on a case: a murder was committed during a police convention.
programme.desc-more: After leaving the hospital, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) quickly returned to duty in Special Unit 5-0, where a murder investigation was awaiting them. The case takes an intriguing turn when the victim's body is discovered in the 5-0's premises, raising questions about the team's safety. As they try to solve this mystery, the agents must also work with an MI-6 agent to track down a formidable terrorist, responsible for an attack on the British embassy in Madrid. Barely the case closed, McGarrett and Alicia, a key figure on his team, became targets of a serial killer, who did not hesitate to remove them. Meanwhile, the rest of the team, including members like Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Kim) and Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), is mobilizing to save them, leading to unexpected twists in this season full of action and suspense.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.sub-title: E ho'i na keiki oki uaua o na pali
programme.desc: McGarrett and his team are investigating the murder of a ranch owner. Shortly before his death, he had discovered human skeletons buried in his property.
programme.desc-more: In this season's iconic series, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) are called upon to investigate a troubling case involving military veterans engaged to eliminate mafia leaders. In parallel, they meet with Quinn Liu, a sergeant of the military police, whose methodical approach and efficiency quickly impress the team. Recognizing his talent, Steve invited him to join the famous 5-0 group of investigators, thereby strengthening their ability to solve increasingly complex cases, ranging from kidnappings to murders to drug trafficking networks. This tenth season is marked by the return of iconic characters and captivating intrigues, not to mention a long-awaited crossover with "Magnum". Tensions are rising as the team faces ever more dangerous threats while navigating the personal and professional challenges ahead.

programme.title: A season at the zoo

programme.desc: Charles Ingalls must endure Jim Tyler's contempt every day. At the village festival, the latter intends to distinguish himself from the game of the log cutters.
programme.desc-more: In Walnut Grove, the effervescence is at its peak as the annual celebration approaches, promising laughter and friendly competitions. Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) and her sister Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson) are enthusiastically preparing for the three-legged race, an event that will test their coordination. Meanwhile, Laura is looking forward to the hula hoop fight, where she hopes to compete with the formidable Nellie Oleson (Sidney Greenbush). Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle) is now in the pie competition, determined to prove her culinary talents against her competitors. In another corner of the party, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) faces Jim Tyler (Richard Bull) in a woodcut competition, a challenge that fuels rivalry between the two men. As preparations are in full swing, the spirit of community and competition intersects, promising a memorable day for all the inhabitants.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.sub-title: The richest man in the village
programme.desc: Charles Ingalls has serious money problems and struggles to make ends meet. He's looking for a little work to make some money...
programme.desc-more: In the peaceful Walnut Grove community, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) is faced with major financial difficulties that push him to seek additional employment. Debts are accumulating, and to support his family, he accepts various small jobs, testing his endurance and his spirit. Meanwhile, her daughter Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson), who wanted to contribute to the home, made the difficult decision to leave school to work. This choice distances her from her academic aspirations, but she is determined to help her loved ones. As Charles and Mary struggle to maintain the balance of their families, tensions rise and sacrifices become inevitable. The series highlights the values of solidarity and perseverance, while exploring the economic challenges facing the Ingalls family. Family relations and community spirit are essential to overcoming these challenges.
