programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Charles is making an appointment with the doctor for Mary. He thinks his bad grades and little problems in class are medical...
programme.desc-more: Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson), an exemplary student of the small prairie house, is going through a difficult period, marked by an unexpected fall on the stairs. His father, Charles Ingalls (Scottie McCreery), concerned about his recent school failures, decided to consult a doctor. During this visit, the doctor discovers that Mary's problems with concentration and academic performance are related to visual impairment. To help her overcome this challenge, he prescribed a pair of glasses, an accessory that, although common to some, represented Mary as a symbol of change and challenge. In parallel, her mother, Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), and her sister, Laura (Melissa Gilbert), are fighting to support her in this transition, exploring the themes of family, support and resilience. This new obstacle leads Mary to rediscover her inner strength and fight for her academic future, while learning to accept her new equipment.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Laura has become friends with the new bank manager. He does not believe in his sincerity and accuses him of playing the comedy of sympathy.
programme.desc-more: In the small town of Walnut Grove, the atmosphere is in full swing with the inauguration of the first local bank, an event that arouses many expectations among the inhabitants. Mr Sprague, the new director of the bank, is greeted with enthusiasm, but also with some distrust. Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon), always concerned about the well-being of his community, strives to create friendly ties with Mr. Sprague, multiplying the gestures of kindness towards him. Meanwhile, her daughter Laura (Melissa Gilbert) discovers a new unexpected friend during a fishing game, developing an complicity with Mr. Sprague who might well change their perception of life in the city. However, as the bank became the centre of Walnut Grove's social life, tensions and conflicts of interest began to emerge, testing the relations between the inhabitants and the values of solidarity that united them.

Maddie and Athena are investigating the abduction of a mother and her child, while Hen and Karen are learning more about Mara's family history.
programme.desc-more: The long-awaited honeymoon of Athena Grant (Angela Bassett) and Bobby Nash (Peter Krause) takes an unexpected turn when they find themselves trapped in a catastrophic situation on their cruise. Meanwhile, Buck (Oliver Stark) is entering a new relationship that allows him to better understand his own emotions and rediscover himself, while navigating the complexities of love and commitment. Maddie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) and Chimney (Kenneth Choi) are preparing to celebrate their union, surrounded by their loved ones and colleagues, highlighting the joys and challenges of wedding preparations. At the same time, Harry (Gavin McHugh), Athena's son, returns to Los Angeles, crossing the path of people with varied stories, bringing their share of surprises and twists. This final season, as intense as the first, celebrates the 100th episode, mixing action, emotion and humour.

The 118 team is called to rescue when a trailer containing millions of bees spills over the streets of Los Angeles, releasing the swarm.
programme.desc-more: Members of the Los Angeles Emergency Response Unit 118 are confronted with chaotic situations and scenarios worthy of action films. This season begins with an unusual incident: a traffic accident results in the release of millions of bees, immerse the city in a real frenzy. Firefighters, first aid workers and other stakeholders must demonstrate cold blood and expertise to deal with this environmental disaster while ensuring the safety of citizens. At the heart of this dynamic, the team must also learn to navigate the organizational transition following the retirement of Captain Bobby Nash. This change brought the new captain, Gerrard, to the fore, whose tyrannical leadership style tested the cohesion and team spirit of the unit 118. Tensions are rising as each member adapts to this new hierarchy while continuing to carry out their crucial work. In parallel to these professional challenges, Bobby finds himself juggling his real responsibilities with his role as technical advisor on the stage of the drama series "Hotshots". This series, which offers a fictional look at the challenges of everyday life in a fire station, will highlight the realities of emergency response.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: Fifth century, island of Brittany. The kingdom of Kaamelott is organized around its ruler, King Arthur. Surrounded by his faithful knights of the Round Table, he strives for the mission entrusted to him by the gods: to seek the Holy Grail!
programme.desc-more: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.sub-title: The richest man in the village
programme.desc: Charles Ingalls has serious money problems and struggles to make ends meet. He's looking for a little work to make some money...
programme.desc-more: In the peaceful Walnut Grove community, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) is faced with major financial difficulties that push him to seek additional employment. Debts are accumulating, and to support his family, he accepts various small jobs, testing his endurance and his spirit. Meanwhile, her daughter Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson), who wanted to contribute to the home, made the difficult decision to leave school to work. This choice distances her from her academic aspirations, but she is determined to help her loved ones. As Charles and Mary struggle to maintain the balance of their families, tensions rise and sacrifices become inevitable. The series highlights the values of solidarity and perseverance, while exploring the economic challenges facing the Ingalls family. Family relations and community spirit are essential to overcoming these challenges.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Charles is making an appointment with the doctor for Mary. He thinks his bad grades and little problems in class are medical...
programme.desc-more: Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson), an exemplary student of the small prairie house, is going through a difficult period, marked by an unexpected fall on the stairs. His father, Charles Ingalls (Scottie McCreery), concerned about his recent school failures, decided to consult a doctor. During this visit, the doctor discovers that Mary's problems with concentration and academic performance are related to visual impairment. To help her overcome this challenge, he prescribed a pair of glasses, an accessory that, although common to some, represented Mary as a symbol of change and challenge. In parallel, her mother, Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), and her sister, Laura (Melissa Gilbert), are fighting to support her in this transition, exploring the themes of family, support and resilience. This new obstacle leads Mary to rediscover her inner strength and fight for her academic future, while learning to accept her new equipment.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Laura has become friends with the new bank manager. He does not believe in his sincerity and accuses him of playing the comedy of sympathy.
programme.desc-more: In the small town of Walnut Grove, the atmosphere is in full swing with the inauguration of the first local bank, an event that arouses many expectations among the inhabitants. Mr Sprague, the new director of the bank, is greeted with enthusiasm, but also with some distrust. Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon), always concerned about the well-being of his community, strives to create friendly ties with Mr. Sprague, multiplying the gestures of kindness towards him. Meanwhile, her daughter Laura (Melissa Gilbert) discovers a new unexpected friend during a fishing game, developing an complicity with Mr. Sprague who might well change their perception of life in the city. However, as the bank became the centre of Walnut Grove's social life, tensions and conflicts of interest began to emerge, testing the relations between the inhabitants and the values of solidarity that united them.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Walnut Grove's best baseball players agree to play a game that engages both the honour and the money of the bettors...
programme.desc-more: After a devastating loss the previous year, Walnut Grove's baseball team was determined to get the lead straight. Nels Oleson, the team's launcher, no longer meeting expectations, raises concern among players and supporters. As the team desperately seeks a replacement capable of restoring hope, the arrival of Mr.Mumfort, a new passionate and experienced coach, turns out to be a boon. With his rigorous method and team spirit, he re-edynamizes the players, instilling strategies and a sense of collective. Young talents, such as Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) and Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson), are beginning to shine under her tutelage. However, the team must also overcome the internal rivalries and tensions that threaten their cohesion. Between intense training and decisive games, Walnut Grove's team must learn to fight together to hope for victory and prove that they can overcome the obstacles of the past.

The 118 members received a medal for the rescue of the cruise ship. Hen and Karen face a barrier in the adoption process.
programme.desc-more: The long-awaited honeymoon of Athena Grant (Angela Bassett) and Bobby Nash (Peter Krause) takes an unexpected turn when they find themselves trapped in a catastrophic situation on their cruise. Meanwhile, Buck (Oliver Stark) is entering a new relationship that allows him to better understand his own emotions and rediscover himself, while navigating the complexities of love and commitment. Maddie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) and Chimney (Kenneth Choi) are preparing to celebrate their union, surrounded by their loved ones and colleagues, highlighting the joys and challenges of wedding preparations. At the same time, Harry (Gavin McHugh), Athena's son, returns to Los Angeles, crossing the path of people with varied stories, bringing their share of surprises and twists. This final season, as intense as the first, celebrates the 100th episode, mixing action, emotion and humour.

programme.desc: Marie chained the deliveries and reloading of spruce, Clémence carried 29 tons of paper while Emilie carried 26 tons of gravel.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Charles is making an appointment with the doctor for Mary. He thinks his bad grades and little problems in class are medical...
programme.desc-more: Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson), an exemplary student of the small prairie house, is going through a difficult period, marked by an unexpected fall on the stairs. His father, Charles Ingalls (Scottie McCreery), concerned about his recent school failures, decided to consult a doctor. During this visit, the doctor discovers that Mary's problems with concentration and academic performance are related to visual impairment. To help her overcome this challenge, he prescribed a pair of glasses, an accessory that, although common to some, represented Mary as a symbol of change and challenge. In parallel, her mother, Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), and her sister, Laura (Melissa Gilbert), are fighting to support her in this transition, exploring the themes of family, support and resilience. This new obstacle leads Mary to rediscover her inner strength and fight for her academic future, while learning to accept her new equipment.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Walnut Grove's best baseball players agree to play a game that engages both the honour and the money of the bettors...
programme.desc-more: After a devastating loss the previous year, Walnut Grove's baseball team was determined to get the lead straight. Nels Oleson, the team's launcher, no longer meeting expectations, raises concern among players and supporters. As the team desperately seeks a replacement capable of restoring hope, the arrival of Mr.Mumfort, a new passionate and experienced coach, turns out to be a boon. With his rigorous method and team spirit, he re-edynamizes the players, instilling strategies and a sense of collective. Young talents, such as Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) and Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson), are beginning to shine under her tutelage. However, the team must also overcome the internal rivalries and tensions that threaten their cohesion. Between intense training and decisive games, Walnut Grove's team must learn to fight together to hope for victory and prove that they can overcome the obstacles of the past.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Laura offers her friendship to a child who is being repulsed by Nellie Oleson. She also enters Amos Pike's house and discovers that he is not the dangerous fool that everyone claims...
programme.desc-more: Driven by a challenge from Nellie Oleson (Alison Arngrim), Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) decided to venture into the isolated house of Mr. Pike (Richard Bull), a hermit whom the rumor presents as a madman. As Laura enters this mysterious place, she discovers an elderly man, haunted by the memory of his late wife, whose loss plunges him into deep melancholy. Mr. Pike, although considered strange by the Walnut Grove residents, reveals to Laura poignant stories about his lost love and the life they shared. As she spends time with him, Laura realizes that true madness may lie in the judgment of others. This encounter upsets his prejudices and allows him to understand the importance of empathy and compassion towards those living in the shadow of their pain. As this adventure unfolds, Laura learns essential life lessons about loss, love and loneliness.

programme.title: Bear
programme.desc: Youk bear runs happy days with her mother. But a stone that detachs itself from a rock wall makes it orphan. Disembodied, he wanders in the wild in search of some comfort, which he believes he finds with Kodiak Kaar, an adult bear. He agrees to take it under his protection...
programme.desc-more: A bear dies crushed by a rock, leaving an orphan in the icy immensity of the mountains. The hairball will have to learn life earlier than expected, clinging to an adult male who didn't really want that.

programme.title: The Tournesol case
programme.desc: The residents of the Château de Moulinsart are concerned. For some time now, glass and bottles of milk have been mysteriously broken in the vicinity of the peaceful home. The phenomenon ends when Professor Tournesol abstains from attending a congress on nuclear physics in Switzerland...
programme.desc-more: Professor Tournesol, a leading scientist, has just developed a revolutionary invention: an ultrasonic weapon capable of destroying glass objects. Although initially conceived as a research project, this weapon has alarming destructive potential if it is perfected to target other materials. Only Professor Bretzel, his former colleague, has the knowledge to activate this machine. Tintin, accompanied by his faithful dog Milou, Captain Haddock and Professor Tournesol, set out to find Bretzel and warn him of the dangers of invention. However, they quickly discover that Bretzel was abducted by syldave agents. Shortly thereafter, Professor Tournesol's turn was to be kidnapped. Tintin and his friends then raced against the clock to find the missing scientists, thwart the malicious plans of the kidnappers and prevent this technology from falling into bad hands, while facing the obstacles that stand in their way.

programme.title: Toy Story 4
programme.desc: Andy went to college and gave Woody and Buzz The Flash to little Bonnie. At school, the little girl made Forky, a new toy, with a plastic fork. Woody and his friends enthusiastically welcomed the newcomer while Forky considered himself a waste. Forky ends up escaping...
programme.desc-more: Woody has always favoured the joy and well-being of his young owners – Andy and Bonnie – and his companions, not hesitant to take all the risks for them, however unconsidered they may be. The arrival of Forky, a new toy that doesn't want to be one in Bonnie's room, is a big blow to the whole little gang. It is the beginning of a great adventure and an extraordinary journey for Woody and his friends. The cowboy will discover how vast the world can be for a toy...

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: In the fifth century, King Arthur and his prious knights tried to raise up the divine mission entrusted to them: to go in search of the Holy Grail.
programme.desc-more: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In the rural atmosphere of the American Midwest, Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) and her friend Jonah, fearless pioneer children, discover what they believe to be a golden line in an isolated valley. This revelation ignites Laura's imagination, which begins to dream of a life of opulence and comfort, far from the daily struggles that her family endures. The visions of a flamboyant house, luxurious clothes and a carefree life haunt her, while she aspires to make her loved ones discover the pleasures that wealth can bring. However, this golden dream is not without consequences. By stepping in this quest for fortune, Laura and Jonah must navigate through the dangers of greed and disproportionate ambitions. The relationship between friends will be tested, and they will have to learn that true wealth lies not only in gold, but also in the family ties and love that unite them.

Members of the Los Angeles Emergency Response Unit 118 are confronted with chaotic situations and scenarios worthy of action films. This season begins with an unusual incident: a traffic accident results in the release of millions of bees, immerse the city in a real frenzy. Firefighters, first aid workers and other stakeholders must demonstrate cold blood and expertise to deal with this environmental disaster while ensuring the safety of citizens. At the heart of this dynamic, the team must also learn to navigate the organizational transition following the retirement of Captain Bobby Nash. This change brought the new captain, Gerrard, to the fore, whose tyrannical leadership style tested the cohesion and team spirit of the unit 118. Tensions are rising as each member adapts to this new hierarchy while continuing to carry out their crucial work. In parallel to these professional challenges, Bobby finds himself juggling his real responsibilities with his role as technical advisor on the stage of the drama series "Hotshots". This series, which offers a fictional look at the challenges of everyday life in a fire station, will highlight the realities of emergency response.
programme.desc-more: 9-1-1 is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the crises that hit American citizens and highlights the heroic work of first responders. Through stories from police, firefighters and ambulances, the series offers us a perspective on the challenges they face on a daily basis. Each episode reminds us of the crucial importance of the 9-1-1 emergency number, which is a true link between those in distress and those who work for their safety. The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Together, they lead a diverse team of stakeholders, each bringing their unique skills and personal stories. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

programme.title: The Rookie: Los Angeles Cop
programme.desc: After the Armstrong case broke, John Nolan was blamed and his training period extended for a month. This sanction is accompanied by a visit to a disciplinary commission and may well ruin his chances of becoming an inspector or joining a specialized unit. Promote investigator, Lopez prefers to keep her pregnancy quiet, fearing that she will be treated differently if she knows. Shortened by the pandemic, this third season is the shortest of the series with only 14 episodes.
programme.desc-more: Recently divorced and faced with a major turning point in his life, John Nolan (Nathan Fillion), a man aged 40 years, finds himself somewhat lost after his son left for university. On an ordinary day, he became a witness to a bank robbery where he barely escaped death. This traumatic event leads him to a profound introspection on his life choices and the path he wishes to take. Driven by a strong desire to change his life, John decided to leave his old life behind and settle in Los Angeles to fulfill his dream of becoming a policeman. As a new LAPD member, he must navigate in a complex environment where danger and stress are pervasive. At the earliest age of recruits, he found himself under the wing of Talia Bishop (Alyssa Diaz), his educational determination, who would have to help him overcome the specific challenges associated with his unique situation. Between training events, police intrigues and the need to prove its worth to younger colleagues, John Nolan will have to show courage and resilience while finding his place in a constantly changing world.

programme.title: A private case
programme.desc: In Spain, in 1949. Marina Quiroga, a young woman from a long family of police officers, dreams of being able to join this illustrious line. When she finds out about a mysterious murder case, she decides to investigate and gets on the murder track with the help of her loyal butler, Héctor. Between the mysterious mist of Sacred Ribbon, the elegant streets of Vigo and the dangers of the city's harbour and lowlands, she does not step back in front of anything to solve the matter. Between suspense, action and humour, this friendly series gives the beautiful role to the Spanish Aura Garrido, assisted by a phlegmatic Jean Reno.
programme.desc-more: In Spain, in 1949, Marina Quiroga (Aura Garrido), a young woman from a prestigious line of police officers, aspired to prove herself in a world dominated by men. When rumors of a mysterious murder begin to circulate, she sees this as an opportunity to assert herself and prove her worth. Accompanied by her faithful butler, Héctor (Gorka Otxoa), she is immersed in a thrilling investigation that leads her through the elegant streets of Vigo, where secrets and dangers are hidden at every corner of the street. While sailing between the enigmatic mist of Sacred Ribbon and the dark lows of the harbour, Marina must show courage and ingenuity to expose the murderer. The series, mixing suspense, action and humour, highlights the charism of Aura Garrido, supported by the captivating presence of Jean Reno, who embodies a mysterious and phlegmatic character.

programme.title: A dream life
programme.desc: Istanbul. Sanem Aydın dreams of becoming a novelist, but is forced to work in the family grocery store. To escape an arranged marriage, she accepted a position in an advertising agency, where she met the boss Can Divit, a barouder photographer who had recently returned to the city. Alchemy is immediate, but the obstacles are numerous.

programme.title: A treasure in your home
programme.desc: This program is to estimate your items and then sell them at an auction to get a nice little amount of money.
programme.desc-more: What if a treasure hides in your attic? In each episode, a private individual opens his or her doors, convinced to own a nugget: rare stamps, family jewels, old vase or forgotten old instrument. He entrusts us with the estimate he makes and what he dreams of accomplishing with that sum. Then visit a auctioneer, whose expert verdict sometimes contains cruel disillusionments... or beautiful surprises !!

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: At the end of the 19th century, the Ingalls family moved to Walnut Grove, Minnesota. Charles, the father, worked in various professions to feed his family. Her daughters attend school. There is a rivalry between the Ingalls and Oleson families, especially between the two mothers. A birth is expected in the Ingalls. But tragic events are preparing, which will forever change Walnut Grove's physiognomy. Adapted from Laura Ingalls Wilder's novel, a sentimental evocation of the life of the nineteenth-century American pioneers.
programme.desc-more: After a devastating loss the previous year, Walnut Grove's baseball team was determined to get the lead straight. Nels Oleson, the team's launcher, no longer meeting expectations, raises concern among players and supporters. As the team desperately seeks a replacement capable of restoring hope, the arrival of Mr.Mumfort, a new passionate and experienced coach, turns out to be a boon. With his rigorous method and team spirit, he re-edynamizes the players, instilling strategies and a sense of collective. Young talents, such as Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) and Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson), are beginning to shine under her tutelage. However, the team must also overcome the internal rivalries and tensions that threaten their cohesion. Between intense training and decisive games, Walnut Grove's team must learn to fight together to hope for victory and prove that they can overcome the obstacles of the past.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: At the end of the 19th century, the Ingalls family moved to Walnut Grove, Minnesota. Charles, the father, worked in various professions to feed his family. Her daughters attend school. There is a rivalry between the Ingalls and Oleson families, especially between the two mothers. A birth is expected in the Ingalls. But tragic events are preparing, which will forever change Walnut Grove's physiognomy. Adapted from Laura Ingalls Wilder's novel, a sentimental evocation of the life of the nineteenth-century American pioneers.
programme.desc-more: Driven by a challenge from Nellie Oleson (Alison Arngrim), Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) decided to venture into the isolated house of Mr. Pike (Richard Bull), a hermit whom the rumor presents as a madman. As Laura enters this mysterious place, she discovers an elderly man, haunted by the memory of his late wife, whose loss plunges him into deep melancholy. Mr. Pike, although considered strange by the Walnut Grove residents, reveals to Laura poignant stories about his lost love and the life they shared. As she spends time with him, Laura realizes that true madness may lie in the judgment of others. This encounter upsets his prejudices and allows him to understand the importance of empathy and compassion towards those living in the shadow of their pain. As this adventure unfolds, Laura learns essential life lessons about loss, love and loneliness.

programme.desc-more: In the rural atmosphere of the American Midwest, Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) and her friend Jonah, fearless pioneer children, discover what they believe to be a golden line in an isolated valley. This revelation ignites Laura's imagination, which begins to dream of a life of opulence and comfort, far from the daily struggles that her family endures. The visions of a flamboyant house, luxurious clothes and a carefree life haunt her, while she aspires to make her loved ones discover the pleasures that wealth can bring. However, this golden dream is not without consequences. By stepping in this quest for fortune, Laura and Jonah must navigate through the dangers of greed and disproportionate ambitions. The relationship between friends will be tested, and they will have to learn that true wealth lies not only in gold, but also in the family ties and love that unite them.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Walnut Grove's life continues to evolve. The installation of a banker upsets relations between villagers and fueled many tensions. Without Laura's help, the newcomer is unlikely to be accepted. Walnut Grove's participation in a baseball tournament and Mary's participation in a mathematics contest are also a source of passion. Isaiah Edwards, for his part, is considering getting married. Adapted from Laura Ingalls Wilder's novel, a sentimental evocation of the life of the nineteenth-century American pioneers.
programme.desc-more: In the effervescence of spring, Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) and Grace Snider find themselves facing a dilemma: they have no rider for the long-awaited ball. The preparations are in full swing, but the lack of partners to dance is a source of enthusiasm. While the other girls are walking with their suitors, Grace feels particularly neglected by Mr. Edwards (Richard Bull), who seems to be noticing his efforts to attract his attention. Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), Laura's mother, is watching the situation empathically and decides to intervene. She proposed to Grace a bold strategy to arouse Mr. Edwards' interest: flirting with another young man. This approach could awaken Mr. Edwards' jealousy and push him to realize his feelings for Grace. In an atmosphere of camaraderie and discovery, the two girls embark on this adventure full of promises and twists, revealing the complexities of the emerging love relationships.

The honeymoon of Athena and Bobby, who had sailed on a cruise, quickly turned into a disaster, despite them. Buck's starting a relationship that will allow her to discover a little more. Maddie and Chimney, on the other hand, are preparing to say "yes" to their relatives and colleagues. Harry, Athena's son, returns to Los Angeles, like other people, more or less distant from the different relief workers. As short as the first, this last season sees the series crossing the heading of the 100th episode.
programme.desc-more: Members of the Los Angeles Emergency Response Unit 118 are confronted with chaotic situations and scenarios worthy of action films. This season begins with an unusual incident: a traffic accident results in the release of millions of bees, immerse the city in a real frenzy. Firefighters, first aid workers and other stakeholders must demonstrate cold blood and expertise to deal with this environmental disaster while ensuring the safety of citizens. At the heart of this dynamic, the team must also learn to navigate the organizational transition following the retirement of Captain Bobby Nash. This change brought the new captain, Gerrard, to the fore, whose tyrannical leadership style tested the cohesion and team spirit of the unit 118. Tensions are rising as each member adapts to this new hierarchy while continuing to carry out their crucial work. In parallel to these professional challenges, Bobby finds himself juggling his real responsibilities with his role as technical advisor on the stage of the drama series "Hotshots". This series, which offers a fictional look at the challenges of everyday life in a fire station, will highlight the realities of emergency response.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: After leaving the hospital, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) quickly returned to duty in Special Unit 5-0, where a murder investigation was awaiting them. The case takes an intriguing turn when the victim's body is discovered in the 5-0's premises, raising questions about the team's safety. As they try to solve this mystery, the agents must also work with an MI-6 agent to track down a formidable terrorist, responsible for an attack on the British embassy in Madrid. Barely the case closed, McGarrett and Alicia, a key figure on his team, became targets of a serial killer, who did not hesitate to remove them. Meanwhile, the rest of the team, including members like Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Kim) and Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), is mobilizing to save them, leading to unexpected twists in this season full of action and suspense.
programme.desc-more: Hawaii, famous for its white sand beaches and turquoise waters, also hides dark realities in its sunny climate. The island of paradise has become a playground for criminals, requiring urgent intervention. Lieutenant-Commander Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin), a SEAL of the U.S. Navy Special Forces, is on his way to Hawaii for a personal mission: to investigate the death of his father. However, the Governor of the State sees his presence as a strategic opportunity. McGarrett was convinced to create a special police unit with extensive powers, enabling this team to act unhindered to restore order on the island. McGarrett recruited Daniel Williams (Scott Caan), a former New Jersey policeman, and Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Dae Kim), a veteran of Honolulu police. Next to them is Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), a young recruit who has a fresh degree and an expert in martial arts. Together, they form an elite unit determined to track down and neutralize the criminals who threaten Hawaii's security. Throughout their dangerous missions, McGarrett also received support from Catherine Rollins (Michelle Borth), his girlfriend and lieutenant, adding a personal dimension to his fight against crime.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: In this season's iconic series, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) are called upon to investigate a troubling case involving military veterans engaged to eliminate mafia leaders. In parallel, they meet with Quinn Liu, a sergeant of the military police, whose methodical approach and efficiency quickly impress the team. Recognizing his talent, Steve invited him to join the famous 5-0 group of investigators, thereby strengthening their ability to solve increasingly complex cases, ranging from kidnappings to murders to drug trafficking networks. This tenth season is marked by the return of iconic characters and captivating intrigues, not to mention a long-awaited crossover with "Magnum". Tensions are rising as the team faces ever more dangerous threats while navigating the personal and professional challenges ahead.

Throughout their dangerous missions, McGarrett also received support from Catherine Rollins (Michelle Borth), his girlfriend and lieutenant, adding a personal dimension to his fight against crime.

programme.title: A sweeter Christmas
programme.desc: As they prepare their wedding, Sophie and Sam are so surprised to see their love story adapted to Christmas film! Their small town of Waynesbridge is turning into a filming set, thus upsetting their daily lives. In the spotlight, everyone's expectations and unforeseen events are accumulating, putting their couple seriously to the test. Will they succeed in preserving their love and finally organizing the marriage they dream of?

In the vibrant city of Los Angeles, the 118 relief team, led by Bobby Nash (Peter Krause), are facing increasingly unpredictable and dramatic emergencies. Whether it is a burning airship threatening a crowded stage or the collapse of a conference-hosting structure, each intervention tests not only their professional expertise, but also their personal ties. Meanwhile, Maya (Michelle Hurd) and Bobby have to deal with their new reality at home, while their son Harry is in Miami with Michael (Rockmond Dunbar) and David (Kenneth Choi). The challenges of daily life intertwine with the adrenaline of interventions, revealing the depth of the characters and the sacrifices they make. Over the course of the sixth season, rescuers discover that the real heroism lies as much in the action as in the management of the emotional crises that affect them outside of their work.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: Beverly Hills 3 cop
programme.desc: In this new adventure Axel Foley (Eddie Murphy) will lead the investigation in the famous Wonderworld amusement park in Beverly Hills. He is looking for the dangerous sponsor of a gang of car thieves responsible for the death of his friend Todd (Gilbert R. Hill).

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: L'Hérault, in the south of France. A department near the Spanish border that smells good on holiday but not for everyone. Brackets, assaults, or insanity. programme.title: XXL works : swimming pools and lagoons
programme.desc: The Diffazur family-owned company has revolutionized the pool market in France for nearly 50 years and is now the European leader in the creation of reinforced concrete pools. His team of experts is ingenuity-based to realize the most incredible and unexpected wishes of their clients everywhere in France. A new XXL challenge awaits the team in the Pyrenees where the customer wants a real lagoon to appear on his property. The project is expected to be a titanic project, everything must be done perfectly to ensure the success of this project.

programme.title: XXL works : swimming pools and lagoons
programme.sub-title: Submerged beach sea view on the French Riviera
programme.desc: The Diffazur family-owned company has been revolutionizing the pool market in France for nearly 50 years. The team is back in the south of France, with a project that will require a lot of work and ingenuity. The customer of the day wishes a swimming pool that gives the appearance of having a beach immersed in his garden. The constraints are numerous in order to be able to make a quality trompe l'oeil, especially since the pool must be positioned so as to have a view of the sea and therefore create a perfect illusion.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As the group dynamics evolve within the group of friends, the female presence is increasing around Leonard (Johnny Galecki), Sheldon (Jim Parsons), Howard (Simon Helberg) and Raj (Kunal Nayyar). At the same time, Howard is preparing for a major turning point in his life, with the wedding on the horizon and expedition projects to the international space station. This fifth season promises many twists and hilarious tensions within this iconic group.

programme.title: Full eyes
programme.desc: After more than twenty years of absence, "Full eyes" makes its great return. Carole Rousseau and Jacques Legros take over the show in an atmosphere that is both complicit and nibbling. On the agenda of this return, stories are absolutely crazy and strong in emotions: a ride that breaks in half, a truck suspended over the void, a woman stuck in her cabin or a paratrooper who is the victim of an epilepsy attack and who faints in the middle of the flight. Specialists are taking part in answering questions raised by these images. The program also evolves with time thanks to a new section: "False or Real?". In this sequence, the team decrypts impressive videos that circulate on social networks to determine whether they are genuine or the fruit of artificial intelligence.

The customer of the day wishes a swimming pool that gives the appearance of having a beach immersed in his garden. The constraints are numerous in order to be able to make a quality trompe l'oeil, especially since the pool must be positioned so as to have a view of the sea and therefore create a perfect illusion.

programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: Andrea, Manusch and their two children did not hesitate to transport their camper to the other side of the world. programme.desc-more: Because he's bored in hell, Lucifer leaves everything, quits and opens a nightclub in Los Angeles. This adaptation of a comic book plays on the codes of the fantastic and the policeman, without omitting the register of seduction.

programme.title: Alcatraz: Hell Prison
programme.desc: Focus on the most spectacular escape attempts at Alcatraz Prison, perched on a isolated rock in the middle of San Francisco Bay.
programme.desc-more: Alcatraz Prison has locked the worst criminals in US history in prison conditions that some have described as inhuman. Perched on an isolated rock in the middle of San Francisco Bay, it was designed to make escape impossible. Yet, in twenty-nine years of service, 36 inmates tried their luck, in fourteen attempts. Twenty-three were caught, six were shot, seven drowned or disappeared at sea. Not a single one has reached the coast, two and a half kilometers away. Thanks to re-enactments, unpublished archival images and expert testimony, this documentary traces the most spectacular attempts on the island, from secretly dug walls to complicity from outside.

programme.title: Attentate of Charlie Hebdo, 10 years old: terror in Paris
programme.desc: In 2015, from the killing of Charlie Hebdo to the massacres of the coffee terraces and the Bataclan, France was hit by a wave of attacks. These attacks, perpetrated by the jihadists of Al-Quaida and Daesh, plunge the nation into blood, fear and grief. The authorities knew the imminent threat, but the police and intelligence services could not defeat it. President François Hollande confides in how he experienced the trial of power in the face of this violence. Bernard Cazenuve, Anne Hidalgo, the prosecutor François Molins, as well as General Denis Favier and Jean-Michel Fauvergue, the boss of RAID, mix their voices with the testimonies of the victims of Islamist fanaticism.

programme.title: Attacks of 13 November 2015: the heroes of chaos
programme.desc: Ten years after the November 13 attacks, the first responders testify. Police, firefighters and doctors tell of the vital urgency and chaos of this night of horror. They entered the carnage scene, until Bataclan, rescued the victims and secured the scene, often without preparation. Their stories reveal the heroism of these anonymous people and the indelible imprint left on their lives.

programme.title: September 11, 2001: the day when everything changed
programme.desc: Using testimonies from those on the scene this day of 2001, a detailed review of the attacks of 11 September. In what is considered the largest terrorist attack in the history of the United States, four regular aircraft were hijacked to crash on symbolic buildings in the country, including the World Trade Center in New York. A precise reconstruction of events and relevant interventions will help to better understand the mechanisms that came into play on this day that marks the history of the United States.

programme.title: September 11th, seen from the World Trade Center, witnesses of chaos
programme.desc: On September 11, 2001, American Airlines 11 struck the North Tower of the World Trade Center, just a few moments later, United Airlines 175 struck the South Tower. The glass washers, bank employees, security guards and rescue workers, who were inside, tell us what they saw, heard, and how they came out. Six hundred and thirty-seven people remained trapped. That morning, 17,400 people were present in both towers, nearly nine out of ten managed to get out of them. The attacks killed 2,977 people, including 343 firefighters in New York City.

programme.title: The wrath of the Titans
programme.desc: To avenge the massacre of his adoptive family, Perseus, a half-god, takes the lead of a troop of warriors and embarks on a journey into the depths of the forbidden worlds: universes populated by demons, ferocious beasts and monsters. To survive, he will have to accept his destiny and divine nature...
programme.desc-more: Ten years after triumphing over the fearsome Kraken and saving the city of Argos, Perseus (Sam Worthington) turned his back on his divine heritage. Living as a humble fisherman, he tries to escape the shadow of his past, while raising his son alone. But the gods did not forget its existence. While the balance of power on the Olympic wave, Hades (Ralph Fiennes), thirsty for domination, orchestrate a bold blow: he captures Zeus (Liam Neeson), the king of the gods, and locks him in the depths of the Hells. Deprived of its protection, the world of mortals finds itself at the mercy of chaos, and the signs of divine anger are multiplying. The oceans are unleashing, the earth is shaking, and the legendary creatures, freed from their chains, are sowing terror. For Perseus, the retirement time is over. Forced to take up arms, he must face not only Hades forces, but also his own demons.

programme.title: The Titans' Shock
programme.desc: Perseus (Sam Worthington), a young man raised by a couple of fishermen, has long lived away from the conflicts between gods and mortals. His peaceful life was brutally interrupted when Hades (Ralph Fiennes), the god of Hell, attacked his home, killing his adoptive parents in front of him. This tragedy leaves Perseus deeply marked, driven by a desire for revenge against those who devastated his existence. Captured and brought to Argos, Perseus discovered a disturbing secret: he was in reality the son of Zeus (Liam Neeson), which propel him to the heart of an unlikely heroic destiny. While Hades, eager for power, demanded the sacrifice of the beautiful Andromeda (Alexa Davalos) to appease the gods, Perseus was entrusted with a quest of an epic scale. To save the princess and subdue the dark forces that threaten her kingdom, he must bring together a team of fearless warriors. During this perilous adventure, he confronts formidable mythological creatures and gradually discovers his own divine powers. As he navigates between courage and fear, Perseus must learn to embrace his divine heritage and overcome which could prevent him from fulfilling his destiny. In this confrontation between light and darkness, every decision he makes will have decisive consequences for the future of mortals and gods.

programme.title: The Odyssey of Ulysses, the first hero
programme.desc: Far from the invincible half-god, Ulysses is a deceitful man and a very modest king. After the terrible Trojan war, he began a journey of endless return. For ten years he was wandering, and faced terrifying monsters, witches, and capricious gods. But in this odyssey, it is his trick that triumphs over the brute force to find Penelope and Telemaque in Ithaca.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As the group dynamics evolve within the group of friends, the female presence is increasing around Leonard (Johnny Galecki), Sheldon (Jim Parsons), Howard (Simon Helberg) and Raj (Kunal Nayyar). The relationship between Penny (Kaley Cuoco) and Leonard gets more complicated after Penny shared one night with Raj, while Leonard is going through a difficult breakup with Priya. This tumultuous emotional context raises questions about the possibility of a reconciliation between Leonard and Penny. Amy (Mayim Bialik) is eager to advance her platonic relationship with Sheldon, seeking to push him to explore a more intimate connection, which exacerbates Sheldon's associative traits. At the same time, Howard is preparing for a major turning point in his life, with the wedding on the horizon and expedition projects to the international space station. This fifth season promises many twists and hilarious tensions within this iconic group.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: In this sixth season of the iconic series, Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) is on board the International Space Station, a unique experience that puts his ties with his friends to the test. Meanwhile, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) takes advantage of his relationship with Penny (Kaley Cuoco), but he cannot help feeling a growing insecurity in the face of their love. On campus, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) hired a new assistant, triggering the jealousy of Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), who was stepping up his efforts to prove his worth. The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.

programme.title: Neighbors' War: My Life Is Hell
programme.desc: In Blois, Marie has been living a nightmare since her neighbour arrived. A simple hedge that goes beyond the sidewalk has triggered an open war. For the past four years, tensions have been linked: insults, projectiles, threats. In Paris, Zahra and her neighbour are at war. Racist insults, provocations, harassment: each accuses the other and the conflict becomes impossible to calm. In Rueil-Malmaison, Vera has been fighting for years against her neighbours, whom she accuses of being responsible for water infiltrations that threaten her home. Despite her efforts to the town hall and the police, she said she was living in permanent danger. In Belgium, a century-old tree is at the heart of a dispute between neighbours who have lived in good harmony for more than twenty years.

programme.title: Neighbors' War: My Life Is Hell
programme.desc: Violence, insults, broken dialogue: a close-up is made on neighbours who rot their lives and between whom the dialogue is completely broken. Although they have always existed, since the health crisis and the establishment of telework, complaints related to the neighbourhood have increased by 60% according to the CGL, the general confederation of housing. A road that is not very easy, a heat pump too noisy, the noises of children: all these issues of discord in the heart of the daily lives of the neighbours who can no longer live together. Between physical and verbal violence, the neighbourhood disputes are settled with the help of a mediator. Others can go to the courts.

programme.title: Neighbors' War: My Life Is Hell
programme.desc: Close to Grenoble, Claude sees his dream of a peaceful retreat flying in bursts because of a right of way. Since a violent altercation, the dialogue with its neighbours has been broken. In Belgium, Marjorie and Cyril have been fighting their neighbour for only dead leaves for eight years. Between surveillance cameras and complaints, the conflict has grown in size. Noise can poison life too. In Chauray, near Niort, Pascale claims to be subjected every day to the noise of the neighbouring family, and fights to regain calm. In Franche-Comté, Pascal and Brigitte have lived for fourteen years in front of an abandoned crane which they fear will collapse, while its owner remains unreachable. Investigation into these conflicts that turn the neighbourhood into hell.

programme.title: Neighbors' War: My Life Is Hell
programme.desc: Directions the North of France, at the meeting of Betty and Grégory, a couple who give a poignant testimony after being forced to leave his house following the threats of a violent neighbour. In Calais, the inhabitants of a subdivision are at the end of their nerves, exhausted by the nuisance caused by a road transport company which recently settled near their homes. In Marseille, the owners of a student residence are struggling to try to expel squatters who have elected domicile in the building.

programme.title: Neighbors' War: My Life Is Hell
programme.desc: The neighbourhood can become a source of conflict and daily life can turn into a nightmare. Close to Carcassonne, Sébastien is not sleeping. Under his windows, he lives a cock singing all night and he is forced to sue his neighbors to hope he can sleep. In Brittany, Alex and Marlene owners of a crepery are in conflict with their neighbour who complains about the smells and will have to defend himself before a judge. In the Vaucluse, Annick and Guy want to save their hundred-year-old oak that their neighbor would like to see killed.

programme.title: Private investigations: their online investigations
programme.sub-title: Insurance fraud, fraud and theft: private detective profession
programme.desc: A specialist in health insurance crooks, Bruno Hecquet, in northern France, is on the trail of a woman who would simulate a disability. Bruno Boivin and Codiv's limiers track stolen vehicles, and take all the risks in real chase races throughout Île-de-France. In Marseille, Bastien is in the footsteps of Xavier Dupont de Ligonnes, the most famous French fugitive. Finally, in southwestern France, Luc le cadre is doing everything to resolve a violent neighbourhood conflict.

programme.title: Night programmes
programme.desc: Every week, David Chaignon and his team go on the ground to meet passionate people, both in France and abroad. It offers a travelling program that sheds light on the latest cynégetic and fisheries, is interested in techniques in vogue, the regulations in force, new materials...

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), a young prodigy with unparalleled scientific talents, faces challenges that are far more complex than those of his equations. At only 9 years old, her parents, Mary (Zoe Perry) and George (Lance Barber), made the bold decision to enrol her in high school to provide her with an education that was commensurate with her exceptional intelligence. However, this transition turns out to be a real journey for the fighter. From her first day, Sheldon faced the misunderstanding and rejection of her classmates, who failed to grasp her genius or her unconventional manners. Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.
programme.desc-more: In the deep America of the 1990s, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) grew like a living riddle. At only nine years old, this prodigy to stratospheric IQs and in ways as rigid as its meal schedules amazes the Texas landscape of his native city. Between his complex equations scratched on improvised black paintings and his inability to understand the most basic social codes, the young boy embodies a permanent challenge for his entourage. At the heart of this intellectual storm is the Cooper family, as warm as they are uncharted. Mary (Zoe Perry), her godly and loving mother, oscillates between pride and exasperation in the face of this son who questions the Bible with the same rigour as the laws of physics. George Sr. (Lance Barber), his father football coach, desperately tries to instill in him the virile values of Texas, without success. Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), a young prodigy with unparalleled scientific talents, faces challenges that are far more complex than those of his equations. programme.title: XXL works : swimming pools and lagoons
programme.desc: Diffazur is a company capable of shaping custom creations for its customers throughout France thanks to a projected concrete system. The company's team is heading for southern France, more precisely in Provence, for the realization of a project that is literally out of the ordinary. The new owner of a sumptuous and spectacular house built on a hill wants a swimming pool just as unusual. The head of the agency and his two employees will face unimaginable challenges, between the risk of collapse of the terrace and the need to bring construction equipment by air.

programme.title: XXL works : swimming pools and lagoons
programme.desc: Diffazur is one of the largest French builder of free-form swimming pools. The company is able to shape custom creations for its customers throughout France thanks to a particular system of concrete projected. In this episode, the Diffazur team in Montpellier will take care of the project of a young couple: Claire and Leo. They decided three years ago to renovate an old swimming pool on their property, but it went very badly. So they called a team of renowned professionals to find a solution to finally get the pool of their dream.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As the group dynamics evolve within the group of friends, the female presence is increasing around Leonard (Johnny Galecki), Sheldon (Jim Parsons), Howard (Simon Helberg) and Raj (Kunal Nayyar). The relationship between Penny (Kaley Cuoco) and Leonard gets more complicated after Penny shared one night with Raj, while Leonard is going through a difficult breakup with Priya. This tumultuous emotional context raises questions about the possibility of a reconciliation between Leonard and Penny. Amy (Mayim Bialik) is eager to advance her platonic relationship with Sheldon, seeking to push him to explore a more intimate connection, which exacerbates Sheldon's associative traits. At the same time, Howard is preparing for a major turning point in his life, with the wedding on the horizon and expedition projects to the international space station. This fifth season promises many twists and hilarious tensions within this iconic group.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: In this sixth season of the iconic series, Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) is on board the International Space Station, a unique experience that puts his ties with his friends to the test. Meanwhile, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) takes advantage of his relationship with Penny (Kaley Cuoco), but he cannot help feeling a growing insecurity in the face of their love. On campus, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) hired a new assistant, triggering the jealousy of Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), who was stepping up his efforts to prove his worth. The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.

programme.title: Lagoon Master
programme.desc: The designer of extraordinary pools and pools Lucas Congdon and his entire team are in Florida to build a pond that will house koi carps: but rather than stay there, they transform the old family pool into a paradisiac lagoon that communicates with the pond. programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Once again, the stormy relations between Penny and Leonard caused the rupture. Penny is now dating Zack, a character who can't hide his contempt for his geek friends. programme.sub-title: The rapist of the forest of Senart
programme.desc: Between 1995 and 2000, in the forest of Senart, nearly 30 women were attacked by a man, a methodical predator who beat his victims before sexually assaulting them and then fleeing. In 2015, advances in genetics allowed us to put a name on the attacker.
programme.desc-more: Between 1995 and 2000, in the forest of Senart, nearly 30 women were attacked by a man, a methodical predator who beat his victims before sexually assaulting them and then fleeing. A soft voice, a full helmet and a scooter: the police have only these meagre clues to identify the suspect. The attacks ceased in 2000, but the case was never forgotten. In 2015, advances in genetics allowed us to put a name on the attacker. Aïssa Zerouati, from a family of Corbeil-Essonnes, not far from the forest, was about twenty years old at the time of the events. He was married and temporarily arrested in Roubaix.

Merging both to create a unique SL 55 AMG Lorinser, more valuable on the market.This luxury roadster, in a rough version designed to swallow asphalt in royal comfort, hides serious problems.

programme.title: Vintage Mechanical
programme.desc: Baptiste takes up one of the most daring challenges of "Vintage Mechanical": restore a Maserati 3200 GT, the mythical Italian coupe cut for performance. Baptiste will have to complete a complete repair of the engine, establish a precise inventory of each recoverable part, control the two turbos, and also the distribution and clutch that will have to be combed finely.

programme.title: Auschwitz, the Nazi death machine
programme.desc: 77 years ago, in southern Poland, the doors of the Auschwitz death camp finally opened and freed the survivors of this monumental tragedy. This concentration and extermination camp, which welcomed 1,100,000 Jews from all over Europe, is the most deadly of all the machination of the Nazi final solution. A terrible investigation into the vastest concentration complex and Nazi extermination, which became the universal symbol of the Shoah.

programme.title: Mauthausen, the camp of horror
programme.desc: The final Nazi solution was a monstrous complex strategy. Concentrationary and extermination camps were at the heart of this macabre machination. Auschwitz is of course the most sadly known, but in its shadow, the Mauthausen camp has nothing envied it. Created in the middle of Austria in 1938, it grew steadily during the war with its 40 satellite camps scattered across the country. Investigation into the secrets of the worst concentration camps in the Third Reich.

programme.title: Survey of the lost camps of the Third Reich
programme.desc: Wherever the Nazi army has passed, camps have been set up in all the occupied countries, creating large-scale construction projects. Thanks to the work of researchers and 3D reconstructions, local historians are bringing back the history of these forgotten camps and revealing the hell behind these postcard images.

programme.title: 11 September, the day the world turned
programme.desc: Twenty-five years ago, a hundred and two minutes ago, the world changed: the interval between the first impact of an aircraft in the North Tower of the World Trade Center at 8:46 a.m. on September 11, 2001, and its collapse at 10:28 a.m. Four hijacked planes hit America: one tower, then the other, and then the Pentagon in Washington. Twenty-five years later, passenger calls, fire brigade radios, field images and the National Commission's investigation of the attacks allowed for a little bit of a story. Reconstitutions and direct testimony are returning today. Among them, David Pujadas, presenter of the French newspaper 2 on that day, Ali Soufan, former FBI agent, John McLaughlin, former CIA deputy director, among others.

programme.desc: Ten years after the November 13 attacks, the first responders testify. Police, firefighters and doctors tell of the vital urgency and chaos of this night of horror. programme.title: From Charlie Hebdo to Bataclan, the latest secrets of the 2015 attacks
programme.desc: In 2015, from the killing of Charlie Hebdo to the massacres of the coffee terraces and the Bataclan, France was hit by a wave of attacks. These attacks, perpetrated by the jihadists of Al-Quaida and Daesh, plunge the nation into blood, fear and grief. They are announced as reprisals for provocations against Islam and its prophet and as revenge for France's policy against terrorist groups. The authorities knew the imminent threat, but the police and intelligence services could not defeat it. President François Hollande confides in how he experienced the trial of power in the face of this violence.

programme.title: King Arthur: The Truth Behind the Legend
programme.desc: King Arthur, a mythical figure guided by Merlin and surrounded by the preux knights of the Round Table, has been a fascination for centuries. From the quest for the Grail to the betrayals of Lancelot and Mordred, his story is legendary. But did this great ruler really exist? This historical investigation crosses England from Tintagel to Glastonbury, to explore the mysteries of its origins.

programme.title: The Odyssey of Ulysses, the first hero
programme.desc: Far from the invincible half-god, Ulysses is a deceitful man and a very modest king. After the terrible Trojan war, he began a journey of endless return. For ten years he was wandering, and faced terrifying monsters, witches, and capricious gods. But in this odyssey, it is his trick that triumphs over the brute force to find Penelope and Telemaque in Ithaca.

programme.title: Did the city of Troy really exist?
programme.desc: In view of the accuracy of Homer's accounts, the Iliad and the Odyssey, adventurers and archaeologists sought to know whether the poet had drawn inspiration from real places and facts. For more than 150 years, excavations in Turkey on Hisarlik Hill have been retracing the fate of a missing city, occupied for more than three thousand years. Is this Troy? Thanks to re-enactments, unpublished archive images and expert assistance, this documentary deciphers the text of the Iliad. He notes the clues that Homer left on the description and location of the city, and follows those who went to search for it.

programme.title: A guy, a girl
programme.desc: John and Alex are in bad faith, they're fighting, they're getting provoked. They're arrogant, selfish, greedy and jealous. But first, they love each other!
programme.desc-more: In a Parisian apartment where the disputes are as fast as the bursts of laughter, vibrate a thirty-year-old couple as fond as it is exasperating: Jean (Jean Dujardin), nicknamed Loulou by the one who shares her daily life, and Alexandra (Alexandra Lamy), affectionately called Chouchou. He, a seducer clumsy with the great principles but with the little cowardice, she, an independent woman with a well-drained character, forms an explosive duo where love is measured in existential crises and improvised reconciliations. Between the walls of their housing – a battlefield of battle and tenderness at the same time – is a human comedy where the daily hassles become mountains to climb... or to bypass with a pirouette. Chouchou and Loulou, it's the story of two egos who fight, seek and find each other, tirelessly. He dreams of greatness but drowns in details (how to fold a road map without tearing it apart?), she manages their lives with a pragmatism that friezes despotism (the socks that drag are a crime against humanity). Between forgotten races, romantic dinners that turn to the rules of accounts, and friends who always arrive at the wrong time, their relationship is a constant balance between the desire to break everything and the desire to repair everything with a hug. Yet behind the arguments for a poorly closed pot lid or a lost remote control, there is an unwavering complicity. Whether it is in the face of the intrusive mother-in-law, the insufferable office colleagues, or the temptations of infidelity that point their noses, Chouchou and Loulou navigate between nerve attacks and crazy laughs, proving that love is also a laugh of his own faults. For in the background, despite the low blows and the unsaid, one question persists: how can we stay together when we are both the best and the worst that can happen to each other?

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Roland Bondonny, the mystery of blue meatballs
programme.desc: On 25 August 2004, Marius Lac was found murdered in Corrèze. Three years earlier, he had testified in a case of dog poisoning. On 14 February 2001, the notable Roland Bondonny was arrested and sentenced to two years in prison, one of which was suspended. He had appealed. Shortly before the date of this second trial, Marius Lac was murdered.
programme.desc-more: On 25 August 2004, Marius Lac, a retired police officer, was murdered at his home in Corrèze. The man had witnessed the prosecution in the trial of Roland Bondonny, a notable sentenced to one year in prison for poisoning more than a hundred dogs and cats. This murder occurred shortly before Bondonny's appeal trial was opened. In Fourmies, in the North, the gendarmes discover that Alain Bodchon knows Roland Bondonny. On 19 October 2004, Bodchon and Bondonny were arrested. Bodchon confesses to killing Marius Lake at Bondonny's request.

programme.sub-title: On the road to mass killers
programme.desc: In criminology, "mass killers" are not "serial killers". They are distinguished from this, by the fact that they commit at least four murders in a single behavioral sequence, in a unit of place and time. While the United States remains the country most affected by this phenomenon in the world, French justice has also had to investigate and try such cases. Investigation into the killing of Luxiol in 1989 and the killing of Nanterre in 2002.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: On 19 April 2008, the Swedish student Suzanna Zetterberg's body was burned and sifted with bullets. In a few hours, the PJ manages to identify a suspect who withdraws money with Suzanna's credit card. Bruno Cholet, 51, known for illegally taking passengers on his fake taxi, has already spent half his life in prison.
programme.desc-more: On 19 April 2008, Susanna Zetterberg, a 19-year-old Swedish student, went to a nightclub in the 1st arrondissement of Paris, La Scala, with friends. At about 4:30, the girl left the discotheque. Nobody ever saw him again. His calcined body was discovered shortly after in Chantilly Forest, in the Oise. Shot by video surveillance cameras, a few kilometres from the crime scene, a man is being arrested by the police. Bruno Cholet, 51, a illegal taxi driver, already known to the police.
