programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Ponce Gaudissard, the mysteries of Meyrargues
programme.desc: On 31 March 2003, Chantal d'Amato and Audrey, her daughter, were brutally murdered in their house. But the DNA traces found at the crime scene are no match for anyone. Ponce Gaudissard, a repeat rapist, is a police officer who is caught in the act of sexual assault near Aix-en-Provence.
programme.desc-more: On 31 March 2003, in Meyragues, not far from Aix-en-Provence, Chantal d'Amato and his daughter Audrey, 24, were both absent from their work. Alerted, the gendarmes found their house closed, the shutters lowered. But smoke comes out of a window. Inside, the two women are discovered bent and tied. They were slit, and Audrey, who seemed to be the pincipal target, received 29 stab wounds. Despite traces of DNA discovered on site, the investigation is trampling until the name of Ponce Gaudissard appears.

programme.title: Inside Center Parks: holidays all year round
programme.desc: Immersion behind the scenes of the Bois aux Daims site to discover the secrets of Center Parcs, a brand whose success lasts despite an ever stronger competition.
programme.desc-more: More than thirty years after the opening of the first Parks Center in France, this concept halfway between the holiday village and the leisure park continues to seduce as much. With hundreds of identical houses scattered under the trees, its supermarket, swimming pool and restaurants, the ensemble gives the visitor the strange feeling of diving in a fictional setting, a "bulle" that would simulate an ideal city, where children travel freely, in a reassuring and domesticated nature. Discover the secrets of the brand's success.

programme.title: Futuroscope: the techno of attractions
programme.desc: In recent years, Futuroscope has invested 300 million euros to create new attractions including an aquatic park that will open in early July 2024.
programme.desc-more: Futuroscope is the fourth most visited amusement park in France. In 1987 he opened in Vienna with the aim of becoming the window of the future. With 25 avant-garde buildings, it offers highly innovative, image-based attractions that succeed in transmitting scientific concepts in an educational and fun way. In recent years, the Futuroscope has taken a new turn, investing in creating new and revolutionary attractions, including an aquatic park. Discover behind the scenes of this huge futuristic machine.

programme.title: Puy du Fou: the genius of the shows revealed
programme.desc: The Puy du Fou has been able to conquer the hearts in 45 years thanks in part to the engineering treasures deployed to ensure the reliability and robustness of the attractions.
programme.desc-more: For 45 years, Le Puy du Fou conquered the hearts of the French. The world's best-known park in 2012 and 2014 in the United States, this amusement park sees its visitors grow every year. With a new park in Spain, shows in Holland and soon in the United States, it becomes international. Behind these stories developed by the Puy du Fou, which seduce thanks to the emotions they convey, are a whole team of the best talents of the industries concerned to perform the shows.

programme.title: Puy du Fou : the 10 most innovative technos in the park
programme.desc: A focus on the ten most innovative technologies of the Puy du Fou Park, which attracts ever more visitors each year thanks to these prowess.
programme.desc-more: The Puy du Fou attracts an ever-increasing audience every year. While visitors come for historical stories and epic frescoes, the park's success is also based on a particularly elaborate technical mechanics. Behind the stage, teams of engineers and technicians design complex devices, designed to make illusion possible. Each element must combine safety, reliability and fluidity, while remaining invisible to the public. With images shot behind the scenes, in the basement and in the technical corridors, complemented by 3D models, this unpublished documentary reveals, for the first time, the ten most innovative technologies in the park.

programme.title: A guy, a girl
programme.desc: John and Alex are in bad faith, they're fighting, they're getting provoked. They're arrogant, selfish, greedy and jealous. But first, they love each other!
programme.desc-more: In a Parisian apartment where the disputes are as fast as the bursts of laughter, vibrate a thirty-year-old couple as fond as it is exasperating: Jean (Jean Dujardin), nicknamed Loulou by the one who shares her daily life, and Alexandra (Alexandra Lamy), affectionately called Chouchou. He, a seducer clumsy with the great principles but with the little cowardice, she, an independent woman with a well-drained character, forms an explosive duo where love is measured in existential crises and improvised reconciliations. Between the walls of their housing – a battlefield of battle and tenderness at the same time – is a human comedy where the daily hassles become mountains to climb... or to bypass with a pirouette. Chouchou and Loulou, it's the story of two egos who fight, seek and find each other, tirelessly. He dreams of greatness but drowns in details (how to fold a road map without tearing it apart?), she manages their lives with a pragmatism that friezes despotism (the socks that drag are a crime against humanity). Between forgotten races, romantic dinners that turn to the rules of accounts, and friends who always arrive at the wrong time, their relationship is a constant balance between the desire to break everything and the desire to repair everything with a hug. Yet behind the arguments for a poorly closed pot lid or a lost remote control, there is an unwavering complicity. Whether it is in the face of the intrusive mother-in-law, the insufferable office colleagues, or the temptations of infidelity that point their noses, Chouchou and Loulou navigate between nerve attacks and crazy laughs, proving that love is also a laugh of his own faults. For in the background, despite the low blows and the unsaid, one question persists: how can we stay together when we are both the best and the worst that can happen to each other?

programme.title: A candlelit Christmas
programme.desc: A woman joins a seductive shopkeeper in creating Christmas candles, despite their opposite visions. She's looking for a promotion, hoping to fund her daughter's dream.
programme.desc-more: As the end of the year approaches, Juliet, an ambitious wellness expert, finally sees the opportunity to make her talent recognized. His idea? Launch an exclusive range of Christmas souvenir candles, olfactory creations supposed to capture the magic of festive moments and move the most hardened hearts. For her, this project is not only a question of creativity, but a chance to get the much-awaited promotion in her company. Yet his enthusiasm is quickly met with a major obstacle: Tom, the owner of a small craft candle shop, as talented as he is skeptical. For him, the welfare industry is just an illusion machine, and he categorically refuses to collaborate on what he considers to be a marketing operation that is devoid of sincerity. But Tom is hiding a secret that could make things go wrong. Behind his apparent coldness is a father ready to do anything to fulfill his daughter's Christmas vow. When he realizes that the income generated by this project could offer him this opportunity, he reluctantly accepts to associate with Juliet.

programme.title: The Christmas parade
programme.desc: A young boy and his mother are trying to revive an old local train party. The teacher who helps them hides the truth about his mysterious interruption.
programme.desc-more: Charlotte, a single mother who is busy between her work and her son's education, Benny, a ten-year-old boy as dreaming as she is determined, tries to make ends meet. Since her husband's disappearance, the end-of-year celebrations have lost their shine, and Christmas is more than a succession of mechanical gestures, without this spark that once made the eyes of the inhabitants shine. Everything changes when Benny discovers, in an old dusty grimoire found in the attic, the existence of a forgotten tradition: the Christmas train, an enchanted railway parade that, decades earlier, brought together the families of Pine Ridge and neighbouring villages. The ancient accounts describe a luminous procession, where the decorated cars ran to the sound of the songs, distributing gifts and spreading joy throughout the county. Fascinated, Benny persuades her mother to revive this magic that disappeared. Despite her reluctance – and a budget more than limited – Charlotte is convinced, touched by her son's enthusiasm and hope to reconnect with the spirit of the holidays. To carry out this ambitious project, they turn to Benny's professor Zack, a charismatic and mysterious man who seems to share their passion for the d Under his leadership, the project takes shape: the inhabitants are mobilizing, the scenery is coming out of the boxes, and the old train, abandoned for years, is being rehabilitated. Charlotte, who begins to fall under Zack's charm, sees him as an unexpected ally, perhaps even a chance to rebuild his sentimental life. But as the preparations are in full swing, she discovers that Zack is hiding a secret.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Thierry Paulin, the killer of old ladies
programme.desc: In October and November 1984, eight elderly ladies were tortured and killed at home in the 18th arrondissement in Paris. The motive: rob them of their meagre savings. Then, from December 1985 to June 1986, eleven other women were facing the same fate. After a lull, the black series resumed in 1987, but a victim then gave the police the report. Paulin, homosexual, is arrested.
programme.desc-more: In October and November 1984, eight elderly women were tortured and killed at home in the 18th arrondissement in Paris. The motive: rob them of their meagre savings. Then, from December 1985 to June 1986, eleven other women had the same fate. After a lull, the black series resumed in 1987, but a victim then gave the police the report. Paulin, a homosexual, figure of the Parisian night, is arrested and imprisoned but will never be tried. He was hit by AIDS and died in Fleury Mérogis in 1989. Divisional commissioner Bernard Laithier, Commissioner Jacob, witnesses and politicians are referring to this case.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: In 2002, François Besse, once again on the bench of the accused, was sentenced to eight years in prison. The requisite may seem surprising for this multi-recidivist escape. Jacques Mesrine's former right-hand man had indeed been sentenced to death in the 1970s. Since then, his career has been limited to a series of incarcerations and escapes from France's most famous prisons.
programme.desc-more: In 2002, François Besse was sentenced to eight years in prison by the Paris Assize Court, but was sentenced to death in absentia in the 1970s. The "bandit d'honneur" was also the king of escape, and the specialist in robbery and hostage-taking. No wall resisted François Besse, not even those in the high-security neighbourhoods!

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: On Saturday, February 26, 2005, Ludovic Chabé discovered his dead wife on the tile of the living room, a scarf tight around her neck. The house was locked from the inside; There was no break-in. The victim's lover, and then her husband, are very soon suspected.
programme.desc-more: In February 2005, Françoise Chabé was discovered by her husband, who died in the living room, strangled by his scarf, the swollen face. No break-in is found and the house is closed from the inside. The gendarmes suspect first one of her colleagues with whom she would have had an affair, but very soon they turn to the husband, Ludovic. Eight years later, only one person is in the accused's box. Who's the real culprit? The lover or the husband? And what is the motive for the crime? Will the truth come out of the trial?

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: The Konhu brothers, the Kanumera rock
programme.desc: Mika Kusama was alone, discovering one of the most beautiful bays in the world in New Caledonia. In May 2002, the body of this Japanese tourist was found on the rock of Kanumera, calcined, partially bare. That rock was a taboo place. No one could set foot in it, except for the Konhu family.
programme.desc-more: On 6 May 2002, Mika Kusama, a Japanese tourist, was found on the island of Pines in New Caledonia. The young woman is disfigured, calcined and her body is hidden under stones and gills. Soon, investigators were interested in the two Konhu brothers, who owned the land where the Kanumera rock was located, where the victim was found. Didyme and Antoine are the only people who can drive tourists on this famous rock. Already known to the gendarmerie, the two brothers quickly appear as ideal suspects.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Sophie Masala, the dismemberer of the canal
programme.desc: In Toulouse, in May 2016, Sophie Masala killed her colleague Maryline Planche before dismembering her and dispersing her remains in the Canal du Midi. In 2019, the five-year-old, a mother, was sentenced to 27 years of criminal imprisonment.
programme.desc-more: At the end of May 2016, a passerby walks along the banks of the Canal du Midi in Toulouse when his gaze is attracted by a floating object that seems to look like a human leg. The law enforcement officers, who were alarmed, sounded the waters of the city and discovered other members within two days, and then the trunk of a woman hidden in a suitcase. On 27 May, Sophie Masala was arrested, suspected of the murder of Maryline Planche, a co-worker. The last piece of the macabre puzzle is found quickly upon the suspect's indication, buried in a garden close to her home.

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: The mother of a young man who died in 1978 came to Lilly: she found a letter that might indicate that her son was not killed by chance.
programme.desc-more: Lilly Rush (Kathryn Morris), a detective in a special police unit, is dedicated to reopening unsolved old investigations, called "cold cases". His commitment led him to reopen the affair of the mysterious death of his great-grandmother, which occurred in 1929. In parallel, Lilly discovered new evidence in a case of underage violence dating back to 1965, as well as the apparently inexplicable suicide of a teenager in 1994. Through these investigations, Lilly navigates a complex world of family emotions and secrets, while encircling a diverse team, including Kat Miller (Tracie Thoms), a novice but full of potential. This team dynamic is reinforced when Kat helped solve the murder of a Vietnam veteran in 1973. Each episode reveals buried truths, while exploring the lasting impact of unresolved crimes on victims and their loved ones, capturing the essence of the need for justice.

programme.title: A guy, a girl
programme.desc: John and Alex are in bad faith, they're fighting, they're getting provoked. They're arrogant, selfish, greedy and jealous. But first, they love each other!
programme.desc-more: In a Parisian apartment where the disputes are as fast as the bursts of laughter, vibrate a thirty-year-old couple as fond as it is exasperating: Jean (Jean Dujardin), nicknamed Loulou by the one who shares her daily life, and Alexandra (Alexandra Lamy), affectionately called Chouchou. He, a seducer clumsy with the great principles but with the little cowardice, she, an independent woman with a well-drained character, forms an explosive duo where love is measured in existential crises and improvised reconciliations. Between the walls of their housing – a battlefield of battle and tenderness at the same time – is a human comedy where the daily hassles become mountains to climb... or to bypass with a pirouette. Chouchou and Loulou, it's the story of two egos who fight, seek and find each other, tirelessly. He dreams of greatness but drowns in details (how to fold a road map without tearing it apart?), she manages their lives with a pragmatism that friezes despotism (the socks that drag are a crime against humanity). Between forgotten races, romantic dinners that turn to the rules of accounts, and friends who always arrive at the wrong time, their relationship is a constant balance between the desire to break everything and the desire to repair everything with a hug. Yet behind the arguments for a poorly closed pot lid or a lost remote control, there is an unwavering complicity. Whether it is in the face of the intrusive mother-in-law, the insufferable office colleagues, or the temptations of infidelity that point their noses, Chouchou and Loulou navigate between nerve attacks and crazy laughs, proving that love is also a laugh of his own faults. For in the background, despite the low blows and the unsaid, one question persists: how can we stay together when we are both the best and the worst that can happen to each other?

programme.title: The Gentlemen
programme.desc: Supported by his beloved wife and his right arm, a drug baron wants to sell his belongings, coveted by three unscrupulous gangsters.
programme.desc-more: In the complex world of London crime, Mickey Pearson (Matthew McConaughey), a respected gangster, finds himself in the heart of a dangerous imbroglio after being shot in his favourite bar by a mysterious shooter. Prior to this tragedy, Fletcher (Hugh Grant), a private detective with unorthodox methods, was hired by Big Dave, a newspaper director with questionable intentions, to extort a colossal sum from Mickey's band. By infiltrating Mickey's circle, Fletcher visits Ray (Charlie Hunnam), one of Mickey's accomplices, in order to offer him a deal: he holds compromising information about the gang's criminal activities and is ready to exchange it for twenty million pounds. This game of power and manipulation leads to a treason, rivalry and revenge in a world where loyalty is put to the test and where every movement can have fatal consequences.

programme.title: The Christmas parade
programme.desc: Charlotte, a single mother who is busy between her work and her son's education, Benny, a ten-year-old boy as dreaming as she is determined, tries to make ends meet. Since her husband's disappearance, the end-of-year celebrations have lost their shine, and Christmas is more than a succession of mechanical gestures, without this spark that once made the eyes of the inhabitants shine. Everything changes when Benny discovers, in an old dusty grimoire found in the attic, the existence of a forgotten tradition: the Christmas train, an enchanted railway parade that, decades earlier, brought together the families of Pine Ridge and neighbouring villages. The ancient accounts describe a luminous procession, where the decorated cars ran to the sound of the songs, distributing gifts and spreading joy throughout the county. Fascinated, Benny persuades her mother to revive this magic that disappeared. Despite her reluctance – and a budget more than limited – Charlotte is convinced, touched by her son's enthusiasm and hope to reconnect with the spirit of the holidays. To carry out this ambitious project, they turn to Benny's professor Zack, a charismatic and mysterious man who seems to share their passion for the d Under his leadership, the project takes shape: the inhabitants are mobilizing, the scenery is coming out of the boxes, and the old train, abandoned for years, is being rehabilitated. Charlotte, who begins to fall under Zack's charm, sees him as an unexpected ally, perhaps even a chance to rebuild his sentimental life. But as the preparations are in full swing, she discovers that Zack is hiding a secret.

In 2004, in Marseilles, Jean-Baptiste Rambla killed his boss, Corinne Beidl, and after ten years in prison, he murdered Cintia Lunimbu in Toulouse.
programme.desc-more: Laurent Baca was killed on the night of August 5-6, 2014 by a 22-long ball in the temple, then his body was cast into concrete. His companion Edith Scaravetti maintained for four months that she had been out of touch since he had gone to Spain to deliver drugs. Finally, on 20 November 2014, she confessed the death of Laurent Baca, because this hypothesis of a "go fast" did not stand up to the surprise of the victim's family and following the investigations of the investigators.

programme.desc-more: On February 27, 2012, Philippe Gletty, a business manager based near Saint-Étienne, mysteriously disappeared. programme.title: A guy, a girl
programme.desc: In a Parisian apartment where the disputes are as fast as the bursts of laughter, vibrate a thirty-year-old couple as fond as it is exasperating: Jean (Jean Dujardin), nicknamed Loulou by the one who shares her daily life, and Alexandra (Alexandra Lamy), affectionately called Chouchou. He, a seducer clumsy with the great principles but with the little cowardice, she, an independent woman with a well-drained character, forms an explosive duo where love is measured in existential crises and improvised reconciliations. Between the walls of their housing – a battlefield of battle and tenderness at the same time – is a human comedy where the daily hassles become mountains to climb... or to bypass with a pirouette. Chouchou and Loulou, it's the story of two egos who fight, seek and find each other, tirelessly. He dreams of greatness but drowns in details (how to fold a road map without tearing it apart?), she manages their lives with a pragmatism that friezes despotism (the socks that drag are a crime against humanity). Between forgotten races, romantic dinners that turn to the settlement of accounts, and friends who always arrive at the wrong time, their relationship is a constant balance between the desire to break everything and the desire to repair everything with a hug.However, behind the arguments for a poorly closed pot lid or a lost remote control, is a constant complicity. Whether it is in the face of the intrusive mother-in-law, the insufferable office colleagues, or the temptations of infidelity that point their noses, Chouchou and Loulou navigate between nerve attacks and crazy laughs, proving that love is also a laugh of his own faults. For in the background, despite the low blows and the unsaid, one question persists: how can we stay together when we are both the best and the worst that can happen to each other?

programme.title: Home for Christmas
programme.desc: Sarah Moreau (Virginie Efira) is a brilliant and meticulous lawyer whose minute is planned with the precision of a Swiss watchmaking mechanism. Between urgent cases, endless meetings and serial calls, Sarah mastered the art of controlling everything... Except for his personal life. A dedicated single mother, she tries to reconcile her demanding career with her parenting role, while navigating between tensions with her companion, Thomas, a patient but breathless man in the face of her repeated absences.

programme.title: A candlelit Christmas
programme.desc: As the end of the year approaches, Juliet, an ambitious wellness expert, finally sees the opportunity to make her talent recognized. His idea? Launch an exclusive range of Christmas souvenir candles, olfactory creations supposed to capture the magic of festive moments and move the most hardened hearts. For her, this project is not only a question of creativity, but a chance to get the much-awaited promotion in her company. Yet his enthusiasm is quickly met with a major obstacle: Tom, the owner of a small craft candle shop, as talented as he is skeptical. He believes that the welfare industry is just an illusion machine, and he categorically refuses to collaborate on what he considers to be a marketing operation that is devoid of sincerity. But Tom is hiding a secret that could make things go wrong. Behind his apparent coldness is a father ready to do anything to fulfill his daughter's Christmas vow. When he realizes that the income generated by this project could offer him this opportunity, he reluctantly accepts to associate with Juliet.

programme.title: Futuroscope: the techno of attractions
programme.desc: Futuroscope is the fourth most visited amusement park in France. When it opened in 1987 in Vienna, the Futuroscope was a "observatorium of the future". With its 25 avant-garde buildings, it offers image-based attractions, which succeed in transmitting scientific concepts in an educational and playful way. In recent years, Futuroscope has taken a new turn, investing 300 million euros to create new attractions including an aquatic park that will open in early July 2024. How do park teams manage to create spectacular innovations to attract more and more visitors?

programme.title: Puy du Fou: the genius of the shows revealed
programme.desc: The Puy du Fou has been able to conquer the hearts in 45 years thanks in part to the engineering treasures deployed to ensure the reliability and robustness of the attractions.

programme.title: Puy du Fou: the 10 most innovative technos in the park
programme.desc: The Puy du Fou attracts an ever-increasing audience every year. While visitors come for historical stories and epic frescoes, the park's success is also based on a particularly elaborate technical mechanics. Behind the stage, teams of engineers and technicians design complex devices, designed to make illusion possible. Each element must combine safety, reliability and fluidity, while remaining invisible to the public. With images shot behind the scenes, in the basement and in the technical corridors, complemented by 3D models, this unpublished documentary reveals, for the first time, the ten most innovative technologies in the park.

programme.title: A guy, a girl

The division of household chores and negotiations for the next family meal in the mother-in-law can generate incredible tensions. Love life is far from being a long, quiet river.

programme.title: F1 : The film
programme.desc: In the ruthless world of Formula 1, where every second counts and dreams break as fast as they are born, Sonny Hayes (Brad Pitt) is a name that still resonates as an unfinished legend. Formerly a prodigious pilot, addicted for his audacity and mastery of the most demanding circuits, he saw his career shrunk after an accident that left him on the side of the road – literally. From now on, he wanders across the United States in a defracated caravan, participating in clandestine races and local competitions where his talent, although still intact, is worth nothing but pacolette trophies. Until the day when, during the 24 Hours of Daytona, he reminded the world of what he was still capable of. This performance does not go unnoticed. Ruben Cervantes (Javier Bardem), his former teammate in F1, now head of the Apex Grand Prix team, contacted him with an unexpected and tempting offer. Apex, once glorious, is now on the brink of the abyss: in debt, undermined by bad results, and about to be bought by unscrupulous investors. Ruben, desperate, sees Sonny the spark able to give hope back to his team. He suggested that he join the team as a second driver, alongside Joshua Pearce (Damson Idris), the young British hope of the F1, as talented as he was, considered the future star of sport. Sonny accepts, determined to prove that he still has a place among the elite. But the shock of generations and egos is immediate. Joshua, who is used to dominating without division, sees with a bad eye the arrival of this veteran who threatens his status as leader. Between the two men, tensions exploded from the first attempts: opposite strategies, disdain and pure rivalry transform each session into a personal duel. Meanwhile, the Apex stable, plagued by financial problems, internal treason and overwhelming media pressure, struggles to survive.

Death on beaten ground
programme.desc: A young champion was found dead in a tennis tournament. A passionate captain investigates and discovers the secrets of the technical director.
programme.desc-more: As the spotlights light up on the prestigious International de tennis feminin de Paris, the effervescence of qualifications turns into a drama. In the early morning, as the players were about to tread the court in the mud, Vincent Beti (Yannick Noah), the technical director of the tournament, discovered Manon Picard's inanimate body, the young French prodigy whose brilliant career made it one of the public's favourites. His assassination plunges the event into chaos and reveals the ruthless behind the scenes of an environment where sporting rivalries and disproportionate ambitions mix with the shadows of a troubled past. In charge of the investigation, Captain Romain Fabiot (Florent Peyre), a seasoned and passionate tennis cop, finds himself confronted with a puzzle as complex as the strategies of a five-set match. With Camille Lauristan (Roxanne Roux), a young lieutenant determined to prove that she is worth more than her family heritage, he must unravel the sons of a case where every suspect – players, coaches, organizers – seems to hide something. Among them, Vincent Beti, whose silences and contradictions fuel Roman suspicions. If the hypothesis of a murder linked to competition is first imposed – tensions between competitors, jealousies, media pressure – the captain quickly press that the truth is much deeper. Who really wanted Manon dead? A sports rival? A close betrayer? Or someone whose motives date back to a long time before this damn tournament? To break the mystery, Romain will have to dive into the shadows of professional tennis, where glamour looks conceal much darker stakes.

programme.title: OPJ
programme.desc: The body of a woman who has been abused is discovered on a beach. However, it is revealed that she drowned in a pool before being thrown into the sea after her death. programme.desc-more: In the picturesque landscapes of New Caledonia, the OPJ series follows Clarissa Hoarau (Yaëlle Trulès), a policeman from La Réunion, who recently arrived on this paradise island. A widow and mother of two, Clarissa has to juggle her professional responsibilities with her family life, while adapting to her new environment. At the head of a local brigade, she confronts daily criminal cases as complex as they are diverse. Whether it's investigating murders, robberies or local litigation, each episode plunges Clarissa and her team into the sometimes troubled world of crime, while highlighting the cultural peculiarities of the region. The contrast between Nouméa's idyllic framework and the brutal realities of the business she deals with highlights the daily challenges she faces.

Jamy's World
programme.sub-title: Health, transport, climate: animals have the solution!
programme.desc: Habitat, transport, lighting: in the era of global warming and energy saving, animals often have the solution. Close-up.
programme.desc-more: In the current era of fighting global warming, creatures of the animal kingdom often prove to be masters of adaptation and innovation. In the face of the most hostile environments, they have developed ingenious solutions for their survival. We designed our GPS navigation systems through the movement of ants, while studying bird flight patterns contributed to the creation of cleaner aircraft. Jamy meets those who draw inspiration from nature to meet contemporary challenges.

programme.title: Jamy's World
programme.sub-title: Climate warming: will our local products resist?
programme.desc: Apricots du Roussillon, Tomme de Savoie, Burgundy wines: how does global warming affect local products? Jamy Gourmaud is investigating.
programme.desc-more: Jamy explores the challenges and opportunities created by the changing climate on local products. He visits regions such as Roussillon, where apricots could be replaced by grenades, and Burgundy, where wine is experiencing changes of taste due to an increase in sugar in grapes. In Savoie, cheese production is threatened by a lack of grass. Jamy meets scientists who develop heat resistant varieties. Farmers adapt by cultivating new products such as pistachios in Provence.

programme.title: Die to love
programme.desc: In May 68, a 17-year-old high school student took a turn at her teacher, a French teacher, a thirty-year-old protestor: their love caused a scandal.
programme.desc-more: In the tumultuous context of May 1968, Danièle Guénot (Annie Girardot), a recently divorced thirty-year-old mother of two, began a new life as a teacher of letters in a high school in Rouen. His modern and committed teaching method contrasts strongly with that of his colleagues, which arouses admiration but also mistrust. In this atmosphere of revolt and desire for freedom, one of his students, Gérard Leguen (Bruno Pradal), aged 17, develops deep feelings for her. Despite his initial reluctance, Danièle gradually gave way to this unexpected love, shared between passion and guilt. However, their relationship soon attracted attention, and Gérard's parents, desperate to see their son move away, decided to intervene. They try to separate the two lovers by all means, going so far as to file a complaint against Danièle for misappropriation of minors. This explosive situation highlights intergenerational tensions and raises questions about freedom, love and morality. In a changing world, Danièle finds herself facing heartbreaking choices that could upset her life and Gérard's. This poignant drama explores the limits of love and the consequences of the choices we make, while portraying a striking portrait of an era in full swing. programme.desc: Adamsberg seeks to understand the psychosis that has taken hold of some inhabitants, convinced that killer spiders are raging in the area.
programme.desc-more: Commissioner Adamsberg (Jean-Hugues Anglade) went to the Camargue, where he was confronted with a disturbing investigation that plunged him into a world of uncertainty. Lost in his reflections, he feels that he escapes something essential. The question that haunts him is that of reclusion: is it a woman, a beast, or a combination of both? As he went through his investigations, he discovered that Irene, a key figure in his investigation, shared her living space with Louise (Sylvie Testud), a woman marked by a deep fear of spiders and men. Intrigued, Adamsberg asked his lieutenant Froissy (Thierry Hancisse) to investigate Louise and meet her. In doing so, Froissy is digging up a terrible secret that unites Irene and Louise, revealing complex and obscure bonds that could well change the course of the investigation and highlight hidden truths.

programme.desc: In 1931, in Cambodia colonized by France, Madame Dufresne, widow of a French colonial official, invested all her savings in the purchase of a property in Indochina, on the edge of the Gulf of Siam. With the help of her children, 20-year-old Joseph and 16-year-old Suzanne, as well as local farmers, she tried to build a dam against the Pacific. She hopes to fulfill her dream of growing rice and keeping her children with her. When the shy and idle son of a rich Chinese-Cambodian heir, "Monsieur Jo", falls under the charm of Suzanne, she sees it as an opportunity to carry out her project.
